[party.randComp brint kiyoko |布林特哼了一声，断然说道：“把那个女孩交给我们吧。相信我，这样总比以后在地上捡你们的牙齿要好得多。” 那个被腐蚀了的狼人皱起了鼻子，愤怒地嘟囔着。经过片刻的思考，他终于吐出了这句话：“好吧！ 把你的猫带走……我们不再需要它了。” 狼人转身就走，同时示意他的同伴们跟上。等那些野人全都消失在视线之外后，你帮助凯特站了起来，然后将猫女的东西还给了她。 当她重新穿上衣服后，转身对你说：“那么……我表现得怎么样？” 你揉了揉凯特的头发，告诉她，她确实是个很好的“干扰因素”。 “哈哈，真有趣。 不过说真的，我还是很高兴的。 [pc.isVirgin |那些人选择的是我，而不是你。一个人的第一次经历，应该和某个特别的人一起分享。 |确保没有人受伤 ]那么，我们现在准备继续前进了吗？如果那些人改变主意决定回来，我可不想继续留在这里等着他们。 [cait.isLover |用你的拇指轻轻擦拭凯特的脸颊，将她脸上残留的污垢全部清除干净。 |指着她的脸颊，告诉她有地方没涂到。 “什么？哦，谢谢！”凯特擦掉脸上的灰尘，然后向你竖起了大拇指。 ]现在你可以开始行动了。 |清子做了一些手势，不一会儿，那些狼族就开始流口水，四处嗅来嗅去。 虽然你可能不知道她的这个把戏制造出了什么样的幻觉气味，但你可以看出，这种气味确实足以吸引那些狼族的注意，并把他们的注意力引到别的地方去。 你毫不迟疑地冲了过去，抱起凯特和她的所有物品，然后迅速离开了。那些被腐蚀的狼族一旦发现自己被骗了，肯定会暴跳如雷，但那也已经无关紧要了——等到他们赶回来的时候，你和你的团队早就已经消失得无影无踪了。 |恰在这时，凯特发出一声呻吟，坐了起来，开始翻找她的包。经过几秒钟的搜寻，她终于找出了那个东西。 [silly |绿色的网球 |半熟肉包子 ]所有的野人顿时僵在了原地。慢慢地，他们全都伸长了脖子，朝着那个方向望去…… [cait.isLeothran |柔软的、蓬松的 |粉色 ] 小猫们全神贯注地注视着她，因为她拥有它们所渴望的东西。[silly |快去拿！”凯特喊道。 |你们几个饿了吗？”凯特在开口之前问道。 ] 扭动手臂，然后将它甩出去…… [silly |球 |冷饭凉菜 ] 全力冲刺。 他们齐声开始用四肢奔跑，追了上去。 [silly |热门游戏 |美味的小吃 ] 大家都希望能成为第一个得到它的人。当那些被污染的狼族已经离开了一段距离后，凯特清了清嗓子，然后拿起了自己的东西。你走上前去，伸出了手，凯特接受了你的帮助，站了起来。然而，你们还没有完全安全：在那些狼群回来之前，整个小组都必须尽快离开这里。 “不用再说第二次了，”凯特回答道。 大家都是这么想的。 [party.manyCompanions |三 |两个 ] 你们最好赶紧离开那里。远处，你能听到木头断裂的声音，以及那些凶猛野人的喧闹声。不过，鉴于你们已经跑出了那么远的距离，他们应该短时间内找不到你们。 [pc.bg hunter barbarian slumrat |话虽如此，采取额外的预防措施总没有坏处。利用你所掌握的知识，隐藏自己的行踪、掩盖自己的气味，这样你的小队就不会被追踪到。 ] ] ]
rows.raw: " You leave your cover and step out into the open with your [pc.weapon][p |s ] at the ready. The rowdy dogs have had their fun, but it's high time they ran. They're free to fight you on this, but one way or another, the kitty's coming with you. This is not negotiable. The [rand |black-furred |red, earthen-colored |graying ] lupine steps forth with a sluggish gait while the other two defensively stand their ground. The one in front then stops, chuckles, and says, "You're in no position to talk, little [pc.raceCute]. If you start running, we might let you leave." [var0 |"Are those your final words, mongrel?" Azyrran replies, putting her frightful, draconic presence to full use as she stands by your side. "Crawl back into whatever hole you came out of and rethink your epitaph." For a brief moment, you feel an unbidden sensation of awe and sinking dread pass over you, and then it's gone. The beastmen, however, aren't so lucky. You watch them cow in silence before your companion's overwhelming aura. One by one, they turn tail and run, sprinting as hard as their rattled forms can take them. You're not sure whether you should be impressed or concerned. Regardless, it got the job done. |You give them a wry grin and snicker. Do they really think they can win again? Look at them, they can barely even stand! The beast gnashes his teeth and snarls, but you show no fear. However, this doesn't mean you should let your guard down around them; as the saying goes, back a dog into a corner, and it's going to bite. Unfortunately, if you do nothing, they'll just regain their stamina and make the first move against you. You could just skip the foreplay and start fighting them. But, considering how your last battle with them panned out, you'd rather not risk having a repeat of events. By and large, this is a troublesome situation which you've found yourself in. The most obvious solution is perhaps not the best course of action. [var1 |Sure, you could use some of your trail rations as a momentary distraction, but that means you'd be throwing away essential supplies |If you had some food, you could use that to momentarily distract them ]. [party.randComp brint kiyoko |Brint snorts and flatly says, "Just give us the girl. Trust me, it's better than having to pick your teeth up off the ground." The corrupted lupine wrinkles his nose and grumbles angrily. After a moment of deliberation, he spits out, "Fine! Take your cat... we're done with her." The wolfman turns on a heel and heads walks away, gesturing for his group to follow. Once the beastmen are out of sight, you help Cait up before giving the catgirl her stuff back. As she puts her clothes back on, she turns to you and says, "So... how'd I do?" You tousle Cait's hair and tell her that she's a good distraction. "Har har, real funny. But for real, though, I'm glad [pc.isVirgin |those guys went for me and not you. A person's first time should be with someone special |to see no one got hurt ]. Now, are we ready to keep going? I don't wanna stick around if those guys decide to change their mind and come back." Almost. You [cait.isLover |wipe Cait's cheek with your thumb, cleaning the last of the dirt from her face. |point at her cheek and tell her that she missed a spot "What? Oh, thanks!" Cait wipes the dirt off her face and gives you a thumbs up. ]Now you're good to go. |Kiyoko performs a few gestures. Before long, she's got the wolfmen salivating and sniffing the air. While you may not know what kind of illusory aroma her trick created, you can see that it's enough to get the men's attention and draw them elsewhere. Wasting no time, you dash over, grab both Cait and her possessions, and dash off. The corrupted lupines are going to be livid when they find out that they've been tricked, but it's not going to matter. By the time they get back, you and your group will be long gone. |As if on cue, Cait groans, sits up, and digs through her bags. After a few seconds of sifting, she pulls out a [silly |green tennis ball |partially-eaten meat bun ], and all of the beastmen freeze in-place. Slowly, they all crane their necks toward the [cait.isLeothran |fluffy |pink ] kitty, giving her their full, undivided attention. She's got something they want. "[silly |Fetch!" Cait shouts, |You boys hungry?" Cait asks before ] winding an arm back and fling the [silly |ball |lukewarm meal ] at full force. In unison, they break out into a quadrupedal sprint, rushing after the [silly |green toy |hearty snack ] with the hopes of being the first to get it. Once the corrupted lupines are a fair distance away, Cait rubs her throat and grabs her stuff. Walking over, you proffer a hand, and Cait accepts it, pulling herself up. However, you're not in the clear yet: the group has to skedaddle before the pack comes back. "Don't have to tell me twice," Cait replies. The [party.manyCompanions |three |two ] of you hightail it out of there. In the distance, you hear the sound of wood snapping and the noise of furious beastmen. However, with how much ground you made, it's unlikely that they're going to find you any time soon. [pc.bg hunter barbarian slumrat |That said, it doesn't hurt to take extra precautions. Using what you know, you cover your tracks and mask your scent so your group cannot be followed. ] ] ] "

rows.original: [pc.dcb |Treated like some kind of fucking trophy, |Processing the sobering realization of your fate, which settles a pit in your stomach, |Enjoying the bouncy ride with your new fluffy buddy, ] you're unceremoniously hauled deeper into the woods, past verdant underbrush and steep hill.[flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT | | Where's he taking you? ] Accompanied by silence and the passing rays of [dayNight |sunlight |pale moonlight ] from the canopy above, [silly |you decide to pass the time by making small talk with your captor while it's just you and him. [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT |You smuggly beam towards your captor as you remark upon the promise of seeing him again. Genuinely speaking — you're pleased to see that he's alright. This elicits a sheepish chuckle from Bigby. "I guess you did." Despite the fur on his face, you can tell he's blushing. That still leaves one question on your mind. How'd he escape? "I.. uh. I didn't," he awkwardly admits. "When I was trapped on the other side, I mostly sat and waited until my pals broke through the rocks and cleared the way." Mostly? Detecting the use of certain vocabulary, you probe further. Surely he didn't just sit down patiently with his legs crossed and twiddled his thumbs, right? With a sharp claw, he scratches the bottom of his muzzle. "Errr... yeah. Pretty much. When I wasn't moving rocks on my end, I was either doing that or beating my meat to pass the time." Not the response you were expecting, but you titter nonetheless. Talk about transparency! Guess it can't be helped, you understand from firsthand experience the extent of how terribly this corrupt affliction affects their lupine libido. |First thing's first, you ask him his name. He must surely have a name, right? The silence is deafening. When the wolf man responds, he does so muttering faintly under his breath. You didn't catch that, so you goad him into repeating himself. Snarling, your interlocutor stops and then sighs. "Bigby... it's Bigby." You can feel the defeat in his voice. Bigby... Big B... like Big Bad Wolf?! A little on the nose, isn't it? A little playful teasing couldn't hurt as you desperately hold back a wry chuckle. He trudges a response with the weight of his mordant shame, "Yeah... I know." ] |you're left to your silent ruminations. There's not much else you can do otherwise. ] Transitioning from lush forest to rocky terrain — as evident with the thinning density of trees and his long strides lulling into a meandering pace — you [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT |know |can only assume ] you're approaching the destination. Messy stacks of iron tools, such as shovels and pickaxes, lie in littered piles throughout the general vicinity. Passing the threshold of rocky menhirs erected in a half circle formation before a rocky cliff face, you're carried into the open maw of the cave's entrance. Torches in iron brackets line the narrow walls which illuminates a bending passageway and the fifteen foot high canopy of solid bedrock that makes up the ceiling. At the edge of the dim light, provided by the burning torches, shadows move in the darkness.
rows.translation: [pc.dcb |被当作某种该死的奖杯一样对待…… |面对这一令人清醒且令人不寒而栗的命运现实，你的内心会感到一阵沉重的压抑。 |和你的新毛茸茸的小伙伴一起享受这段充满乐趣的旅程吧！ ] 你被毫不客气地拖进了树林深处，穿过茂密的灌木丛和陡峭的山坡。[flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT | | 他要带你去哪里？ ] 在寂静与掠过的轻型线中…… [dayNight |阳光 |淡淡的月光 ] 从上方的树冠中， [silly |当你只有自己和你的俘虏在一起时，你决定通过和他对闲聊来打发时间。 [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT |你偷偷地向抓住你的那个人发送信号，同时感慨着能再次见到他的喜悦。说实话，看到他安然无恙，你真的很高兴。 这引来了比格比尴尬的笑声：“我想，你确实是这么想的吧。尽管他脸上长满了毛发，但你能看出他正在脸红。这就留下了一个问题：他究竟是怎么逃出来的？ “我……呃，其实我没有逃出来，”他尴尬地承认道，“当我被困在另一边时，我大部分时间都是坐着等待，直到我的朋友们打通岩石、开辟出一条通路。主要是？通过观察对方是否使用了某些特定的词汇，你进一步展开了调查。他总不可能只是盘腿坐着，无所事事地玩弄拇指吧？ 他用锋利的爪子抓了抓自己的嘴部下方。 呃……差不多吧。当我没有在搬石头的时候，要么就是在做那个，要么就是在自慰来打发时间。” 虽然这个回答并不是你预期的，但你还是忍不住笑了。这才是所谓的“坦诚”啊！ 我想这也是没办法的事吧，通过亲身体验，你应该已经了解到这种腐败现象究竟会严重到什么程度，它会彻底破坏他们的性欲。 |首先，你得问他叫什么名字。他总该有个名字吧？ 沉默令人窒息。当那个狼人终于开口时，他只是低声嘟囔了几句。你没听清，于是便催促他再重复一遍。 那个狼人咆哮着停了下来，然后叹了口气：“比格比……就是比格比。”你终于听清了。 感受到 他声音里透着沮丧。 “比格比……大比格……就像大坏狼一样？！有点太明显了吧？在你强忍着想要发笑的冲动时，这样稍微调侃一下也没坏处吧。” 他带着深深的羞愧感艰难地回答道：“是啊……我知道。 ] |你只能独自沉浸在沉思之中，除此之外，也没有什么其他办法了。 ] 从茂密的森林过渡到多岩石的地形——从树木逐渐稀疏以及他那原本快步行走的节奏变得缓慢而蜿蜒这一点就可以看出来——你…… [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT |知道 |只能认为是这样。 ] 你即将到达目的地。 在周围的地面上，堆放着铲子、镐头等铁制工具，杂乱无章。当你穿过那些呈半圆形排列的石柱，穿过那面岩石峭壁之前，你便被带入洞穴入口的宽阔空间之中。 铁制支架中的火把排列在狭窄的墙壁两侧，为蜿蜒的通道以及由坚硬岩层构成的十五英尺高的天花板提供了照明。在那些火把散发出的微弱轻型亮中，阴影在黑暗中悄然移动。

|在洞穴昏暗的轻型线中，阿图吉娅的符文无疑显得格外醒目——它们散发着微弱的轻型芒，将她笼罩在一片蓝色的轻型辉之中，就像暗影中那一支孤独的蜡烛。她没有丝毫畏惧，依然坚定不移地寻找着你。当她的目轻型落在你身上时，你那位红头发的同伴却对她置之不理。 [atugia.weapon] 她大步走向你， “哦，天啊，他们对你做了什么？坚持住！” 阿图吉娅双手部合十，低声念着古老的咒语，她的符文开始发轻型，渐渐形成一缕柔和的轻型芒。当她张开双手部时，那缕淡蓝色的轻型芒向你飞来，将它的治愈能量注入你的体内。 |[party.isJustPC |那位身着白色与红色祭司长袍的善良神父缓缓走了出来。他的法杖末端镶嵌着粗糙的木头，而从那里散发出来的光芒，使得一个明亮的绿色光球悬浮在半空中。 “啊， 为了合理地尝试抓住你。 ] 在由坚硬岩层构成的暗影走廊中，你紧随救援者的足部步前行，直到前方出现阳轻型。你拼命冲向出口，穿过最后的门槛，顿时被刺目的轻型芒所包围。仰望天空，再次感受到它的温暖，这种感觉真是太好了。深吸一口气后，你继续沿着边缘向下走去。 尽情享受这份新获得的自由，你开始踏上这段蜿蜒曲折的归途，直到找到自己之前掉落物品的地方。 [pc.weapon] 继续你快乐的生活吧。 你已经成功逃脱了…… [silly |可怕的 结穴 |狼穴 ].

As if to confirm your suspicions, [party.som |an intense green light grows in size which gradually grows in scale as it approaches closer until it floods the chamber in its absolute incandescent radiance. Someone has come to your aid! |[companion1.name] has come to your aid! Deep in unknown territory, [companion1.heShe] defensively creeps forth into the open chamber with their [companion1.weapon] at the ready. |[companion1.name] and [companion2.name] have come to your aid! Deep in unknown territory, they defensively creep forth into the open chamber with their weapons at the ready. ] After a brief investigation, it is enough to confirm the safety of the immediate area. [party.randComp cait berwyn etheryn atugia |Clutching her [cait.weapon] close to herself, your bubblegum cat girl runs up, gets on her knees, and draws you into her embrace. Unfazed by the copious amount of cum which coats you, she tightly hugs you regardless. "Thank Mallach you're okay! Let's get you out of here, but first..." Pulling herself away from the hug, she runs her svelte fingers down to retrieve the book by her waist. Flipping open the codex, Cait mutters a soothing prayer. Coalescing the passionate energies of her devotion and faith, your pink priestess finalizes her chant and runs her middle finger down your breastbone. It feels like an anvil has just been lifted off your chest as a wave of healing magic washes over and to suffuse into you. |Scouring the area with analytical scrutiny, your resident half-breed mage hums to [berwyn.himHer]self and wraps [berwyn.hisHer] white lupine fingers around [berwyn.hisHer] [berwyn.weapon] once [berwyn.heShe] spots you. "Damn. They sure did a number on you, didn't they? Don't worry, I doubt most of them will be back for some time." To be honest, you're glad to see [berwyn.name]'s effeminate face right now. For [berwyn.himHer] to accomplish such a feat as tracking you down and delving deep into dangerous territory to rescue you, you're impressed! "Don't mention it," [berwyn.name] off-handedly replies as [berwyn.heShe] proffers the end of [berwyn.hisHer] [berwyn.weapon] for you to grab on to and use to heft yourself upright. "You're not getting rid of [party.manyCompanions |us |me ] that easily. Now hold still." Prying [berwyn.hisHer] [berwyn.weapon] free from your grasp, [berwyn.name] holds [berwyn.hisHer] spell focus aloft and swirls it above his head as [berwyn.heShe] utters an incantation. Channeling the coalescing magical energies to a single point, [berwyn.heShe] unleashes a wave of healing magic through the air and to providing succor to all around [berwyn.himHer]. |[etheryn.highLibido |A deepening pink hue flushes on Etheryn's cheeks, beneath her beautifully blue eyes; furthermore, her knees buckle and shake like leaves on the wind beneath her. Evident by her appearance — the potent, cloying musk which hangs in the air like a noxious cloud polluting these walls is taking its toll on her. Landing on her arm, Harrick taps his beak at her. Ultimately grounding her back from her unfocused haze. |Stepping into the chamber with Harrick in tow, the miasma of musk beleaguer her senses. Visibly scrunching up her face, she places a hand over her nose and mouth. ] Gathering her bearings, your waifish elf companion [etheryn.lnhConfidence |blanches and her dark blue eyes widen when she spots you. They are drenched in recoiling dread. It takes the goading from Harrick to break her from the petrification. |nearly cries out your name when she spots the state you're in, stopping herself short out of fear of ruining the rescue mission before it has even begun. |furrows her brow and resolves herself when she spots you. ] Etheryn dashes to your side with the utmost alacrity[etheryn.highConfidence | and throws herself on top of you, wrapping her dainty arms around your waist. |. ] [etheryn.lnhConfidence |Falling to her knees and clutching her wrists to her chest, Etheryn's eyes welled with tears. "It's...it's all my fault, [pc.name]. My best... It wasn't enough. I'm..." Wrapping her arms around herself, a deafening silence hung in the air as she bit her lip and struggled to relax her tensed muscles. Wiping her wrists against her eyes and shaking her head, she presses |Inspecting you over, Etheryn sighs in audible relief. Lowering her head, her words are a low murmur. "I was worried about you. When they captured you, I feared the worst. Harrick and I tried tracking them down. I'm sorry it took as long as it did." Yet, she's here right now is she not? She managed to track down your position and put herself in great danger by venturing into the heart of dangerous territory just to bring you back. Isn't that itself admirable? Relenting a half-hearted smile, she presses |"There you are! I was looking everywhere for you. I'm glad to see you're still okay." Using her wrists, she cleans off your face and sits back with a contented smile. ] Pressing a closed fist to her chest, Etheryn utters a soothing prayer to Lumia, bathing you in healing light. |Standing out, unquestionably so from within the wan gloom of the cave, Atugia's runes emit a faint glow which bathes her in blue radiance like a lone candle in the dark. "Oh gods, what did they do to you? Hang on!" Clasping her hands together, Atugia whispers an ancestral chant into them as her runes begin to glow until a flicker of soft light grows within. Taking in a lungful of air, you push on descending down the ledge. Relishing your newfound freedom, you embark on the wayward trek back until you find where you dropped your [pc.weapon] and continue along your merry way. You've escaped the [silly |dreaded Knot Cave |lupine den ]."

rows.original: Just when you have about given up hope of any rescue, you're met with a strange sight! Before you, a blue portal winks into existence and illuminates the chamber. It's almost blinding! Much to your surprise, a loaf of inedible bread lands at your feet. Soon after, a team of mercenaries steps through. A scrappy mercenary steps forward and squints his eyes as he looks around before slinging a metal club over his shoulder. "Hey Einstein, I think you put your teleporter in the wrong place!" A broad-shouldered man carrying a heavy weapon points in your direction. "No. Is proper place. Look." "Oh he-hey, it's [flags.CLUPINES_SILLY_ESCAPE |just the [pc.mfn |dude |broad |uh... person ] we were lookin' for, |another champ! ]" the scrappy mercenary remarks as he then wipes a thumb under his nose and grins. The broad-shouldered man reaches into his vest, pulls out a sandvich, and hands it to you. "Take this." He then turns towards the clean shaven Teutonic man carrying a large apparatus hooked up to him like a backpack. "Doctor?" [flags.CLUPINES_SILLY_ESCAPE |Overjoyed to see your rescuers again |Confused ], you graciously accept the meal given to you and allow the doctor to point his device at you. From its nozzle, a flowing blue mist streams and revitalizes your body. "Alright men..." a tough, well-armed man standing firm, with a tower of hats obscuring his face, before looking back at the portal, "where's the kangaroo?" "Our marksman friend will not be joining us on this mission," a masked man dressed sharply says as he adjusts his tie. "It'd seem that our administrative friends do not condone the improvised use of his jars. Now, if that is all gentlemen, let's get out of here before anyone knows we're here." A dark-skinned man with an eyepatch and a heavy accent smiles and responds, "Och aye. We'll be quiet as wee church mice, spy." "Yeah, I bet ya friggin will, ya cyclops," the mercenary retorts. Standing up to your feet, you trail behind the team as they lead the charge. Dashing down the twisting corridors, activity within the den begins to stir. The denizens are on high alert. Claws and the patter of footsteps running on wet rock echo throughout the cave. The way ahead is plunged in darkness. The mercenary in a full rubber suit steps forth, widening their stance, as they pull out a handheld device from their waist and fires a singular flare into the darkness. Bathing the corridor in a bright red glow, so too does it reveal the wall of corrupted lupines. They are closing in on your position! "Chaaaarge!" Wielding a shovel in one hand, the well-armed man with a tower of hats, runs up ahead. Fighting tooth and nail, claw and fang, the team of mercenaries push against the seemingly endless tide. With a pouncing leap, a snarling lupine man closes the distance with the broad-shouldered man and attempts to wrestle his weapon free. "NO TOUCHING SASHA!" Pulling his weapon free from the tainted strength of the lupine's grip, the man slams the full weight of his weapon against the daring beast and knocks them to the ground. Emerging from the shadows, a daunting silver-furred lupine wearing a top hat makes his presence known. Barking orders to the rest of the pack, he strides forward. Leveling his shovel at the enemy, the man with the spire of assorted hats barks back, "We got you outnumbered, Fido! Give me that hat if you don't want a good ol' can of American whoopass." THUNK A tubed charge is launched from the eyepatched man's weapon, but it sails wide as expected. As it makes contact with the cave wall, it explodes into a cloud of debris and fire. The cave rattles and shakes from the impact! "I think ya missed. It's called depth perception pal, look into it. Also are you trying to bring the whole cave down on top of us, knucklehead?!" the scrappy mercenary chides back while powering up a homerun and hitting a feral lupine with his aluminum bat. "BONK!" The explosion had a greater impact than anticipated, it must've taken out a support column. The walls tremble and quake as dust falls onto your head. Looking up, you watch as a giant chunk of the ceiling plummets in your direction. Your feet do not have time to move, this must be the end.
rows.translation: 就在你几乎放弃任何获救希望的时候，一个奇异的景象出现了！在你面前，一道蓝色的传送门突然出现，照亮了整个空间，光芒几乎刺得你睁不开眼睛！令你惊讶的是，一块根本无法食用的面包竟然落在了你的足部边。 不久之后，一队雇佣兵走了进来。 其中一名身材矮小、看起来相当精悍的雇佣兵走上前，眯着眼睛环顾四周，然后把一根金属棍甩到肩上，说道：“嘿，‘爱因斯坦’，我看你把传送器放错地方了吧！一个肩膀宽阔、手部持重武器的男子正指向你的方向。“不，这里不是合适的地方。看。” “哦，他、他，其实是…… [flags.CLUPINES_SILLY_ESCAPE |就是那个 [pc.mfn |伙计 |广泛 |呃……那个人 ] 我们一直在寻找的…… |又一位英雄！ ]那个魁梧的雇佣兵一边说着，一边用拇指擦了擦鼻子，然后露出了笑容。 这个肩膀宽大的男人从背心里掏出一个三明治，递给了你：“拿着吧。”接着他转向那个胡子刮得干干净净的日耳曼人，那个男人身上背着一个像背包一样的大型装置。“医生？ [flags.CLUPINES_SILLY_ESCAPE |再次见到你们的救援者，我感到无比欣喜。 |困惑 ]你优雅地接受了别人提供的食物，也让医生将他的设备对准了你。从设备的喷嘴中，一股蓝色的雾气流淌而出，为你的身体注入了新的活力。 “好了，各位……”一个身强力壮、武装精良的男子站在那里，一顶高高的帽子遮住了他的脸，他回头望向那个传送门，问道：“袋鼠在哪里？ 我们的神枪手部朋友不会参加这次行动了，”一个穿着考究、戴着面具的男子一边整理领带一边说道，“看来我们的上级并不赞成他随意使用那些特殊装置。好了，各位，如果没有什么其他事情，我们就赶紧离开这里，免得被人发现我们的存在。 一个皮肤黝黑、戴着眼罩、说话带有浓重口音的男子微笑着回答道：“哦，当然。我们会像教堂里的老鼠一样安静的，间谍。” “是啊，我敢打赌你们肯定会这么做的，那些独眼人。”雇佣兵反驳道。 你站起身来，跟在队伍后面继续前进。他们沿着蜿蜒的走廊急速前进，巢穴里的动静开始变得活跃起来，那些居住在那里的生物们都处于高度戒备状态。 爪子抓在湿滑岩石上的声音，以及足部步在岩石上奔跑的回声，在整个洞穴中回荡。前方的道路一片漆黑。那位穿着全套橡胶防护服的雇佣兵向前迈出一步，站稳了身子，然后从腰间掏出手部持设备，向暗影中发射了一枚信号弹。明亮的红光照亮了走廊，同时也暴露出了那些被腐蚀的狼族。他们正在向你的位置逼近！ 冲啊！”那个头戴无数帽子、武装精良的男子手部持铁铲，率先冲了上去。 雇佣兵们拼尽全力，用爪子撕咬，用牙齿攻击，试图抵挡那看似无穷无尽的敌军攻势。一个咆哮着的狼族形态的男子猛地跃起，迅速逼近那个肩膀宽大的男子，试图夺走他的武器。 别碰莎莎！”那个男人从那只狼犬强有力的抓握中夺回自己的武器，然后用武器的全部重量击中了那只大胆的野兽，将其击倒在地。 从阴影中走出来的是一只身披银色毛皮、令人望而生畏的狼犬…… 高顶礼帽 他立刻显露出自己的存在。对着队伍中的其他人发出命令，他大步向前走去。 那个头戴各种帽子的男人将铲子对准敌人，大声回应道：“我们的人数比你们多，Fido！如果你不想被一顿痛揍的话，就把那顶帽子交出来吧！ 砰的一声。 那个戴着眼罩的男子从武器中发射出一枚管状弹药，但正如预期的那样，它偏离了目标。当它撞击到洞穴墙壁时，瞬间爆炸，产生了大量碎片和火焰。洞穴因此而剧烈震动！ 我看你没搞明白吧。这叫‘深度感知’，伙计，去研究研究吧。还有，你是不是想把整个洞穴都压在我们头上啊，笨蛋？！”这个身手部敏捷的雇佣兵一边说着，一边挥动他的铝制球棒，击中了一只野狼。 轰！” 这次爆炸的影响比预想的要大得多，肯定有一根支撑柱被毁掉了。墙壁开始颤抖，灰尘纷纷落下，落在你的头上。你抬头望去，只见一块巨大的天花板碎片正朝你的方向坠落下来。 你的足部根本来不及移动，这一切肯定都是结局了。

Wielding a shovel in one hand, the well-armed man with a tower of hats, runs up ahead. Fighting tooth and nail, claw and fang, the team of mercenaries push against the seemingly endless tide. With a pouncing leap, a snarling lupine man closes the distance with the broad-shouldered man and attempts to wrestle his weapon free. "NO TOUCHING SASHA!" Pulling his weapon free from the tainted strength of the lupine's grip, the man slams the full weight of his weapon against the daring beast and knocks them to the ground. Emerging from the shadows, a daunting silver-furred lupine wearing a top hat makes his presence known. Barking orders to the rest of the pack, he strides forward. Leveling his shovel at the enemy, the man with the spire of assorted hats barks back, "We got you outnumbered, Fido! Give me that hat if you don't want a good ol' can of American whoopass." THUNK A tubed charge is launched from the eyepatched man's weapon, but it sails wide as expected. As it makes contact with the cave wall, it explodes into a cloud of debris and fire. The cave rattles and shakes from the impact! "I think ya missed. It's called depth perception pal, look into it. Also are you trying to bring the whole cave down on top of us, knucklehead?!" the scrappy mercenary chides back while powering up a homerun and hitting a feral lupine with his aluminum bat. "BONK!" The explosion had a greater impact than anticipated, it must've taken out a support column. The walls tremble and quake as dust falls onto your head. Looking up, you watch as a giant chunk of the ceiling plummets in your direction. Your feet do not have time to move, this must be the end.'

rows.original:
Before you could accept your fate, a muscular arm knocks you out of the way and onto the floor. What happened? Floating your gaze upwards, you see your would-be rescuer. It's Bigby!
        
        Bearing the prodigious density of rubble upon his shoulders, he painfully snarls behind clenched teeth as his muscles strain to their limit and knees buckle from beneath the weight.
        
        "Bigby!" you cry out. [flags.CLUPINES_SILLY_ESCAPE
            |
            |"You saved me... why?"
            
            [pc.ra fusata
                |"Mmm monke."
                |Breathing deeply, Bigby softens his expression. "I couldn't... bear the thought of losing you. Our time together was short, but it was the best time of my life. I just gotta tell you how I'm feeling. Gotta make you," he groans in pain. "understand."
            ]
        ]
        
        One foot at a time, you stagger back upright and embrace Bigby. Cradling his face, you lock eyes with him and wait to hear his words.
        
        "Never gonna give you up," Bigby admits.
        
        You sniffle, holding back tears, and tell him that you'll never let him down.
        
        Water wells up in his eyes as a gentle smile forms on his face and he replies, "never gonna run around and desert you."
        
        Using your thumb, you wipe away the tears from his eyes and tell him that you'll never make him cry.
        
        Scrunching up his face, he lowers his head and musters all the might he can to lift the debris. "This is where I say goodbye."
        
        He got the lyrics wrong.
        
        "I know." Bigby raises his head back to look towards you with newfound resolve. "Go, your duty calls you elsewhere. Perhaps, one day, we might meet again."
rows.translation:
就在你准备接受命运的安排时，一只强壮的手臂将你推到了一边，使你摔倒在地。发生了什么？你抬头望去，看到了你的救命恩人——是比格比！

他肩上扛着堆积如山的瓦砾，咬紧牙关，肌肉在极限状态下拼命挣扎，膝盖也在重压下开始颤抖。

“比格比！”你大声呼喊道。 [flags.CLUPINES_SILLY_ESCAPE
            |
            |你救了我……为什么？
            
            [pc.ra fusata
                |嗯，猴子。
                |深吸一口气，比格比放松了自己的表情。“我无法……忍受失去你的念头。我们在一起的时间虽然短暂，但那是我生命中最美好的时光。我必须告诉你我的感受，必须让你明白……”他痛苦地呻吟道。
            ]
        ]
        
        你一步一步地踉跄着后退，最终站直身体，抱住了比格比。你捧着他的脸，与他对视，等待着他说出那些话。

“我永远不会放弃你，”比格比承认道。

你抽泣着，强忍住泪水，告诉他你也不会让他失望。
        
        他的眼中噙满泪水，脸上却浮现出温柔的微笑，他回答道：“我永远不会离开你，也不会抛弃你。”

你用拇指轻轻拭去他眼中的泪水，告诉他，你绝不会让他再次哭泣。
        
        他皱起眉头，低下头，使出全部力气去搬动那些碎片。“就在这里，我要说再见了。”

他把歌词唱错了。

“我知道。”比格比重新抬起头，带着新的决心望着你。 去吧，你的职责召唤你前往别处。也许，有一天，我们还会再次相见。

rows.original:
Before you leave, you lock eyes with Bigby one last time. [pc.isDK
                |Standing your ground, you exclaim your defiance against fate. Nothing is going to prevent you from finding him again. You order him to over to you
                |You won't forget him.
            ] Without another word, you brush your palms along his muzzle and caress his furry face. Leaning in, you pull him into a gentle kiss. A light, passing kiss on his lips, but in that moment you can feel his passionate affection towards you. Slowly, you break from the kiss and take a step back. The taste of his earthen musk lingers on your lips as you pull away.

在你离开之前，你最后一次与比格比对视了一眼。 [pc.isDK
                |你坚定地站在原地，大声表达自己对命运的反抗。没有什么能够阻止你再次找到他。你命令他来到你身边。
                |你永远都不会忘记他。
            ] 你没有多说一句话，只是用手掌轻轻抚过他的嘴部，然后抚摸他那毛茸茸的脸颊。你凑近身体，轻轻地吻了他一下。那只是一个轻触嘴唇的吻，但在那一刻，你感受到了他对你充满热情的爱意。慢慢地，你拉开距离，退后了一步。当你离开时，他身上那泥土般的香气仍萦绕在你的唇边。

rows.original:
Before you leave, you tilt your gaze towards Bigby one last time. [pc.isDK
                |Standing your ground, you exclaim your defiance against fate. The two of you will see each other again.
                |Hopefully you'll get to see him again.
            ] Without another word, you bury your face into his firm shoulder. Pushing yourself against Bigby, you wrap your arms firmly around his waist in a tight embrace. Nuzzling against his fuzzy warmth, Bigby trembles beneath your touch. He can be quite the adorable puppy when he wants to be. Beneath the guise of the wolf, these kinds of glimpses into his humanity makes you wonder what kind of person he was before his corruption. Slowly, you break from the hug and take a step back as you are left with the lingering sensation of his warm touch.

rows.original: Shuffling beneath Bigby's arms, you slip beneath the rubble and emerge on the other side. Behind you, the rocks finally give out and collapse into a pile of untraversable rubble which blocks the corridor behind you. Left with no recourse, you turn your attention back towards the heated battle — watching events unfold as the balance of power shifts in your favor. "Yaaaaagh!" The many-hatted man slams the head of his shovel at the silver-furred lupine's face, which connects with a solid crack, and throws the carnal beast onto the ground. Bending down, he collects his reward. Adding the top hat to his own already prodigious spire of hats, he stands there proudly. "On your feet twinkletoes! That's an order!" Don't need to be told that twice! Springing to your feet, you rejoin with your rescuers as they take point in the perilous push against the unrelenting tide of feral fury bearing down upon them. There is only one way and that is forward. Defeat is not an option. No surrender. Continuing the arduous crawl, fending off scores of these savages in glorious combat, more of them just keep coming! For each corrupted lupine that is defeated, another member of their rank takes their place. How many of them are there?! This is a battle of attrition. It's only a matter seeing whose will breaks first. Despite the numerous points where you thought it was going to be touch and go, your company's unwavering mettle holds strong against the weight of the unending tide. As hopeful as your chances look, this isn't the time to get cocky. The battle is far from over. Thinning the horde, you persist in the unfaltering charge. At long last, after fending off scores of foes in glorious combat, you spot daylight up ahead — you're at the final stretch! Passing through the threshold, you are bathed in the sun's warmth once again on your [pc.skin]. Breathing in a sigh of relief, you look back to your rescuers covering your escape. "Another successful mission," the sharply-dressed man declares as he fetches a handheld kit from his suit pocket. With it in hand, he pops the case open, slides a cigarette out from one of the compartments, brings it to his lips, and lights it with a small flame before tucking the kit back into his suit pocket. Inhaling deeply, the gentleman walks over to you and breathes a plume of smoke out into the open air. Holding a cigarette in two fingers, he presents you with a set of equipment. Something is better than nothing, you suppose. Accepting the set of replacement gear from him, you are presented with a serendipitous discovery. This is everything that you had on your person before you got captured! Holding the neatly folded set of garments in your possession[pc.hasTopGarment |, you unmistakably spot your [pc.top][pc.hasBottomGarment | and [pc.bottom] within the pile ]. But wait, you distinctly remember them being shredded into ribbons just a few days ago! Making note of it, |[pc.hasBottomGarment |, you unmistakably spot your [pc.bottom] in the pile. But wait, you distinctly recall this being shredded into ribbons just a few days ago! Making note of it, ] ] you don your equipment and watch as the mercenaries hop into an open blue portal one by one before it ultimately winks shut behind them, leaving no trace of its or their existence. Relishing your newfound freedom, you embark on the wayward trek back until you find where you dropped your [pc.weapon] and continue along your merry way. You've escaped the [silly |dreaded Knot Cave |lupine den ].
rows.translation: 你从比格比的臂弯下钻过，穿过碎石堆，终于来到了另一边。在你身后，那些岩石终于坍塌下来，形成了一堆无法通过的碎石，堵住了你身后的通道。别无选择，你又将注意力转向那场激烈的战斗——看着局势逐渐向对你有利的方向发展。 呀啊啊啊！”那个戴着许多帽子的男人用铲子的头部猛击那只银毛狼的面部，顿时发出清脆的断裂声，那只野兽被击倒在地。他弯下腰，捡起了自己的战利品——将那顶高帽加到自己已经堆得高高的帽子堆上，然后骄傲地站了起来。“快站起来，快！这是命令！ 用不着再重复两次了！你立刻站起身来，与救援者们一起加入了这场艰苦的战斗。面对那股无情袭来的狂暴力量，他们只能向前冲。别无选择，只能勇往直前。 失败绝不是选项。绝不投降。继续这段艰苦的挣扎，在激烈的战斗中击退成群的这些野蛮人，但他们却源源不断地涌来！每有一只被击败的堕落狼族，它们的同类中就会有一只取而代之。 它们一共有多少呢？！这就是一场消耗战，关键在于看谁的意志先崩溃。 尽管在很多情况下你都认为局势会变得十分紧张，但你们公司坚定的意志力在面对这一连串的挑战时依然坚如磐石。虽然成功的机会看起来很大，但现在还不是骄傲自满的时候。 这场战斗远未结束。在不断削弱敌人的同时，你依然坚定不移地向前冲锋。终于，在经历了无数次激烈的战斗并击退了成群的敌人之后，你看到了前方的光明——你已经进入了最后阶段！穿过那道门槛，你再次沐浴在阳光的温暖之中…… [pc.skin]你松了一口气，回头看着那些帮助你逃脱的人。 “又完成了一次成功的任务，”那个穿着整洁的男子一边说，一边从西装口袋里拿出一套便携式工具。他打开工具包，从其中一个隔层里取出一支香烟，把它送到嘴边，用一个小火苗点燃了它，然后把工具包放回西装口袋里。 那位绅士深吸一口气，走到你面前，然后将一口烟雾吐向空气中。他用两根手指夹着香烟，向你展示了一套装备。 你心想，有总比没有好吧。 接过他递来的替换装备，你意外地发现了一件令你惊喜的东西——这些正是你被俘虏之前身上所携带的所有物品！将这套整齐折叠好的衣物握在手中，你不禁感到一阵欣慰。[pc.hasTopGarment |你立刻就认出了它。 [pc.top][pc.hasBottomGarment | 以及 [pc.bottom] 在那一堆东西中 ]但是等等，你明明记得就在几天前，它们还被撕成了碎片啊！把这个情况记下来吧。 |[pc.hasBottomGarment |你立刻就认出了它。 [pc.bottom] 还在那堆东西里呢。但是等等，你明明记得就在几天前，这些东西还被撕成了碎片啊！记下来吧。 ] ] 你穿戴好装备，看着那些雇佣兵一个接一个地跳进那道蓝色的传送门，然后那传送门最终在他们身后关闭，再也没有留下任何痕迹。 尽情享受这份新获得的自由，你开始踏上这段充满未知的归途，直到找到自己之前掉落物品的地方。 [pc.weapon] 继续你快乐的生活吧。 你已经逃脱了…… [silly |可怕的 结穴 |狼穴 ].

rows.original: That same feeling of being watched again, like pricks of a needle on the nape of your neck. There's an easy way to solve this. [pc.dcb |"Hey!" you say loudly, turning and pointing into the forest. "You'd better come out here. I know I'm good looking, but it's rude to stare." |"Hello?" you call into the forest, turning and looking around. "You can come out, if you like. It's safe, I won't hurt you." |"Heeeeyyy!" you call into the forest, turning and waving your arms. "Come on cutie! I saw your face last time, you're totally pretty and I wanna get to know you!" ] You stand there for a few seconds wondering when you should start feeling like an idiot for addressing an empty forest but at last, your worry is put to rest. That same face you saw earlier appears from behind a tree — and the rest of her follows in surprising fashion. You hadn't noticed this the last time but there are large, wooden-looking antlers sprouting from the top of her head, and just below that is a set of pointed ears. Two bright green eyes watch your reaction as the bare-breasted girl reveals herself, black hooves trotting uncertainly over the dirt and moss. She looks like some kind of... deer-centaur? [party.has cait |"So cute!" Cait gasps, and the centaur girl blushes immediately. "H-hello," she stutters, looking [party.som | |at you and Cait |between the three of you ]. "I'm sorry about following you, but you just looked so... interesting." |[pc.dcb |"Hey there, cutie," you say with a smirk, suppressing a grin when the centaur girl blushes immediately. |"Hello," you say, smiling at her. "I didn't know deer girls lived in the forest here." "H-hello," she stutters, looking [party.som | |at you and [comp1.name] |between the three of you ]. "I'm sorry about following you, but you just looked so... interesting." |"Ohmigosh, what a cutie you are," you say, smiling at the diminutive deergirl. "Nice to meet you!" She blushes immediately, trying to get her words out for a second before it happens."H-hello," she stutters, looking [party.som | |at you and [comp1.name] |between the three of you ]. "I'm sorry about following you, but you just looked so... interesting." ] ] "How did you turn invisible the last time we met?" you ask. "That's pretty strong magic." "Magic?" she asks, tilting her head in confusion. "I just went back to my tree. You um, gave me a bit of a shock..." [party.som |Her tree? Something's... not quite right about this conversation. By chance, you happen to glance down and notice — her hooves aren't touching the ground. She's floating about half an inch in the air. |[party.compNames] leans in and whispers to you. "[pc.name]... she's not touching the ground." You glance down to verify the claim and — sure enough — she's floating about half an inch in the air. |[comp1.name] leans in and whispers to you. "[pc.name]... she's not touching the ground." You glance down to verify the claim and — sure enough — she's floating about half an inch in the air. ] She follows your gaze and lets out a sound like an ashamed 'oh' and sinks downward, hooves pressing down into the earth once more. "Sorry, I get distracted sometimes," she offers by way of explanation. You nod as if that were an acceptable reason and continue. "So, what's your name? I'm [pc.name]." rows.original: Leaves crinkle under[pc.hasToes |foot |hoof ] as you walk through the forest, weapon at the ready. You're not quite sure if this is unfounded paranoia — or perhaps founded paranoia, owing to the giant fucking demon after your soul — but it feels like someone is watching you, and has been for a while now. [party.som |All on your lonesome, you begin to wonder whether you should have brought someone with you... |Maybe you should have brought more than one friend... |It's a good thing you've got two friends with you... ] Some sensation — a gut feeling maybe — makes you whirl around to face the possible threat, brandishing your [pc.weapon]. What you see is a glimpse of a surprised girl's face peeking out from behind a tree before she gasps and disappears behind it, leaving you bemused and feeling silly. Strangely enough, though... "What the- there's nobody here," you mutter, poking around the tree. Shit. Was it this tree? [party.hasAll cait brint |"Whatcha mean?" Brint asks, poking around the nearby trees. "Did you see something, [pc.name]?" Cait says. "There was a person here," you say, nodding at the tree trunk. "I saw her when I spun around. Felt like someone was watching us." "Huh," they chorus. "Guess she got away?" you ask the air, looking about. "Might have been an apparition," Cait suggests. "Some kind of ghost or spirit." "Aw, man," Brint says glumly. "I hate ghosts. Can't even hit 'em well." "Cheer up, maybe I'm just going crazy," you sigh, shaking your head. "Whatever, let's keep moving." On the bright side, the feeling of being watched is gone. |[party.hasAll cait brienne |"What's up, [pc.name]?" Brienne asks, coming up behind you. "Did you see something?" Cait says. On the bright side, the feeling of being watched doesn't persist. ] ]

rows.original:
You and Grainne trot off to the outskirts of her little territory and dig some holes in the dirt together, the cheerful dryad humming a tune that sounds like it might be birdsong. Sitting back and admiring your handiwork, she speaks up.
        
        "You know, I didn't think it would be so fast," she says. "I thought it was meant to take ages. Like a season!"
        
        Now that she mentions it...
        
        "Have you talked to Doireann or Orlaith about that?" you ask.
        
        "I asked Doireann once and she said it usually took her a season. And others take longer," Grainne says. "Isn't that kind of weird?"
        
        "Grainne... didn't you say all dryads are unique?" you say, putting a hand on her shoulder. "What if this is your gift? And you just never knew this whole time because you'd never been bred?"
        
        The dryad stares at you uncomprehending for several seconds before her mouth falls open and she gasps loudly, clapping a hand to her face.
        
        "Oh my god!" she says in an excited half-whisper. "Oh my god, you're right!" She springs up and onto her hooves, holding her arms up in the air like she's won a contest. "Yaaay!"
        
        "Seems like you're pretty special, huh?" you say, smiling. She responds by leaping into you — again — and bouncing against your front, head [pc.hasBreasts
            |between your [pc.breasts]
            |against your [pc.chest]
        ] while she hugs you tight. "Good girl, there you go."
        
        "Ooohhh, I'm so happyyyy," Grainne sing-songs, smiling wide as she rubs herself against you. "This is so exciting!" She stays in your arms and prances, hopping up and down on her hooves before stopping and looking up at you. "We're gonna perform so many rituals."
        
        "Are we, now?" you ask with a grin.
        
        "Yes!" she says, squeezing you as best she can. "We've gotta make the most of this, right?"
        
        "Hey, if you think you can handle it, I'm all for it," you say.
        
        "Of course I can!" Grainne declares, brimming with newfound confidence. "I already have a couple of times, after all. Let's get back to my tree!"
        
        "Do you know how gifts work?" you ask on the way back. "Why one dryad has some ability and another has a different one?"
        
        "Nature decides," she says with a shrug. "I think, anyway. Our knowledge of that kind of thing is... murky."
        
        What exactly did nature anticipate that necessitated a dryad that gives birth in a day or two, you wonder.[flags.DOIREANN_MET
            | Doireann did say she was born after a huge war... well, no matter.
        ]
        
        You get back to Grainne's grove and chat with her before departing, giving her a kiss before you set off. She waves, and keeps waving, until you disappear from sight down the trail.
rows.translation:
你和格瑞恩一起跑到她那片小领地的边缘，在泥土里挖了一些洞，那位快乐的干女神轻声哼着听起来像是鸟鸣般的旋律。当你坐下来欣赏你们共同完成的成果时，她开口说道。
        
        你知道吗，我本来以为这个过程会慢很多，”她说，“我以为至少需要好几个季节才能完成呢！”

现在她提到了这个……

“你有没有跟杜伊伦或者奥莱丝谈过这件事？你问的这个问题……

“我曾经问过杜伊伦，她说通常需要一个季节的时间，而其他人则需要更长的时间，”格兰妮说道，“这样不是有点奇怪吗？”

“格兰妮……你不是说过所有的干女都是独一无二的吗？你是这么说的，”他把手搭在她的肩上，“那么，如果这就是你命中注定的礼物呢？而你之所以一直不知道，只是因为你从未经历过那样的经历罢了……”

那位树精愣了几秒钟，完全不明白他在说什么，然后突然张大嘴巴，惊呼出声，还用手捂住了脸。
        
        哦，我的天啊！”她兴奋地半低声说道，“哦，我的天啊，你说得对！”她一下子跳了起来，用蹄子站立着，双臂高高举过头顶，就像赢得了比赛一样。“耶耶耶！”

“看来你确实挺特别的，嗯？你是这么说的，”她微笑着说道。然后，她又一次跳向你，轻轻撞在你的胸口和头上。 [pc.hasBreasts
            |在你的……和……之间 [pc.breasts]
            |违背你的意愿 [pc.chest]
        ] 当她紧紧地拥抱你时，说道：“好姑娘，这样才对。”

“哦哦哦，我太开心了！”格瑞恩边唱边笑，笑容满面地蹭着你。“这太令人兴奋了！”她紧紧地抱住你，在你的怀里蹦来跳去，用她的蹄子上下跳动，然后停下来，抬头看着你。 我们要举行很多仪式呢。”

“是吗，现在就要开始吗？”你笑着问道。

“没错！”她紧紧握住你的手说，“我们必须充分利用这个机会，对吧？”

“嘿，如果你觉得自己能应付得来，我完全支持。”你说。
        
        当然可以！”格瑞恩充满自信地宣称，“毕竟我已经试过几次了。我们还是回到我的树旁吧！”

“你知道礼物是怎么运作的吗？”在返回的路上，你问道，“为什么同一个树精会拥有某种能力，而另一个却拥有不同的能力呢？自然会决定，”她耸了耸肩说道，“至少我是这么认为的。我们对这类事情的了解其实……并不清楚。”

你不禁会想：自然究竟预料到了什么，才会需要那种只需要一两天就能完成分娩过程的树精呢？[flags.DOIREANN_MET
            | 杜伊伦确实说过她是在一场大规模战争之后出生的……不过，算了，这些都无关紧要了。
        ]
        
        你在离开之前回到格瑞恩的小树林，和她聊聊天，然后亲她一下再出发。她会不停地挥手，直到你沿着小路消失在视线之外。
rows.raw:
'
        You and Grainne trot off to the outskirts of her little territory and dig some holes in the dirt together, the cheerful dryad humming a tune that sounds like it might be birdsong. Sitting back and admiring your handiwork, she speaks up.
        
        "You know, I didn't think it would be so fast," she says. "I thought it was meant to take ages. Like a season!"
        
        Now that she mentions it...
        
        "Have you talked to Doireann or Orlaith about that?" you ask.
        
        "I asked Doireann once and she said it usually took her a season. And others take longer," Grainne says. "Isn't that kind of weird?"
        
        "Grainne... didn't you say all dryads are unique?" you say, putting a hand on her shoulder. "What if this is your gift? And you just never knew this whole time because you'd never been bred?"
        
        The dryad stares at you uncomprehending for several seconds before her mouth falls open and she gasps loudly, clapping a hand to her face.
        
        "Oh my god!" she says in an excited half-whisper. "Oh my god, you're right!" She springs up and onto her hooves, holding her arms up in the air like she's won a contest. "Yaaay!"
        
        "Seems like you're pretty special, huh?" you say, smiling. She responds by leaping into you — again — and bouncing against your front, head [pc.hasBreasts
            |between your [pc.breasts]
            |against your [pc.chest]
        ] while she hugs you tight. "Good girl, there you go."
        
        "Ooohhh, I'm so happyyyy," Grainne sing-songs, smiling wide as she rubs herself against you. "This is so exciting!" She stays in your arms and prances, hopping up and down on her hooves before stopping and looking up at you. "We're gonna perform so many rituals."
        
        "Are we, now?" you ask with a grin.
        
        "Yes!" she says, squeezing you as best she can. "We've gotta make the most of this, right?"
        
        "Hey, if you think you can handle it, I'm all for it," you say.
        
        "Of course I can!" Grainne declares, brimming with newfound confidence. "I already have a couple of times, after all. Let's get back to my tree!"
        
        "Do you know how gifts work?" you ask on the way back. "Why one dryad has some ability and another has a different one?"
        
        "Nature decides," she says with a shrug. "I think, anyway. Our knowledge of that kind of thing is... murky."
        
        What exactly did nature anticipate that necessitated a dryad that gives birth in a day or two, you wonder.[flags.DOIREANN_MET
            | Doireann did say she was born after a huge war... well, no matter.
        ]
        
        You get back to Grainne's grove and chat with her before departing, giving her a kiss before you set off. She waves, and keeps waving, until you disappear from sight down the trail.
        '

rows.original: "Grainne, what is this place?" you ask, looking around. "I've never seen anything like it in my life." "My grove, I guess," the dryad says, shrugging. "Do you like it?" "It's amazing. It looks like... I don't even know what it looks like," you say with a shake of your head. "I didn't know there was anywhere on the planet like this." All around you, unfamiliar trees and creatures live and breathe in unison. A small being that looks like a cross between a lizard and a monkey regards you with cautious eyes before flitting back into the surroundings, disappearing from sight. You're not even sure that was a real animal. "Oh," Grainne says, realization in her voice. "I guess you wouldn't see these trees outside of a sacred grove, [pc.name]. They grow from a dryad's power. I think you'd call that magic, or essence. Something like that." "So this space is yours?" you ask. "You made everything here?" She nods. "This is how I wanted my home to look while I was growing. Now that I'm here, I really like it." Grainne smiles. "I'm really happy that you like it too." It's hard to even imagine what she's describing and you doubt she could tell you, but it sounds like she had a mental image of what she wanted her grove to look like before she was born, and holding onto that image exerted power on the real world. "It's nice," you murmur.

rows.original: "What are dryads?" you ask. "Nature," Grainne replies, then smiles. "Sorry, that's not very informative. But... I don't know how else to describe it. We're born from the desire of a forest to grow, and we both nurture and nourish the forest we guard." "So you're a manifestation of the forest itself?" you say. Grainne nods. "We know what the forest knows. It tells us in its roots. In its leaves. In the animals that inhabit it. In a way, I am my forest, and my forest is me." Grainne spreads her arms, and for a moment you can see the purity of her purpose shining in her pretty eyes. "We are born knowing what the forest has learned during our coalescence, and it teaches us more as we grow. I don't know much about the outside world, though..." "Can you move from your forest?" you ask. "I don't think so," Grainne says hesitantly. "Even if I could, I wouldn't want to. It would feel wrong. If a dryad could leave her forest... I'm not sure what would happen to her. Perhaps if she took it with her?" She shakes her head. "I hope I never find out. Hey, tell me about your grove. Where do you live?" "A city of stone," you say. "Hawkethorne, it's called. It's where I'm living while [party.solo |I adventure." |we," you gesture between yourself and [party.compNames], "adventure." ] "Stone?" she asks, curious. "You mean like pebbles? Or like mountains?" "Somewhere in between," you say, smiling.[party.has brint | "Oh, I lived in a mountain once," Brint says, giving Grainne a grin. "I prefer the trees." "Me too!" she says happily. "Wow, I wanna hear about your adventures sometime." |[party.has brienne |"I used to live in a mountain," Brienne says, smiling at Grainne. "I prefer your grove." "Me too!" Grainne says happily. "Wow, I wanna hear about your adventures sometime." | "It's a little complicated." "Uh huh," Grainne says, nodding. It must be hard for her to imagine it. "Adventuring sounds fun! Tell me about it sometime." ] ]

rows.original:
"Are you always alone?" you ask. "You mentioned you had sisters, I think."
    
    "I'm never alone!" Grainne laughs, smiling. "I'm surrounded by nature. But yes, I do have sisters. Orlaith and Doireann, and they're both amazing."
    
    "Can you visit each other's groves?" you say.
    
    "Yup! But it's rude to just show up. It's their grove, after all," she says, waving an arm to indicate the general area. "Each one is sacred. Arriving without an invitation can make things weird... trust me, I know." Grainne covers her face with her hands and moans despairingly. "The amount of times I bumbled into seed-spreading rituals..."
    
    "Do you think I could meet your sisters?" you ask.
    
    "You can! Actually, they've been asking about you," Grainne says, taking her hands away and smiling a little nervously as she glances to the side. "I think they want to make sure I'm not being silly. I've um, talked with them about you a little already."
    
    "Are they like you?" you ask.
    
    "Well, we're all different. Every tree has its own... personality, I guess," she explains, placing a hand on her tree and smiling. [flags.GRAINNE_SEED
        |"You know, it goes along with their gift. Every dryad has something that makes them unique and special." Her expression softens. "Thank you for teaching me about mine, [pc.name]."
        
        "Not a problem," you say, reaching in and stroking her cheek. Grainne closes her eyes, leaning into your palm. "You're a great girl, Grainne. I'm sure you'll make a great mother of the forest."
        
        "Oh," she murmurs, her voice catching in her throat. "Thank you."
        |"They're bigger than I am, and more beautiful. I wish I had half of Doireann's maturity or Orlaith's presence. They're both so... so special, and I don't really have anything that makes me unique." She sighs, then shakes her head vehemently, her antlers swaying. "They tell me my gift will show in time, and not to worry. I try, but it- it's hard."
        
        "It sounds like they really look out for you," you say.
        
        "They do!" Grainne says, nodding happily. "I'm really glad I know them."
    ]
rows.translation:
你总是一个人吗？”你问道，“我记得你说过你有姐妹吧。”

“我从来都不孤单！”格瑞恩笑着说，“我周围充满了大自然。不过，我确实有姐妹，奥莱丝和杜伊伦，她们都非常棒。你们可以互相拜访对方的果园吗？”你问道。

“当然可以！但直接去拜访是不礼貌的。毕竟那是他们的果园，”她一边说，一边挥了挥手部示意那个大概的位置，“每个果园都是神圣的。如果没有得到邀请就擅自前往，可能会让事情变得尴尬。相信我，我知道的。”格瑞恩双手部掩面，绝望地呻吟道，“我究竟有多少次搞砸了那些播种仪式啊……”

“你愿意让我见见你的姐妹们吗？”你问道。

“当然可以！ 其实，他们一直在问起你的事情，”格瑞恩说道，她收回双手部，有些紧张地笑了笑，同时瞥了一眼旁边。“我想他们是想确认我是不是在胡说八道。嗯，我已经和他们简单聊过你的事情了。他们和你一样吗？”你问道。

“嗯，我们每个人都是不同的。我想，每一棵树都有它自己独特的……个性吧，”她一边说，一边把手部放在自己的树上，微笑着。 [flags.GRAINNE_SEED
        |你知道，这正是他们与生俱来的特质。每一个树精都有自己独一无二的特点。”她的表情变得柔和起来，“谢谢你让我了解了自己所拥有的那些特质。 [pc.name]没有问题，”你说道，伸手部轻抚她的脸颊。格兰妮闭上了眼睛，依靠在你的手部掌中。“你是个很棒的女孩，格兰妮。我相信你一定会成为森林中一位出色的母亲。”

“哦，”她轻声说道，声音在喉咙里哽住了。“谢谢你。
        |她们比我高大，也更加美丽。我真希望自己能有杜伊伦一半的成熟，或者奥莱丝那样的魅力。她们两个都那么……那么特别，而我，却没有什么能让自己与众不同。”她叹了口气，然后猛地摇了摇头，她的鹿角也随之晃动起来。“她们告诉我，我的天赋迟早会显现出来的，让我不要担心。我也一直在努力，但是……这真的很难。”

“听起来她们真的很关心你啊。”你说。

“确实如此！”格兰妮开心地点了点头，“能认识她们，我真的很高兴。
    ]

rows.original: "So, what is a seed-spreading ritual?" you ask. "Is that how dryads reproduce?" "Well, not always," Grainne says. "Left alone long enough, a dryad can pool her essence to produce a seed she can plant herself. That's how sole guardianship of a forest can sustain itself until another dryad is born." "Does that make the original dryad the mother?" you ask. Grainne shakes her head. "No. The tree she plants is like... like an empty pool of water. Nature itself decides whether that pool will be inhabited or not. We don't have parents, or descendants. Each of us is wholly unique." She wrinkles her nose. "So my sisters tell me, anyway. I don't know." "That sounds a little lonely," you say, looking over at Grainne. "The progenitors... the original guardians have it rough," she admits. "It can be many, many seasons before nature births another dryad. Until then, her sole company is nature itself." She gestures at the trees, holding her hand out until a small bird alights upon it. It chirps once and takes flight, leaving the dryad smiling. "But it's not so bad." "Did your sisters keep you company?" you ask. She nods. "They knew when I was born, having lived in the forest for so long already. There are lots of dryads around, but not all of them are as welcoming as Orlaith and Doireann. They took me under their wing on the day of my birth." You smile. "It sounds like they've been keeping you out of trouble ever since." "Yeah," Grainne says, smiling wide. "They have. I'm lucky to be accompanied by such amazing sisters. Back to seeding rituals, though... actually, I guess you could ask them about it, now that I think of it." She ponders it a bit, then nods. "If you want to be seeded, Orlaith might take some convincing. If you want to do the seeding yourself, though, Doireann is very accepting." "How about you?" you ask. [flags.GRAINNE_SEED |"Of course you can always seed me, [pc.name]," she says, smiling even as she blushes. "I'd be happy to share a ritual with you... or- or several." "Good to know," you say, smiling. |"M-me?" she stammers, going red. "I- well, I- if you, if that's what you really want, I guess? I've never been seeded or anything so I don't really know but I'd be happy to try it, probably? Wow, this is making me more nervous than I thought!" [pc.isVirgin |"It's okay," you say, smiling. "I've never done it among my own people either." She blinks. "Really? I guess I... I just assumed. That does make me feel a little better. Sorry, I get a little caught up in comparing myself to my sisters, sometimes..." |"Relax," you say, smiling. [pc.hasCock |"I've got a pretty good idea of what I'm doing. I can guide you." "O-oh... that would be- really nice, actually," she says, looking at you hopefully. "That would help a lot." |"I'm pretty sure I can't seed you without a penis anyway. But we could have some fun." "Well... I like fun," she says cautiously. "That sounds good to me." ] "Ah, wait!" Grainne realizes. "I never even explained the ritual!" "I'm pretty sure I get the idea..." you say. rows.translation: 进一步了解她的头衔吧。

rows.original:
"How do you feel about Grainne?" you ask her.
    
    [flags.ORLAITH_TALK_YOU
        |"Of course, I love her and want to protect her," Orlaith says, crossing her arms. "What did she say about me?"
        
        "She said you were really cool," you recall. "It seems like she looks up to you a lot."
        
        "Ah," she says, her pointed ears wiggling happily for a moment before she stops them. "Anything else?"
        
        "She mentioned you were very good with magic," you say, glancing at the foliage sprouting from beneath her hooves. "You do seem to be gifted."
        
        "Aah, yes," Orlaith says, smirking a little as she follows your gaze. "My 'magic.' It does come in handy during my duties. Just one of my quirks, I suppose. When you spend so long in touch with it, finer control of the essence is easy. I don't think Grainne knows quite what I usually use it for but perhaps that's for the better..."
        
        "She did mention she'd stumbled across you seeding others a couple of times," you say. "If that's what you're implying."
        
        "Oh she did, did she?" she sighs, seemingly more amused than annoyed. "That girl, always so curious. Keeping her out of trouble is a challenge. Still, I don't think she's made the connection between abundance and seed-bearing.[var0
            | Well, perhaps she has," Orlaith continues, peering at you, "thanks to you.
        ]"
        |"What did she say about me?" Orlaith sighs. "I love her, of course. I try to protect her as best as I can. Is that a satisfying answer, or do you want to pry deeper into our lives?"
        
        She seems reluctant to tell you much when you're so unfamiliar. Maybe you should introduce yourself a little.
    ]
rows.translation:
你对格兰妮有什么感觉？”你问她。
    
    [flags.ORLAITH_TALK_YOU
        |当然，我爱她，也想保护她，”奥莱丝双臂交叉说道，“她对我说了什么？”

“她说你真的很酷，”你回忆道，“看来她非常敬佩你。
        
        啊，”她说，那对尖耳朵高兴地动了一会儿，然后才停下来。“还有别的吗？”

“她提到你很擅长魔法，”你说道，同时瞥了一眼她蹄子下面长出的叶子。 你确实似乎有天赋。”

“啊，没错，”奥莱丝微笑着顺着你的目光说道，“这就是我的‘魔法’。在执行任务时，它确实派上了用场。我想，这只是我的一些特殊习惯罢了。当你长时间与这种力量保持联系时，就能够更精确地控制它的力量了。 我觉得格瑞恩并不知道我通常用它来做什么，但也许这样反而更好……”

“她确实提到过，有几次偶然看到你在帮助别人使用这个工具，”你说道，“如果你指的是这个意思的话。哦，她真的这么做了吗？”她叹了口气，听起来更多的是觉得好笑而不是恼火。“那个女孩，总是这么好奇。让她不惹上麻烦可真是个挑战。不过，我觉得她应该还没搞明白‘丰富’和‘结籽’之间的关系吧。[var0
            | 嗯，也许她确实做到了，”奥莱丝继续说道，目光紧盯着你，“这都要归功于你。
        ]"
        |她对我说了什么？”奥莱丝叹了口气，“我当然爱她，也会尽我所能保护她。这样的回答够让你满意了吗？还是你想进一步了解我们的生活？”

既然你对她来说还很陌生，她似乎也不太愿意多谈。也许你应该先自我介绍一下吧。
    ]

rows.original: [flags.DOIREANN_ORLAITH_3SUM |"You and Doireann seem very close..." you say. "Yes... we are," Orlaith murmurs, averting her eyes. "I love her very much, after all." "It seems like she has you wrapped around her little finger," you say, smiling. "I- she's special to me," Orlaith says, blushing slightly. "What of it?" "No need to get defensive, I think it's very cute," you reassure her. "You two are an incredible match. And thank you for letting me into your relationship." "Oh, well... don't worry about it," she says, mollified. "I- I should be thanking you for... for everything you've done." "You already know the best way to thank me," you murmur. "Yes... I think I do," she says, grinning slightly. |"What do you think of Doireann?" you ask. "My oldest friend," Orlaith says, smiling slightly. "Nearly all of my cherished memories involve either her or Grainne, and usually both. She is gentle, kind, accepting. Doireann helped me understand what it meant to be seed-blessed. She is half a season older than I am, and yet so much wiser." She sighs. "She says my headstrong-ness is part of my charm." "You love her," you observe. "Very much," she says, nodding slowly. "We performed our first seed-bearing ritual together. I think back on that often, on the path it has led us down. Where would I be if not for her? I wonder sometimes." "How long have you known her?" you ask. "I have long since lost count of the seasons," Orlaith says, gazing out over the trees of her grove. "We came into being not long after a great, great war. I cannot imagine many of the short-lived races have a memory stretching back that far. I consider myself fortunate to have had her accompanying me all this time." ]

rows.original:
If she's so reluctant to share, you can at least get the ball rolling.
    
    "How about [party.solo
        |I talk about myself a little?" you say, spreading your arms. "So you can get to know me."
        |we talk about ourselves a little?" you say, spreading your arms. "So you can get to know us."
    ]
    
    "That would be nice, actually," Orlaith says, smiling at [party.som|you|the two of you|the three of you]. "I would like to hear about you[party.solo| from your own mouth. You can tell a lot about someone by how they talk about themselves."|, especially from [party.som||your companion|your companions]. You can tell a lot about someone by how their friends talk about them. What they say and what they leave unsaid."]
    
    You sit down to talk with Orlaith[party.solo
        |,
        | with [party.compNames],
    ] the dryad listening to your tale with polite interest at first and rapt attention later. By the time you've finished spinning the tale about Kasyrra — though leaving out a couple of details, namely her desire to acquire your soul — she's practically hanging on your every word, eyes wide and sparkling with curiosity.
    
    "Wow," she says after a while, drawing back a bit after realizing how eager she looks. "It sounds like you're in the middle of something fairly interesting.[party.has cait
        | And I'm sorry to hear about your sister, Cait."
        
        "It's okay," Cait says, smiling and patting your leg. "We'll get her back."
        | Not to mention tragic."
        
        "A bit of both," you agree.
    ]

"That's just like Grainne. It means nature has chosen me to impart blessings upon our kin. I share my essence with others in the hopes of helping our forest grow. "Yes, I possess both sets of genitalia. Would you like to see?" ]

rows.original: "If you would," you say, and Orlaith nods in approval. "Very well. Then look," she says, hooves padding on the grass as she turns all the way around to poke her hindquarters out at you. What you see is an adorable deer tail sticking upwards and below that, the dark, somewhat puffy ring of Orlaith's asshole protruding outwards and looking every bit like it might be made out of cocoa. Under that is a long slit mostly covered by very soft-looking skin — and then it opens slightly, showing you a flash of bright wet pink flesh before closing again. A small trail of wetness dampens her fur, dripping downwards. "Did you see?" Orlaith asks you, twisting at the hips to look back around at you. You nod, and the corner of her mouth twists upwards in a sexy smirk. "Good. Keep looking." Below her drooling sex, hanging between her furred hindlegs, are two massive leathery-black balls, each bigger than a clenched fist. They look to have a strange, shimmering quality to them — as if their insides are filled with... "Is that... essence?" you ask, staring at Orlaith's nuts. Watching them is actually a little hypnotic; they glow and throb, giving off the illusion of temporary enlargement. "It is," she replies, grinning. "Do you want to know how I primarily use my magic? Watch." You feel something in the air, some kind of fuzzy noise — and your eyes widen at the sight of Orlaith's overloaded balls swelling, filling with ever-more essence until they're the size of melons, practically sloshing with seed. rows.original:
You decide to let your alraune-spawn grow naturally. Maybe that will give her a chance of some kind of normal existence? Once you've recovered your bearings somewhat, you bundle up the seed, get dressed, and head outside of town a short ways into the forest. There's plenty of soft soil out there that's easy to dig up, making a little hole for your newborn seed to snuggle up in. You cover it, give it some water, and turn to leave.

        You've barely taken ten paces back towards the village when you hear a loud rustling behind you. With a start, you glance over your shoulder, only to see a crater where you'd planted the seed a moment ago. The brush to the north rustles and shakes, as if something large was running through it... something human-shaped.
        
        No way...

        不可能……

rows.original: The sweet scent of nectar greets you in a gust of wind before you come across yet another trio of the Alraune's daughters hard at work putting the forest back into shape. Or at least, judging from their efforts, what they feel putting it back into shape ought to be like... no sooner have you drawn close that one of them spots you and rouses her sisters. "Oh! Oh! Look, it's [kas.romantic|winged grandmother's lover and ]Mother's [pc.mf |master |mistress ]! What are you doing here at this time of [dayNight |day |night ]?" Checking up on their work, of course. You've noticed that the effigies always come in trios... "Well, it's like mother says. One can hide and skive, two can plot with each other, but three is too much to go lazing about without being absolutely sure that no one will tattle. Mom's really smart like that." You see. You also see that they're looking terribly bored. "We are! You want to play with us, Mother's [pc.mf |master |mistress ]? It'll be fun, and if you win, we can let you have all of the things we found when cleaning up the underbrush! That's what adventuring types like you want, right?" Ah, they learn so quickly. Well, the choice is still yours as to whether you'll entertain the Alraune's daughters... which is more of a choice than what you or anyone else had before. What'll it be?

rows.original: As you're meandering through the forest, a by now familiar sweet scent comes to you, wafting through the branches. Well, it's different from how it used to be — the effigies' sweetness has lost its sickly, enticing nature and has changed into something more inviting. It's a small change, to be sure, but one that promises to put the context of the encounter in an entirely different light. You've defeated the Alraune; there isn't anything left to fear from any of her daughters. Following the warm, gentle scent, you wind up in a small clearing in which several effigies are gathered, tending to the flowers with hands and tentacle-like vines alike. Not quite the idyllic image of a vast meadow of fragrant flowers you once had when meeting these girls for the first time, but certainly an improvement over running amok in the forest and harassing people. One of the effigies looks up from her work and notices you, her expression turning unsure. "O-oh! It's you! The one whom Mother, um, well..." The effigy shifts and looks even more uncomfortable, which isn't a big surprise. Your situation with having defeated the Alraune and subjugated her no doubt has left her daughters not knowing exactly what to do these days, let alone how to behave around you. [pc.dcb |That's perfectly fine. You beat up their mother and bent her to your will, and if these girls get any ideas of being uppity at you then you're more than willing to do the same to them. That they fear you is just about par for the course, and to be completely honest? Putting the fear of you in these once wayward creatures feels pretty damned good and is the best way of keeping them in line and out of causing trouble for anyone traveling through the forest |That's natural, but awkward at the same time. You briefly explain to the plant-girls that while you defeated their mother, there's no need for them to act so tense around you unless they're up to no good; you aren't going to beat them up just for being there |Awww, it's so sad that they're scared of you! Sure, you had a bit of a struggle with their mommy, but then you kissed and made up, so it should be all right now, yes? Their mommy is your mommy now, too, so that makes you all one big happy family; family members shouldn't be afraid of each other like that, it really brings down the mood and no one likes a sourpuss ]. Now then, what're they up to? The effigies look amongst themselves — the stares of her sisters makes it clear to the poor girl that since she was the first to speak to you, she can very well be the one to bring the conversation to a close. "Um... Mother's had a change of mind — we're not to bother people any more, or at least not unless they come to us first. There've been a couple of those... but anyway, ever since you told mother to stop, she says we need to try and stop too, so we did! Mostly. Mother also said if people still want to have fun, then they're fair game!" All right, but she still hasn't answered the question of what exactly she and her sisters are doing here. "We're fixing up the forest, making it pretty again." The hesitant note starts creeping back into the effigy's voice. "We... we kinda ran roughshod over the whole place before you came along, so... um..." She's not to worry, you're not going to beat her up just for that; she's working to fix her mistakes, after all. [pc.isDK |What you might beat her up for is defying you and continuing to be such a wishy-washy mess after you explicitly told her not to |Now, she needs to hold her head up and speak to you with a little more confidence — all those %"um"s are really making her look a little silly ]. "I get why we have to do this, but it's just so boring working on planting flowers and clearing dead wood," the effigy grumps, her sisters nodding in agreement. "Sometimes we run into one of the hornet people out on patrol and they're all kinds of fun, but they don't come around often enough. We've been well-behaved ever since Mother told us to keep it to ourselves, so I don't see why we can't catch a break every now and then... "I know! Do you want to have a go with us, [pc.mf |mister |miss ]? It'll be just like old times — we can make it worth your while if you win!" And what if you don't win? What do you get for entertaining them nevertheless? "Oh, we can still make it worth your time, only in a different way!" The wiggling of the effigy's tentacle-like vines can only be described as a rough equivalent of grabby hands, and the fact that she and her sisters are all doing it makes it clear what'll happen should you lose. On the other hand, you did manage to beat their mother, so you'd have to be trying to lose in order to actually experience defeat, right? Right? Well, the choice is yours. Do you want to let these plant-girls have the fun they feel they so richly deserve?
rows.translation: 当你穿梭在森林之中时，一种如今已经变得熟悉的甜腻香气从树枝间飘荡而来。不过，这种香气与过去有所不同——那种令人作呕的、诱人的甜味已经消失了，取而代之的是一种更加令人愉悦的气息。 这确实只是一个小小的改动，但这个改动有望让整个遭遇的背景呈现出完全不同的面貌。 你已经击败了阿尔劳娜；她的那些女儿们已经不再值得你害怕了。 顺着那温暖而柔和的气息，你来到了一片小空地，那里有几尊雕像，它们用双手部以及类似触手部的藤蔓照料着那些花朵。虽然这与你初次见到这些女孩时所想象的、那片开满芳香花朵的广阔草地的景象有所不同，但比起在森林里乱跑、打扰别人来说，已经好了很多。 其中一个雕像从工作中抬起头来，注意到了你，她的表情显得有些不确定。 “哦！是你啊！就是那个妈妈……嗯，那个……” 雕像的动作变得更加局促不安，这也并不奇怪。 你击败了阿尔劳妮并使其屈服，这种情况无疑让她的那些女儿们这些天都不知道该怎么做，更不用说该如何在你面前表现了。 [pc.dcb |那完全没问题。你把他们的母亲揍得服服帖帖，让她完全屈从于你的意志；如果这些女孩敢对你耍横，你完全不介意再对她们做同样的事。她们害怕你，这也是意料之中的事。说实话，让这些曾经叛逆的女孩对你产生恐惧，这种感觉简直太棒了。 以及 这是让它们守规矩、避免给任何穿越森林的人带来麻烦的最佳方法。 |这很正常，但同时也让人觉得有些尴尬。你可以简单地告诉那些植物女孩们，虽然你打败了她们的母亲，但她们没有理由在你面前表现得那么紧张——除非她们在暗中图谋不轨；你总不会因为她们就在那里，就打她们吧。 |哎呀，他们居然害怕你，真是太让人难过了！虽然你之前和他们妈妈之间发生了一些小矛盾，但后来你们又亲了亲、和好了，所以现在应该一切都没事了吧？他们的妈妈现在也是你的妈妈了，这样你们就成了一个幸福的大家庭；家庭成员之间不应该互相害怕，那样会破坏气氛的，而且没人喜欢一个整天闷闷不乐的人啊。 ]那么，他们到底在搞什么名堂呢？ 那些雕像仿佛在互相交流着什么——她姐妹们那充满意味的目轻型让这个可怜的女孩清楚地意识到：既然她是第一个和你说话的人，那么她也很有可能成为结束这场对话的人。 嗯……妈妈改变主意了——我们不能再打扰别人了，至少除非别人先来找我们。之前确实有几次这样的情况……但不管怎样，自从你让妈妈停止这样做之后，她就说我们也应该试着不再打扰别人，于是我们就这么做了！ 基本上是这样。妈妈也说过，如果人们还是…… 想要 只要是为了开心，那么这样做也没关系！” 好吧，但她仍然没有回答那个问题：她和她的姐妹们究竟在这里做什么。 “我们正在修复这片森林，让它重新变得美丽。”那个声音中又重新浮现出些许犹豫。“在你们到来之前，我们确实把这里弄得一片狼藉，所以……嗯……” 她不必担心，你不会因为这个就责备她的；毕竟，她正在努力弥补自己的过错。 [pc.isDK |你之所以想揍她，大概是因为她公然违抗你的命令，而且在你明确告诉她不要这样之后，她依然表现得如此优柔寡断、摇摆不定。 |现在，她需要抬起头，以更加自信的态度与你交谈——那些“%嗯%”的声音真的让她看起来有点傻乎乎的。 ]我明白我们为什么必须这么做，但真的…… 无聊 正在忙着种花和清理枯枝呢，”那个玩偶抱怨道，她的姐妹们也都纷纷点头表示同意。“有时候我们会遇到那些出来巡逻的黄蜂人，他们其实挺有趣的，不过他们出现的频率实在太低了。自从妈妈告诉我们不要把这件事告诉别人之后，我们一直都很守规矩，所以我不明白为什么我们就不能偶尔享受一下轻松时轻型呢…… “我知道！你想和我们一起试试吗？ [pc.mf |先生 |错过 ]那样就会和过去一样了——如果你赢了，我们一定会让你觉得这次投资是值得的！” 那么，如果你……会怎么样呢？ 不要 赢？那么，即使你费心去取悦他们，最终又能得到什么呢？ “哦，我们仍然可以让你的付出有所回报，只不过方式会不同而已！” 那个雕像上那些像触手部一样的藤蔓的摆动，只能被形容为类似“贪婪的手部”在抓取东西的动作。而她和她的姐妹们都在这样做，这一事实清楚地说明了：如果你输了，会发生什么。 另一方面，你毕竟还是打败了他们的“母体”，所以你应该是故意想要输掉比赛，才能真正体验到失败的感觉，对吧？ 对吧？ 好吧，这个选择就在你手部中。你是想让这些“植物少女”们得到她们自认为应得的乐趣呢？
rows.raw: " As you're meandering through the forest, a by now familiar sweet scent comes to you, wafting through the branches. Well, it's different from how it used to be — the effigies' sweetness has lost its sickly, enticing nature and has changed into something more inviting. It's a small change, to be sure, but one that promises to put the context of the encounter in an entirely different light. You've defeated the Alraune; there isn't anything left to fear from any of her daughters. Following the warm, gentle scent, you wind up in a small clearing in which several effigies are gathered, tending to the flowers with hands and tentacle-like vines alike. Not quite the idyllic image of a vast meadow of fragrant flowers you once had when meeting these girls for the first time, but certainly an improvement over running amok in the forest and harassing people. One of the effigies looks up from her work and notices you, her expression turning unsure. "O-oh! It's you! The one whom Mother, um, well..." The effigy shifts and looks even more uncomfortable, which isn't a big surprise. Your situation with having defeated the Alraune and subjugated her no doubt has left her daughters not knowing exactly what to do these days, let alone how to behave around you. [pc.dcb |That's perfectly fine. You beat up their mother and bent her to your will, and if these girls get any ideas of being uppity at you then you're more than willing to do the same to them. That they fear you is just about par for the course, and to be completely honest? Putting the fear of you in these once wayward creatures feels pretty damned good and is the best way of keeping them in line and out of causing trouble for anyone traveling through the forest |That's natural, but awkward at the same time. You briefly explain to the plant-girls that while you defeated their mother, there's no need for them to act so tense around you unless they're up to no good; you aren't going to beat them up just for being there |Awww, it's so sad that they're scared of you! Sure, you had a bit of a struggle with their mommy, but then you kissed and made up, so it should be all right now, yes? Their mommy is your mommy now, too, so that makes you all one big happy family; family members shouldn't be afraid of each other like that, it really brings down the mood and no one likes a sourpuss ]. Now then, what're they up to? The effigies look amongst themselves — the stares of her sisters makes it clear to the poor girl that since she was the first to speak to you, she can very well be the one to bring the conversation to a close. "Um... Mother's had a change of mind — we're not to bother people any more, or at least not unless they come to us first. There've been a couple of those... but anyway, ever since you told mother to stop, she says we need to try and stop too, so we did! Mostly. Mother also said if people still want to have fun, then they're fair game!" All right, but she still hasn't answered the question of what exactly she and her sisters are doing here. "We're fixing up the forest, making it pretty again." The hesitant note starts creeping back into the effigy's voice. "We... we kinda ran roughshod over the whole place before you came along, so... um..." She's not to worry, you're not going to beat her up just for that; she's working to fix her mistakes, after all. [pc.isDK |What you might beat her up for is defying you and continuing to be such a wishy-washy mess after you explicitly told her not to |Now, she needs to hold her head up and speak to you with a little more confidence — all those %"um"s are really making her look a little silly ]. "I get why we have to do this, but it's just so boring working on planting flowers and clearing dead wood," the effigy grumps, her sisters nodding in agreement. "Sometimes we run into one of the hornet people out on patrol and they're all kinds of fun, but they don't come around often enough. We've been well-behaved ever since Mother told us to keep it to ourselves, so I don't see why we can't catch a break every now and then... "I know! Do you want to have a go with us, [pc.mf |mister |miss ]? It'll be just like old times — we can make it worth your while if you win!" And what if you don't win? What do you get for entertaining them nevertheless? "Oh, we can still make it worth your time, only in a different way!" The wiggling of the effigy's tentacle-like vines can only be described as a rough equivalent of grabby hands, and the fact that she and her sisters are all doing it makes it clear what'll happen should you lose. On the other hand, you did manage to beat their mother, so you'd have to be trying to lose in order to actually experience defeat, right? Right? Well, the choice is yours. Do you want to let these plant-girls have the fun they feel they so richly deserve?"

rows.original: "Yeeeees!" It's a little startling to see all of the effigies drop what they're doing and come bounding towards you giggling. "Thank you so much, this is so much more fun!" You've barely any time to ready your [pc.weapon] before they're upon you, bodies jiggling and vines flailing. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 耶耶耶！”看到所有那些玩偶突然放下手头的事情，笑着朝你跑过来，确实有点让人措手不及。“太谢谢了，这样有趣多了！” 你几乎没时间去准备…… [pc.weapon] 在他们靠近你之前，那些身体会不停地晃动，那些藤蔓也会疯狂地挥舞着。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " "Yeeeees!" It's a little startling to see all of the effigies drop what they're doing and come bounding towards you giggling. "Thank you so much, this is so much more fun!" You've barely any time to ready your [pc.weapon] before they're upon you, bodies jiggling and vines flailing. It's a fight!"

rows.original: Let them have a little fun.
rows.translation: 让他们玩得开心一点吧。

rows.original: "Aww," the effigies chorus. For a moment they look ready to disobey their mother and foist themselves upon you anyway, but they drag themselves away with visible effort and make to return to their job sulkily. Hey, they need to learn some discipline if they're going to be useful to anyone, themselves included. They can play all they want once the job's done, and not one moment sooner. "Aww, boo." As one, the effigies stick their tongues out at you. "Maybe some of the hornets will drop by soon, they're much more fun than you are." [party.has azyrran |"Oh, I don't know about that," Azyrran chuckles. "I think my sisters have more discipline than to toy with a couple of fuck-plants mid-patrol, no matter how tempting they might be. And if they are... I'll need to have a word with them about hive knight discipline." ] For all that they are, the Alraune's offspring really are as childish as they ought to be. All right, behave now — you're off.
rows.translation: 哎呀，”那些小家伙们齐声说道。有那么一瞬间，它们似乎准备违抗母亲的命令，硬要缠上来打扰你，但最终还是费了九牛二虎之力才拖着自己走开，闷闷不乐地回去继续干活了。 嘿，如果这些小家伙想对自己和别人都有用的话，它们确实需要学会一些纪律性才行。 等工作完成后，他们就可以想玩多久就玩多久，一点也不会提前。 “哎呀，真讨厌。”那些玩偶们同时把舌头伸出来对着你。“也许很快就会有一些黄蜂过来呢…… 他们是 比你有趣多了。 [party.has azyrran |哦，这个我就不知道了，”阿兹兰轻笑道，“我觉得我的姐妹们可不会有在巡逻时去摆弄那些该死的植物的习惯，不管它们有多诱人。如果她们真这么做了……那我可得跟她们谈谈关于蜂群骑士的纪律问题了。 ] 尽管有着种种特点，阿尔劳奈的后代们确实像他们应该的那样天真幼稚。好了，现在要规矩点啦——你们可以出发了。
