"I think my sisters have more discipline than to toy with a couple of fuck-plants mid-patrol, no matter how tempting they might be. And if they are... I'll need to have a word with them about hive knight discipline." ] For all that they are, the Alraune's offspring really are as childish as they ought to be. All right, behave now — you're off.'

rows.original: "Ouch! Uncle! Uncle!" Panting and out of breath, the trio of effigies huddles up, sweet nectar oozing from just about every orifice and turning the air even more sickly sweet. "That's enough!" That's enough, indeed. Is it just you, or do the effigies look utterly turned on by your little spar? They didn't use to do that before... are they that bored, or does it have something to do with you now being their mother's [pc.mf |master |mistress ], as it goes? Oh well. Once the plant-girls have caught their collective breath and given each other smooches on the bits where it stings most, one of them steps up and clears her throat. "Thanks again. Well, like we promised, you can have all this stuff we found when we were clearing out the forest. It's not like we've anything to do with it save bury the lot or toss it in the river anyway." Cool.[pc.isDK | At least you're getting something useful out of this mess. ] "And um... if you don't mind... you're pretty strong. My sisters and I would love it if you could stay awhile and play with us for just a bit longer, if you're okay with that. Not like we're going to try to force the issue, but..." Oh, really? "We'll even let you pick what you want to do with us! But you have to let us know whether you're interested or not to begin with. "...Please?" That's better, and considerably more polite than they used to be. Still, it's quite clear that the effigies are asking for sex — are you interested in having some fun with the plant-girls?
rows.translation: 哎哟！叔叔！叔叔！”那三个小玩偶气喘吁吁地挤在一起，它们身体的每个孔洞都在分泌甜美的汁液，使得周围的空气变得更加甜腻难闻。“够了！” 确实够了。是只有你这么觉得，还是那些小玩偶真的被你的小玩笑惹得兴奋不已呢？它们以前可不会这样……是它们太无聊了，还是因为你现在成了它们妈妈的缘故呢？ [pc.mf |掌握 |女主人；情妇 ]嗯，就是这样吧？好吧。等那些植物女孩们缓过气来，互相在那些被蜇得最疼的地方亲亲吻吻之后，其中一个人站了出来，清了清嗓子。 “再次感谢大家。就像我们之前承诺的那样，你们可以把我们在清理森林时找到的所有这些东西都拿去吧。反正这些东西对我们来说也没什么用处，要么把它们埋掉，要么扔进河里就是了。” “不错嘛。[pc.isDK | 至少你还在得到…… 某个东西 在这团乱麻中，这东西还算有点用处。 ] 嗯……如果你不介意的话……你其实挺强壮的。我和我的姐妹们真的很希望你能再多留一会儿，和我们一起玩一会儿，如果你没问题的话。我们当然不会强迫你，只是……哦，真的吗？” “我们甚至会让你自己决定想和我们一起做什么！但首先，你必须告诉我们你是否感兴趣。” “……拜托了？” 这样就好多了，也比他们以前的态度礼貌多了。 不过，很明显，这些形象是在暗示性行为……你对和这些植物女孩一起享受一些乐趣感兴趣吗？

rows.original: Well, you've taken the effigies from their work for this long, a little while more can't hurt. Barely have the words left your lips that the trio of plant-girls comes bounding up to you, squeezing their supple bodies against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] and rubbing their honeyed flowers all over your person. The scent of flowers and nectar intensifies along with their arousal to the point where it's cloying and dizzying; the sound spanking and show of strength that you've just given them turning some kind of switch on in the backs of their minds. Fingers and vines alike dig into your [pc.armor], and contented hums sound in your ears. The Alraune's daughters are made to be alluring, and they know it as they caress and disrobe you piece by piece. "Thanks a lot," one of them whispers sultrily. "This is sooo much better than working, and we can make you feel sooooo good. What do you want with us? Show us the favor that you showed Mother, okay?"
rows.translation: 嗯，你们已经用了他们作品中的这些形象这么久了，再多用一会儿应该也没关系吧。话音刚落，那三个植物女孩就蹦蹦跳跳地跑到了你面前，将她们柔软的身体紧紧贴在你的身上…… [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 它们的芳香花朵会紧紧贴在你的身上。花香与花蜜的气息会随着它们情绪的激动而愈发浓烈，甚至让人感到窒息、头晕目眩；而你刚才展现出的力量与激情，似乎触发了它们内心深处的某种机制。 无论是手指还是藤蔓，都会紧紧抓住你…… [pc.armor]悦耳的哼唱声在你耳边回荡。阿尔劳奈的女儿们生来就具有诱惑力，她们深知这一点，因此她们一边轻抚着你，一边慢慢地为你脱去衣服。 “真的非常感谢，”其中一位女子柔情地低语道，“这样可比工作愉快多了，而且我们还能让你感到…… 所以呢…… 好的。你到底想让我们做什么？请你像对待那位女士那样帮助我们吧，好吗？

rows.original: Can't hurt to indulge them just a little further.
rows.translation: 稍微满足他们的要求也没什么坏处吧。
rows.raw: "Can't hurt to indulge them just a little further."

rows.original: Nuh-uh. You're not falling for it — you've already given the effigies enough playtime, and now they need to get back to the task their mother set them. Honestly, if they want to have more fun, they need to work for it. "Aww, boo. You're worse than Mother, to get us all worked up and not follow through." Given that it was never part of the deal to begin with, maybe she should think twice about making up expectations that're just a bit unrealistic. As one, the effigies stick their tongues out at you. "Whatever. Well, you won fair and square, so take the stuff and go. Maybe you won't be in such a lousy mood when we see you next." With that, the plant-girls turn back to their forest tending, very pointedly and poutily ignoring you. Oh well, they'll grow out of it...
rows.translation: 不行。你不会上当的——你已经给这些小雕像足够的时间去“玩耍”了，现在它们应该回去完成它们“妈妈”交给它们的任务了。说真的，如果它们还想继续玩得开心的话，就必须这么做。 工作 哎呀，真讨厌。你比妈妈还坏，把我们都惹急了，最后却什么都不做。” 既然这本来就不是原本的约定，或许她应该好好考虑一下，是否应该设定一些不切实际的目标。 那些雕像全都把舌头吐向你。“算了，反正你也是通过公平竞争赢得这些东西的，那就拿走吧。也许下次见到你时，你的心情就不会这么糟糕了。” 说完，那些植物少女便转身继续照料她们的森林，明显是在故意不理你，还一副生闷气的样子。 好吧，他们迟早会明白的……

rows.translation: 当你穿梭在森林中时，眼角的余光突然瞥见了一抹亮橙色的头发——然后…… [var0|及时回退，才能避开那致命的一下向下斩击。|当剑深深刺入你的肩膀时，你会痛苦地嚎叫。] 你踉跄着后退，看到一张被蓬乱头发遮住了一部分的熟悉面孔——是艾丽卡！与第一次见面相比，她看起来更加凶狠、更加野性，但毫无疑问，那就是她。她举起了剑，朝你咆哮道： “又是你啊？又来挑战我这个恶魔吗？”她边说边朝你逼近。 [var1|这次肯定会有所不同，混蛋！|我总是很乐意打败那些恶魔！] 这是一场激烈的战斗！

She looks meaner, more wild since your first meeting, but otherwise it's unmistakably her. She hefts her sword, snarling at you. "You again. Back for another round, demon?" she says, stalking towards you. [var1|"It's gonna be different this time, fucker!"|"I'm always happy to beat demon ass!"] It's a fight!'

rows.original: Ahead of you, you see what appears to be an armored human woman with a head of flaming orange hair, a brightly glowing sword brandished in her right hand as she looks wildly back and forth. She doesn't seem to have spotted you yet, so you could probably fall back safely if you had a mind to.
rows.translation: 在你前方，你看到一个看起来像是身穿盔甲的女性，她的头发呈火焰般的橙色，右手挥舞着一把光芒闪耀的剑，她正疯狂地四处张望。她似乎还没有注意到你，所以如果你想的话，应该可以安全地后退。
rows.raw: "\n        Ahead of you, you see what appears to be an armored human woman with a head of flaming orange hair, a brightly glowing sword brandished in her right hand as she looks wildly back and forth. She doesn't seem to have spotted you yet, so you could probably fall back safely if you had a mind to."

rows.original: As you move closer, the woman turns to face you; her eyes are brilliant blue and at the moment, bloodshot, wild and unfocused; she's breathing hard, and there's equal parts lust, fear and confusion written all over her face. Her eyes focus on you as she begins to speak. "Who are you? More demons? I..." she pauses here, shivering visibly, and you can see that her face is flushed. Something must've happened... not that you have time to think about it. She's brandishing her blade at you now, the fear and confusion on her face replaced by cold fury. "You monsters tried to take my soul once," she begins, "you may have given me a... male parts, but... I am Eryka, I am a paladin, and I'll never let you take me! YOU CAN'T HAVE MY SOUL!!" she howls, lunging at you. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你逐渐靠近时，那个女人转过身来面对你；她的双眼呈现出鲜艳的蓝色，但此刻却充满了血丝，显得狂野而涣散；她呼吸急促，脸上写满着欲望、恐惧与困惑。 她的目光紧紧地盯着你，然后开始说话。 “你是谁？又是来捣乱的恶魔吗？我……”她在这里停住了，明显在颤抖，你的也能看到她的脸已经涨红了。肯定发生了什么……不过你现在根本没有时间去思考这些。 她现在正用她的刀指向你，她脸上的恐惧与困惑已被冰冷的愤怒所取代。 “你们这些怪物曾经试图夺走我的灵魂，”她开始说道，“你们或许给了我……男性的身体，但……我依然是…… 艾丽卡我是一名圣骑士，绝不会让你夺走我的灵魂！你不可能得到我的灵魂！！”她厉声吼道，同时向你冲了过来。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: No, you decide — you're not ready to deal with a crazed woman roaming the forest with a sword just this moment. You slip back into the trees, backtracking for a few minutes until you're sure you're safely away from her, then continue your journey.
rows.translation: 不，这个决定由你来做——此刻你实在没有精力去应付一个拿着剑在森林里四处游荡的疯女人。你悄悄地退回到树林中，折返了几分钟，确保自己已经安全地远离了她，之后才继续继续你的旅程。

rows.original: The paladin falls to her knees, clutching her head and... is she hyperventilating? She gets ahold of herself, looking up at you with more focus and clarity in her piercing blue eyes — and no small amount of shame. "I... I am so, so sorry. Please, please forgive me. I didn't..." she shudders, wrapping her arms around herself. "My sword... it's supposed to glow when tainted beings are near. So when you showed up, I... well. I'm the tainted one. I know that now. The red demon... Kasyrra, she called herself — attacked me, and I couldn't-couldn't fend it off. It was... toying with me, taunting me. It did something to me... I got away, but then I was lost in the forest, and... why am I so... hot!?" she says, holding her head in her hands. [pc.dcb|Well, that sucks for her. Shouldn't have been so weak.|Well, that's horrible! You find yourself wondering how you can help the poor woman.|Like, that sucks! Why can't that meanie demon leave cuties alone? What was her name? Kas... Kiss... Kiss-eara?] You wonder if there's any way to help the fallen paladin... but she answers your question for you. "I have to... gotta get back to the temple. Velun's followers can purify me, I know it." she says, planting the tip of her sword into the ground and leaning heavily on it as she stands. "Will you help? I'm... not sure I could defend myself if I went alone," she admits, huffing and shifting her legs uncomfortably. "My name is Eryka, by the way." she adds as an afterthought, carefully scanning the forest. "What's yours?" "[pc.name]," you tell her, considering your options.
rows.translation: 圣骑士双膝跪地，双手部抱头……她是在过度换气吗？她终于稳住了情绪，抬起头看着你，那双深蓝色的眼睛中充满了专注与清醒——同时也带着一丝羞愧。 “我……我真的、真的很抱歉。请原谅我，我真的没有……”她颤抖着，双臂紧紧抱住自己。“我的剑……在有被污染的存在靠近时应该会发光的。所以当你出现的时候，我……嗯，其实我就是那个被污染的人。 我现在知道了。那个红色恶魔……她自称卡希拉，她攻击了我，而我根本无法抵挡。它是在戏弄我，在挑衅我。它对我做了什么……我逃走了，但之后却在森林里迷路了。.. 为什么我会这样…… 热门的？？”她双手部抱头说道。 [pc.dcb|唉，她真是太倒霉了。真不该这么软弱。|哎呀，那太糟糕了！你会开始思考该如何帮助那位可怜的女性。|真是太糟糕了！为什么那个坏心眼的恶魔就不能放过这些可爱的生物呢？她叫什么来着？卡丝……基斯……基斯-艾拉？] 你在想是否有什么办法能够帮助那位倒下的圣骑士……但她已经为你解答了这个疑问。 “我必须……必须回到神庙。我知道，维伦的追随者们能够净化我。”她说着，将剑尖插入地面，然后倚着剑站了起来。 你会帮忙吗？我……不确定如果独自面对的话，能否保护好自己，”她边说边喘着气，不自在地挪动着双腿。“顺便说一下，我叫艾丽卡，”她补充道，同时仔细地观察着周围的森林。“你叫什么名字呢？" "[pc.name]你告诉她，仔细考虑一下你的各种选择吧。

rows.original: Of course you’ll help! You can hardly blame her for falling against a demon like Kasyrra — after all, she even managed to make you take a nap for a week. Which begs the question, actually — how long has Eryka been in the wild? "I’m... not sure." the paladin says, blinking. "I fought Kasyrra — if it can really be called a fight. When I lost, she... she changed me... but I got away, somehow. I think she let me get away. She was only toying with me while we were fighting, I don’t... I can’t imagine her being unable to catch me after I started running for the woods. All I could do was climb a tree and hide. I heard her laughing, saying something about hide and seek — maybe Velun protected me! I’ll have to make a sacrifice at his temple in thanks," she says, walking with you through the forest back to Hawkethorne. [eryka.fucked |The way she walks, almost bow-legged, you can tell she's still unused to her new endowments. |You can't help but see that her gait is off, almost like she’s not familiar with her own body... ] "Anyway," she continued, interrupting your thoughts, "I stayed hidden for hours. I don’t know how long exactly, but I was praying to Lumia, Velun, anyone who’d listen to keep her from finding me, and I guess they listened — I mean, I’m still here, and I still have my soul. When I finally felt like it was safe to come out, she was gone. I picked my sword off the ground and tried to find my way back home, but I kept getting lost. Like the forest was all... warped around. Maybe I was going a little mad!" She stops and laughs, a broken edge in her voice. "I was running out of my rations by the time I saw you. It’s a good thing you came along when you did. I may be a paladin of Velun, but the Treefather hasn't exactly told me how to sprout food out of oak trees." By now, the buildings of Hawkethorne are in view, visible relief spreading through your companion’s entire form. She walks faster towards the town, almost running, but stops short suddenly, turning back to you. "Here." she says, sheathing her gladius, quickly unbuckling it and handing it to you pommel-first. "You need this more than I do right now. Besides, I can get another one. And, well... you’ll use it well. Thank you." Before she goes, you have to ask — the lupine boys she was with. What happened to them? "Oh! Gods, are they not back in town? I-I don't know, then. When that demon attacked us, I told them to run, and they did. I haven't seen them since!" Well, at least you have one of the four.
rows.translation: 你当然会帮忙的！她遇到像卡希拉这样的恶魔，实在很难怪她——毕竟，她甚至还让你睡了一整周的懒觉呢。这就引出了一个问题：艾丽卡在野外已经待了多久了呢？ “我……不太清楚。”圣骑士眨了眨眼说道，“我和卡希拉交过手——如果那真的能算得上是一场战斗的话。当我失败的时候，她……她…… 改变了 我……不过不知怎么的，我逃脱了。我想她…… 让 让我逃走了……我们打架的时候，她只是在逗弄我而已。我……我无法相信，在我跑进树林之后，她竟然没能抓住我。我当时只能爬上树躲起来。我听到她在笑，还说了些什么关于‘捉迷藏’的话——也许是维伦保佑了我！我以后一定要去他的神庙献祭，表示感谢。”她说着，和你一起穿过森林，朝着鹰棘镇的方向走去。 [eryka.fucked |她走路的姿势有点内八字，一看就能看出她还没有完全适应自己新获得的能力。 |你不禁会发现，她的步态有些不自然，仿佛她并不熟悉自己的身体…… ] 无论如何，”她继续说道，打断了你的思绪，“我躲藏了几个小时。具体用了多久我并不清楚，但我一直在向卢米娅、维伦，或者任何愿意倾听我的神明祈祷，希望他们能阻止她找到我。我想他们应该听进了我的祈祷——毕竟我现在还活着，我的灵魂也还在。 当我终于觉得可以安全地现身时，她已经不见了。我从地上捡起我的剑，试图找到回家的路，但却一再迷路。仿佛整个森林都……发生了扭曲。也许我真的是有点疯了！她停了下来，笑了起来，声音里带着一丝疲惫：“见到你的时候，我的口粮已经快用完了。你正好在那个时候出现，真是太好了。虽然我是维伦的圣骑士，但树父可没教过我如何用橡树来制造食物啊。" 此时，鹰棘镇的建筑物已经清晰地映入眼帘，那种兴奋与期待的情绪明显地体现在你的同伴身上。她加快了脚步，几乎是在奔跑，但突然停了下来，转身朝你走来。 “给你。”她说着，将手中的长剑收回剑鞘，迅速解开剑带，然后将剑柄朝前递给了你。“你现在比我更需要这把剑。而且，我再买一把也没关系。总之……你会好好使用它的。谢谢你。 在她离开之前，你必须问问——她当时和那些狼族男孩们一起。他们后来怎么样了？ “哦！天啊，他们应该还没回到镇上吧？那我也不知道……当那个恶魔袭击我们的时候，我让他们赶紧逃跑，他们也是这么做的。从那以后我就再也没见过他们了！” 好吧，至少你还知道他们四个人中的其中一个的下落。

rows.original:
Brother Sanders is standing on the chapel's stoop when you arrive, and he's given just a split second to brace himself before the paladin charges him, throwing those great big arms around him in a crushing hug. He wheezes, then laughs, patting her back and mussing her ginger hair. "Welcome back, Eryka, dear girl. I see you're not much worse for wear."

        "I'm... alive," Eryka confirms. "I'm not sure how much longer I would've been though, if [party.names] here hadn't come along." 
        
        The elder priest gives you a grateful nod. "You have our deepest thanks. Come, lass, let's get you cleaned up and those scrapes tended to."
        
        Eryka gives you a wave as she's taken inside by the kindly cleric.
rows.translation:
当你到达时，桑德斯兄弟正站在小教堂的台阶上。就在圣骑士冲向他、用那双宽大的手臂紧紧拥抱他的那一瞬间，他才有那么一刹那的时间来做好准备。他喘着气，然后笑了起来，轻拍着她的背，还弄乱了她那金色的头发。“欢迎回来，艾丽卡，亲爱的姑娘。看来你并没有受到太大的伤害。”

“我还……活着，”艾丽卡确认道。“不过我也不确定，如果再继续下去，我还能撑多久…… [party.names] 这里之前可没有这样的人来过。”

那位年长的牧师向你表达了由衷的感激：“我们真的非常感谢你。来吧，姑娘，让我们帮你清洗干净，处理一下那些擦伤。”

艾丽卡向你挥了挥手，然后就被那位好心的牧师带进了屋里。

rows.original: Yeah, fuck that. She attacks you, tries to force herself on you, and then she has the nerve to ask for your help? Sure, she was driven out of her mind by demonic corruption and lust, but that's all the more reason not to want to be around her. She can go it alone. You tell her as much and the woman's face falls, fear entering her expression. "I... I understand. I just hope I can make it back alone." she says, turning and heading into the forest, in the direction of Hawkethorne. Seems like she has her bearings now that she's not panicking, at least... she should be fine, right?
rows.translation: 去他的吧。她攻击你，试图强迫你，然后还敢厚着脸皮向你求助？当然，可能是被恶魔的腐蚀与欲望冲昏了头脑，但这也更说明为什么不应该和她待在一起。 她完全可以独自完成这件事。你这么告诉她后，那个女人的脸色立刻变得阴沉下来，恐惧写在了她的脸上。“我……我明白了。我只是希望自己能够独自成功完成它。”她说着，转身朝着鹰棘镇的方向走进了森林。 看起来她现在不再慌慌张张了，至少应该是这样吧……她应该不会有事的，对吧？

rows.original: Of course you'll help... yourself to a piece of that ass. Looking Eryka up and down, you announce aloud that she's one sexy bitch. She somehow goes even paler, eyes widening as a shaky arm raises her sword in front of her. "No. I can't! I have to FIGHT the corruption, I can't give into it again! I'll be lost! Y-you are a demon!" she says, frantically waving her sword about before you bat it out of her weakened arm, smirking. You step forward before she can react, slamming your palm into her solar plexus, sending her crumbling to the ground on her back, gasping for air. And last but certainly not least, how did she end up fighting Kasyrra by herself? "Whoah, whoah, buy me dinner first!" the woman says jokingly, holding her palms out in front of herself defensively. "Well, where do I start? I mean, my parents were from the south — I don't know what city, but dad was a town guardsman there — slipped off a rooftop chasing a gang of thieves and broke his neck when I was six. Mom moved up here to live with my grandfather not long after the funeral, but she caught winter fever the next year," she says sadly, sighing. "Grandpa's still going strong, though — I've never even seen the man sneeze," she says, cracking a small smile. "I started training two years after that under Brother Sanders. Why, though? I never really thought about it — grandpa just introduced me to Sanders, said he'd known him for years and he'd teach me to defend myself. I picked it up pretty easily — enough so that he offered to train me as a paladin two years later, anyway. I said yes. No real reason, honestly, besides I needed to learn a skill. At least..." she trails off, thinking. "At least, strange as it sounds, I didn't want to be a paladin because of some traumatic event or something. Not because I had a strong sense of justice or wanted to purge evil from the world, not to fight demons or anything.... Though it seems I'm gonna be doing that last thing regardless. I mean, I definitely believe in justice and trying to make the world a better place, but... I mainly just thought paladins were fuckin' awesome. 你又喝了一大口，然而紧接着，一阵不适感开始在体内蔓延，同时水从手部指间流过，还让手部指感到发痒。 你几乎可以肯定自己听到了那些温柔的话语：“再喝一小口就好……”

然而，那座雕像依然纹丝未动。不过，如果利用别人的善意反而会破坏这份善意本身。感到精神为之一振后，你站起身来，抓起装备准备再次离开。 无论这种“祝福”带来了什么效果，你都可以持续享受这种状态好几个小时。你甚至都没有注意到自己脸上正挂着笑容，即使你确实听到了有人低声说着“七天”这个词。
rows.raw:
"
    It certainly doesn't look or smell poisoned. You settle down to your knees by the fountain and reach out with cupped hands in front of the vase. The water is faintly chilled, and just the touch of it is enough to have your skin tingling. When you bring it to your mouth and drink you feel incredible. There's no flavor but you're immediately refreshed; any weariness in your muscles seems to be flushed out.

    You go for another gulp before a wave of discomfort ripples through you, and the water runs through your fingers and makes them itch. You could almost swear you hear soft words; "Just one sip..."

    But the statue hasn't moved. Still, a blessing isn't a blessing when you take advantage of it. Feeling greatly refreshed you climb to your feet and grab your gear to leave again. Whatever the blessing did, you're pretty sure you could go for hours.

    You don't even notice the smile on your back, even when you're sure you hear the muttered words "Seven days."
    "

rows.original:
The crystals look valuable; you pluck one from the water, shivering at the refreshing chill of it, before raising it to eye level. Your fractal reflection stares back at you through facets of deep ruby, and you could swear there's an inner light inside it.
            
            And it's getting brighter.

            You suck in a sharp breath as pain lances through your palm, hot and searing like a stovetop. You try and drop the gemstone, but find that only ash and embers fly from your grasp as you flail in a panic. When the burning fades, you check your palm and thankfully find it unharmed... and yet the memory of that burning pain remains, throbbing in the back of your mind. You grit your teeth and glower at the bitch on the pedestal, contemplating how hard it would be to just break her down or carve some sex organs on her... and just as quickly the idea fades, as if washed away by the breeze.

            You sigh and turn to leave. In the back of your mind, there's a lingering tingle. Faintly, you could swear you hear, "A beginning... but much more work left to do."
rows.translation:
这些晶体看起来非常珍贵；你从水中摘出一颗，感受到它带来的清凉触感，然后将其举到眼前。那些深红色宝石的切面中，你的倒影仿佛在注视着你，你甚至敢发誓，那些宝石内部仿佛蕴含着某种轻型芒。
            
            而且，轻型线正在变得越来越亮。

            你猛地吸了一口气，因为剧烈的疼痛像火焰一样灼烧着你的手掌，那种感觉热得令人难以忍受。你试图扔掉那颗宝石，但却发现，在慌乱中试图甩开它的瞬间，只有灰烬和余火从你的手中飞溅出来。 当灼烧感消退后，你检查自己的手掌，庆幸地发现它并没有受到任何伤害……然而，那种灼烧般的疼痛依然留在你的记忆中，在脑海中不断回荡。你咬紧牙关，怒视着那个被你奉为偶像的人，思考着：要毁掉她，或者在她身上刻上一些象征性的符号，该有多难啊…………然而，这个想法很快就消失了，仿佛被微风带走了。

你叹了口气，转身准备离开。在心底，却还残留着一丝莫名的兴奋。隐约间，你仿佛听到了这样一句话：“一个新的开始……但还有许多工作等着去做。"

rows.original: The crystals look valuable; you pluck one from the water, shivering at the refreshing chill of it, before raising it to eye level. Your fractal reflection stares back at you through facets of deep ruby, but when you turn the crystal over it seems smaller. A surprised yelp rips itself out of you as a burning sensation sinks into your palm as though you'd gripped a hot coal. You shake your hand violently but the crystal's practically glued to your hand even as it reduces in size. A few heartbeats later and you're blinking back to reality on your knees. A hurried check of your palm reveals a viscous purple fluid dripping from its surface, but there's no hole beneath. Washing the goop away in the fountain reveals no scars or burn marks either, and the purple fluid breaks down into nothing. The memory of that pain remains, at least for a few moments longer before a steady relief settles in. There's an itching at the back of your mind, the sensation that you're no longer wanted here... You back up, before departing the clearing completely... yet you're sure that you can hear a soft voice say "You're welcome..."

Something about her smile grows frosty, but she plants her lance and shield, bowing her head in a more genuine expression. "Sorry, I don't mean to sound ungrateful. My name is Azyrran, hive knight and daughter of Queen Nyzerrah. I'm very, very glad you came by."
    
    "You're a princess?" You blink, suddenly an awful lot more self-conscious. While you're still patting yourself down, she throws up her hands disarmingly, wings buzzing a few times as though to emphasize.
    
    "No, well, yes. But there are lots of us, I promise... or were, at least. I'm not sure?"
    
    When the hornet's mood clearly shows signs of spiralling down to earth, you stiffen up— tears were not what you'd expected. "What are you doing out here all alone, Azyrran? Especially when those plant-girls are around here starting fights."
    
    "That's... maybe we can talk about it in the future? I'm still feeling a little raw." When your only response is a shrug and a fresh dose of awkward silence, she continues. "I know this is a little forward, and I wouldn't ask you just after getting out of a scrap like that, but..." Azyrran turns to look at a tremendous wall of sharp vines, face scrunching up again. "Would you be willing to spar with me when next we meet? I'd appreciate it, a lot."
    
    "How come?"
    
    "I've been fighting effigies alone for a while, I want to improve and get stronger."
    
    You're not convinced that's the whole story, but she looks sincere at least. "Do we have to fight?"
    
    Azyrran twiddles her chitinous digits together, making them gently tippa-tap. "We can hug, too. I kinda miss hugs. Usually I'd be more than happy to cuddle up to the cute plant girls, but as you've seen..."

rows.original: The collapse of your line was so sudden, it barely registers when you're dumped down to the ground. There's no strength in your legs, and the world's tipped over onto its side. The effigy slinks up to you, rubbing her mitts together. "Aw yeah, this is gonna be good..." You brace yourself for the first hand to land on you, before a far larger figure slinks out of the brush, a feast of curves and tentacles. "Hey! You were called home, like, ages ago. What are you doing?" "Look at what we found!" The towering flower-lady peers over you and the similarly-dazed hornet, before huffing and planting her hands on some voluptuous hips. "They're precious, but I think Mother had plans for at least one of them? And I don't super remember. Plus it's hometime; just leave them, I'm sure you can play later." There's a lot of pouting and petulance, but thankfully they leave you largely un-molested. At least except for the more vocal effigy, who runs up to the hornet, squeezes a titty while making a honk noise, and then leaves, licking honey from her fingers. "Rude," the caramel-skinned hornet groans.
rows.translation: 你的防线崩溃得如此突然，以至于当你被摔倒在地时，几乎感觉不到任何疼痛。你的双腿完全没有力气，整个世界仿佛都倾倒在了你的身边。 那个雕像悄悄地靠近你，一边搓着她的手部套。 哇，这下可要有好戏看了……” 你刚做好准备迎接第一记攻击，突然一个体型庞大得多的生物从灌木丛中悄悄现身——它浑身都是曲线与触手部。“嘿！你早就该被叫回家了啊。 你在干什么？” “看看我们发现了什么！” 那个高大的花仙子俯身看着你和那个同样目瞪口呆的黄蜂，然后气呼呼地把手部搭在自己那丰满的臀部上：“这些东西很珍贵，但我觉得妈妈至少对其中一样有别的安排吧？ 我其实不太记得了。而且现在也是回家时间了，把它们留下吧，我相信你之后还能继续玩。 虽然他们会嘟着嘴、表现得有些任性，但幸运的是，他们基本上不会打扰你。至少除了那个爱大声喧闹的人——他会跑到那只大黄蜂跟前，一边按喇叭一边捏它的胸部，还会发出各种声音来…… 然后 叶子们从她的手部指上舔食着蜂蜜。“真无礼，”那只皮肤呈焦糖色的大黄蜂抱怨道。

rows.original:
By the time your enemies have gone, you can feel enough strength in your limbs to find your feet. The hornet on the other hand, although sitting up, has her knees hugged up to her chest, and her face buried in some combination of boobs-and-knee, wings hanging like a limp cape.

        "Are you hurt?" The question sounds dumb even before you finish it, but it snaps the woman from her daze. 
        
        She wipes her eyes, limps her way to a standing position, and gives you a curtsey more at home in a rich boudoir than a dirty field. "Nothing serious, just my pride... usually I can handle things just fine on my own, but it looks like I got a little too caught up in things. I'm so sorry you got involved on my account."
        
        "It's fine, it could've turned out worse."
        
        "Y-yes, sorry, I didn't mean to sound ungrateful. My name is Azyrran, hive knight and daughter of Queen Nyzerrah."
        
        "Shit, a princess?" 
        
        Azyrran winces and shrugs. "Sort of, sorry, it's a complicated story that I'm not really up to telling. I'm feeling just a bit too sorry for myself." She tucks a muddied lock of flaxen hair out of her face, and you can see evidence of faint makeup streaked with tears. "But when I'm not, would you do me the honor of sparring with me when next we meet? I... definitely need to improve."
        
        You're not convinced that's the whole story, but she looks sincere at least. "Do we have to fight?"
        
        Azyrran twiddles her chitinous digits together, making them gently tippa-tap. "We can hug, too. I kinda miss hugs. Usually I'd be more than happy to cuddle up to the cute plant girls, but as you've seen..." Her expression turns frosty again, and she takes wing, looking over her shoulder and giving you a tired wave before disappearing.
rows.translation:
当你的敌人离开后，你会感到四肢重新恢复了力量，能够稳稳地站立。而那只黄蜂，虽然已经坐了起来，但她的膝盖紧紧地贴在胸前，脸埋在胸部和膝盖的交界处，翅膀则像一条无力的披风一样垂着。

        你受伤了吗？”这个问题在你说出口之前就已经显得很愚蠢了，但它却让那个女人从恍惚中清醒过来。

她擦了擦眼睛，一瘸一拐地站了起来，然后向你行了一个礼——这个礼更适合在豪华的闺房里举行，而不是在肮脏的田野里。“没什么大碍，只是有点丢脸而已……通常我都能自己处理这些事情，但看来这次我确实太过于投入其中了。真的很抱歉，让你因为我而卷入了这件事。
        
        没关系，情况本可能更糟。”

“是、是的，抱歉，我并不是想显得不领情。我叫阿兹兰，是蜂巢骑士，也是尼泽拉女王的女儿。”

“该死，原来是个公主？ 
        
        阿兹兰皱了皱眉，耸了耸肩：“算是吧，抱歉，这个故事有点复杂，我实在不太适合来讲。我现在只是觉得自己太可怜了……”她把一缕沾满泥污的亚麻色头发从脸上拨开，你能看到她脸上残留的淡妆，以及被泪水冲晕的痕迹。 但当我不在的时候，下次见面时，能否请你陪我练习一下？我……确实需要提高自己的水平。
        
        你并不相信事情就是这么简单，但至少她看起来是真心的。“我们非得吵架吗？”

阿兹兰把她的几丁质手指轻轻扭动在一起，发出“嗒嗒”的声响。“我们也可以拥抱啊。我其实有点想念拥抱的感觉呢。通常情况下，我会很乐意依偎在那些可爱的植物女孩身边，但就像你看到的那样……”她的表情又变得冷淡起来，然后振翅飞走了，还回头朝你挥了挥手，似乎有些疲惫，随后便消失在了视线中。

rows.original:
You pause and consider the hornet for a few moments, before placing an arm on Azyrran’s shoulder. She bounces on the spot, looking at you with confusion before you pull her closer and push her head down onto your shoulder. She gasps and wriggles in a brief moment of panic, before the tension bleeds out of her. The hornet knight sighs and closes her eyes, practically climbing your body in an attempt to stay close before squeezing you back.

    The nervous flutter of her wings is a gentle buzz once she’s finally wrapped properly around you. "Oh I..." She sighs again, nuzzling your neck. After a few moments you begin to feel moisture on your chest, and not just thanks to the pressure of her tits against you. With one arm around her shoulders still, your hand goes up to stroke and play with her hair.
    
    Gently you run your fingertips around the lines of her scalp, soaking up the soothing sounds that build up in the base of Azyrran’s throat.
    
    Eventually your hug becomes less of a somber affair; it’s possible to feel the smile of her lips each time she nuzzles your neck. Her arms squeeze you back tight enough to squirt honey onto you, which causes a little giggle to erupt from her at the same time... and admittedly, the faint pheromonal scent of horny hornet.
    
    Still, jumping to sex right now would spoil the moment. Azyrran is warm in your lap and cuddling you back. Occasionally she toys with your [pc.hair] while you trail your fingers up and down her back. Eventually her snuggling comes to a halt, and when you look down it’s into a blissful and half-asleep face. You give Azyrran a squeeze, smirking.
    
    "Mmnf? Oh... uh." She blushes and squirms out of your lap. "That was really nice... thanks for that."

[flags.AZYRRAN_TALK_ABOUT
        |"You want to know how I’m doing?" Azyrran smiles, hugging her chest a little. "I’m feeling stir-crazy if I’m honest." 

        She looks off into the western woods — no doubt the direction of her hive — before returning her attention to you. "My kind ache without companionship, and my self-imposed exile has gone on for what feels like an eternity..."
        
        [rand
            |"Recently I saw a farm, and watched the animals walk around. That was peaceful to sit and observe. I like watching communities." Her expression warms up further, wings twitching a few times with unspoken anticipation. "They were cute. I want to pet the sheep next time I see them."
            |"A hunter flirted with me recently. She was very sweet. But apparently not as sweet as my chest, I swear she nearly drank me dry!" Her thighs rub noisily together. "I’m mostly just glad she chose not to shoot first. I know my sisters have no doubt harassed her."
            |"Maybe it sounds a little childish, but I spent a long time just sitting around and smelling flowers. There are still some wonderful thick patches that aren’t too corrupted."
            |"I was nearly caught by some wolves today while I was enjoying the sun through a break in the canopies." She pouts, folding her arms. "Stung the lot of them, for ruining my nap. That soon got them to go away."
            |She hangs her head for a moment "Well... it wasn’t such a good day today. I had to fight my sisters. I-I mean, it was good that I did! I saved someone from them!" 
            
            She puffs her chest up and straightens out again. "Sorry, I’ve kind of got to force myself to stay positive about these things."
        ]
        
        The both of you spend a few peaceful minutes making small-talk before she runs out of subjects about herself.
        |"My name is Azyrran. I am a Knight of the Hive..." 

        She trails off after that simple announcement, squeezing her own knee. "I am going through some difficulties with my hive, currently. A hive knight protects her home, alongside a coterie of sisters." Her eyes wander across her chitinous extremities, pitted and scarred from countless confrontations. 
        
        "I am a hornet, as you can plainly tell. The majority of us are stronger and quicker than our cousins, the bee-folk, but less..." she trails off and gestures at her not-inconsiderable bust size. "Blessed of the chest than they are renowned to be."
        
        "Like them, we produce enchanted honey from a steady diet of nectar and... well, actually-delicious food." Azyrran continues, looking you up and down for a brief moment before clearing her throat. "Recently, my people have become more... aggressive. I'm sure you have seen them, marauding through the forest accosting travelers and monsters alike. They seek to spread the queen's eggs far faster than ever before. I am expected to do the same now."
        
        The curvy hornet blinks, before waving her hands at you. "N-not that I intend to. I... don’t enjoy taking what is not freely offered. No, I intend to stop this, somehow. Maybe with your help?"
    ]

[flags.AZYRRAN_TALK_ABOUT
        |你想知道我最近过得怎么样吗？”阿兹兰微笑着，轻轻抱了抱自己的胸膛，“说实话，我感到非常烦躁不安。”

她将目光投向西边的树林——那无疑是她蜂巢的方向——然后才将注意力重新转向你。“我的种族天生就需要陪伴，而我自己强制选择的流放生活，已经持续了仿佛永无止境的时间……
        
        [rand
            |最近我去了一个农场，看着那些动物在周围活动，真是让人感到很宁静，坐下来观察它们真是太惬意了。我就喜欢观察各种生物群体。”她的表情变得更加温暖，翅膀还不停地轻轻颤动，似乎在期待着接下来会发生什么。“那些动物真的很可爱，下次再见到羊的时候，我一定想摸摸它们。
            |最近有个猎人跟我调情，她人挺甜的……不过显然没有我的胸部甜，我发誓，她差点把我‘喝干’呢！”她的大腿不停地摩擦着，发出声响。“还好她没有先开枪，要不然我的姐妹们肯定不会放过她。
            |也许这听起来有点幼稚，但我确实花了很多时间坐在那里闻花香。现在还有一些保存得很好的花丛，它们并没有受到太大的破坏。
            |今天我在树冠的缝隙中享受阳光的时候，差点被一些狼抓到呢。”她撅着嘴，双臂交叉抱在胸前，“我把它们都蜇了一下，就因为它们打扰了我午睡，它们很快就跑掉了。
            |她低下头想了一会儿，然后说道：“嗯……今天真不是什么好日子。我不得不和我的姐妹们吵架。不过，其实我这么做也是好事！我帮了别人，让他们免受她们的伤害！”

她挺了挺胸，又重新站直了身子：“抱歉，对于这些事情，我确实得强迫自己保持积极的态度才行。
        ]
        
        你们俩聊了几分钟闲话，直到她再也没有关于自己可以谈论的话题了。
        |我的名字是阿兹兰。我是蜂群的骑士……”

她简单地说完这些后，便停下了话语，轻轻按了按自己的膝盖。“目前，我的蜂群遇到了一些麻烦。作为蜂群的骑士，我应该和我的姐妹们一起保护我们的家园。她的目光落在自己那布满凹痕与伤疤的肢节上——这些都是无数次战斗留下的痕迹。”

“你们看得出来，我是一只黄蜂。我们这类生物，大多数都比我们的近亲——蜜蜂们——更强壮、更快速，但也有一些例外。……”她话音渐弱，同时指了指自己并不小的胸围，“看来我们的胸部确实如人们所说，是上天赐予的恩赐。”

“和她们一样，我们也是通过摄入花蜜以及……嗯，其实是非常美味的食物，来生产出这种被施了魔法的蜂蜜的。阿兹兰继续说道，上下打量了你一番，然后清了清嗓子继续说：“最近，我的族人变得愈发……好斗了。你们肯定也看到了，他们在森林里横冲直撞，既袭击旅行者，也攻击怪物。 它们试图以前所未有的速度传播女王的卵。现在，我也被要求这么做。

那只身形弯曲的黄蜂眨了眨眼睛，然后朝你挥了挥手部：“不……我不是这个意思。我……不喜欢强行夺取那些不是自愿给予的东西。 不，我打算想办法阻止这件事。也许需要你的帮助？
    ]

rows.original:
[flags.AZYRRAN_TALK_SELF
        |Azyrran gently claps her hands, wings buzzing cutely. "You’re going to tell me of your adventures? Wonderful." 

        The chocolate hornet settles in and gives you her full attention while you start to tell her of your most recent escapades. [party.som
            |Your journey has had its own lonely moments, but you’ve not really had a chance to slow down between supposed-heroics and land-wide questing. Once you’ve finally exhausted your time Azyrran’s sitting with a soft smile on her face, apparently satisfied to soak up some social energy from you.
            |[companion.Name] also joins in the tale-telling too, and by the time both of you have finished describing your latest (mis)adventures Azyrran is practically glowing for the exposure to some social interaction.
            |Your companions join in the telling too, and by the time the lot of you have finished she’s practically glowing for the exposure to some social interaction.
        ]
        
        "You do expose yourself to an awful lot of danger, it’s quite impressive. Quite the few uhm... lurid escapades too."
        
        You can juuust about make out the blush beneath her dark skin.
        |"I don't think you've introduced yourself properly," Azyrran chides. 

        [pc.dcb
            |"Me? I’m [pc.name], as you know. Just a [pc.class]. Not much else to say."
            |"The name’s [pc.name], a [pc.class]. It’s a pleasure to meet you."
            |"Oh! Well, as you know, [pc.name]! It’s totally great to meet you! Oh, uh. I’m a [pc.class] and I like long walks on the beach."
        ] She reaches out and takes your hand to shake it, before you even get a chance to offer it. There’s a faint smile on her face as she does so, pausing only to give your digits a squeeze before letting go. 
        
        Azyrran fidgets for a few seconds, looking you over again. "Sorry, I guess it’s a bit weird to just sit and ask you to divulge all of the details of your travels. Plus I’m sure you have other places to be..." She straightens out finally, returning to her soft smile. "Is there anything you need to know first?"
    ]

[flags.AZYRRAN_TALK_SELF
        |阿兹兰轻轻拍手，她的翅膀发出可爱的嗡嗡声。“你打算给我讲讲你的冒险经历吗？太好了。”

那只巧克力色的大黄蜂安静地待在旁边，全神贯注地听你讲述最近发生的那些趣事。 [party.som
            |你的旅程中也曾有过孤独的时刻，但在那些所谓的英雄事迹与遍布各地的任务之间，你其实从未真正有机会放慢脚步。直到你终于耗尽了所有的时间，阿兹兰才会面带温柔的微笑坐在你身边，显然，她很乐意从你身上获取一些社交互动带来的乐趣。
            |[companion.Name] 它也会加入到这些故事讲述中来。等到你们俩都讲完自己最近的那些“冒险”经历后，阿兹兰简直因为得到了这些社交互动的机会而兴奋不已呢。
            |你的同伴也加入了这个讲述过程，等到你们所有人都讲完之后，她因为得到了这些社交互动的机会而显得格外开心。
        ]
        
        你确实将自己置于许多危险之中，这一点相当令人钦佩。而且，你也经历了不少……相当惊险的冒险经历呢。”

几乎可以看出来，她那深色的皮肤下隐藏着一抹红晕。
        |我觉得你还没有好好做自我介绍呢，”阿兹兰责备道。 

        [pc.dcb
            |我？我啊…… [pc.name]如你所知，只是一个而已。 [pc.class]没什么别的要说的了。
            |这个名字是…… [pc.name]，一个 [pc.class]很高兴见到您。
            |哦！嗯，如你们所知…… [pc.name]真高兴见到你！哦，我叫…… [pc.class] 而且我喜欢在海滩上长时间散步。
        ] 她主动伸出手部来与你握手部，甚至在你还没来得及主动伸出手部之前。她脸上带着一丝淡淡的微笑，握住你的手部后，还轻轻捏了捏你的手部指，然后才松开。

阿兹兰坐立不安地晃动了几秒钟，又重新打量了你一番。 抱歉，我想直接坐下来要求你透露旅行中的所有细节，确实有点奇怪。而且我肯定你还有其他事情要处理……”她终于挺直了身子，又恢复了那温柔的微笑，“有没有什么事情你需要先了解的呢？"
    ]

rows.original: [flags.AZYRRAN_TALK_HIVE |Azyrran’s expression becomes immediately stormy. "As of yet, there has been no change for good or ill. I suffer with that every day, and do what little I can to ensure my sisters do not harm the innocent." |"So... what is the deal with your hive?" you ask. And judging by the miserable expression on her face, you almost regret the question. "My sisters, my queen... they’ve changed. It began as a promise from that— that demon to our queen, magic to help us create more honey. My hive is small and poor; we have often struggled to feed ourselves. We often have to resort to our martial skill to secure provisions for hard winters. The demon's whispers were worth her weight in gold... if they had not been full of venom. Things quickly spun out of control. I was away when the worst changes occurred, investigating the nearby ruins for useful metal we could reforge into weapons. I was waylaid by mutating plants in the night, and then effigies began to appear..." She gulps and trembles, squeezing her hands together. "By the time I returned, that same corruption was waiting for me at home." "Apparently my Queen, my mother... has become Queen in name only compared to this monster. My sisters did not take long to change. They are less independent than we Hive Knights, easily swayed by the Queen's moods. When the demon's magic worked itself upon her, they all but tripped over themselves to follow suit." ]
rows.translation: [flags.AZYRRAN_TALK_HIVE |阿兹兰的表情立刻变得阴沉起来。“到目前为止，情况还没有发生任何好转或恶化的变化。我每天都在为此苦恼，也在尽自己所能去确保我的姐妹们不会伤害无辜的人。 |那么……你们的蜂群到底发生了什么？”你问道。从她脸上那痛苦的表情来看，你几乎后悔提出了这个问题。 “我的姐妹们，我的女王……她们变了。这一切都始于那个人的一个承诺…… 恶魔 献给我们的女王，这种魔法能帮助我们生产更多的蜂蜜。我的蜂巢很小，资源也很匮乏；我们常常难以获得足够的食物来维持生存。在严冬来临之际，我们常常不得不依靠自己的武艺来获取生存所需的物资。而那个恶魔的低语，确实价值连城。…如果它们没有充满毒性的话。事情很快便失控了。最糟糕的变化发生时，我并不在场——当时我正在附近的废墟中寻找可以重新锻造成武器的有用金属。夜里，那些变异植物阻住了我的去路，随后那些雕像也开始出现了。她咽了口唾沫，双手颤抖着说道：‘当我回到家时，同样的腐败已经在我家里等待着我。’” “显然，我的女王，我的母亲……与这个怪物相比，她只不过是名义上的女王罢了。 我的姐妹们很快就改变了态度。她们没有我们这些蜂骑士那么独立，很容易受到女王情绪的影响。当恶魔的魔法开始对她起作用时，她们几乎争先恐后地跟了上去。" ]

她把瓶子递给你，让你尝一口，当你品尝时，会感受到那种浓郁、醇厚的口感；这种酒完全可以与这个国家最上等的茶叶和蛋糕一起享用。 阿兹兰听到你脸上流露出的无言赞美，顿时脸红了，她迅速把那些果实紧紧地包起来，再用一根细丝带将其固定好。“太完美了……哦！还有，那些女仆们也拿了一些去制作糖果了。 [var0|我相信您的孩子们一定会非常高兴的！|这里的所有年轻女孩都会对此感到非常高兴的。]这已经不是第一次了，在走进女王的寝室之前，阿兹兰总会伸出手部来帮助你。房间的一切依旧和往常一样，只不过那些散发着温暖香气的蜡烛让整个空间显得格外温馨舒适。..它甚至还能掩盖那种浓重的“该死”气息。尼泽拉，以她那丰满的身材和迷人的姿态，坐起来朝你愉快地挥了挥手部：“你好，勇士！还想再来点‘该死’的体验吗？” 阿兹兰立刻结结巴巴地拒绝了，从你手部中挣脱开来，脸上还带着红晕。 "[pc.HeShe] 帮我跑了一些杂务，我只是觉得……嗯，你可能会愿意帮忙吧。 [pc.himHer] 请与我们分享吧。” 女王的微笑灿烂而迷人，她在宽大的沙发上腾出了一些空间。已经有几名侍女拿着热饮走了过来；事实上，她们似乎还带来了一台小型金属炉子，用来保持茶壶里的茶水始终处于热的状态。 一旦你坐下来并且得到了所需的一切，尼泽拉就会轻拍你的膝盖，示意阿兹兰也过来坐下……毕竟，这是她的家。这位蜂群骑士坐在你身上，而你则将手部臂环绕在她的腰间。“那么，”尼泽拉开始说道。 我最喜欢的小英雄最近在忙些什么呢？ 阿兹兰灿烂地微笑着，将手部中的瓶子放在大腿之间。“这个……这是给你的……我想你了，所以想送你一些特别的东西。” 女王眨了几下眼睛，然后用她那由几节甲壳构成的手部指轻轻拿起了那个瓶子。 还是温热的……你这是刚弄好的吗？”当阿兹兰点头表示肯定时，女王轻轻拧开瓶盖，闻了闻。她闭上眼睛，满意地叹了口气：“哦，亲爱的孩子，我敢说，你在制作蜂蜜方面的本领，和你在成为一名骑士方面的才能一样出色啊。她把空着的那只手部放在阿兹兰的头上，轻轻揉着它的耳朵，同时从蜂蜜瓶中取出一口蜂蜜品尝。 当女王再次睁开眼睛时，她脸上绽放出的笑容如此灿烂，仿佛能让你的胃都跟着一起跳动起来，然后她将你们俩紧紧拥入怀中。“这真是太棒的惊喜了！我从来没尝过用这些花朵制成的蜂蜜！你们一定要告诉我是从哪里弄来的！ 你沉浸在那个拥抱中——几乎被尼泽拉那甜美的胸部挤得面都快不见啦——然后解释说，那是来自阿尔劳奈的；那些雕像的幕后主使。 “啊……也许我得找个时间去拜访她一趟。”她坏笑着说道。 哦，天啊，千万别这样…… 听到这话，她忍不住笑了起来，然后轻轻拍了拍你的头：“哦，别这么担心啦！我真的不会那么做的。如果我把她带走的话，会破坏这里的力量平衡的……我确实得注意保持这种平衡才行。 一些 那些东西……”她小声嘟囔着，“不过也许我的一些女孩应该去见见她那些所谓的‘偶像’……” 你捏了捏她的胳膊，只换来她又一次的咯咯笑声。随后，她便和你还有阿兹兰一起，舒服地蜷缩在沙发上。 不过这样也挺好的！你知道吗，你是唯一一个坐在我的沙发上，而目的并不是为了做爱的人……”片刻之后，她咬了咬撅起的嘴唇继续说道，“不过，我相信我们还是可以改变这个状况的。空气中浓烈的催情香气令人垂涎欲滴，但幸运的是——或者也许并不幸运——这时一名侍女端着一盘点心和额外的饮料走了过来，打断了你的思绪。 蜂蜜酒吗？糖果吗？”她带着友好的微笑问道。 [var0 |糖果！”这个清脆悦耳的声音在女王的寝室里回荡，一群身披睡衣、覆盖着绒毛的小黄蜂嗡嗡地飞了过来。你惊讶地发现，它们身上仍然带着那道…… [pc.hairColor] rows.raw: ' By the time you reach the hive’s entrance once more, a chill wind begins to breathe its way through the crisp evening air. You grumble and bear it, taking a few extra moments to pull yourself together before stepping up to the guards. The hive knights there have great big fuzzy scarves on, and warm smiles on their face as they sip from steaming drinks. "Hi [pc.name]! Knight Azyrran said you were coming over, please, get out of the cold!" One of them pulls you into a bubbly hug, sneaking a kiss on your lips before letting you go. It’s surprising to see the hive so full; knights and drones travel to-and-fro, in a literal buzz of motion. You’re quickly escorted up to the handmaiden’s chambers, where your own knightly friend is waiting for you with a smile on her face... and some considerably less-full tits. Azyrran proudly holds a bottle of thick-looking honey, with little pollen-y flakes floating around in it. "Took a few, uh, filterings to get it even like this! But I was in such a hurry. What do you think? I haven’t corked it yet." She holds the bottle out to you in order to take a sip, and when you do so you’re met with lush thickness; this could be served alongside the finest teas and cakes in the land. Azyrran blushes at the wordless praise on your face, corking it up tightly and wrapping a thin silken ribbon around it. "That’s perfect. Oh! Also the handmaidens took some to make candy with. [var0|I’m sure your children will be delighted!|All of the younger girls around here will be very happy with it all.]" Not for the first time, Azyrran offers her arm to you before walking through the door to the Queen’s chambers. It looks much as it always does, although warm spice-scented candles keep the whole room feeling warm and pleasant... it even helps to cover up the heavy-duty fuck scent. Nyzerrah, in all of her massive, bimbo-licious glory sits up and gives you a cheerful little wave. "Hello champion! Come for more fucking?" Azyrran immediately stammers out a no, slipping from your grasp and blushing. "[pc.HeShe] helped me run some errands, I just thought that, well... you’d like [pc.himHer] to share with us." The Queen’s smile is a radiant thing, and she makes some space on her expansive sofa. A couple of handmaidens are already approaching with hot drinks; in fact it looks like they’ve brought a little metal standing-stove for keeping a teapot prepared. Once you’re seated and provided for, Nyzerrah pats your lap in order to invite Azyrran to sit in it... and fair enough, it’s her home. The hive knight seats herself on you, and you wrap an arm around her waist. "So then," Nyzerrah begins. "What has my favorite little champion been up to?" Azyrran smiles brightly, resting the bottle in her hands between her thighs. "This. This is for you... I missed you, and wanted to give you something special." The Queen blinks a few times, gently plucking up the bottle with a tic-tic of chitinous digits. "Still warm; did you make this just now?" When Azyrran nods, the Queen gently pops the cork and takes a sniff. Her eyes drift closed and a satisfied sigh passes her lips. "Oh dear sweetling, I daresay you make as fine a producer of honey as you do a knight." She places her free hand on Azyrran’s head, rubbing one of her ears delicately while taking a mouthful from the honey bottle. When the Queen’s eyes open up once more she’s beaming with a smile powerful enough to make your own stomach flip-flop over before pulling you both into a hug. "This is such a wonderful surprise. I haven’t tasted honey from these flowers ever before! You must tell me where you got it from!" You settle into the hug — nearly losing your face in Nyzerrah’s sweet tits — and explain that it was from the Alraune; the boss of the effigies. "Aah... I might have to pay her a visit some time." she muses with a wicked smile. Oh gods no... A giggle bubbles up out of her at that, and she pats you on the head instead now. "Oh don’t be such a little worrier! I wouldn’t really, we’d mess up the ecos... ec— uh, balance, of power around here if I went and plucked her up. I do have to keep an eye out for some things..." she quietens down to a mumble. "Although maybe some of my girls should meet these effigies of hers..." You pinch her arm, only earning another giggle before she cuddles up on the sofa with you and Azyrran properly. "This is nice though! Did you know you’re the only person who has sat on my sofa without it being for the express purpose of fucking?" she nibbles a pouting lip a moment later. "Although we could change that yet again, I’m sure." The redoubling of powerful fuck-aphrodisiac scent in the air is enough to make your mouth water, but you’re thankfully — or perhaps unthankfully — interrupted by a handmaiden arriving with a plate of treats and extra drink. "Mead? Candies?" she offers with a helpful smile. [var0 |"Candies!" The sound that trills through the Queen’s chambers is a bright and sun-shiney thing, and a scattering of fuzz-covered, nightgown-wearing hornetlings buzz into view. You’re surprised to find they still have that streak of [pc.hairColor] in their hair that you’ve come to associate with the ebon streak of the demon Kas’ own gift in Nyzzy... before that thought can brew any further you’re being hugged by the face once your children realize you're in the Queen’s room. "[pc.mf|Daddy|Mommy]!" they cry in delight. "What are you doing here?" one asks before you shower her with little kisses that have her squealing and buzzing away out of reach. "What, you didn’t think you were asked up here just for sweets did you?" asks the tray-bearing handmaiden, swapping the heavily-laden sheet off to one hand so that she can adjust her hair... it also serves to remind you of how delightfully muscular they are. Mnf. Thankfully there are plenty of treats to go around, and you do your best to make sure your children feel loved. They grow up fast; incredibly fast... but hopefully they’ll always be this happy to see you. Nyzerrah too — despite her bubbly bimbo-ness — appears every part the loving mother, although she does have the natural benefit of loyalty-enhancing pheromones or... something. It certainly seems that way. Sadly even a bellyful of sugary treats can’t keep the young girls awake for long, and their clinging to you becomes more of a doze-y snuggle. One of the handmaidens returns with fresh drinks, trading off her carried goods in order to gently scoop up your children. They nestle into her chest and cling instinctively to her muscular frame, buzzing quietly. "I’ll take them to bed now." the handmaiden explains with a grin, nuzzling up into the hair of one and giving her a little kiss when she giggles. |You pluck one of them up as you’re handed the hot drink, opting to snuggle up in Nyzerrah’s expansive cleavage where it’s nice and warm. The candies have just now started to harden, and so they melt in your mouth moments later. Your tongue quickly feels like it’s been coated in sweetness, fragrant and floral. ] '

rows.original: Once it’s just you, Azzy, and the Queen, your time together becomes something quiet, peaceful, and snuggly. After a ravaging sexual encounter in the woods, it’s rather a surprise when Nyzerrah doesn’t make a move on you; if anything she goes out of her way to resist her fuck-hungry impulses in order to pet and play with your [pc.ears] and [pc.hasHair|hair|scalp] while you all relax. As drinks empty themselves, and warm satisfaction overrides the scent of sex and desire you find that blankets are brought in. Nyzerrah’s own are enormous thick things laced with threadgold and silver, Azzy’s own blanket is rather... adorable. Striped like a hornet and covered in little stitched hearts, made of wool instead of silk. The Queen grins and puts a 'shush'-ing finger to her lips when the knight falls asleep first. "Usually she would have to go off to her own bed, but she’s such a little cutie-bootie... I suppose she can stay." her other hand strokes Azyrran’s hair softly, not stopping until your caramel cuddlebug begins to snore quietly. Thankfully for you, sleep comes soon after, pressed up in a faceful of perfect tit and soft fuzzy blankets.

            It takes serious, concerted effort to slip out of their grasp without waking either hornet — and you certainly catch a few squirts of honey in the face — but you manage in the end. The morning has stolen away some of the chill of the previous evening thankfully, and by the time you make it down to the hive’s entrance you’ve been kissed and hugged by just about every bimbo hornet in the hive. rows.original: Pacing down one of the many old trails that wind their way through the Old Forest, you pause as your sense of smell is suddenly assaulted by an overwhelming, cloying and above all sweet scent. You'd thought you'd gotten accustomed to the enticing smells the forest's corrupted plant life had on offer, but this is something else — similar, yet different at the same time. More intense. More concentrated. And as your eyes adjust to the dim light of this particularly gloomy patch of forest, the source of the scent is revealed. Kneeling by the side of the forest trail is a trio of hornet-girls, busy at gathering all the sweet nectar they can get their fuzzy hands on. You'd heard of insect-folk living in the forest, bee and hornet alike — before the snowstorm, they supposedly came to trade with Hawkethorne, honey and wax for things they couldn't make themselves. These, though... sure, this particular trio appears insectile enough, but that's where the similarity to the stories ends. As they stop sucking off cock-vines and lapping at lewdly-shaped flowers to turn their wide, vacuous gazes in your direction, you're afforded a good look at them. Gentle, tapered faces with deeply inset and pupilless black eyes suggest at what they might once have been before corruption got to them; antennae jut from their heads amidst a head of long, curly and fuzzy blonde %"hair" that looks completely out of place on an insect. The more you study the hornet girls, the more you think — no, you're certain they're little more than empty-headed bimbos at this point. rows.raw: ' [flags.HORNET_PT_2 |The scent of honey greets you even before you see yet another trio of armor-clad hive knights tromping down the forest trail in single file, a friendly yet decidedly military air about them. Spotting you, the hornets throw you [party.has azyrran |and Azyrran ]a smart salute, their stiletto chitin boots clicking together smartly even as you acknowledge them with a nod[party.has azyrran | and Azyrran salutes back ].[var0 | A little while later, one of Queen Nyzerrah's luscious handmaidens brings up the rear, serene and peaceable in contrast to the knights' disciplined demeanor. ] Out patrolling the forest again, then? [var0 |"Indeed," the handmaiden replies. "Things have gotten to the point where the Queen has seen fit to assign some of her personal handmaidens to support the knights in their endeavor. The imps have been growing fiercer by the day, with some of them even learning to wield rudimentary magic against our knights — magics of the perverse sort, of course. Hence our presence amongst our sister knights." Well then, you'll have to thank them for keeping the forest safer than it would be otherwise, not just for their own but for other people in the bargain. While it won't get rid of the imps and other troublemakers, at least the trails should be traversable with such lovely ladies on patrol. "High praise from the savior of our hive," the handmaiden replies with a nod. "You flatter us. In that case, Savior, would you allow my sisters and I to test ourselves against you? It would be an honor to challenge someone who has bested the queen herself in combat, and teach us many things; imps slake my sisters' thirst for combat, but little else. I understand that my sisters have made you an offer in the past... and it still stands, if that's your desire." |"That's right," one of the knights replies. "Our duty is to keep the hive's environs safe so that our sisters can gather... there is no end of honey these days, but as the Queen says, one cannot live on honey alone." [rand |"I'd never thought I'd say this, but I'm actually getting quite sick of having so much honey about," another of the knights chips in with a sigh. "We don't need to go raiding the bees any more... imps still put up a reasonable fight, but they're not as fun as messing with the bees." |"That's right," another of the knights chips in. I understand that my sisters have made you an offer in the past... and it still stands, if that's your desire." ] [party.has azyrran |"If my sisters are ensuring the safety of everyone in this part of the woods, it'd be best to keep them sharp and on their toes, [pc.name]," Azyrran adds. There's honey to be had if you win... and maybe eggs if you lose. |As you pace down the forest trail, a scent that's familiar to you by now hits your nose: hornet honey. Indeed, as you draw closer to the source, a trio of chitin-clad figures appears from the underbrush, coming towards you as you make your way down the path; the hornet-girls each throw you [party.has azyrran |and Azyrran ]a crisp salute as you come within hailing range, keeping a respectful distance. Their heavy black chitin armor gleams in the dim [dayNight |light that filters in through the canopy |moonlight ], making them look every part the knight even as it shows off their curvaceous bodies. Even after purification, it looks like some effects of Kasyrra's corruption still linger within the hive... not that it's entirely a bad thing. [party.has azyrran |"Well met, sister," one of the hive knights says to Azzy. "Out on the queen's business with our savior, aren't you?" "Right. And what are you three doing here?" |"Well met, savior of the hive," one of the knights says to you. "All in Queen Nyzerrah's realm know of your heroic actions in restoring us to our senses and saving us from the demon's influence." Now isn't that nice, to finally get some recognition at last. Ahem. What are they doing here, then? ] "Out on patrol. Ever since we've regained our senses, we've discovered that the usual threats of the forest have either grown in strength or being outright replaced with nuisances of a different nature — roving gangs of imps, for example. The Queen's ordered the patrols doubled, and none of the drones are to head out alone or even in pairs. Always at least three." She gestures first to herself, then to her sisters. Sounds like a smart idea. Well, if there's nothing else, you'll be on your way, then. "There is one matter..." another of the hive knights pipes up, clearing her throat uncertainly. That being? Well, the question has to be asked, but judging by the blushes on their faces, the way they're looking down at their feet and the fact that one of them is tapping her chitin-gauntleted fingers together, you can already guess at the answer. "We'd like to challenge [party.has azyrran |the both of you." Azzy claps her hands together. "I'm not against a little rough and tumble if [pc.name] thinks [pc.heShe] can spare the time. Keep the lot of you sharp, as it were. How about it, [pc.name]?" |you." ] That... might not have quite been what you were expecting, but in a way, after coming to know Azyrran, combat definitely has several sexual undertones to it if her sister knights work the same way she does. Why do they want to fight you, though? You managed to defeat their queen... wouldn't they just be throwing themselves against a proverbial brick wall? "Well, we don't get stronger by going up against enemies weaker than us — we don't learn anything that way. You've got to challenge people stronger and smarter than yourself if you're going to improve any. Isn't that right[party.has azyrran |, sister?" Azzy nods slowly. "They're not wrong, [pc.name]. And besides, it would be a honor to go up against you." |?" ] You have to admit that what they're saying does make some sense.[silly | After all, you can't assume that these girls are running on an XP system of advancement like you are. ] And what do you get out of it? "Well..." as one, the trio of hive knights lower their weapons and raise their hands to their bosoms, bound just to prevent the head-sized, honey-filled jugs from jiggling everywhere and getting in the way. It's clear that they're still getting used to having all that extra weight hanging about on their chests, although they seem to like it a lot despite the encumbrance. "We'll give you some of our honey if you win. There's just so much of it in the hive these days, it's starting to get a little embarrassing." "That, and if you'd like to grace us with your presence after a show of strength, we wouldn't mind in the least." And if you lose... The trio of hive knights say nothing, but the glint of venom on their ovipositors catches your eye. No doubt the queen's stuffed them full of eggs to be doling out to those they defeat in honorable combat... [party.has azyrran |"Sounds like a fair proposition to me, even if I'm obviously biased," Azzy says to you, a glint in her eye. "How about it, [pc.name]?" |"Well, what do you say?" ] ] '

rows.original: "We yield! We yield!" Panting and very much out of breath, the hive knights slowly rise from their knees, their faces reddened from no small amount of exertion... and by the looks of it, arousal. Fighting really turns these girls on, doesn't it?[var0 |Thankfully, their sister handmaiden is around to soothe them, kiss their hurts, and make them all feel better — quite literally so while you're watching, and without reservation or shame. "There, there," she coos as she tends to her knightly sisters. "Doesn't that sting a lot less now?" ] [party.has azyrran |"Come on, sisters, on your feet!" Azyrra shouts. "You're all Mother's elite — you've got more in you than this! You're hive knights!" ] Well, you've emerged the victor in all of this; given the time that you've spent on instructing them, hopefully they've learned something from this bout. "And as promised, your compensation." Reaching into a small bag at her waist, one of the hive knights produces two small jars of honey. "You've given us much to reflect upon, savior of our hive." You gain two hornet honey. rows.translation: 当你沿着古老的森林小径前行时，突然感觉到有些事情不对劲…… [pc.ra lupine|风中飘来的一丝气息，或许，只有你那敏锐的猎狼鼻才能闻出来。|阴影的移动，当地野生动物突然陷入的寂静……]即使考虑到旧森林目前的状况，这也足以让你保持警惕了。你手部指着…… [pc.weapon] 当你小心翼翼地注视着那些高大的树枝和茂密的灌木丛时。 [pc.bg hunter|在这样的荒野中积累了多年的生存经验，让你能够敏锐地察觉到即将到来的危险——尽管你还不确定这种危险究竟来自何处。 什么 那就是另一个完全不同的问题了……] [party.hasCompanions|你也有同样的感觉， [pc.name]?" [flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER|你立刻认出了他们的真实身份：都是拥有狐狸特征的人，就像清子一样。他们的穿着风格或许有些不同，但本质上是相同的。不过，恐怕并不是所有人都像她那样友善吧……] 非常抱歉。我们必须做任何必要的事情来生存。请放心，我们并没有想要杀死你们，但我们也明白，我们不能空手部而归。” 森林中的灌木丛中传来沙沙声，又有一个那些有着狐妖外貌的生物出现了——这一次，它有四条尾巴而不是两条——它手部持一支带刃的长矛，矛头直指你的方向。 他的穿着风格与弗罗斯特边境地区常见的服饰有所不同——和另外两个强盗一样，他穿着一件看起来像长袍的衣服。不过，这件衣服上缝制了保暖的毛皮和厚实的布料，这说明这三个人也并非完全的外来者。 如果这能让你感觉好一些的话，我，日向，承诺有朝一日会以同样的方式偿还我们从你这里夺走的一切。” 又两支箭呼啸着划过空中，落在了你的足部边；显然，如果你打算进行谈判的话，现在就是时机。 他到底想要什么？硬币吗？ 一阵苦笑，然后摇了摇头。“啊……不是。是黄金、宝石，那些装饰品……看着确实很漂亮，但它们填不饱肚子，也不能提供真正的营养。 如果你身上带着食物，我们就吃那些；否则，还有…… 替代方案……” 他们周围有一整片森林，却还要用这种方式拦截过路的旅行者？他们看起来明明应该是那种能够依靠森林资源生存的人啊。至少，那些弓应该用来猎取野兽，而不是用来对付人类才对。 快过来，别犯傻了。这片森林已经变了，受到了某种邪恶力量的影响。我的下属们都不敢去摘那些树枝上的果实，也不敢吃地里长出来的东西，平时常见的猎物也变得少得可怜。那些花朵分泌出的花蜜散发着恶臭，而考虑到那些被这些花蜜影响后的生物的遭遇，我们能够保持原状，全都是因为凯罗斯的恩典。 [silly|要是你不加小心、不考虑后果就随便拿东西往嘴里塞，那你简直就是个白痴。] 好了，我可没时间听这些闲话。你是愿意让我们拿我们需要的东西，还是非要强迫我们不可？ [party.has brint arona cait | [party.has arona|如果他们想打架，那他们就一定会得到他们想要的战斗，”阿罗娜低沉地说道，“相信我吧…… [pc.name] 如果你喂这些狡猾的家伙，它们下次还会再来索要更多。不过，只要狠狠地敲打它们的头部，它们就会学会远离你。再说，如果你想从我这里得到帮助，威胁可不是正确的办法。] [party.has cait|我并不是专家，但是他们…… 做 他们看起来不仅衣衫褴褛，而且明显营养不良，”凯特补充道。“他们可能在其他事情上也在撒谎，但至少他们并不是因为饿才这样。你觉得我们有没有必要把我们手头的东西分给他们一些呢？] [party.has brint|现在，别再拿‘是你逼我这么做的’这种说辞来搪塞了。 卡克就在你身后，”布林特说道，他的双手随时准备在必要时出手。“你站在这里，就是选择了当强盗。我可不记得自己曾经有过拦截路人、抢走他们食物的举动…… 我 快要饿死了。] | [companion1.hasTags reserved|一方面，我能够理解这三个人目前所处的困境。 [companion1.name] 她沉思道：“当他们声称自己不想要金钱时，这确实反映了他们话中的真实性……但同时，他们请求慈善的方式也未免有些欠妥，你不觉得吗？最终，这个决定还是由你来做吧。 [pc.name]."] [companion1.hasTags aggressive|我可不会轻易交出我们的东西！ [companion1.name] 他惊呼道，脸上露出痛苦的表情。 [companion1.hisHer] 如果他们需要帮助，本可以好好请求的—— [pc.name]你总不会就这样屈服于他们的要求吧？] [companion1.hasTags playful|哦，所以他们想玩游戏吗？我随时都愿意陪他们玩！ [companion1.name] 一边说着，一边旋转着 [companion1.hisHer] [companion1.weapon] 关于。 [companion1.HeShe] 他肯定没有把这件事当回事……这其实也不足为奇，但毕竟还是挺让人意外的！] ] 正如人们所说，现在主动权在你手部里。对于这些目前就摆在你面前的“狐妖人”，你打算如何应对呢？
rows.raw: " You're pacing down the ancient forest trail when you suddenly get the sense that something's off — [pc.ra lupine|a scent in the wind, perhaps, distinct to your keen lupine nose|a shift of the shadows, a sudden stillness in the local wildlife]. Even considering the current state of the Old Forest, that's reason enough for you to be on guard, and you finger your [pc.weapon] warily as you eye the tall boughs and thick undergrowth. [pc.bg hunter|A lifetime of experience in wildernesses like these has taught you well, and you're certain of imminent danger — although from what is another question altogether...] [party.hasCompanions|"You feel it too, [pc.name]?" [companion1.name] whispers as you pace forward in measured steps. "I don't think we're alone."] Your attention is drawn by a stretching sound of elastic tautness — [pc.bg hunter|one that you only know too well as that of a drawn bowstring|you're not sure what it is, but your instincts kick in, saving you right there and then]. Throwing yourself forward, you [party.som|hit the ground in a roll|pull [companion1.name] down to the ground with you|yell for [companion1.name] and [companion2.name] to duck] as an arrow whistles through the air where you stood just a moment ago, burying its point into a nearby tree. Readying your [pc.weapon], you gaze upwards into the forest canopy where the arrow came from — and perched in the branches are two figures, perfectly human save for the pair of fox ears perched atop their heads, and as many tails swaying behind them. Each one's already got another arrow nocked and ready to loose as you pull yourself to your feet, [party.som|gritting your teeth|helping [companion1.name] up as you stand|yelling for [companion1.name] and [companion2.name] to get up and look alive]. [flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER|At once, you recognize them for what they are: kitsune, fox-featured people, just like Kiyoko. Slightly different style of dress, perhaps, but indisputably the same. Guess not all of them are as friendly as she is...] "My apologies. We do what we must to survive. Don't worry, we don't intend to kill you, but do understand we don't intend to leave empty-handed, either." The forest undergrowth rustles, and another one of those foxy folk — this time with four tails instead of two — steps out onto the trail, a bladed spear in his hands and its business end pointed directly at you. His style of dress is a little different from what one would usually find in the Frost Marches — like the other two bandits, he's clothed in what looks like a long robe. Warm furs and heavy fabrics have been worked into the clothing, though, suggesting that these three aren't complete foreigners, either. "If it makes you feel any better, I, Hinata, promise to someday repay what we take from you in equal measure." Two more arrows whistle through the air and land at your feet; it's becoming apparent that if you intend to parley, the time for that is now. What exactly does he want? Coin? A bitter laugh, and a shake of the head. "Ah... no. Gold and gems, trinkets and baubles... pretty enough to look at, but they won't fill hungry stomachs... or otherwise provide sustenance. If you have any food on you, we will be having that; otherwise, there are... alternatives..." There's a whole forest around them, and they need to waylay travelers like this? Surely they look like the kind who could live off the land. At the very least, those bows could be turned towards game rather than people. "Come now, don't be obtuse. The forest, it has changed, touched by a fell influence. Neither of my subordinates dare taste fruit from the bough nor what grows in the soil, and the usual game has grown alarmingly scarce. Flowers drip vile nectar, and seeing what it has done to the hornet-folk, it is only by the grace of Keros that we remain untainted. [silly|You'd have to be an idiot to pick things up and put them in your mouth without care or concern.] "Now then, I tire of idle talk. Will you allow us to take what we need, or shall you force our hand?" [party.has brint arona cait | [party.has arona|"If it's a fight they want, it's a fight they're going to get," Arona says with a grunt. "Take it from me, [pc.name] — if you feed these foxy bastards, they'll just come back for more next time. Clobber them hard over the head, though, and they'll learn to stay away. 'Sides, if you want charity from me, threats aren't the way to go about doing it."] [party.has cait|"I'm no expert, but they do look more than a little bedraggled and malnourished," Cait adds. "They might be lying about something else, but it's not about going hungry, at the very least. Do you think it might be worth sharing anything we have?"] [party.has brint|"Now, don't go about with this whole 'you made me do it' khaak," Brint says from behind you, his hands ready to draw at a moment's notice. "You're standing here, you made the choice to be bandits. I sure don't remember resorting to waylaying people and stealing their food when I was going hungry."] | [companion1.hasTags reserved|"On one hand, I can understand the straits which this trio have found themselves in," [companion1.name] muses. "It speaks to the truth of their words when they say they don't want money... but at the same time, their method of requesting charity is rather ill-advised, don't you think? Ultimately, I leave the decision to you, [pc.name]."] [companion1.hasTags aggressive|"I'm not just going to hand over our stuff!" [companion1.name] exclaims, a grimace on [companion1.hisHer] face. "If they wanted help, they could've asked nicely — [pc.name], you aren't just going to give in to their demands like that, are you?"] [companion1.hasTags playful|"Oh, so they want to play? I'm up for a game anytime!" [companion1.name] says, twirling [companion1.hisHer] [companion1.weapon] about. [companion1.HeShe] sure isn't taking this very seriously... which shouldn't come as a surprise, but still!] ] As they say, the ball's in your court here. What are you going to do with these fox-people currently in your face?"

rows.original: Despite the way they're asking, you can understand there's someone in need here.
rows.translation: 尽管他们的提问方式有些特别，但你可以看出，这里确实有人需要帮助。
rows.raw: "Despite the way they're asking, you can understand there's someone in need here."

rows.original: You're not giving up anything of yours! Fight them!
rows.translation: 你并没有放弃自己的任何东西！与他们战斗吧！
rows.raw: "You're not giving up anything of yours! Fight them!"

rows.original: Holding out your hands palms forward, you take a step towards the trio. All right, you can understand their situation here. Food, was it? The leader of the trio — the one who called himself Hinata — nods, lowers his bladed spear, and moves to meet you halfway on the forest trail. The archers in the trees don't budge, though, and their arrows are still trained on you as the two of you come within arm's length of each other. "Yuzu, Kiri, hold. As to what I meant, traveler, it couldn't be more clear. Food, victuals, sustenance. We're not picky, so long as it doesn't carry any of the taint that pervades the forest." Hinata looks a little pensive and scratches his stubbly chin. "Ah, such trouble for the want of a simple bite of bread!" He mentioned alternatives. What did he mean by that? "Hmm..." the fox-person eyes you, clearly considering something. After a moment or two, he shrugs. "It can't get any worse, so why not? If you would rather keep your provisions, we can feed directly off your life-force." [flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER 2 |Just like Kiyoko asked... Hinata's expression is stony. "You appear to be taking this in stride; you must have considerable mental fortitude. I'm impressed." No, it's just that you've met another kitsune before, and she made a similar offer. The concept isn't exactly new to you. "I imagine she was in worse straits than I am in now, to reveal that fact so freely. Most don't take well to the very idea. It makes them squeamish." She was. |He what? Hinata looks away, although you notice he's still watching you out of the corner of his eyes. "I said, if you would rather us not commandeer your provisions, we can feed directly off your life-force." [party.has cait|Even Cait's looking a little unsure at this. "I don't know if this is the best idea, [pc.name]. To hear it put so plainly, it's..." He snorts. "Disturbing? Unsettling? Maybe. But it is what it is, and we are what we are."] How exactly does this process work? ] "Neither my subordinates nor I won't take anything of that nature you won't freely give of your own accord. That's important. As for how, sex is usually the most pleasant way to go about it. I mean, I could rip it straight out from you, but that would be most uncomfortable indeed." Hinata sighs and leans on his bladed spear, looking up at his subordinates. "Here you are doing me a favor, and I'm contriving to sabotage myself by scaring you off... please, just make your decision already. We're hungry." [party.has arona| You feel a tap on your shoulder, and turn to find Arona glowering at you. "I don't like appeasing these gingertails. Better to knock their heads and teach 'em a lesson! But since you said you're going to help them, I say get to fuckin'. Put on a show for me, huh?" ]
rows.translation: 你双手部掌心向前，朝那三人走去。嗯，你现在应该能理解他们的处境了——他们是来讨要食物的吧？ 那三人的领头者——那个自称“日向”的人——点了点头，放下了他的长矛，然后在森林小路上与你迎面而来。不过，藏在树上的那些弓箭手部们依然没有动，他们的箭依然对准着你，就在你们两人距离只有几步之遥的时候。 柚子、切里，等等。关于我的意思，旅行者，已经再清楚不过了。食物、粮食、养料——我们并不挑剔，只要这些东西没有带着那股弥漫在整个森林中的污秽气息就行。 日向看起来有些若有所思，他挠了挠自己短短的胡茬。 啊，就因为想吃一口简单的面包，竟然惹来了这么多麻烦！ 他提到了其他选择。他这么说是什么意思呢？ 嗯…… 那个狐妖人盯着你看，显然在思考着什么。过了一两分钟，他耸了耸肩。 情况已经不能再糟了，所以为什么不呢？如果你更愿意保留自己的储备，我们可以直接吸取你的生命力来维持生存。 [flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER 2 |正如清子所问的…… 日向的表情冰冷而僵硬。 你似乎能够冷静应对这一切，想必你拥有相当强的心理素质。我真的很佩服你。 不，只是你之前曾经遇到过另一只狐妖，她也向你提出了类似的提议。这个想法对你来说其实并不陌生。 我想，她当时的处境一定比我现在更糟糕，才能如此坦然地透露那个事实。大多数人根本无法接受这个想法，这会让他们感到不适。 她确实是。 |他什么？ 日向将视线移开，不过你可以看出，他仍在用眼角的余光注视着你。 我说过，如果你宁愿我们不夺取你的补给，我们也可以直接吸取你的生命力来维持生存。 [party.has cait|就连凯特看起来也有点不确定该怎么做。 我不知道这是否真的是个好主意…… [pc.name]听你这么直白地说出来，其实…… 他哼了一声。 令人不安？令人惶恐？也许吧。但事实就是如此，我们也是这样的。] 这个过程究竟是如何运作的呢？ ] 无论是我的下属还是我，都不会接受任何你并非出于自愿、主动给予的东西。这一点非常重要。至于如何实现，性通常是最令人愉悦的方式。我的意思是，我也可以强行从你那里得到它，但那样确实会让你感到非常不适。 日向叹了口气，靠在锋利的长矛上，抬头看着他的下属们。 你这样帮了我一个忙，而我却故意吓跑你，从而自毁前功……拜托了，赶紧做出决定吧。我们真的饿了。 [party.has arona| 你感到有人轻拍了自己的肩膀，转过头去，发现阿罗娜正怒视着自己。 我可不喜欢讨好这些软弱的人。干脆直接教训他们一顿才对！但既然你说了要帮助他们，那你就给我好好表演一下吧，懂吗？ ]

rows.original: Give the hungry kitsune a portion of your provisions. This will consume one camping supplies.
rows.translation: 把你的一些食物分给那些饥饿的狐妖吧。这样做会消耗一份露营用品。
rows.raw: "Give the hungry kitsune a portion of your provisions. This will consume one camping supplies."

rows.original: You don't actually have any food on you at the moment... try not to get into the habit of making promises you can't keep.
rows.translation: 你现在身上其实一点食物都没有……尽量别养成做出自己无法兑现的承诺的习惯。
rows.raw: "You don't actually have any food on you at the moment... try not to get into the habit of making promises you can't keep."

rows.original: Rather than give up any of your provisions, feed the kitsune trio in a more... direct, if pleasurable, manner.
rows.translation: 与其放弃你们手中的任何物资，不如用一种更为直接、也更令人愉悦的方式来喂养那三只狐妖吧。
rows.raw: "Rather than give up any of your provisions, feed the kitsune trio in a more... direct, if pleasurable, manner."

rows.original: Sighing, you dig out some of your more conventional food from your pack and handle the wrapped bundles of wax paper to Hinata. He shakes each one in turn, foxy ears alert and twitching as if trying to detect anything untoward in the packages, but appears satisfied with what he hears. With a sharp whistle and wave of his hand, he signals to the archers in the trees to come down and gather up the fruits of your charity. "I'm indeed quite grateful, [pc.race]." A deep bow. "Might I ask for your name?" Your name? "It seems improper, now that you have shown me kindness despite the circumstances, to not be properly introduced. My name is Hinata Kuroda, and you are?" "[pc.name]." "I will remember this, [pc.name]." By now, the other two fox-people have finished stowing away the food, and Hinata watches them disappear into the undergrowth, following in their wake. "It pains me to have to go so quickly, but if we meet again perhaps we can speak at length on more peaceable terms. Know that the bridge north to the Frostwood is rendered impassable by a rather disturbing creature, which is why we are unable to return home and are reduced to banditry. If you are going that way..." With that, all three kitsune vanish into the roots and shrubs, leaving the path ahead as clear as it once was. [party.has cait| "Wait, what was that about the bridge again?" Cait says, stepping forward, but the kitsune trio have since long gone, slipped away into the forest. "My subordinate here went a little overboard, for which I must apologize most profusely." Yeah, okay, sure. That was... an experience, to say the least. "We have to go now, but I will remember this act of kindness. If you have need of us, we've set up camp by the old elven jetty to the west side of the forest. It's safer there." With that, Hinata gives you a final bow, and the kitsune trio turn to gather up their clothes and things. In the blink of an eye, all three of them are gone, leaving behind only a sensation of utter enervation that hangs about in your entire being. With the high of having touched numerous fluffy tails wearing off, you sure could do with a nap right about now... |"How are you feeling?" Y-you're fine, you promise. Hinata shakes his head. "You don't look fine. Kiri went a little overboard there. If any of the forest's more vicious inhabitants come upon you like this, you won't stand a chance." What should you do, then? "...Come with us to our camp; we'll let you rest there until you're capable of braving the forest again. Given the favor you've just done us, this is the least we can do for you." It doesn't look like the kitsunes are going to take no for an answer, so you allow yourself to be bundled up. Once the kitsunes have gathered up their possessions — and yours, since you're in no shape to carry much — they herd you off into the forest... ] "

rows.original: You've been waylaid by a trio of kitsune wildlings — gold, amber and black alike, intent on robbing you of your food. Lithe, ragged and looking slightly undernourished, each of them wear stony expressions and hard gazes, intent on their grim purpose now that they've committed themselves to their banditry.
rows.translation: 你被三只狐妖野兽给拦住了去路——它们分别是金色、琥珀色和黑色，目的都是抢走你的食物。这些狐妖身形敏捷，衣衫破烂，看起来有些营养不良，但它们的表情严肃，目光坚定，一旦决定了要行窃，就一定会完成这个目标。
rows.raw: "\n    You've been waylaid by a trio of kitsune wildlings — gold, amber and black alike, intent on robbing you of your food. Lithe, ragged and looking slightly undernourished, each of them wear stony expressions and hard gazes, intent on their grim purpose now that they've committed themselves to their banditry."

rows.original: Things aren't going so well for the foxy trio; they're outmatched, and they know it. Using his bladed spear to try and get as much distance between his party and yours, the black-furred kitsune whistles sharply to the archers in the trees, who turn tail and vanish into the forest's thick canopy. He himself lunges into undergrowth, a rapidly disappearing rustle, and [pc.bg hunter|though you're [a] [pc.mf|man|woman] of the woods yourself, this isn't your turf|a quick chase soon proves fruitless, much to your frustration]. You know these people are supposed to be slippery, but that has to be some skill for them to vanish that quickly into cover. It's certainly far more impressive than their attempts at banditry, that's for sure. [party.solo||[party.has cait arona |[party.has cait|"They sure can make like a tree when they put their minds to it," Cait says, shaking her head in the now-still forest. "Are you okay, [pc.name]?" Yeah, you're fine. Just a little aggrieved. "I kind of feel sorry for them, but their situation still isn't an excuse for banditry. Come on, let's get going while the coast's clear — the faster we're through the forest, the less likely we are to bump into them again."] [party.has arona|Arona has little care for the undergrowth, snapping roots and trampling small bushes in her pursuit of the foxy bandits. Eventually, even she has to admit defeat, but not before having left a small trail of destruction in her wake. "Damn it," she snarls, panting heavily she she returns to you. "I swear, I'll turn the lot of them into pelts when I finally get my hands on their furry hides."] |[companion1.hasTags playful slutty|"Ah, if only they could have been a little friendlier. Or maybe if you could have been a little friendlier, [pc.name]." [companion1.name] looks out wistfully into the forest and heaves a small sigh. "They had such fluffy tails, I really, really wanted to pet them." Seriously? Those three were willing to rob [companion1.himHer], and all [companion1.heShe] can think of is petting fluffy tail? "That's why I said if they were a little friendlier. Seriously, [pc.name] — with horrors all around us, you need to pay a little more attention to the fluffier things if you're going to keep your wits from being bent all over."] [companion1.hasTags aggressive|"Damn it," [companion1.name] says, eyeing the underbrush suspiciously, as if a pair of fluffy fox ears might pop out any moment. "How do they move so fast through woods as thick as these? I swear, if they get away again..." Given how they're clearly far more familiar with this stretch of the woods than either of you are, you're pretty sure that's going to happen should you have the misfortune to run into that trio again. [companion1.name] says nothing, but glowers and smashes a fist into [companion1.hisHer] palm.] ]] Now that the commotion's died down somewhat, you take a moment to check the ground where the fight took place. The kitsunes might not have much, but maybe something got dropped in the scuffle...
rows.translation: 对于这个由三只狐妖组成的小团队来说，事情进展得并不顺利——他们处于劣势，而且自己也清楚这一点。那只黑毛狐妖利用他的带刃长矛，试图让自己的队伍与你们的队伍保持一定的距离，同时他向树上的弓箭手部们发出尖锐的信号，那些弓箭手部立刻转身消失在了茂密的森林中。而它自己则冲进了灌木丛中，很快，那里就只剩下了一阵逐渐消失的沙沙声…… [pc.bg hunter|尽管你…… [a] [pc.mf|男人|女性] 你自己也身处这片森林之中，这里并不是你的地盘。|一场短暂的追逐很快就被证明是徒劳的，这让你感到非常沮丧。]你知道，这些人本来就应该行动敏捷、难以捉摸，但他们能如此迅速地躲进掩体，这确实需要一定的技巧。比起他们那些抢劫的行为，这一点无疑要令人印象深刻得多。 [party.solo||[party.has cait arona |[party.has cait|只要他们下定决心，确实能够办成大事。 凯特在如今已变得寂静的森林中摇着头说道。 你没事吧？ [pc.name]?" 嗯，你没问题的。只是有点委屈而已。 我其实挺同情他们的，但他们的处境也不能成为抢劫的借口。快点，趁现在没有人在，我们赶紧离开吧——我们越快穿过这片森林，就越不可能再遇到他们了。] [party.has arona|阿罗娜对那些低矮的灌木丛毫不在意，她在追逐那些狡猾的强盗时，随意折断树根，踩踏那些小灌木。最终，就连她也不得不承认失败，但在离开之前，她确实留下了一片一片的破坏痕迹。 该死。 她咆哮着，气喘吁吁地回到了你身边。 我发誓，等我终于抓到他们的毛皮，一定会把它们全都做成毛皮制品。] |[companion1.hasTags playful slutty|啊，要是他们能再友好一点该多好。或者，也许…… 你 本可以态度更友好一点。 [pc.name]." [companion1.name] 他满怀惆怅地望着森林，轻轻叹了口气。 它们的尾巴毛茸茸的，真的…… 真的吗 真想摸摸它们。 真的吗？那三个人居然愿意去抢劫？ [companion1.himHer]以及所有其他内容 [companion1.heShe] 我能想到的就是抚摸那柔软的尾巴吧？ 这就是我为什么那么说的原因。 如果 他们变得友善多了。说真的。 [pc.name] — 在周围充满种种危险的情况下，如果你想保持清醒的头脑，就必须更加关注那些看似微不足道的事情。] [companion1.hasTags aggressive|该死。 [companion1.name] 他说着，怀疑地盯着那些灌木丛，仿佛随时都会有一对毛茸茸的狐妖耳朵从里面冒出来似的。 他们究竟是怎么做到这样的移动方式的…… 快 要穿过这么茂密的树林吗？我发誓，如果他们再逃掉了…… 鉴于他们显然比你们任何一个人都更熟悉这片森林，你们很确定，如果不幸再次遇到那三个人的话，这种情况肯定会发生。 [companion1.name] 什么也没说，只是怒目而视，然后一拳砸了下去。 [companion1.hisHer] 手部掌。] ]] 现在喧闹声已经有所减弱，你花了一点时间检查了战斗发生的地方。那些狐妖可能没有什么值钱的东西，但也许在混战中有什么东西掉了下来……
