rows.original: Turned into a pincushion by the archers in the trees, you struggle to stand; Hinata solves that particular conundrum for you by sweeping out your legs from under you with the haft of his bladed spear.[party.som|| Seeing you go down, [companion1.name] rushes forward to aid you, but the black-furred kitsune takes advantage of the break to plant the butt of his spear directly into [companion1.name's] stomach, sending [companion1.himHer] onto the ground alongside you| Seeing you go down, [companion1.name] and [companion2.name] rush forward to aid you, but the black-furred kitsune takes advantage of the broken formation to meet them head-on, sending them to the ground with a quick series of strikes with the haft of his spear]. You groan and move to push yourself upright, but a blade-point on the back of your neck advises against that particular course of action. "I think that concludes negotiations." Hinata clears his throat, then whistles. "Yuzu, Kiri, hold your fire. Come down and search [party.solo|[pc.himHer]|them] while I hold [party.solo|[pc.himHer]|this one] down." The fox-girls do just that, hopping down from their perches and rifling through your possessions. Their search is quick but methodical, making short work of anything you might have had; they even go to the trouble of repacking everything in far neater bundles than they'd found them in. How gods-be-damned polite. [party.hasCompanions| "You're not going to get away with such banditry!" [companion1.name] shouts, [companion1.hisHer] voice slightly muffled by dirt and old leaves. "No, we aren't," comes the absolutely calm reply from Hinata. "But we need to be alive in order for karma to eventually catch up with us."]
rows.translation: 被树上的弓箭手射中，你几乎无法站立；而日向用他那带刃的长矛柄将你的双腿扫开，帮你解决了这个难题。[party.som|| 看着你倒下， [companion1.name] 他急忙冲上前去帮助你，但那只黑毛狐妖却趁这个机会，将长矛的矛柄直接刺了进去…… [companion1.name's] 胃部，开始蠕动…… [companion1.himHer] 与你一起摔倒在地| 看着你坠落下去， [companion1.name] 以及 [companion2.name] 他们急忙前去援助，但那只黑毛狐妖却利用他们混乱的阵型，迎头与他们交战，仅仅用几下长矛的击打，就将他们击倒在地。]你呻吟着试图坐直身体，但脖子后方抵着的刀刃却提醒你，最好不要这么做。 我想，谈判到此为止吧。 日向清了清嗓子，然后吹了一声口哨。 柚子、切里，先不要开火。下来帮忙搜索吧。 [party.solo|[pc.himHer]|他们] 而我依然紧握着…… [party.solo|[pc.himHer]|这个。] 向下。 那些狐妖女孩就是这么做的——从它们的栖息处跳下来，翻遍你的所有物品。它们的搜寻速度很快，但却非常有条不紊，把你可能拥有的任何东西都找得一干二净；甚至还会费心把所有东西重新整理成比原来更加整齐的包裹。 真是见鬼了…… 有礼貌. [party.hasCompanions| 你这种抢劫行为是逃不掉的！ [companion1.name] 喊叫声， [companion1.hisHer] 声音因沾满灰尘和老树叶而显得有些模糊。 不，我们不是。 雏田给出了一个极其冷静的回答。 但我们必须活下去，这样才能让因果报应最终降临到我们头上。]

rows.original: Eventually, the two fox-girls come up with their arms full of stuff — your stuff. It might not be much, but it's yours, damn it. Not theirs. But possession is three-fourths of the law, as they say... "A reasonable haul, Master." "Good, at least we won't be on half-rations tonight. Yuzu, Kiri, you two head off first. I'll cover our tracks." The kitsune archers bow and scamper off, leaving Hinata looking down at you, the point of his bladed spear still on your neck. "See? That wasn't so hard, was it? The next time someone approaches you with a reasonable request for charity, I'd suggest lending a helping hand. Oh, who am I kidding? My words are probably falling on deaf ears at this point. Thank you for the food, and enjoy your day." He gives you a mocking bow, and at last the sharpness of steel is lifted from your neck. Before you can right yourself — assuming you had the strength to do so — he's gone and turned tail, vanishing into the undergrowth after his subordinates.
rows.translation: 最终，那两个狐妖女孩抱满了东西走了过来—— 你的 些东西吧。虽然可能不算很多，但总归是有些用的。 你的， 该死。这些东西不是他们的。但俗话说，占有即等于拥有…… 收获颇丰啊，大师。 好了，至少今晚我们不用吃减半的口粮了。柚子、桐，你们两个先走，我来掩护我们的踪迹。 那些狐族弓箭手鞠了一躬，然后迅速跑开了，留下希娜塔依旧低头看着你，他那带刃的长矛依然抵在你的脖子上。 看到了吧？其实并没有那么难，对吧？下次再有人向你提出合理的慈善请求时，我建议你伸出援手。哦，其实我在骗谁呢？现在我的话恐怕已经没人听了。谢谢你们提供的食物，祝你们一天愉快。 他嘲讽地向你鞠了一躬，随后那把锋利的钢刀便从你的脖子上移开了。还没等你恢复过来——前提是你还有力气这么做的话——他就转身逃跑了，跟他的手下们一起消失在了灌木丛中。

rows.original: Eventually, though, the two fox-girls come up and dip their heads ever so slightly. "Master, we found nothing edible amongst the traveler's possessions." "Hm. Problematic. Our friend here is either brave or stupid to go wandering about in the woods without victuals." Joke's on him — he wasted so much time and energy bringing you down, and now he's got nothing to show for it. Hinata bares his teeth. "Oh, we'll get something out of you all right.[party.som|| You and your companion both.| You and your companions all.]"
rows.translation: 最终，那两只狐狸女孩走了过来，微微低下了头。 大师，我们在那位旅行者的物品中没有找到任何可食用的东西。 嗯，这可有点麻烦了。我们的这位朋友，要么是太勇敢了，要么就是太蠢了，才会不带食物就在树林里乱逛。 他可真是自作自受——他花了那么多时间和精力来陷害你，现在却什么也没得到。 日向露出了牙齿。 哦，我们肯定能从你们这里得到一些有用的信息。[party.som|| 你和你的同伴都是。| 你和你的同伴们所有人。]"

Though you refused my initial offer and I'm now in a position to simply take everything I would like from you, I will nevertheless still effect an equitable exchange. After all, even in my current situation, one has to keep to the tenets." He's the one who waylaid you with malicious intent — is that accepted under whatever these tenets of his are? A shrug. [pc.breasts]|平息你的情绪/缓和你的紧张状态 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]] 它已经变为了某种更具攻击性的形态。那双毛色漆黑、长着钩状爪子的手部，附着在日向那如此人类化的手部腕上，看起来显得格格不入；当你意识到它的另一只手部也发生了同样的变化时，会不由得感到一阵毛骨悚然。 我知道，我最近的所作所为总有一天会让我付出代价，我也准备好了面对这一切。你也应该为自己的行为做好准备。种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆——因果报应迟早会到来。试着去理解别人所处的处境，即使你不同意他们的观点，这也会对你大有帮助。 日向凑近你，轻轻地将一根头发从你的眼前拨开，然后用它那锋利的爪子把那根头发绕了起来。他的另一只手部…… [pc.hasBreasts|停止了对你胸部的那种轻柔逗弄…… 它用尾巴的尖端轻轻触碰你的鼻子，仿佛是在戏弄你，然后把你放到了森林的地面上。 谢谢你提供的食物，我已经有一段时间没有品尝到如此美味的东西了。 慢慢地，不慌不忙地，日向收拾好自己的东西，然后转向柚子和桐人。[ comp1.|[comp2. |依然在追求极致的感官体验…… [companion1.name] 以及 [companion2.name] |仍然忙着欺负那些可怜的人…… [companion1.name] ] ]. 好了，姑娘们，该出发了。 是，主人。 那些狐妖女孩们收拾好东西，排成一列跟在日向后面；她们没有浪费任何时间，很快就离开了，只留下凉爽的森林风声和树叶的沙沙声。
rows.raw: " His face disimpassioned, his mouth set into a thin, straight line, Hinata grabs you by the collar with a small sigh, hefting you up against the nearest stout tree until his eyes are level with yours. Through the dirt and black paint that stain his thin face and pointed chin, the black-furred kitsune wildling considers you, his expression eerily blank and neutral. "Well, then. Though you refused my initial offer and I'm now in a position to simply take everything I would like from you, I will nevertheless still effect an equitable exchange. After all, even in my current situation, one has to keep to the tenets." He's the one who waylaid you with malicious intent — is that accepted under whatever these tenets of his are? A shrug. "I don't like it any more than you do, although I think that is not the answer you were fishing for." [comp1.|[comp2. |Over Hinata's shoulder, you can see the red and golden kitsune wildlings each taking up [companion1.name] and [companion2.name] respectively, caressing them with their fluffy tails and running their hands all over their bodies. The moanings that rise into the forest pretty much dash any hope of your companions making a heroic effort to save you now — they're quite literally more tied up than you are at the moment. |Over Hinata's shoulder, you can see the red and golden kitsune wildlings squabbling over [companion1.name], reducing [companion1.himHer] to a mess of moaning putty as they stroke [companion1.himHer] over and over again with their fluffy tails. ]] That doesn't excuse banditry...! "No, it doesn't, but I will take full responsibility for my actions, and that of my subordinates once the situation is resolved. In the meantime..." Hinata snaps his fingers as he closes the few remaining inches between the two of you, and wisps of blue flame flicker to life on his fingertips with the sound of flint striking steel. The slitted pupils of his eyes seem to dilate as his carefully calm face fills more of your vision; you can feel his breath on your chin and neck, a scent of emptiness and void. As if he were dead inside. "Let's not make the situation any worse for either of us than it is already, all right? I understand we both find this distasteful at some level. If it helps... remember that this is merely a transaction." Your breath catches as Hinata's fingers trace slowly along your cheek, bluish sparks flying outwards from the dalliance of his fingertips, a flush of heat rising each time they make contact with your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. This goes on a little longer before he moves further up, stroking your [pc.hair]. The motion of his fingers is gentle; they barely press against your [pc.hair], tickling more than brushing. You wonder what he'll do next, but once he reaches your neck, he simply shifts his hand back to the top, and starts over. [pc.hasEmoteEars |This time, though, he plants his hand directly between your ears, and begins tickling their backs with his fingertips, the same sensual warmth pounding against your skull. At the same time, the black-furred kitsune presses the heel of his palm against your forehead, bobbing your head back and forth as he gives you a headpat only one who has deeply experienced the joys of such is able to bestow. You can't help but moan unwillingly, a deep-seated animal need welling up in you as Hinata continues patting your head. It feels peculiarly good, a release of tension from the center of your being, as your muscles relax and your world narrows to his hand on your hair, and this sound of pleasure coming from inside you. The fact, of course, that he's probably doing this for the same reason a farmer fattens a chicken for slaughter, but it's kinda hard to focus on that particular bit of harsh reality now amidst the dancing blue flames. "I practice a lot on the girls; they seem to like it a lot. I don't understand it myself, but it seems to give them so much happiness, and the key to good morale in a situation like this is setting their hearts right." |You're a little disappointed at first, but gradually, as his digits trace stroke after stroke over your scalp, you feel the warmth of the ghostly blue flames spread through you, more comforting than erotic. The steady movements are pleasant, almost hypnotic, and you drift into a pleased daze as Hinata pets you. ] You feel Hinata's chest stir against yours as he chuckles. "If only you could see yourself now. Ready to kill me one moment, reduced to this the next. It's nice to let someone close sometimes, isn't it?" Without waiting for a response, the black-furred kitsune worms his other hand into your [pc.armor], parting it with a flick of his wrist. His hand feels larger than it should be, furrier, and as you blearily part your eyes and try to gather your wits, you find that the hand [pc.hasBreasts|toying with your [pc.breasts]|smoothing down your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]] has transformed into something more predatory. Dark-furred and hook-clawed, it looks completely out of place attached to Hinata's very human wrist; a prickling at your scalp dawns the realization that his other hand, too, has followed suit. "I know that karma will exact a price from me someday for my recent actions, and am prepared to face them. You should be prepared to face that of yours, too. What goes around always eventually comes around. Try to understand the situation other people happen to be in; it might do you a world of good, even if you don't agree." Hinata leans over you and gently brushes a strand of hair away from your eyes, twirling it about a sharpened claw. His other hand [pc.hasBreasts|stops its tender teasing of your breasts and ]finds its way over your heart, pressing down just hard enough for your pulse to hammer hard against the heel of his palm. With a swift motion, Hinata tears your heart out — or at least, it feels that way. Mortality clarified in a single strike; fingers and claws alike turn to ice that mirrors the prurient heat of the flames. Your heart flutters in his grasp, a bird caught in a trap, growing weaker by the moment as he crushes the life out of it, juice bursting from an overripe fruit. The cold emptiness strikes at your core, meets the heat wafting down from above, and transforms into a shuddering, feeble pleasure. Never mind that it's draining your vitality by the moment, you can't help but perversely want more from this predatory monster with impeccable manners. Hinata's three tails have wound their way about your legs and waist, keeping you upright when you can no longer stand on your own, and at length he removes his arms and catches you under the arms when you slump forward. Ringing ears, blurred vision — the end is within reach, yet so far off... "There, there. You'll feel much better after a nice long rest." He flicks you on the nose with a tail-tip, almost teasingly, then lowers you to the forest floor. "Thank you for the food; I haven't tasted something quite as intense for some time now." Slowly, unhurriedly, Hinata gathers up his things, then turns to Yuzu and Kiri[ comp1.|[comp2. |, still hammering away at the height of sensuality with [companion1.name] and [companion2.name] |, still busy mauling poor [companion1.name] ] ]. "All right, girls, it's time to depart." "Yes, Master." As one, the fox-girls gather their things, and fall into line behind Hinata; they waste no time in leaving, and soon all that remains is the cool forest wind and the rustling of leaves."

rows.original: The kitsune wildlings have set up camp on the old stone jetty, a moss-grown structure of ancient pale elf make. A large pothole in the jetty has been repurposed into a makeshift firepit, and they've put together a decent lean-to against one of the nearby trees. It doesn't look comfortable, but at least it'll keep off the miserable Marches rain. Unfortunately for the wildlings, their boat-building skills are nowhere near their capabilities of shelter construction — an incomplete raft lies on one side of the jetty, a half-hearted attempt to remedy their situation. Huddled in the dark, rats in a... well, the forest's not quite a maze for the likes of them, but it's not much better from where they stand. Hinata and his two underlings are at least functional in body, if a little pinched-looking. Morale, though, is rather wanting, judging by the general air of depression which hangs around all three of the furred fox-people.
rows.translation: 那些狐族野人们在那座由古代苍白精灵建造的、长满苔藓的旧石码头上搭起了营地。码头上有一个很大的坑洞，他们把它改成了一个临时用的火坑，还在附近的一棵树上搭了一个还算不错的遮蔽所。看起来…… 舒适不过，至少这样能让他们免受三月份那场讨厌的雨水的侵袭。可惜对于那些野人来说，他们的造船技术远不如建造避难所的能力——码头的那一边放着一只未完工的筏子，那只是他们为改善处境而做出的敷衍了事的尝试罢了。 躲在暗影中，那些老鼠……嗯，对于它们来说，这片森林虽然算不上真正的迷宫，但处境也差不多。至少日向和他的两个手下还能行动，虽然看起来有点憔悴罢了。 不过，从那三个毛茸茸的狐妖人身上弥漫着的沮丧气氛来看，他们的士气确实相当低落。

rows.original:
You approach the kitsune trio at their fire, and they silently shuffle aside to admit your entrance by the warm glow, orange tinged with flickers of blue — a small respite, for what it's worth. Hinata has what looks like a small strand of wooden prayer beads out, mumbling under his breath; Yuzu has let down both her hair and tails and is brushing them with a comb. Never mind that she isn't getting any less bedraggled from it, but the repetitive motion and attempts at some semblance of normalcy seem to soothe some small measure of the golden-furred kitsune's frayed nerves.

    Kiri, on the other hand, simply stares sullenly into the dancing flames, as if willing them to rise up and consume her. If the other two don't look to be in the mood to make small talk, she's doubly so; you can practically see the storm clouds gathering about her brow.
    
    Even if none of them say it, at least they appear to be thankful for the company. You did have more than just company in mind, right?
rows.translation:
你走向那三只狐妖，它们默默地让开道路，让你在那温暖而略带蓝光的火光旁走了进去——至少这也算是一种小小的慰藉吧。日向手中拿着一小串木制念珠，正低声念着什么；柚子则把头发和尾巴都放了下来，正在用梳子梳理它们。 尽管她的衣衫依然狼狈不堪，但这种重复性的动作以及试图恢复日常生活秩序的努力，似乎在某种程度上缓解了这只金毛狐妖紧绷的神经。

而基里，却只是闷闷不乐地凝视着那些跳跃的火焰，仿佛希望它们能够吞噬自己。 如果另外两个人看起来都没有心情闲聊，那么她更是如此；你几乎能看到她额头上正聚集着“暴云”。

即使他们中没有一个人说出来，至少他们看起来还是挺感激有人陪伴他们的。 你心里想的肯定不只是有伴同行这么简单，对吧？

rows.translation: 与那些狐狸族人分享一些你的食物吧。
rows.raw: "Share some of your provisions with the fox-people."

rows.original: "Things are looking fairly dismal in this section of the woods," Hinata admits with a sigh. "My subordinates and I have been scouting around awhile, and to be frank I'm amazed that none of us have succumbed to one or more of the insidious dangers that lurk in these parts. I'm not even sure how long the forest can contain this corruption... it's only a matter before it spreads further southwards. I suppose we only have Keros to thank for our good fortune so far; he has a habit of growing tired of carrying one on his shoulders for too long. "But come. You had matters you wished to discuss?"
rows.translation: 这片森林里的情况看起来相当糟糕。 日向叹息着承认了这一点。 我和我的下属们已经在这里四处探查了一段时间，说实话，我很惊讶我们当中竟然没有人遭遇过这些地区潜藏的种种危险。我甚至不确定这片森林还能再抑制这种腐蚀势力多久……它迟早会向南方蔓延开来。我想，我们之所以至今还能幸免于难，全要归功于凯罗斯；他有个习惯，就是不会让这种腐蚀势力在他身上持续太久。 但是过来吧。你不是有事情想要讨论吗？

rows.original: Yuzu and Kiri perk up when you produce the food from your belongings, but Hinata holds them back with an outstretched palm. "Hold." "O-of course, Master." As one, all three kitsune shuffle to their knees, dirty, unkempt, miserable, but still clinging to what shreds of dignity they still have. With Hinata leading them, they kowtow to you, practically pressing their foreheads into the dirt before rising again. "Your continued kindness is unprecedented. You have my gratitude, [pc.name]." Hinata looks askance. "Were I alone, my pride would tempt me to refuse on principle, but that is simply not an option when I have two girls under my care." He really can be a stuck-up stick in the mud sometimes, does he know that? You thrust the bundle of waxed paper into the black-furred kitsune's hands, which he promptly passes on to his charges. "I don't have much I can repay you with, but feel free to share our fire tonight. It's the least I can do. The woods can be dangerous." Behind him, Yuzu and Kiri are busy ripping the waxed paper apart with ravenous intent, the latter pushing the former aside and setting apart a portion of your offerings. "We can't rely on the [pc.race]'s charity for Keros knows how long. Everyone's still on half rations to stretch out the food, remember?" "Y-yeah. I didn't forget..." Hard bread and boiled sweets, dried apples and salted nuts. Practically impervious to spoilage and thus largely unpalatable, but such trifling concerns are forgotten when true, gnawing hunger sets in. Kiri sighs, the fox-girl pushing aside her amber-red forelocks to rub her temples. "If only bread and salt could staunch the flow of otherworldly corruption seeping into the trees." Yuzu scowls. "Shut up, Kiri. Respect this [pc.race]'s charity and eat without spoiling the mood." The fox-girls settle down in silence to eat while Hinata remains as he is, steadily holding your gaze. It's only when they're done that he accepts some small portion of the offerings you've so kindly bestowed upon the trio. "Yuzu, Kiri, we will allow our guest [party.som||and [pc.hisHer] esteemed companion|and [pc.hisHer] esteemed companions ]to use the shelter tonight." Really, that isn't - "I insist. We are perfectly comfortable sleeping under the stars." You look back at the black-furred kitsune, and realize this is a point of pride for him. Oh, fine, fine... "Excellent. Good night, then — I think we will stay up a little longer..." 硬面包和煮熟的甜点，干苹果和咸坚果。这些食物几乎不会变质，因此也很难吃，但当真正的饥饿感袭来时，这些琐碎的顾虑就被抛到九霄云外了。 基里叹了口气，这位狐妖女孩把她那琥珀红色的前发拨到一边，然后揉了揉太阳穴。 要是只有面包和盐就能阻止那些从异世界渗入树木中的邪恶力量就好了。 柚子皱起了眉头。 闭嘴，基里。尊重这个…… [pc.race]既能做慈善，又能享受美食，而且还不破坏气氛。 你躺在树叶上，周围弥漫着那种淡淡的、带着泥土气息的霉味。这种感觉其实相当放松，不知不觉中，你就渐渐进入了梦乡，远处，狐妖们篝火闪烁的轻型芒在空气中跳动……

rows.original: You look Hinata in the eye over the fire, and tell him you'd like to help out him and his girls in a more... direct manner. For about half a minute or so, Hinata says nothing, the wooden prayer beads slipping through his fingers. Lovingly polished and gleaming in the faintly eerie campfire, they move faster and faster until his fingers are a blur, cycling through the entire strand in mere moments. At last, he draws a deep breath and sighs. "I hope you haven't acquired a taste for this." Pray, tell. "Some of those my brethren spirit away for fun develop a fondness for being fed upon. The orgies in the forest glades, the cold thrill of being brought so close to being extinguished, the obscene degrees of raw pleasure some less scrupulous kitsune are willing to impart for a regular source of food, pleasure that isn't diminished by being filtered through the flesh. "It is a sad sight to see people governed by their cravings, and to make things worse, it is through no fault of their nature that such appetites have been awakened." ... "Can I trust you on this? I would rather go without than create one more poor soul wandering the depths of the Frostwood seeking fluffy tails." ...Yes. More silence. At last, Hinata claps his hands; Yuzu and Kiri's ears perk up at the sound, and they immediately drop what they're doing and come forward, settling to either side of their superior. "[pc.name] has graciously offered [pc.himHer]self to us. Please, let us show gratitude for [pc.hisHer] kindness." This again? He really doesn't need to - "It. Is. Important." The note of finality in Hinata's voice is unmistakable. "If you don't give thanks properly, if you fail to give back something of equal value to that which you take, it's easy to forget that these are people who are freely giving of themselves to you, and start thinking of them as little more than food. "Yuzu. Kiri." "Yes, Master." As one, the three kitsune kowtow to you, pressing their foreheads into the dirt — in that moment of clarity, you can see exactly why all this decorum is needed, why every one of their movements is so heavily ritualised. Why they don't just say yes and take up your offer. It all boils back down to keeping one's hunger in check... not too different from anyone trying not to descend into outright gluttony, only with more dire consequences. At long last, the trio of wildlings rise once more. Yuzu looks uncertain, the golden-furred kitsune hugging herself with her arms folded across her small breasts, but Hinata gives her a pat on the forelocks and looks back to you. "It's okay, Yuzu. You go first, since you're the most self-aware. Kiri can have her share next; I'll be fine with what remains after the both of you have fed." "Yuzu just thinks it's not right that you're depriving yourself all the time, Master," Kiri interjects. "We understand that you feel responsibility for our well-being, but you can hardly lead us to the fullest of your capacity if this goes on much longer." Hinata's eyes narrow, and he glances at Yuzu. The golden-furred kitsune looks away, but nevertheless nods. "...Very well. Leave me what you will, this one time." [party.has cait |"Hold up a moment there." Cait's voice, steel over uncertainty, as she sidles into the firelight by your side. "If you're going to do this, [pc.name], I'm going in with you." As one, the three kitsune turn their gazes towards the pink kitten. Brows furrowing, Hinata chews his lip as he studies Cait from head to toe. "I am hesitant," he says at last. "While there is no bad blood between our patrons, Mallachite, it would reflect poorly on us if word got out that we were feeding off a priestess of Mallach. Problems could arise." "Well, you have to live long enough to see those problems in the first place. Don't be so sanctimonious, and don't make it all about you. I'm not about to let [pc.name] do this all by [pc.himHer]self, and you shouldn't starve out your girls." Cait glares at Hinata, clearly challenging him to turn down her offer. He does have a point, though. Will she be all right? "You know how tired I get after working my healing magic, [pc.name]. I'll just think of it as something like that. When you get down to it, it's not too different, right? Besides... I was never actually confirmed as a priestess, anyway." "You may not have the title of one, but you certainly do have the bearing, mannerisms and way of thinking that belies an adherent of Mallach. We should strive to act like the people we wish to become — or in other words, fake it until you make it." Cait sighs. "There are those back home who would protest that statement quite vigorously." Just as good a thing she left when she did, then. So, she's in? Hinata inclines his head. "I will not partake of the Mallachite, but the girls will be more than welcome to her. I believe the likes of the priestess will be more to their tastes, anyway." "Of course I would. You're too stiff and dry to appreciate my particular style, anyway. Who knows, maybe your girls will show me a trick or two I can pass on to [pc.name] here in the future." Hinata just smiles. ] [party.has atugia |Out of the blue, you hear Atugia clear her throat behind you. "Hey, [pc.name]? I'm up for pitchin' in." Come again? You're not quite sure you heard that correctly. "I said, I'm up for pitchin' in. This sort of thing isn't any trouble for the likes of me, I'm already kinda used to it at this point. I mean, weirder stuff's happened to me in my past, a couple of foxy soulsuckers ain't too much of an eye-raiser at this point." Is she absolutely sure about this? "I don't say things I don't mean, at least, not about stuff as heavy as this. Can't let you do all the heavy liftin' by yourself, can I?" Hmm. Why is she used to it, anyway? Did she use to have her life-force drained from her on a regular basis, or what? "Something like that, yeah." Atugia clears her throat and looks pensive. "I ain't givin' you the details 'cause it's not my secret to spill, so don't go diggin' any deeper when I'm doin' you a favor, 'kay?" All right, all right, if she insists. ] "If there is nothing else, I think we shall begin. The night does not last forever, and time is precious..."
rows.translation: 你在篝火旁直视着日向的眼睛，告诉他你希望能够以一种更……直接的方式来帮助他和他的伙伴们。 有大约半分钟的时间，日向什么也没说，那些木制念珠在他手部指间不断滑动。这些念珠被精心打磨过，在微弱的篝火光下闪闪发光，它们移动的速度越来越快，直到他的手部指几乎看不清了——短短几秒钟内，整串念珠就已经被他快速地拨弄了一遍。最后，他深深地吸了一口气，叹了口气。 希望你还没有对这种东西产生兴趣。 祈祷吧，说出来吧。 那些被我的同胞们为了取乐而‘精神控制’的家伙，后来反而对被人吞噬这种行为产生了嗜好。在森林空地上举行的那些狂欢派对，那种几乎被彻底消灭的冰冷恐惧感，还有一些不那么拘小节的狐妖们为了获得稳定的食物来源而愿意提供的那种极其原始的快感——这些快感在通过肉体这一媒介传递时，丝毫不会减弱。 看到人们被自己的欲望所驱使，实在是一种令人痛心的景象。更糟糕的是，这些欲望的觉醒并非出于他们的本性。 ... 在这件事上，我能信任你吗？我宁愿不这么做，也不愿再让另一个可怜的人在霜林里四处游荡，寻找那些毛茸茸的尾巴。 ……是的。” 又是一阵沉默。终于，日向拍了拍手部；由宇和桐人的耳朵立刻竖了起来，他们立刻放下手部头的事情，走上前来，站在这位上级的两侧。 "[pc.name] 慷慨地提供了 rows.original: "The issue is a thorny one. To make a long story short, the river separates the Old Forest from the Frostwood proper, and there is only one bridge that spans it — an affair of marble stonework, a remnant of pale elf civilization. It lies to the north, and is practically the only way to ford the river safely. A rather... noisome creature has taken up residence on its far end, and anyone foolhardy to attempt the crossing anyway is quickly taken up into its clutches." You can see how that would be a problem. "The river is too broad, and the current too swift to attempt to swim across; anyone who tried would either freeze, or barring that be swept away by the current. That, and there is our personal dislike of cold water. Yuzu and Kiri have been kind enough to float several suggestions, however, none of them have really taken root. The furthest we've gotten is that -" he gestures at the half-finished raft lying on the side of the jetty — "but going is slow, to make an understatement." And the three of them have been out here for how long, exactly? "Weeks, I'd say. We were sent out once the weather cleared up, and to be sure, all our original provisions have been depleted, even on half rations." There is something. Why haven't they headed south to Hawkethorne? If they can't head home into the Frostwood, at least the little hamlet ought to be able to put them up. "Another trio of mouths to feed without any skills to contribute? You overestimate the charity of others, [pc.name]." He can't say that for sure until he's tried. Is it really worse than slowly starving in the forest? Hinata sighs, rubbing his temples. "[pc.name]... we're monsters. Kitsune have to supplement ourselves with the life-force of others; that's good enough to give normal folk a deep-seated revulsion, and rightly so. People who don't have an instinctive terror of life-draining soul-suckers tended to perish during the Godswar. They're right to not trust predators, even if they use utensils and follow meal etiquette — being denied the chance to earn our keep would be the least of our worries." Come now. You know that Garth and his ilk aren't the type to - A quick chopping motion of Hinata's hand puts paid to any hope of swaying him. "If it were me alone, I might risk it; the townsfolk might not have heard of kitsune before beyond tails and tales and I could conceivably blend in. However, I have the girls in my charge, and Kiri is particularly bad at concealing her more... savage nature." So until the bridge is cleared, they're stuck here. A nod. "That, or we finally manage to scrounge together enough usable material to build a raft capable of weathering the river. As you can imagine, the going is agonisingly slow."

You overestimate the charity of others, [pc.name]." He can't say that for sure until he's tried. Is it really worse than slowly starving in the forest? Hinata sighs, rubbing his temples. "[pc.name]... we're monsters. Kitsune have to supplement ourselves with the life-force of others; that's good enough to give normal folk a deep-seated revulsion, and rightly so. People who don't have an instinctive terror of life-draining soul-suckers tended to perish during the Godswar. They're right to not trust predators, even if they use utensils and follow meal etiquette — being denied the chance to earn our keep would be the least of our worries." Come now. You know that Garth and his ilk aren't the type to - A quick chopping motion of Hinata's hand puts paid to any hope of swaying him. "If it were me alone, I might risk it; the townsfolk might not have heard of kitsune before beyond tails and tales and I could conceivably blend in. However, I have the girls in my charge, and Kiri is particularly bad at concealing her more... savage nature." So until the bridge is cleared, they're stuck here. A nod. "That, or we finally manage to scrounge together enough usable material to build a raft capable of weathering the river. As you can imagine, the going is agonisingly slow."'

rows.original: "If I were to sum up the situation in one word, it would be problematic. This is not the Old Forest I am used to; much has changed in a very short time. It reminds one of tales of the Godswar." You nod and ask Hinata to go on. "As you've no doubt noticed by now, two invasive species of plants have begin filtering down from the north, vines that twist themselves into phallic shapes and large, enticing flowers that... well, complement the vines in their nature. There are other kinds, of course, either originating from the same source or corrupted from the forest's natural flora, but these two have come to dominate wherever they invade. Their sweet scents have enticed the local hornet and bee-folk to feed from them, and well, neither is quite the same any more. "You can see why living off the forest is a far less viable option than it used to be. The animals are either in hiding or have fled; some have been mentally affected instead of physically so. The local wolves in particular have become unnaturally aggressive, and although food is food, wolf meat is painfully stringy." "All I can do is thank Keros that fish and fox berries are still edible," Kiri mutters from the other side of the fire. "If the source of the corruption is removed, things may return to some semblance of normalcy, although there'd still be a lot of clean-up involved," Hinata continues with a sigh. "Ensure that you bring plenty of food with you, [pc.name]. You don't want to end up like us; putting something plucked from the bough or scrounged from the dirt into your mouth is a dangerous proposition these days." Indeed...
rows.translation: 如果要用一个词来形容目前的状况，那就是‘有问题’。这里已经不是我熟悉的旧森林了；在这么短的时间内，发生了太多变化。这一切让人不禁联想到关于神战的故事。 你点了点头，示意日向继续说下去。 正如你们现在肯定已经注意到的，有两种外来入侵植物物种开始从北方蔓延过来：那些会缠绕成阴茎形状的藤蔓，以及那些外形庞大、色彩诱人的花朵……嗯，这些花朵在某种程度上与那些藤蔓在性质上是相辅相成的。 当然，还有其他种类的植物，它们要么源自同一个源头，要么是在森林中自然演变而来的；但这两种植物一旦侵入其他地区，就会占据主导地位。它们甜美的香气吸引了当地的黄蜂和蜜蜂，让它们以这些植物为食，而这样一来，这两种植物也就彻底发生了变化。 你可以理解，为什么现在依靠森林为生已经不再像过去那样可行了。那些动物要么躲藏起来，要么已经逃走了；有些动物则是受到了精神上的影响，而不仅仅是身体上的伤害。尤其是当地的狼群，它们的攻击性变得异常强烈，虽然肉是可以吃的，但狼肉的纤维实在太粗糙了，吃起来非常不方便。 我所能做的，就是感谢凯罗斯，因为鱼和狐狸果仍然可以食用。 基里在火堆的另一边低声说着什么。 如果能够消除导致这种混乱的根源，情况或许会恢复到某种正常的状态，不过仍然需要进行大量的清理工作。 日向叹了口气，继续说道。 一定要带上足够的食物。 [pc.name]你肯定不想落得我们这样的下场；如今，把从树枝上摘下来的东西或从地上捡起来的东西放进嘴里，实在是一件非常危险的事情。 确实如此……

rows.original: "What is there to say? Do you get questions like this often for being yourself, [pc.race]?" Well, his kind isn't a sight in many centers of civilization, that's for sure. Hinata chuckles. "Far across the ocean, on isles to the east, kitsune have a civilization of their very own. Or at least, that's what the den mother tells me; I've never seen it before, let alone set foot on its shores. The divine lord Keros brought over a handful or two of kitsune over to this part of the world, as he did with other focal points of the Godswar, to support the rank and file Sorra and Lumia provided. I — we all are — the descendants of the survivors of that conflict, and form a diaspora of sorts. Even after some generations removed from our land of origin, we still don't quite fit, and it shows." The lack of prolonged contact with other peoples hasn't helped, you take it. "It is a good or bad thing, depending on your point of view." The black-furred kitsune sighs and scuffs the dirt with his fingers. "I'm really not in the mood to discuss this right now. Can we move on?" Right. "What else? Ah, yes. A couple of den mothers were brought over during that period, particularly illustrious bloodlines, those. The Trickster wanted to see the frontier settled, and if it was going to be so, who better to do it than his own people? And for that, you need hands... quite a number of hands, in fact. As it happened, one of the two was lost in an unfortunate incident, and the other... well, where I am getting with all this is that if you look far back enough, most of us are distantly related one way or another. And well... the locals have contributed from time to time." You get the feeling that Hinata is deliberately avoiding the more metaphysical aspects of kitsune nature, and that it's probably not a good idea to ask him about it. Not just because he's on edge and likely to refuse, but also because he's frankly not likely to know that much about the whys and wherefores. Best to save those questions for someone else.
rows.translation: 还有什么好说的吗？就因为你是你自己，就经常遇到这样的问题吗？ [pc.race]?" 嗯，他的这种类型在许多文明中心确实是不常见的。 雏田轻笑了一声。 在浩瀚的海洋彼岸，东边的那些岛屿上，狐族拥有他们自己的文明。至少，是母狐这么告诉我的；我从未亲眼见过它，更没有踏上过那些岛屿的土地。神圣的凯罗斯将少数几只狐族带到了这个地区，就像他把其他一些关键地点也纳入神战计划一样，目的是为了补充索拉和卢米娅所派遣的普通战士们。 我们所有人，都是那场冲突中幸存者的后裔，因此形成了某种意义上的散居群体。即使已经离开故乡数代之后，我们依然感觉自己不太属于那里，这种感觉显而易见。 可以这么说，长时间没有与其他人进行交流确实没有起到任何积极作用。 这到底是好事还是坏事，取决于你的观点罢了。 那只黑毛狐妖叹了口气，用手部指在泥土上划来划去。 我现在真的没有心情讨论这个话题，我们能不能换个话题吧？ 好的。 还有什么呢？啊，对了。在那段时间里，有几位族长被请了过来，尤其是那些出身显赫的家族。那个狡猾的人希望边境地区能够得到安定，而如果要实现这一目标，还有谁比他自己的族人更合适呢？ 为此，你需要很多双手部……事实上，是相当多的双手部。不幸的是，其中一只手部在一场意外中失去了，而另一只……嗯，我的意思是，如果追溯得足够远，我们大多数人都或多或少地有着某种亲缘关系。 嗯……当地人也时不时地提供了帮助。 你会觉得，日向似乎在刻意回避关于狐族本质中那些更为抽象、玄妙的方面，因此，向他询问这些问题可能并不是个好主意。不仅因为他目前处于紧张状态，很可能会拒绝回答，而且说实话，他很可能也不太了解其中的原因和原理。把这些问题留着问别人吧。

rows.original: "Not from my point of view, or at least any more than you would find any of your physical needs disturbing. I imagine a radish is terrified when you drag it out of the earth, and a chicken would find it outrageous if it were to imagine you beheading, plucking, butchering and roasting it over a spit. None change the essence of the act." There's the fact that most people don't consider radishes or chickens sapient, though. People most certainly are. "That only makes it easier. Though, I can see why most would find the thought unsettling — those who didn't were mostly culled during the Godswar. Self-preservation is an important instinct. Either way, it's one of the reasons why my kind tends to stay away from others — even with the precept of equivalent exchange mandating that we should endeavor to give back as much as we take, there will always be those who are rightfully mistrustful." Hence the sex? Hinata looks over the fire at Kiri and Yuzu, and the tiniest hint of a smile plays on his lips. "It's the easiest way to give back in the act. Pleasure for vitality... it's a transaction that's not too far off from what other races practice, although via different means." How does it feel? "Imagine... hmm... imagine you're a pot filled with water. I'd like to drink some of the water... and after that, the pot is still a pot, and it'll fill back up on its own over time. Provided I don't drain it dry in one go, that is. "People have... flavors. You get attached. It brings color to your existence, it's easy to start craving more for its own sake, to lose yourself. And then you disobey the precept of equivalent exchange, forsake Keros' teachings, and fall afoul of karma. Then one day, that luxuriant, lovely pelt of yours is claimed by some vengeful kinsman and turned into a rug or coat." Hinata is silent for a little while, having pulled out the blade of his spear and sharpening it with a bit of water-worn stone. The repetitive motions, the faint scraping noise, the crackling of the fire punctuate the uncomfortable silence, which he finally breaks. "You've seen the girls around me. You didn't think kitsune are so impeccably polite for no reason, did you? Decorum is... important, Azami drilled that into my head since I was very young. It's a constant exercise in keeping one's uglier instincts in check." Hmm, you hadn't thought of it that way. "...Some days, I worry about Kiri. Then I worry that my worries are well-founded. Actually, I think we should change the subject now." If he wishes.
rows.translation: 至少从我的角度来看，并不会比你感到自己的任何生理需求令人不适更过分。我想，当你把萝卜从土里拔出来时，它肯定也会感到恐惧；而如果一只鸡想象到你正在把它斩首、拔毛、宰杀，然后串在烤肉叉上烤制，它也会觉得这种行为简直太残忍了。不过，这些都不会改变这些行为的本质。 不过，事实上，大多数人并不认为萝卜或鸡具备智慧——而人类显然才是有智慧的生物。 这反而让事情变得更简单了。不过，我也能理解为什么大多数人会觉得这种想法令人不安——那些没有这种顾虑的人，大多在神战期间就被消灭了。自我保护是一种重要的本能。无论如何，这也是我们这类人倾向于与他人保持距离的原因之一。尽管‘等价交换’的原则要求我们应当尽力回馈自己所获取的一切，但总会有那些理所当然会对我们保持怀疑的人。 所以这就是原因吗？ 日向望着火堆中的桐人和柚子，嘴角浮现出一丝微笑。 这是最直接、最有效的回报方式。用快乐来换取活力……这种交换方式其实与其他种族所采用的方法并无太大区别，只不过手段不同而已。 感觉怎么样？ 想象一下……嗯……想象你自己是一个装满水的壶。我想喝掉其中的一些水，但喝完后，这个壶依然还是那个壶，过一段时间它又会自动重新装满水。当然，前提是我不能一次把里面的水都喝光。 人们会对某些东西产生情感依恋。它们为你的生活增添色彩，会让你不由自主地渴望得到更多，甚至因此迷失自我。而当你违背等价交换的原则，背离凯罗斯的教诲时，你就会招致因果报应。终有一天，你那华丽珍贵的皮毛会被某个怀恨在心的家伙夺走，然后被制成地毯或外套。 日向沉默了一会儿，他拔出了长矛的刀刃，用一块被水侵蚀过的石头将其磨得更加锋利。那些重复的动作、微弱的刮擦声，以及篝火发出的噼啪声，共同打破了这种令人不安的沉默，最终他打破了这份沉默。 你看到我身边的这些女孩了吧？你肯定不会认为狐妖会无缘无故地表现得如此有礼貌，对吧？礼仪……是非常重要的。从我还很小的时候起，阿兹米就一直教导我这一点。礼仪其实就是一种不断约束自己那些更丑陋本能的方式。 嗯，你从这个角度考虑过这个问题，真是很有启发。 有时候，我会为基里担心。然后我又会想，我的这些担忧是否是有道理的。其实，我觉得我们现在应该换个话题了。 如果他愿意的话。

rows.original: "That is does. We are not quite up to the task ourselves." What's this creature that's claimed the bridge, anyway? "A sapient plant that has assumed the form of a rather voluptuous and vulgar woman, if I may say so." Hinata scratches his stubbly chin and thinks. "An alraune, if I'm not wrong, and clearly the originator of many such lesser creatures that now roam the forest. Not the kind of alraune I'm used to, of course. Much more perverse and direct, judging from what time the girls and I have spent spying on her and the people unfortunate enough to fall into her clutches. "It is hard to mistake her lair — a large field of pink flowers that has taken root in the adjoining pale elf ruins, a place favored by the now-corrupted hornet and bee-folk alike. Given the stink that rises from the place, I've little doubt that you will have no trouble finding it long before it comes into view." Any advice[pc.bg hunter| from one wildsman to another]? The black-furred kitsune raises an eyebrow. "Oh? Do you fancy your chances?" [party.has cait|"We have to," Cait pipes up. "If we've going to see the witch, we're going to have to cross the bridge one way or another."|There seems to be little choice. Your path to the witch brings you beyond the river, deeper into the woods.] "Oh. Lady Oxana. Her." Is something wrong? "No, at least, not personally. If you do make it there, be respectful of the lady — she's fair-minded, but doesn't take nonsense from anyone." Now, about this alraune... "She is a plant, and so naturally fears fire. If she were alone, the girls and I could still stand a chance if we could simply light her up and be done with it. In fact, since she is almost certain to use her surroundings to her advantage, I would suggest finding some way to torch that field of flowers about her before she can react, removing that tool from her arsenal. Some amount of oil, pitch, or grease would make an excellent firestarter. If fire is not your thing, than blighting her with magic or poison might prove equally effective and less wantonly destructive, if less readily available. "The problem is that she always keeps at least a handful of her offspring nearby, and is certain to call more once threatened. Focus your efforts on bringing the alraune down instead of letting her daughters divert you from your task. Bring some scents of your own to keep your mind clear and counteract those which she carries on her person." Is that all? "It is what conjecture I feel is reasonably grounded. Best of luck to you, then." You thank Hinata for the advice, although you're not sure how much of it you can practically put to use. It might prove useful, it might not... you'll find out eventually, won't you?

"What I can tell you is that it's definitely of kitsune origin. What I can't tell you is very much else. It definitely wasn't made in the last century or two; none of us wear anything in this style any more. Where did you find this?" You briefly recount your foray into the forest ruins, leaving out the more salacious aspects of the murals on the walls. Hinata listens intently, and rubs his stubbly chin when you're done. "Yes, that would match up. I'm afraid my knowledge is of the wilds, not the past — if the bridge ever becomes clear, you should head into the Frostwood and ask around for the matron of my den. She'll know, if anyone does." Oh-kay, the matron of the Frostwood kitsune den, then. You're mildly surprised he didn't give you a name, but Hinata doesn't seem intent on divulging more at the moment, instead staring into the fire. Perhaps a change of subject is in order...

rows.original: You've been walking for what feels like hours; it'll be good to get off your feet, if only for a few minutes. Judging by the light-grayness of the clouds overhead, you've still got some time before the storm hits. Walking over to the unlit campfire, you set everything down and relax, enjoying the pleasant view of the waterfall and stream. [party.has cait quin |[party.randComp cait quin |Caitriss |Quintillus ] takes this time to clean both body and clothes by the river. ] [party.has atugia |Atugia goes over to a nearby log, sets down her bag, and takes a seat before reaching into her pack and pulling out a hardcover book labeled %"The Sailgraves and its History — Volume II" by Guruum, Sage of the South Isles. ] [party.has agni brienne kiyoko viviane |[party.randComp agni brienne kiyoko viviane |Agnimitra lights her finger on fire and flicks the flame at the campfire before flourishing her wrist upwards, causing the campfire to erupt into an impressive bonfire. Sure, she could've performed a simple hand gesture and achieved the same result, but as she usually says: where'd the fun in that be? |[brienne.hasSet PyromancersCloth |Casually, Brienne flicks her wrist and hits the firewood with a small, flaming dart. After some time, the flames grow into a cozy campfire |Brienne gets on one knee and lights the campfire with a flint and tinder. Once it's lit, she takes a seat in front of it and begins polishing her [brienne.weapon] ] |Kiyoko lights the campfire with her foxfire before letting it crackle and burn on its own |With a flick of her wrist, Viviane conjures a few sparks on the old firewood, magically lighting the campfire until it's a crackling fire before going [party.has atugia |over to Atugia and striking a conversation with her |to a nearby stone and opening a book ] ]. ] As for [drifa.dated |Drifa |the dark-haired priestess ]? She takes a seat next to you, humming and holding her hands on her lap. The anxious bouncing of her leg makes it obvious that something's on her mind. Before long, she says, "Y-uh... well, I... what I wanted to say is... sorry, I'm really bungling this, aren't I?" [party.has etheryn |"It's okay. I know what it's like. Don't push yourself too hard," Etheryn says. After that, she [etheryn.lowConfidence |reaches her hand out, as if to pat Drifa's shoulder, but shrinks away at the last second. Instead, Ryn gives her a solemn nod |pats Drifa's shoulder ] before turning her attention to Harrick |A bit, but it's harmless. You tell her to relax and compose her thoughts, first ]. "Right." Drifa closes her eyes and steadies herself. Deep breath in, deep breath out. Inhale, exhale. After her third pass, she nods. "Can we talk?" [pc.isCunning |You smirk and ask if this is the reason she wanted to stop; surely it wasn't because she wanted to check out the sights. So |Sure ], what's up? [pc.isValkyrie |"You're a Valkyrie, right? A divine servant of my, err, our goddess." [pc.isDK |Isn't that obvious |Yeah ]? "Well, I was..." Drifa scratches her cheek, "wondering what she's like. Is Lumia really like how the tales make her out to be?" Depends. Which tales, in particular, are she referring to? The Dawn Maiden is a Living God with various interpretations across the world. Who she thinks Lumia is may differ from what a boreal elf may believe. "That's why I'm asking. Since you've been blessed by her light, you must've seen what she's like. Most of what I know about our goddess is from what Brother Sanders told me. When I think of Lumia, I imagine a noble and awe-inspiring warrior-queen, clad in indestructible armor as she protects the innocent. Depictions of her in a chapel are one thing, but nothing can beat a first-hand account." Lumia is that and more. The Golden Knight is undoubtedly a fearsome warrior on the battlefield, but her indomitable strength is matched only by her radiant love for everyone. As for who she is, as a person, you can best describe her as %"motherly"; not just physically, either, but characteristically, as well. She's a caring woman that cares about all of her children. You pat Drifa's head and tell her that Lumia, no doubt, cares about her too. "Really?!" Excitedly, Drifa's tail begins to wag. "Then... then I hope our actions today will make her proud." If she wants to know the answer to that, she could go and ask Lumia. Drifa's eyes widen and her face flushes a deep red hue. "W-wait, what?! Me? Meeting her? She's a goddess and I'm me! I doubt she'd make the time for a village girl that stumbles over her own words." She shouldn't downplay herself. Even if she's nervous to face off against a den of dangerous beastmen, the mere fact that she's still committed to this battle is heroically brave of her. Besides, if [drifa.dated |your sweetheart |she ] really wants to talk to Lumia, there might be a certain valkyrie with connections who can help set things up for her. That's if Lumia doesn't come down after this and personally congratulate her. "You'd... do that?" The dog-girl's body jitters, giddy at the idea of meeting her goddess. [drifa.dated |Of course! Why wouldn't you? Such an encounter would mean the world to her, and it's not like it's something you can't arrange due to your position. However, priorities. The corrupted cave needs to be dealt with, first. |It depends on how valiantly she performs in the corrupted cave. Granted, if Drifa really wanted to talk to Lumia, you're sure the Dawn Maiden could make some time for her ]. "Guess we have something to look forward to, then." Hastily grabbing her gear, eager to continue onwards, Drifa says, "Let's get going! Those butts won't kick themselves!" |[pc.itemOnPerson Dawnsword |"I heard from [liaden.atChapel |Lia |Sanders ]. Is it true — the Dawnblade — do you really have it?" You ask what she knows and how much [liaden.atChapel |Liaden |Brother Sanders ] told her about it. "More than anyone else in Hawkethorne[liaden.atChapel |, save for Brother Sanders | ]. He's the one who told me of the myths and legends — that it was a sacred boon from Lumia, to the Order of the Oriflamme. I also know that it's more than just a weapon. The Dawnblade was a beacon possessed of Lumia's own radiance — a light for all to see. It's these stories that inspired me to walk the path that I do now. In fact, when I was a little girl, I dreamt of being the one to find it." Drifa chuffs. "You can imagine how surprised I was when Liaden said that it was recovered by a [pc.title]. If you truly possess the Dawnblade, I'd very much like to see it before we enter the cave." You[drifa.dated |'ll do her one better. You pull out the elaborate hilt of the Dawnsword out and proffer it to your [drifa.isCollared |pet |sweetheart ]. "Wh-what?!" Drifa's attention flits between you and the sword. "You're not serious, right? Th-this is the Dawnblade! I can't accept this! Wait, where's the rest of it?" Placing a hand on her shoulder, you tell her that's okay. She said it's her childhood dream to see the Dawnsword firsthand, so, you're helping her fulfill that dream. As for the sword, you're not really sure where the rest of it is, but you assure her that it's perfectly functional. "O-kay." Tentatively, Drifa reaches out and accepts the gilded handle. She then traces a finger along its surface, inspecting it with a curious yet reverent interest. Nevertheless, the weapon remains dormant in her hands. "Amazing. It's so light. But, um... how do I use this?" You inform her that it's activated through force of will; however, since she's not its owner, the sword won't activate for her. "Wha-?" The Dawnsword will activate for you, though. Scooting behind Drifa, you wrap an arm around her waist and hold her svelte hand in yours, letting a tense moment pass before activating the sword hilt in her grasp | pull out the elaborate hilt of the Dawnsword and activate it ]. Suddenly, a blazing, golden radiance bursts forth from its guard and [drifa.bigTitty |her buxom chest leaps |she flinches ]. A low hum accompanies the incandescent glow of it being active. After a second, Drifa relaxes [drifa.dated |against your chest ]before staring in awe at the blade made of pure energy[drifa.dated |. Smiling, you ask her in a whisper if it's everything she hoped it'd be. |, her tail wagging enthusiastically. Is this everything she hoped it'd be? ] No response. [drifa.dated |Your sweetheart is |She's ] utterly captivated by the warm, radiant light glowing before her. Hey, if she stares any harder, she'll go blind. Didn't her parents tell her to not stare at the sun? "[silly |They should've sent a poet |[drifa.dated |It's more beautiful than I could ever have imagined!" Slowly, and with your guidance, the dog-girl sweeps the sword around. "I never thought- I'm... I'm really doing this! This is real!" She then turns her head, gracing you with tears of joy and a trembling smile, which you meet with a quick kiss. "Hey, [pc.name]?" Yes? "I don't know what I did to deserve someone like you. Thanks... for everything |O-oh, sorry. I was, ehhh... yeah. It's greater than I ever expected. Thank you... for giving me this chance to see it firsthand. It's an honor, truly ] ]. Now, um... we should probably get going." She chuckles anxiously. "We've got a cave to save. Wait... that actually rhymed!" [drifa.dated |After you've let go of Drifa and retrieved the Dawnsword, y |Y ]ou gather your things and press on. |[pc.itemOnPerson CorruptedDawnsword |"I heard from [liaden.atChapel |Lia |Sanders ]. Is it true — the Dawnblade — do you really have it?" You ask what she knows and how much [liaden.atChapel |Lia |Brother Sanders ] told her about it. "More than anyone else in Hawkethorne[liaden.atChapel |, save for Brother Sanders | ]. He's the one who told me of the myths and legends — that it's a sacred artifact from Lumia, to the Order of the Oriflamme. I also know that it's more than just a weapon. The Dawnblade was a beacon possessed of Lumia's own radiance — a light for all to see and take comfort in. It's these stories that inspired me to walk the path that I do, now. In fact, when I was a little girl, I dreamt of being the one to find it." Drifa chuffs. "You can imagine how surprised I was when Liaden said that it was recovered by a [pc.title]. If you truly possess the Dawnblade, I'd very much like to see it before we enter the cave." She's not going to like what she sees. "What do you mean?" You pull out the elaborate hilt of the Dawnsword and activate it. However, instead of a golden brilliance, a blood-red light bursts forth from its guard. Drifa's face is bathed in the sword's menacing, crimson glow and the light of excitement in her eyes begins to fade. Slowly, her ears flatten against her head and her expression turns somber. Wordlessly, [drifa.dated |your [drifa.isCollared |pet |sweetheart ] |the priestess ] closes her eyes and shakes her head. You did tell her that she wouldn't like what she saw. "This is wrong. This is all wrong! What happened?!" [pc.isDK |So much for Lumia's artifact being an incorruptible beacon. ]It's unfortunate she had to see this, but it's a lesson she's got to learn now rather than later when the situation is much more dire. Good intentions alone don't defeat monsters, strong people defeat monsters. This new form of the Dawnsword represents that power needed to defeat evil. Drifa lets out a defeated sigh and stands up. Cradling her elbows and avoiding eye contact with you, she mutters, "Perhaps some things are just better left buried. If it's alright with you, we should get going." |Keeping her eyes on the rushing veil of the waterfall nearby, Drifa says, "You've traveled a lot on your adventure, right?" You've had your fair share of sightseeing ever since the troubles began. As of lately, you've been running all across the Frost Marches, getting up to all kinds of trouble. The dog-girl lets out an awkward chuckle. "I hope the good kind. But, um... do you ever wonder if there's stuff behind waterfalls? Like treasure chests?" Okay, what's really on her mind? Her tense body language gives the impression that it's more than just about waterfalls. Drifa lets out a long sigh. "It's that obvious?" [drifa.hasFlower |Taking the blue flower out of hair and letting it rest on her open palms |Rubbing her palms together ], she looks into the distance. "Yeah. This whole thing has me on edge. Knowing what's on the line, I'm afraid of what'll happen to us if we fail. Before you came in and rescued me, those madmen already said what they were going to do if they got their hands on me." [pc.isDK |She's not getting cold |If she wants, she can go ]- "No," Drifa interrupts. "I said I was going to do this, so I'm going to do it! Yes, I may be scared, and yes, I may not be the right girl for the job, but I know that I can't stand back and let these things keep happening to good people. If I can be the difference between terrible defeat and victory, then I have to take that chance." You sigh and pat her on the back. The call to adventure is hardly ever a planned choice; it's something that just happens one day. [pc.isDK |Strong people |Heroes ] aren't born, they're made through the trials they overcome. Not everyone has it in them, but the fact that she answered the call is telling that she has the makings to [pc.isDK |be a powerful woman |be a hero ]. Whatever happens, you'll be there to guide her along the way to be the best version of herself she can be. "I appreciate it. Actually, since we're here, talking about this, what was your call to adventure? It's hard to imagine you as anything other than the person you are now." You [party.has cait |gesture at your pink cat companion and ]tell Drifa the tale of how you were just minding your own business in the Frost Hound inn during a nasty blizzard before an injured and desperate catgirl made a big entrance, begging for help in rescuing her abducted sister. From there, the rest is history. "You're a good [pc.manWoman], [pc.name]. You could've easily ignored the problem and left once the blizzard was over, but you didn't. You stuck around and chose to make a difference." Drifa [drifa.hasFlower |puts the blue flower back into her hair and ]continues, "The world needs people like you. Hopefully, one day I can become as great as you." Then what better test than the corrupted mine? It's good that she decided to tag along; who knows, this might become a good story to tell in the future. If she plays her cards right, she might even have people looking up to her. "That'd be nice, but I doubt my poor head can handle all of that attention. B-but, um, yeah, we should... probably get going." Drifa stands. "Oh, and [drifa.isCollared |[pc.master] |[pc.name] ]?" You pick up your [pc.weapon] and turn your attention back towards Drifa. "Thanks." For? "For giving me this pep talk. I really needed it." She then throws dirt onto the campfire, putting it out[party.manyCompanions | while everyone else gets ready to leave ]. "Let's go kick some butt!" ] ] ]
rows.translation: 你似乎已经走了好几个小时了；哪怕只是休息几分钟，也让双腿得到放松也是件好事。从头顶云层的浅灰色来看，暴风雨还没有到来。你走到那处没有灯轻型的篝火旁，把所有东西放下来，尽情地欣赏着瀑布和溪流的美景，放松身心。 [party.has cait quin |[party.randComp cait quin |凯特 |昆蒂勒斯 ] 利用这段时间，在河边清洗自己的身体和衣服。 ] [party.has atugia |阿图吉娅走到附近的一根原木旁，放下背包坐下，然后从背包里拿出一本精装书，书名是《航海者与他们的历史——第二卷》，作者是南岛的智者古鲁姆。 ] [party.has agni brienne kiyoko viviane |[party.randComp agni brienne kiyoko viviane |阿格尼米特拉将手指点燃，然后用火焰轻触营火，随后手腕一扬，顿时让营火变成了熊熊燃烧的篝火。当然，她本也可以用一个简单的手势来达到同样的效果，但正如她常说的：那样做还有什么乐趣呢？ |[brienne.hasSet PyromancersCloth |布蕾妮随意地甩了甩手腕，一道燃烧的小箭射中了木柴。不一会儿，火焰便熊熊燃烧起来，形成了一堆温暖的营火。 |布蕾妮单膝跪地，用打火石和引火物点燃了营火。火苗一旦燃起，她就坐在火堆前，开始擦拭她的…… [brienne.weapon] ] |清子用她的狐火点燃了篝火，然后让火焰自行噼啪作响、持续燃烧。 |薇薇安轻轻一甩手部腕，就在那些旧木柴上引发了几道火花，魔法般地点燃了篝火，让火焰立刻变得噼啪作响，然后她便离开了。 [party.has atugia |走向阿图吉娅，与她开始交谈。 |走到附近的一块石头旁，然后翻开了一本书。 ] ]. ] 至于 [drifa.dated |Drifa |那位黑发的女祭司 ]她坐在你旁边，轻声哼着曲子，双手部交叠放在膝盖上。她那焦急不安的坐姿明显说明她心里在想着什么。不久之后，她说道：“嗯……其实我想说的是……对不起，我这次真的搞砸了，对吧？ [party.has etheryn |没关系，我明白那种感受。不要让自己太勉强，”伊瑟琳说道。说完之后，她…… [etheryn.lowConfidence |她伸出手，似乎想要轻拍德里法的肩膀，但在最后一刻又缩了回来。相反，瑞恩只是严肃地点了点头。 |轻拍德里法的肩膀 ] 在将注意力转向哈里克之前 |有点，不过没什么坏处。你让她先放松下来，整理好思绪吧。 ]好的。”德丽法闭上眼睛，调整好自己的状态。深吸一口气，再缓缓呼出。吸气，呼气。经过第三次尝试后，她点了点头：“我们可以谈谈吗？ [pc.isCunning |你露出一丝 smirk，问道：这就是她想停止的原因吗？肯定不是因为想欣赏风景吧…… |好的。 ]怎么了？ [pc.isValkyrie |你是一名女武神，对吧？我是说，你是我……呃，一位神圣的仆从。 我们的 女神。 [pc.isDK |这不是很明显吗？ |是的。 ]嗯，我当时在想……”德莉法挠了挠脸颊，“她到底是个怎样的人呢？卢米娅真的像那些传说中描述的那样吗？” 这得看具体情况。她具体指的是哪些传说呢？“黎明少女”是一位被世界各地人们以不同方式解读的神灵。她对卢米娅的看法，可能与极北精灵们的认知截然不同。 这就是我之所以要问这个的原因。既然你受到了她轻型芒的照耀，那你一定亲眼见过她的真实模样。关于我们的女神，我所知道的大部分内容都是桑德斯兄弟告诉我的。每当我想到卢米娅，我就会想象她是一位高贵而令人敬畏的战士女王，身披坚不可摧的铠甲，守护着无辜的人们。教堂里的描绘固然重要，但没有什么能比得上亲耳听来的描述更真实了。 Lumia正是这样的一个人。黄金骑士在战场上无疑是一位令人生畏的战士，但她那不可战胜的力量，唯有她对所有人的那份炽热的爱才能与之相媲美。至于她作为一个普通人，用“母性”这个词来形容她再合适不过了——这种特质不仅体现在她的行为举止上，更体现在她的性格中。她是一位充满关爱的女性，始终关心着身边的每一个人。当你轻拍Drifa的脑袋，告诉她Lumia肯定也会关心她的时候，你会感受到这种母性的温暖与力量。 真的吗？！”德丽法兴奋地摇起了尾巴，“那么……那么我希望我们今天的行动能让她感到骄傲。” 如果她想知道这个问题的答案，她可以去问卢米娅。 德丽法的眼睛瞪得大大的，脸也涨成了深红色，“等、等等，什么？！让我去见她？她可是…… 女神 而我，就是我这样的一个人！我觉得她根本不会花时间去关注一个连话都说不利索的乡村女孩。” 她不应该低估自己。即使面对一群危险的兽人她感到紧张，但仅仅因为她还决心要参加这场战斗，这就已经体现了她无比的勇气。更何况，如果…… [drifa.dated |你的爱人 |她 ] 如果真的想和Lumia谈谈的话，或许有某个关系网广阔的Valkyrie能够帮助她安排见面事宜。当然，前提是Lumia在这件事之后没有直接下来亲自向她表示祝贺。 “你真的会……这么做吗？”狗娘子的身体微微颤抖，一想到能够见到自己的女神，她就感到无比兴奋。 [drifa.dated |当然可以！你为什么不呢？这样的相遇对她来说意义重大，而且以你的地位，安排这种事情根本不是问题。不过，还是得先处理那些被污染的洞穴才行。 |这取决于她在那片被污染的洞穴中表现得有多英勇。当然，如果Drifa真的想和Lumia谈谈，这位黎明少女肯定能抽出时间来见她。 ]看来我们确实有事情可以期待了。”德丽法急忙抓起自己的装备，迫不及待地想要继续前进，说道：“我们赶紧出发吧！那些家伙自己也不会动身的！ |[pc.itemOnPerson Dawnsword |我听说…… [liaden.atChapel |莉亚 |桑德斯 ]是真的吗……那把黎明之刃，你真的拥有它吗？” 你想要知道她究竟知道些什么，以及她掌握了多少信息。 [liaden.atChapel |莉娅登 |桑德斯兄弟 ] 在鹰棘镇，没有人比我更了解这件事了。[liaden.atChapel |除了桑德斯兄弟之外 | ]正是他告诉了我那些关于这些神话和传说的故事——说那是一件来自卢米娅的神圣馈赠，是献给奥里弗拉姆骑士团的。我也知道，它不仅仅是一件武器。黎明之刃是一面散发着卢米娅轻型芒的信号灯，是一道所有人都能看到的轻型芒。正是这些故事激励我走上了如今这条道路。事实上，当我还是个小女孩的时候，我就梦想着自己能够找到它。”德丽法轻声说道，“你可以想象，当莉娅登告诉我那把剑已经被找回来时，我有多么惊讶…… [pc.title]如果你真的拥有黎明之刃，那么在进入洞穴之前，我真的很想亲眼看看它。[drifa.dated |我会做得更好。你把晨曦剑那精美的剑柄拔出来，然后递给她…… [drifa.isCollared |宠物 |亲爱的 ]什、什么？！”德丽法的目轻型在你和那把剑之间来回切换。“你不会是认真的吧？这、这是…… 黎明之刃我无法接受这个！等等，剩下的部分在哪里？” rows.raw: " You've been walking for what feels like hours; it'll be good to get off your feet, if only for a few minutes. Judging by the light-grayness of the clouds overhead, you've still got some time before the storm hits. Walking over to the unlit campfire, you set everything down and relax, enjoying the pleasant view of the waterfall and stream. [party.has cait quin |[party.randComp cait quin |Caitriss |Quintillus ] takes this time to clean both body and clothes by the river. ] [party.has atugia |Atugia goes over to a nearby log, sets down her bag, and takes a seat before reaching into her pack and pulling out a hardcover book labeled %"The Sailgraves and its History — Volume II" by Guruum, Sage of the South Isles. ] [party.has agni brienne kiyoko viviane |[party.randComp agni brienne kiyoko viviane |Agnimitra lights her finger on fire and flicks the flame at the campfire before flourishing her wrist upwards, causing the campfire to erupt into an impressive bonfire. Sure, she could've performed a simple hand gesture and achieved the same result, but as she usually says: where'd the fun in that be? |[brienne.hasSet PyromancersCloth |Casually, Brienne flicks her wrist and hits the firewood with a small, flaming dart. After some time, the flames grow into a cozy campfire |Brienne gets on one knee and lights the campfire with a flint and tinder. Once it's lit, she takes a seat in front of it and begins polishing her [brienne.weapon] ] |Kiyoko lights the campfire with her foxfire before letting it crackle and burn on its own |With a flick of her wrist, Viviane conjures a few sparks on the old firewood, magically lighting the campfire until it's a crackling fire before going [party.has atugia |over to Atugia and striking a conversation with her |to a nearby stone and opening a book ] ]. ] As for [drifa.dated |Drifa |the dark-haired priestess ]? She takes a seat next to you, humming and holding her hands on her lap. The anxious bouncing of her leg makes it obvious that something's on her mind. Before long, she says, "Y-uh... well, I... what I wanted to say is... sorry, I'm really bungling this, aren't I?" [party.has etheryn |"It's okay. I know what it's like. Don't push yourself too hard," Etheryn says. After that, she [etheryn.lowConfidence |reaches her hand out, as if to pat Drifa's shoulder, but shrinks away at the last second. Instead, Ryn gives her a solemn nod |pats Drifa's shoulder ] before turning her attention to Harrick |A bit, but it's harmless. You tell her to relax and compose her thoughts, first ]. "Right." Drifa closes her eyes and steadies herself. Deep breath in, deep breath out. Inhale, exhale. After her third pass, she nods. "Can we talk?" [pc.isCunning |You smirk and ask if this is the reason she wanted to stop; surely it wasn't because she wanted to check out the sights. So |Sure ], what's up? [pc.isValkyrie |"You're a Valkyrie, right? A divine servant of my, err, our goddess." [pc.isDK |Isn't that obvious |Yeah ]? "Well, I was..." Drifa scratches her cheek, "wondering what she's like. Is Lumia really like how the tales make her out to be?" Depends. Which tales, in particular, are she referring to? The Dawn Maiden is a Living God with various interpretations across the world. Who she thinks Lumia is may differ from what a boreal elf may believe. "That's why I'm asking. Since you've been blessed by her light, you must've seen what she's like. Most of what I know about our goddess is from what Brother Sanders told me. When I think of Lumia, I imagine a noble and awe-inspiring warrior-queen, clad in indestructible armor as she protects the innocent. Depictions of her in a chapel are one thing, but nothing can beat a first-hand account." Lumia is that and more. The Golden Knight is undoubtedly a fearsome warrior on the battlefield, but her indomitable strength is matched only by her radiant love for everyone. As for who she is, as a person, you can best describe her as %"motherly"; not just physically, either, but characteristically, as well. She's a caring woman that cares about all of her children. You pat Drifa's head and tell her that Lumia, no doubt, cares about her too. "Really?!" Excitedly, Drifa's tail begins to wag. "Then... then I hope our actions today will make her proud." If she wants to know the answer to that, she could go and ask Lumia. Drifa's eyes widen and her face flushes a deep red hue. "W-wait, what?! Me? Meeting her? She's a goddess and I'm me! I doubt she'd make the time for a village girl that stumbles over her own words." She shouldn't downplay herself. Even if she's nervous to face off against a den of dangerous beastmen, the mere fact that she's still committed to this battle is heroically brave of her. Besides, if [drifa.dated |your sweetheart |she ] really wants to talk to Lumia, there might be a certain valkyrie with connections who can help set things up for her. That's if Lumia doesn't come down after this and personally congratulate her. "You'd... do that?" The dog-girl's body jitters, giddy at the idea of meeting her goddess. [drifa.dated |Of course! Why wouldn't you? Such an encounter would mean the world to her, and it's not like it's something you can't arrange due to your position. However, priorities. The corrupted cave needs to be dealt with, first. |It depends on how valiantly she performs in the corrupted cave. Granted, if Drifa really wanted to talk to Lumia, you're sure the Dawn Maiden could make some time for her ]. "Guess we have something to look forward to, then." Hastily grabbing her gear, eager to continue onwards, Drifa says, "Let's get going! Those butts won't kick themselves!" |[pc.itemOnPerson Dawnsword |"I heard from [liaden.atChapel |Lia |Sanders ]. "More than anyone else in Hawkethorne[liaden.atChapel |, save for Brother Sanders | ]. He's the one who told me of the myths and legends — that it was a sacred boon from Lumia, to the Order of the Oriflamme. I also know that it's more than just a weapon. The Dawnblade was a beacon possessed of Lumia's own radiance — a light for all to see. It's these stories that inspired me to walk the path that I do now. In fact, when I was a little girl, I dreamt of being the one to find it." Drifa chuffs. "You can imagine how surprised I was when Liaden said that it was recovered by a [pc.title]. If you truly possess the Dawnblade, I'd very much like to see it before we enter the cave." You[drifa.dated |'ll do her one better. You pull out the elaborate hilt of the Dawnsword out and proffer it to your [drifa.isCollared |pet |sweetheart ]. "Wh-what?!" Drifa's attention flits between you and the sword. "You're not serious, right? Th-this is the Dawnblade! I can't accept this! Wait, where's the rest of it?" Placing a hand on her shoulder, you tell her that's okay. She said it's her childhood dream to see the Dawnsword firsthand, so, you're helping her fulfill that dream. As for the sword, you're not really sure where the rest of it is, but you assure her that it's perfectly functional. "O-kay." Tentatively, Drifa reaches out and accepts the gilded handle. She then traces a finger along its surface, inspecting it with a curious yet reverent interest. Nevertheless, the weapon remains dormant in her hands. "Amazing. It's so light. But, um... how do I use this?" You inform her that it's activated through force of will; however, since she's not its owner, the sword won't activate for her. "Wha-?" The Dawnsword will activate for you, though. Scooting behind Drifa, you wrap an arm around her waist and hold her svelte hand in yours, letting a tense moment pass before activating the sword hilt in her grasp | pull out the elaborate hilt of the Dawnsword and activate it ]. Suddenly, a blazing, golden radiance bursts forth from its guard and [drifa.bigTitty |her buxom chest leaps |she flinches ]. A low hum accompanies the incandescent glow of it being active. After a second, Drifa relaxes [drifa.dated |against your chest ]before staring in awe at the blade made of pure energy[drifa.dated |. Smiling, you ask her in a whisper if it's everything she hoped it'd be. |, her tail wagging enthusiastically. Is this everything she hoped it'd be? ] No response. [drifa.dated |Your sweetheart is |She's ] utterly captivated by the warm, radiant light glowing before her. Hey, if she stares any harder, she'll go blind. Didn't her parents tell her to not stare at the sun? "[silly |They should've sent a poet |[drifa.dated |It's more beautiful than I could ever have imagined!" Slowly, and with your guidance, the dog-girl sweeps the sword around. "I never thought- I'm... I'm really doing this! This is real!" She then turns her head, gracing you with tears of joy and a trembling smile, which you meet with a quick kiss. "Hey, [pc.name]?" Yes? "I don't know what I did to deserve someone like you. Thanks... for everything |O-oh, sorry. I was, ehhh... yeah. It's greater than I ever expected. Thank you... for giving me this chance to see it firsthand. It's an honor, truly ] ]. Now, um... we should probably get going." She chuckles anxiously. "We've got a cave to save. Wait... that actually rhymed!" [drifa.dated |After you've let go of Drifa and retrieved the Dawnsword, y |Y ]ou gather your things and press on. |[pc.itemOnPerson CorruptedDawnsword |"I heard from [liaden.atChapel |Lia |Sanders ]. Is it true — the Dawnblade — do you really have it?" You ask what she knows and how much [liaden.atChapel |Lia |Brother Sanders ] told her about it. "More than anyone else in Hawkethorne[liaden.atChapel |, save for Brother Sanders | ]. He's the one who told me of the myths and legends — that it's a sacred artifact from Lumia, to the Order of the Oriflamme. I also know that it's more than just a weapon. The Dawnblade was a beacon possessed of Lumia's own radiance — a light for all to see and take comfort in. It's these stories that inspired me to walk the path that I do, now. In fact, when I was a little girl, I dreamt of being the one to find it." Drifa chuffs. "You can imagine how surprised I was when Liaden said that it was recovered by a [pc.title]. If you truly possess the Dawnblade, I'd very much like to see it before we enter the cave." She's not going to like what she sees. "What do you mean?" You pull out the elaborate hilt of the Dawnsword and activate it. However, instead of a golden brilliance, a blood-red light bursts forth from its guard. Drifa's face is bathed in the sword's menacing, crimson glow and the light of excitement in her eyes begins to fade. Slowly, her ears flatten against her head and her expression turns somber. Wordlessly, [drifa.dated |your [drifa.isCollared |pet |sweetheart ] |the priestess ] closes her eyes and shakes her head. You did tell her that she wouldn't like what she saw. "This is wrong. This is all wrong! What happened?!" [pc.isDK |So much for Lumia's artifact being an incorruptible beacon. ]It's unfortunate she had to see this, but it's a lesson she's got to learn now rather than later when the situation is much more dire. Good intentions alone don't defeat monsters, strong people defeat monsters. This new form of the Dawnsword represents that power needed to defeat evil. Drifa lets out a defeated sigh and stands up. Cradling her elbows and avoiding eye contact with you, she mutters, "Perhaps some things are just better left buried. If it's alright with you, we should get going." |Keeping her eyes on the rushing veil of the waterfall nearby, Drifa says, "You've traveled a lot on your adventure, right?" You've had your fair share of sightseeing ever since the troubles began. As of lately, you've been running all across the Frost Marches, getting up to all kinds of trouble. The dog-girl lets out an awkward chuckle. "I hope the good kind. But, um... do you ever wonder if there's stuff behind waterfalls? Like treasure chests?" Okay, what's really on her mind? Her tense body language gives the impression that it's more than just about waterfalls. Drifa lets out a long sigh. "It's that obvious?" [drifa.hasFlower |Taking the blue flower out of hair and letting it rest on her open palms |Rubbing her palms together ], she looks into the distance. "Yeah. This whole thing has me on edge. Knowing what's on the line, I'm afraid of what'll happen to us if we fail. Before you came in and rescued me, those madmen already said what they were going to do if they got their hands on me." [pc.isDK |She's not getting cold |If she wants, she can go ]- "No," Drifa interrupts. "I said I was going to do this, so I'm going to do it! Yes, I may be scared, and yes, I may not be the right girl for the job, but I know that I can't stand back and let these things keep happening to good people. If I can be the difference between terrible defeat and victory, then I have to take that chance." You sigh and pat her on the back. The call to adventure is hardly ever a planned choice; it's something that just happens one day. [pc.isDK |Strong people |Heroes ] aren't born, they're made through the trials they overcome. Not everyone has it in them, but the fact that she answered the call is telling that she has the makings to [pc.isDK |be a powerful woman |be a hero ]. Whatever happens, you'll be there to guide her along the way to be the best version of herself she can be. "I appreciate it. Actually, since we're here, talking about this, what was your call to adventure? It's hard to imagine you as anything other than the person you are now." You [party.has cait |gesture at your pink cat companion and ]tell Drifa the tale of how you were just minding your own business in the Frost Hound inn during a nasty blizzard before an injured and desperate catgirl made a big entrance, begging for help in rescuing her abducted sister. From there, the rest is history. "You're a good [pc.manWoman], [pc.name]. You could've easily ignored the problem and left once the blizzard was over, but you didn't. You stuck around and chose to make a difference." Drifa [drifa.hasFlower |puts the blue flower back into her hair and ]continues, "The world needs people like you. Hopefully, one day I can become as great as you." Then what better test than the corrupted mine? It's good that she decided to tag along; who knows, this might become a good story to tell in the future. If she plays her cards right, she might even have people looking up to her. rows.original:
With how close the corrupted mine is, you can't stop here. Plus, with the gray, overcast sky overhead, it looks like it's going to rain soon; you don't want to be outside, crawling up a slippery mountainside when the storm hits.

        "Oh... I see."
        
        She doesn't sound too enthusiastic. She doesn't have a problem with this decision, does she?
        
        "N-no, I understand. Please, lead the way. I'll... be right behind you"

鉴于那座被污染的矿井离我们这么近，我们不能在这里停留。再加上头顶上灰蒙蒙的天空，看起来马上就要下雨了；在暴风雨来临的时候，你肯定不想待在户外，在湿滑的山坡上爬来爬去吧。

她的语气听起来并不是很热情。其实她对这个决定并没有什么意见，对吧？

rows.original: As you venture closer to the mountains, the vegetation thins out, making way for high ledges of stone and compact clay. Steep escarpments divide this part of the region from the rest of the Old Forest. Needless to say, unless you've come with the proper supplies, the climb isn't going to be safe or easy. One wrong move — one misstep — and you'll be on the receiving end of a rather uncomfortable landing. There's a sandy, foot-worn trail which snakes up the cliffside, a much easier approach than the alternative. That being said, it's obviously well-used — if you pick this approach, you're bound to run into company along the way. [party.hasGuest |Drifa cranes her head back and points. "[drifa.dated |The mine is just up there. So... what's the plan |That's- it's... it's right there. The cave, I mean." She rubs her shoulder and chuckles sheepishly. "So what's the, uh... plan ]?" ]

rows.original: Risk be damned! You're not going to waste resources or risk breaking your neck by climbing up a rocky cliffside when there's a perfectly good footpath right there! If you run into trouble along the way, so be it. It's not like you're losing any time by taking the conventional path. [party.sizeRange 1 3 |You're |The party's ] going around! Sticking close to the walls, you navigate up the winding path, but along the way, you encounter a pair of corrupted lupine hunters on their way to the den with their ill-gotten spoils. Unfortunately, with their animal companions close by, they thwart any and all plans you might've had to hide or ambush them as the beasts stop in their tracks, sniff, and then snarl in [party.isJustPC |your |[party.yall]'s ] general direction, alerting the hunters to your presence. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 管他什么风险！既然有了一条很好的小路，你为什么还要浪费资源，或者冒险爬上那些布满岩石的悬崖呢？如果途中遇到了麻烦，那也没关系。毕竟，走常规路线并不会让你浪费任何时间。 [party.sizeRange 1 3 |你真是…… |该党的 ] 四处游荡！ 你紧贴着墙壁，沿着蜿蜒的小路向上前进，但在途中，你遇到了一对腐败的狼族猎手，他们正带着不义之财返回巢穴。不幸的是，由于他们的动物伙伴就在附近，你任何想要隐藏或伏击他们的计划都会失败——那些野兽会立刻停下来，嗅探一番，然后发出低吼…… [party.isJustPC |你的 |[party.yall]的 ] 这种一般性的信号会让猎人注意到你的存在。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: You test your fitness and climb up the old-fashioned way.
rows.translation: 你通过传统的方式来测试自己的体能，然后攀登上去。
rows.raw: "You test your fitness and climb up the old-fashioned way."

rows.original:
While the climb up the cliff might be tricky, there's no reason to take unnecessary risks. Sorting through your camping supplies, you pull out some rope, a bundle of twine, and a set of pitons. Shouldering the coil of rope, you look at the cliff face again and plan your ascent, gathering your nerves before taking the first step.

        Much to your surprise, the climb proves to be easier than expected; the ability to create additional handholds by jamming the pitons into the rock trivializes the task. It really does pay to be prepared. Step by step, pull by pull, you make it up the cliff face without too much trouble, hauling yourself up and onto solid ground. Afterwards, you turn around and look over the edge, taking in just how perilous a fall could've been, grateful that you didn't have to climb up the hard way.
rows.translation:
虽然攀爬悬崖可能会有些危险，但完全没有必要去冒不必要的风险。你整理了一下露营用品，找出了几根绳子、一捆麻绳以及一套攀岩钉。背起那卷绳子，你再次审视悬崖的表面，仔细规划攀登路线，然后在迈出第一步之前，努力让自己镇定下来。

        令你惊讶的是，攀登过程其实比预想的要容易得多；通过将岩锥插入岩石中来制造额外的抓握点，让这项任务变得轻而易举。做好准备确实很有好处。一步一步地攀爬，一次一次地用力拉扯，你终于顺利地爬上了悬崖峭壁，到达了坚实的地面上。 后来，你转过身去，俯瞰下方，才意识到那次坠落本来会有多危险，同时也庆幸自己没有不得不费力地爬回去。

rows.original:
Standing victorious with your corrupted foes driven before you, you take a moment to catch your breath and watch as their wolves scatter with their tails between their legs. Both of the corrupted lupines struggle to stand — one of whom actually succeeds and takes off after his beasts. That just leaves the older hunter of the two; his attempts to push himself back up are met with failure as he succumbs to his weariness.

    Encouraged from the adrenaline of the fight, his bulbous knot and beastly red erection leave their sheath as it throbs with yearning desire. Of course, there's also the option of his long tongue — if he likes to use it so much, why not find a better use for it? There is, however, the option to make sure he isn't a problem that'll come back to bite you in the ass. Purification takes time — time which you don't have. Instead of doing anything lewd with him, you could just tie him up and leave him for later.
rows.translation:
当你将那些被腐蚀的敌人驱赶到面前并取得胜利后，你暂停片刻喘息，看着他们的狼群惊慌失措地四散逃窜。那两只被腐蚀的狼也艰难地试图站立——其中一只终于成功站了起来，随后追着它的同类逃走了。 这时，只剩下那位年纪较大的猎人了；他试图重新站起来，但却一次次失败，最终还是被疲惫所吞噬。

在战斗带来的肾上腺素刺激下，他那粗壮的阴茎从包皮中勃起，剧烈地跳动着，充满了强烈的欲望。 当然，还有另一个办法——利用他那条长舌头。如果他这么喜欢用它，为什么不找些更有意义的事情让它发挥作用呢？不过，也必须确保他不会成为一个日后会反过来害你的麻烦源。 净化需要时间——而你根本没有那么多时间。与其对他做出什么不当举动，不如把他绑起来，留到以后再处理。

rows.raw: " You walk over to the gate and [pc.bgcl thief charmer slumrat |eye the padlock. After some consideration, you go through your set of lockpicks and select one, then slide it into the mechanism.
