“真的有那么明显吗？”奥利维亚得意地笑着说，“其实并不是。在阿斯盖尔任命我为他的队长之前，我其实是一个冒险团队的一员，我们接受了清除这个地方的赏金任务，然后………这么说吧，我们的举动简直捅了马蜂窝。在我们的那次小行动之后，阿斯盖尔勃然大怒，他开始派出袭击队，还在行动中俘虏了一些人。而我之所以没有像其他同伴那样遭到报复，是因为我接受了阿斯盖尔的最后通牒；他认为我的吟游技巧对他的帝国建设计划会有帮助。"
rows.raw:
'
    "Is there anything specific you want to know, dearest?"

    You ask her about what you should expect, and perhaps a little insight into who the corrupted lupine jarl is.
    
    "Well..." Olivia leans back in her seat, "I do recall him telling me about his military background — he and Refnir used to be soldiers for some warlord in the Heartlands. He wasn't always a 'jarl' here; in fact, he was just one of many mercenaries that the old foreman of the mines hired on. Before long, he took over and became the boss of this place."
    
    You ask if Asgeir was corrupted by this point
    
    Olivia laughs. "Oh no, Asgeir took over because the old foreman was being a dumbass and almost got everyone killed. Asgeir thinks of himself as some grand savior for his men. His corruption didn't happen until a bunch of plant girls came to the mines."
    
    Where does Olivia come into all of this? Unlike most of the men here, she's not a miner.
    
    "Is it that obvious?" Olivia says with a smug grin. "No. Before Asgeir made me one his captains, I was actually part of an adventuring group that accepted a bounty to clear this place out, and... let's just say that kicked the proverbial hornet's nest. After our little attack, Asgeir was furious, and he started sending out raiding parties, taking prisoners in the process. The only reason I'm not getting violated like the rest of my companions is because I accepted Asgeir's ultimatum; he thinks my bardic skills can be of use in his empire-building plans."'

rows.translation: [flags.KQ_OLIVIA_TASK |[pc.isDK |奥利维亚从胸前取出了那支电银长笛，仔细端详了一会儿，然后递给了你。“请小心保管。那支长笛对我来说意义非凡。其实，你为什么需要它呢？” 你微微鞠了一躬，向这位吟游诗人道了谢，然后转身离开了。 “喂！回来啊…… 回答 是我！ [pc.NAME]!" |奥利维亚从胸前取出了那支电银长笛。“你为什么需要它？你甚至知道这东西是什么吗？” 你确认她手部中的确实是一把提克里斯族的法术长笛。至于为什么需要它，你给她讲了一个有点离奇的故事，然后向她保证，这把长笛在击败那个被腐蚀的酋长时起着至关重要的作用。 奥利维亚瘫坐在椅子上，双手部交叉握在一起。“试试看吧。” 你耸了耸肩，然后将一切都告诉了她。 奥利维亚皱起眉头，仔细思考着你告诉她的这些奇怪信息。 所以你是说，阿斯盖尔是从一个鬼屋里得到了他的水晶剑，而现在有个冰人想让你用我的笛子来摧毁阿斯盖尔的剑，因为那把剑……是有生命的？ [pc.isBimbo |没错！ |你解释说，那个“冰人”其实是两个战前的精灵灵魂融合在一起，它们利用一块冰来显现自己的形态。除此之外，差不多就是这个意思了。 ] 没错，”奥利维亚点头说道。几秒钟后，她调整了一下坐姿，继续说道：“你知道这一切听起来有多奇怪吗？ [pc.isBimbo |她难道不相信你吗？你说的都是实话啊！ |她可以认为这听起来很荒谬，但你向她保证，这是事实。而且，这个机会能够夺走阿斯盖尔珍贵的武器，实在是一个不容错过的机会。 ] 经过短暂的思考，奥利维亚气呼呼地把你那支电银长笛递了过来。“我就咬一口吧。至少这个故事会挺有趣的……你到底会不会使用这种东西啊？ [pc.bgcl charmer minstrel |你接过那支由 electrum 制作的笛子，感受着它握在手中的重量，然后告诉她，你对这种乐器其实并不陌生。 [silly |爱 |乐器 ]太棒了！ |你摇了摇头，完全不知道该如何使用这个东西。不过，使用它应该不会那么难吧？毕竟它只是一支魔法长笛而已。 “好吧，现在开始上课了。”奥利维亚站起身来，轻轻敲了敲乐器下装的那些孔洞中的一个。 首先，要确保将长笛的另一端对准水晶；确认位置正确后，用手部指按住这个音孔，然后吹气。当声音传递到水晶上时，再同时按住这两个音孔，然后轻轻持续吹气几秒钟，就能让水晶破裂。”奥利维亚一边说，一边分别指了指长笛顶部的音孔和下装的音孔。 ] 现在，在你离开之前，我觉得我有必要告诉你这件事：我想那个充满怨气的灵魂会希望你摧毁霜刻，但我认为，如果你们中的某个人能够使用它，而不是让它被毁掉，那反而会是最好的结果。你可以利用阿斯盖尔自己的武器来对抗它。 别让那个鬼魂用内疚感逼你毁掉那件古代遗迹，那只不过是一个印记而已。 你开玩笑地问奥利维亚，是不是开始喜欢上你了。 “不、不要那样想！奥利维亚双臂交叉，撇了撇嘴，气呼呼地说：“我只是……希望你能赢，这样我就能离开这个地方了。 ] |你去跟仙人掌一起玩吧，”奥利维亚说着，还朝你竖了中指，“我可不想理你。 不是 我把我的工具给你。你知道我为了得到这个工具付出了多少努力吗？如果你完成了你的任务，我就…… 考虑 让你明白吧。” 你告诉她，这一点非常重要。[pc.isChamp | 为了削弱阿斯盖尔 ]她总不能不让你借吧？” “等我拿回来后，难道还要让你尝自己的口水吗？那绝对不可能。 ]

Approaching the sepia-colored curtain, you hear the sound of bubbling and hissing from the other side.

    "Bah, no good! It needs more niter!"
    
    You ready your [pc.weapon] and storm into the laboratory, barging in upon an elderly lupine standing behind a large wooden desk. At his side is an imp girl, the little demoness carrying a burlap pouch which she drops at your sudden entrance.
    
    The cloaked lupine [pc.swornGod nareva
        |stops what he's doing and gives you his full attention, regarding you with a wry smile. "Your presence has not gone unnoticed, young Astrida. I already know who you are, what you are, and why you have come. So lay down your weapons and let us share words rather than war
        |meets your gaze, grumbles, and says, "I know who you are and why you've come, [pc.mf

            |girl
        ], so put that toy away so that we may speak
    ]."
    
    [var0

rows.original: You will not negotiate with him!

Crouching atop a tall stool, the warlock's imp familiar kicks her feet back and forth. Unlike her master, the lady-imp notices your presence and playfully wags her fingers at you. She then flaps her tiny wings over to her master and takes away his bottle of ink.

    "Return what is mine, fiendling. I do not have time for your games."
    
    "Yer crinkly old ass ever hear what a break is? Besides, ya got company," Meridyx says, pointing at [party.yall].
    
    Tharsus' snout twitches and he grumbles. He then dips his ink-covered claw into a cup of water, grabs his staff, and gives you a curt: "What?"
rows.translation:
那个女妖坐在高足部凳上，她手下的小妖精不停地用足部踢她的腿。与它的主人不同，这个女妖注意到了你的存在，还调皮地朝你挥了挥手指。然后它扑动着小小的翅膀飞到它的主人身边，抢走了他的墨水瓶。

“把属于我的东西还回来，这个小捣蛋鬼。我可没时间陪你玩这些把戏。”

“你这个皱巴巴的老家伙，到底知不知道什么是‘休息’？而且，你还有客人呢，”梅里迪克斯说着，指了指…… [party.yall]塔萨斯的鼻子抽动了一下，他嘟囔了几句。然后，他将沾满墨水的爪子浸入一杯水中，抓起手中的法杖，简短地问道：“什么？

rows.original: [var0 |You point your weapon at the warlock and tell him that Olivia sends her regards. "Then I shall deal with her — right after I deal with you." |You [pc.isMage |sling a spell at him |[pc.weaponMRT |run up and perform a horizontal swing with your [pc.weapon] |fire your [pc.weapon] |[silly |yeet |huck ] your [pc.weapon] at him ] ], but the slippery bastard ducks down, dodging your attack before it can land. This mistake won't be repeated. You walk around the desk and point your weapon at the lupine crawling on his back. The cowering dog lets out a hacking cough and says, "I give up! You're too strong! Please, let me go and I promise to change — I've learned the error of my ways!" You doubt the sincerity of his feebleness and words. Does he take you for some kind of fool? He gives you a toothy smirk. "It was worth a shot." ] He then grabs a flask from his robes and chucks it at you. While you dodge out of the way in the nick of time, the glass sails past your shoulder and shatters on the nearby cell door. The tinkling of crystalline shards is accompanied by a brilliant burst of flame, creating enough noise to draw the attention of what's on the other side. The first kick causes the half-molten door to buckle, the second tears it right off its weakened hinges. What comes lumbering out is a crime against nature. The lilac-furred creature sports massive G-cups with full, luscious lips where its nipples should be, while slick tentacles wiggle and writhe in a putrid mass that extends from the beast's back. Her attention snaps to you, and she begins to salivate; slick fem-cum flows down her muscular thighs and her two dog cocks swell to full mast. She's eager and ready to play. [party.hasGuest |"What in Lumia's name is that?" Drifa says, her voice trembling. "My pet project, and your doom!" 他们那扭曲的脸上浮现出凶残的笑容，带着淫邪的渴望盯着你，然后猛地朝你冲了过来。你无力阻止他们，被他们按倒在地，四肢被牢牢抓住，装备也被夺走了…… [pc.top] 以及 [pc.undergarments] 你的身体被撕成了碎片，只剩下一些残片还紧贴在你的身上，此刻你已完全赤裸，暴露在自然环境中。

一只疯狂的狼族将你按在地上，喘着粗气，它露出那参差不齐、畸形的獠牙，舔着自己的嘴巴，然后露出恶魔般的笑容，紧紧抓住你的头，将自己炽热、肿胀的阴茎压在你的脸上，说道：[pc.ra lupine
        |[pc.mascFem
            |欢迎来到这个游戏包。
            |我要让你成为我的女人。
        ]
        |认清自己的位置，奴隶。
    ]这种泥土的气息如此浓烈、如此原始，以至于当你置身于它那弥漫的云雾之中时，它仿佛会灼烧你的喉咙。由于你距离这种植物如此之近，它那浓重的麝香气味会侵入你的鼻孔，充满你的肺部，因此你不得不竭力抵抗它那强烈而令人窒息的存在。 但是，你逐渐意识到，这种困扰并不是一开始才出现的。它其实一直都在那里，悄悄地侵蚀着你的意志力。

那个压在你脸上的东西终于移开了，那个狼族也松开了抓住你头部的手。 抓住它。 [party.sizeRange 2 3 4
        |[party.hasGuest
            |女孩
            |[companion1.raceShort]
        ]
        |另外两个人
        |另外三个人
    ] 然后放入其中 [party.oneCompanion
        |[companion1.himHer]
        |他们
    ] 等一下！这个我拿走了。”

其他那些被腐蚀的狼族放开了你的四肢，但你的自由并没有持续太久——因为你立刻被一个魁梧的家伙扛在肩上，被带进了洞穴的更深处。你和其他人被分开了…… [party.compNames]无论在何处 [party.oneCompanion
        |[companion1.heShe]的
        |他们是
    ] 希望自己能被选中吧。 [party.oneCompanion
        |[companion1.heShe]'
        |他们
    ]会没事的。
rows.raw:
"
    Your [pc.weapon] slips from your hand[var0|s] and falls to the ground as the pack of corrupted lupines slowly encroach upon you. [party.compNames] struggle[party.oneCompanion
        |s
    ] to continue the fight. You've been defeated.
    
    A predatory grin forms on their twisted expressions. They leer at you with a lecherous hunger before sprinting towards you. Powerless to stop them, you're tackled to the ground, held down by your arms and legs, and stripped of your equipment as your [pc.top] and [pc.undergarments] are torn apart in shredded ribbons. Save for anything left that clings onto your form, you're left completely bare before the elements.
    
    Holding you down and panting, a maddened lupine revels in feral aplomb as he bares his jagged, misshapen fangs and licks his maw. The wolfman then grins devilishly as he affirms a solid grip on your head, lays his hot, turgid cock on your face, and says, "[pc.ra lupine
        |[pc.mascFem
            |Welcome to the pack
            |I'm going to make you my bitch
        ]
        |Learn your place, slave
    ]."
    
    So potent and primal is this earthen scent that it burns in the back of your throat as it looms over you in a miasmic cloud. Being so close to the lupine, as the pervasive odor of his musk invades your nostrils and fills your lungs, you try your best to stave back its overpowering tainted presence. But, you come to the grim realization that this didn't just start assaulting you. It's always been there, silently ebbing away at your endurance.
    
    The dick on your face slides away and the wolfman lets go of your head. "Grab the [party.sizeRange 2 3 4
        |[party.hasGuest
            |girl
            |[companion1.raceShort]
        ]
        |other two
        |other three
    ] and put [party.oneCompanion
        |[companion1.himHer]
        |them
    ] in holding! I got this one."
    
    The other corrupted lupines let go of your limbs, but your freedom is short-lived as you're then slung over a burly shoulder and carried off deeper into the cave. You're separated from [party.compNames]; wherever [party.oneCompanion
        |[companion1.heShe]'s
        |they're
    ] being taken, you hope [party.oneCompanion
        |[companion1.heShe]'
        |they'
    ]ll be okay.
    "

rows.original: Surviving the ambush, you get your bearings and continue. All that's left to do is flip the lever and reactivate the lift. If you wish to push forward, you'll have to flip that switch and take the elevator down into the unknown depths below.
rows.translation: 在躲过埋伏后，你确定了方向，继续前进。接下来要做的就是拨动那个杠杆，重新启动电梯。如果你想继续前进，就必须按下那个开关，乘坐电梯进入下面那未知的深处。
rows.raw: "\n    Surviving the ambush, you get your bearings and continue. All that's left to do is flip the lever and reactivate the lift. If you wish to push forward, you'll have to flip that switch and take the elevator down into the unknown depths below."

rows.original: If Tharsus' words are to be believed, he should be in the chamber below; whether his coup is even able to overthrow Asgeir is a different matter entirely. You've done everything in your power to weigh the odds in your favor. Surely, without the other captains to support him, the corrupted warlord has little chance to succeed. [party.hasGuest |Before you reactivate the mechanism, you turn to Drifa and ask if she's feeling nervous about the battle ahead. Drifa [drifa.isCorrupt |laughs. "Nervous? All I feel is perfect hatred. It's our enemies that should be afraid. |rubs the back of her neck and nods. "A little, yeah. Sure, I may not be some powerful hero, b-but that doesn't matter. People are counting on us, and as long as I can still fight, I'm not giving up. We're going to finish this, once and for all! ]" ] With nothing left for it, [party.yall] step onto the lift and descend.
rows.translation: 如果相信塔尔苏斯的话，他应该就在下面的房间里；不过，他的这次行动是否真的能够成功，还很难说。 有能力 要推翻阿斯盖尔则是另一回事了。你们已经竭尽所能地让自己处于有利的位置。毫无疑问，如果没有其他船长们的支持，这个被腐蚀的军阀几乎没有成功的机会。 [party.hasGuest |在重新激活这个机制之前，你转向Drifa，询问她是否对即将到来的战斗感到紧张。 [drifa.isCorrupt |笑着说：“紧张吗？我感受到的只有无比的仇恨。应该害怕的是我们的敌人。 |他轻轻揉了揉她的后颈，点了点头。“有一点吧，是的。当然，我可能算不上什么强大的英雄，但那并不重要。人们都在期待着我们，只要我还能战斗，我就不会放弃。我们必须彻底完成这件事！ ]" ] 已经没有任何办法了…… [party.yall] 走进电梯，然后开始下降。

rows.original: Before long, the lift comes to stop, and you're greeted by the sight of Tharsus, his imp familiar, and a hulking lupine monstrosity. The corrupted lupines around him turn to look at your arrival; once they see that it's just [party.yall], they lose interest and go back to their preparations. The imp, Meridyx, waves and says, "Hey, champ. What took ya so long?" Tharsus closes his tome with a solid fwump and stows it inside his robes before turning to face you. "Ah. The [pc.title] is here. I expected you sooner. No matter." He wasn't waiting for you, was he? The warlock scoffs. "Humble yourself[pc.isMage |, mageling ]; I do not need your services to succeed. I am merely giving my men time to get into position before we engage with the pincer attack. We wouldn't want our little jarl to run away, would we? My ascension will be assured." In that case, since there's time to kill, you ask for his notes on genderbending the wolfmen. You don't want them getting accidentally destroyed in the upcoming fight. You upheld your end of the bargain, now it's his turn to make good on his promise. "As if I could forget." Tharsus reaches into his robes and pulls out a scroll case. "All of the ingredients you'll need are in my office. Feel free to use the alchemical pool; I won't need it once I'm finished here." You accept the scroll case and stow it into your pack for safekeeping. "You shall have your score of men once I've dealt with Asgeir. You may accompany us into the jarl's chamber, but you will not intervene in the fight. The honor of breaking that fool is mine. But enough talk, it's time to begin." "Got it, boss!" Meridyx gets off her butt and flies over to her master.
rows.translation: 不久之后，电梯停了下来，你眼前出现了塔尔苏斯、他的小精灵伙伴，以及一只庞大的狼族怪物。他周围那些被腐蚀的狼族也都转过头来，注视着你的到来；当他们看到来者只是…… [party.yall]他们失去了兴趣，便重新开始准备自己的事情。 那个小恶魔梅里迪克斯挥了挥手，说道：“嘿，冠军，你怎么花了这么长时间？” 萨拉斯用力合上了他的典籍。 砰！ 然后他把东西藏进自己的长袍里，转过身来面对你。“啊，这个…… [pc.title] 他在这里。我本来以为你会来得更快些，不过也没关系。 他其实并不是在等你，对吧？ 那个巫师冷笑道：“低下你的头吧。[pc.isMage |马格林 ]我不需要你的帮助就能取得成功。我只是想给我的手下们一些时间，让他们做好战斗准备，然后再发起夹击行动。我们当然不希望我们的小酋长逃跑，对吧？我的崛起已经是必然的了。 既然有空闲时间，你便去向他索要关于如何让那些狼族改变性别的方法。你可不想在即将到来的战斗中让这些资料被意外毁掉。你已经履行了自己的承诺，现在轮到他兑现他的诺言了。 我怎么可能忘记呢。”萨鲁斯从长袍里掏出一个卷轴袋，“你所需要的所有材料都在我的办公室里。你可以随意使用炼金池，等我完成这里的工作后，就不再需要它了。 你接过那个卷轴袋，将其收进背包中妥善保管。 “等我解决了阿斯盖尔，你就会得到你所需的人手。你可以和我们一起进入酋长的房间，但不得干预这场战斗。 打破那个傻瓜的记录，这个荣誉应该属于我。不过废话少说，是时候开始了。” “明白，老板！”梅里迪克斯立刻行动起来，飞到了她主人的身边。

rows.original: Moving forwards, leaving the antechamber, you pass through an archway and enter into a dark tunnel. Deeper inside, a commotion on the other end of the tunnel, growing increasingly noticeable as you draw closer to the hub of activity. That's nothing in comparison to the swelling concentration of dense musk which slams into you like a wall. [pc.lowLibido |The sheer volume of lupine pheromones which fills these walls is overpowering! Assaulting not just your nostrils, but biting the very fiber of your being, the miasma is enough for your eyes to wetten and squint |Submerged in the potent magnetism of something so primal, your heart thrums with surreal anticipation ]. At the end of a modest stretch of corridor, another archway opens into a larger cavern which has been enlarged and reshaped into a crude throne room. Two sets of three pillars flank the central area, and gnawed animal bones lie strewn about on the floor. At the center of this chamber is an imperious figure sitting upon a throne which has been carved out of a large stalagmite. From the opposite exit, more wolfmen pour out into the chamber. That must be Tharsus' reinforcements. The seated warlord glares at [party.yall] before turning his gaze to the demonic lupine with you. "What is the meaning of this?" The corrupted lupines still loyal to Asgeir snarl and gnash their teeth at the warlock's men, poised to snap at any moment. Tharsus grins and steps forward. "I should thank you, jarl. You've amassed quite the army for me. However... you've outlived your usefulness." "Tharsus, you snake!" Asgeir shouts, grabbing his weapon and standing up. "You dare take up arms against your own jarl?" The warlock snickers. "I was never loyal to you. That honor goes to my master, Tollus. You were always a means to an end. Although, if you get down on your knees and beg, I might keep you around as my pet." Asgeir points his weapon at Tharsus. "You will lead our men to their doom." "You're right about one thing," Tharsus beckons the lupine monstrosity over to his side, "I will lead. Since you don't want to step down willingly, I challenge you for the position of jarl." Asgeir looks at the standstill between the two lupine forces and snarls. "Fine. I accept your challenge. Your insurrection will die here." "May the best hound win." Tharsus shrugs off his robes and stands up straight, revealing his true, broad physique. "Gertrude, Meridyx, to me!"
rows.translation: 继续前行，离开前厅后，你穿过一座拱门，进入了一条暗影的隧道。 在隧道深处，另一端传来了嘈杂声，随着你逐渐靠近声源，这些声音变得越来越清晰。然而，与那股浓重的麝香气息相比，这些嘈杂声简直微不足道——那股麝香气息就像一堵墙一样，猛烈地扑面而来。 [pc.lowLibido |这些墙壁中弥漫着的狼毒信息素的数量实在太过庞大，简直令人难以承受！它们不仅侵袭你的鼻孔，更深入你的灵魂，这种浓烈的气味足以让你的眼睛湿润、不由自主地眯起眼睛来。 |被这种如此原始、强大的力量所吸引，你的心脏因充满超现实的期待而剧烈跳动。 ]在一条较为狭窄的走廊尽头，另一处拱门通向一个更大的洞穴。这个洞穴已经被扩建和改造，变成了一个简陋的王座厅。中央区域两侧各有一排三根柱子，地面上散落着被啃咬过的动物骨头。 在这个大厅的中心，有一位威严的人物坐在由一根巨大的石笋雕刻而成的王座上。从对面的出口处，更多的狼族涌进了大厅——那些一定是塔苏斯的援军。 那位端坐着的军阀怒目而视。 [party.yall] 在将目光转向与你一起出现的那头恶魔般的狼族之前，他问道：“这到底意味着什么？” 那些仍然效忠于阿斯盖尔的堕落狼族，正对着那名巫师的部下低吼着、咬牙切齿，随时准备发动攻击。 塔萨斯咧嘴一笑，向前走了几步。“我应该感谢你，酋长。你为我召集了一支相当强大的军队。不过……你的用处已经过了。” “塔萨斯，你这个卑鄙的家伙！”阿斯盖尔怒吼着，抓起武器站了起来。 你竟敢拿起武器反抗自己的领主？” 巫师冷笑道：“我从来就没有对你忠诚过。那份忠诚属于我的主人——托卢斯。你只不过是我达到目的的工具罢了。不过，如果你跪下来恳求，或许我会允许你继续留在我身边，当作我的宠物吧。阿斯盖尔将武器指向塔尔苏斯：“你会带领我们的人走向灭亡。” “有一点你说的没错，”塔尔苏斯把那只狼族怪物招到自己身边，“我确实会那么做。 带领既然你不愿意主动辞职，那我就向你发起挑战，争夺这个酋长的职位。” 阿斯盖尔看着双方军队之间的对峙局面，低吼道：“好吧，我接受你的挑战。你们的叛乱在这里就会终结。” “愿最优秀的猎手获胜。”塔苏斯甩开长袍，挺直身体，展现出他那结实魁梧的体格，“格特鲁德、梅里迪克斯，跟我来！

rows.original: Both sides exchange a vicious series of back-and-forth attacks. Asgeir puts up a good fight, but without the aid of his captains, he's quickly overwhelmed. Any damage he deals is mitigated by the imp's magic. Gertrude, the lupine giant, then smacks Asgeir with a thunderous blow, sending him flying and crashing through a rocky pillar; while he's trying to recover, Tharsus grabs the warlord by the neck and places a hand on his chest, ripping the lifeforce from his body. "It's over," Tharsus says, throwing Asgeir to the ground. "You are broken." Asgeir tries to push himself up, but his arms give out underneath him and he collapses. He reaches for his weapon, but Tharsus kicks it away. "I won't give you the mercy of a quick death. I want you to remember this — the pain and humiliation. I want it to leave a scar in your worthless head. I want you to know. Your. Place." Tharsus steps on Asgeir's head and looks to the crowd. "From this day onwards, you all serve me! If any of you dare to stand against me, I shall flense your soul from your body! Follow me as your lord and master, and I shall give you the strength you need! Pledge your loyalty to me or suffer my wrath!"
rows.translation: 双方展开了一系列激烈的交锋。阿斯盖尔虽然奋力抵抗，但在没有他的将领们协助的情况下，很快就陷入了困境。他造成的任何伤害都被那魔物的魔法削弱了。随后，那头狼族巨兽格特鲁德用一记雷霆般的打击将阿斯盖尔击飞，使他撞上了一根岩石柱子；而当他还试图恢复的时候，塔尔苏斯抓住了这位军阀的脖子，将一只手放在他的胸膛上，夺走了他的生命力。 一切都结束了，”塔尔苏斯说着，将阿斯盖尔甩到地上，“你…… 损坏的阿斯盖尔试图挣扎着站起来，但他的手臂却突然失去了力量，他整个人倒了下来。他试图去拿自己的武器，但塔苏斯一脚将武器踢开了。 “我不会给你一个速死的机会。 我要你永远记住这一切——那份痛苦与羞辱。我要让这些记忆在你那毫无价值的脑袋里留下永远的伤痕。我要让你明白：你的位置，就在这里。“塔尔苏斯踩在阿斯盖尔的头上，然后望向人群说道：“从今天起，你们所有人都必须为我效力！ 如果你们当中有人敢反抗我，我就把你们的灵魂从身体里撕出来！跟随我，成为我的奴仆和追随者，我会赐予你们所需要的力量！向我宣誓效忠，否则就承受我的愤怒吧！

rows.original:
The lift comes to a stop, and [party.isJustPC
            |you
            |everyone
        ] steps off the platform before advancing, passing through an archway and entering a dark tunnel.
        
        Deeper inside, a commotion on the other end of the tunnel, growing increasingly noticeable as you draw closer to the hub of activity. That's nothing in comparison to the swelling concentration of dense musk which slams into you like a wall. [pc.lowLibido
            |The sheer volume of lupine pheromones which fills these walls is overpowering! Assaulting not just your nostrils, but biting the very fiber of your being, the miasma is enough for your eyes to wetten and squint
            |Submerged in the potent magnetism of something so primal, your heart thrums with surreal anticipation
        ].
        
        At the end of a modest stretch of corridor, another archway opens into a larger cavern which has been enlarged and reshaped into a crude throne room. Two sets of three pillars flank the central area, and gnawed animal bones lie strewn about on the floor. Within the chamber, a mob of wolfmen argue amongst themselves, and at the center of it all is an imperious figure sitting upon a throne which has been carved out of a large stalagmite. You're well and truly in the belly of the beast.
        
        Locking eyes with the seated wolfman, you watch as he furrows his brow and raises a hand, bringing the entire chamber to a deathly silence. Then, in a regal tone, touched with the gravelly smolder that comes with age, the lupine warlord says, "[pc.Title]... [asgeir.met
            |so we meet again
            |I've been expecting you for some time now
        ]..."

rows.original: "Well. Perhaps there may be surprises in store for me yet. Or perhaps you obscure your plans on principle. Or perhaps you are an instinctive bluffer. No matter. You've earned my respect for reaching this far; not many can say the same. But know this," Asgeir glares at you and says in a stern tone, "if you're here to challenge me, my men will violate you." The warlord's expression relaxes as he then says, "We don't have to be enemies. I could use someone like you as a subject. There's a place for you by my side – not as an equal, but as something more akin to a pet. If you [var0 |surrender Rimescore |lay down your arms ] and devote yourself to me, I can assure you that you will be unharmed. That is my covenant to you. Do you accept?"

rows.original: The final blow lands, knocking the mighty lupine warlord off-balance and sending him to his knees as he tries to regain his footing. [flags.KQ_RIMESCORE |Pickaxe head-down, the mattock pressing against the cave floor, he leans his weight on the handle |Sword point-down, its tip pressing against the cave floor, he leans his weight on the pommel ] and slowly levers himself upright again. It's clear that he's spent almost all of his strength fighting you and has no chance of snatching victory from the jaws of defeat, yet is too stubborn to accept defeat. You're not about to leave anything to chance — while Asgeir is busy with righting himself, you dash forward and kick his [flags.KQ_RIMESCORE |warpick out from under him. The pickaxe |sword out from under him. The crystalline blade ] flies from his hands with a loud clatter, skidding across the cold stone floor, and Asgeir collapses face down on the floor, panting and heaving, each breath drawn out. "My dream..." Asgeir raises his chin just high enough off the ground to peer at the empty space beyond your feet, and you watch as the blood haze drains from his eyes, his expression being replaced with one of pained clarity. "I... failed." The corrupted lupines look at each other in stunned silence before turning and standing down. With Asgeir's defeat, you've severed the head of this serpent; his plans for conquest have been thwarted. You're the strongest person in the eyes of the beastmen, and none of them dare to challenge you. Question of the matter is: what should you do with the corrupted lupines? You've seen their strength firsthand; they're a powerful force to be reckoned with if applied properly. You could recruit them to serve as a standing force for the Wayfort. However, if you're wishing to rehabilitate them, it'd be best to imprison them so a professional can work on cleansing their corruption. There's also the option of making them walk the ice – a Marcher term which would mean their exile to the frozen wastes. Any of these choices will resolve the issue; it's only a matter of how you wish to proceed.

rows.original: You tell Asgeir and his beastmen that they've gone too far and have committed treason against their own homeland. Following the laws of the land, the only proper punishment for the corrupted lupines is to make them walk the ice. The ex-jarl and his men shall be exiled to the furthest reaches of the north so they'll no longer be a danger to their own kinsmen. If there's still a shred of respect for their own heritage in the beastmen, they will carry out this sentence for the rest of their days. Asgeir clutches at his chest and staggers to his feet. "So... you wish to kill us without getting your hands dirty." You retort with how he damned his own men with a foolish pursuit, and now it's time he faces judgment for his actions. It's that or execution. "Blood and ice!" The corrupted warlord grumbles. "Fine." You ask him if he's got any last words. The other corrupted lupines gnash their teeth at you. "Stand down. I regret nothing. Everything I did, I did for my men." Asgeir stands up straight. "I will not give you the joy of knowing we perished in that frozen waste. I will lead my followers to the ice sheets of the glacial rift and endure its tribulations while you watch your world die. We shall not meet again." Asgeir pushes past you, taking the corrupted lupines with him. With that out of the way, you go around and free the wolfmen's captives, receiving many profuse thanks as they make beelines for the exit. You're done here.
rows.translation: 你去告诉阿斯盖尔和他的那些兽人，他们已经做得太过分了，他们背叛了自己的家园。根据这个国家的法律，对于那些堕落的狼族来说，唯一的惩罚就是…… 小心翼翼行事那位前酋长和他的手部下们将被流放到最北方的边疆，这样他们就不会再对自己的族人构成威胁了。如果那些野人还对自己的传统有一丝敬意的话，他们就会终生执行这个判决。 阿斯盖尔捂住胸口，踉跄着站了起来。“所以……你们想不费吹灰之力就杀了我们。” 你反驳道：正是他那愚蠢的举动害了自己的手部下，现在他终于该为自己的行为承担后果了。 要么就这样，要么就处决。 “鲜血与冰霜！”那个被腐蚀的军阀低吼道，“好吧。” 你问他是否有什么最后的话要说。其他那些被腐蚀的狼族则对你露出凶狠的目光。 “退下吧。我没有任何遗憾。 我所做的一切，都是为了我的部下。”阿斯盖尔挺直身子说道，“我不会让你们有机会知道我们是在那片冰封的荒原中丧生的。我会带领我的追随者们前往冰川裂谷的冰原上，在那里忍受一切艰难困苦，而你们则会眼睁睁看着自己的世界走向毁灭。 我们再也不会见面了。”阿斯盖尔从你身边挤过去，带着那些被腐蚀的狼族一起离开了。 事情解决后，你转身去解救那些被狼族俘虏的人们，他们纷纷向你表示衷心的感谢，然后急匆匆地朝出口跑去。 你在这里的任务已经完成了。

rows.original: You produce a long rope and form a coffle with the corrupted lupines, tying their wrists together to prevent them from escaping even in the event that they get the bright idea of resisting you before reaching the eldritch green pool. Their leader, Asgeir, submits with his head down; that alone seems enough to get the rest of the pack to comply. Along the way, you free the wolfmen's captives. Many of the people you freed express their gratitude to you before making their way towards the exit. [party.Yall], trailed by a platoon of corrupted lupines, head to Tharsus' laboratory and grab the necessary reagents for the alteration. Per his instructions, you mix them all together into a large jar before leaving his office, bringing the wolfmen with you. After a brisk walk, you finally approach the eldritch pool. You try to ignore the moist, sticky warmth of its sickening, green glow as you study it, thoughts of how welcome a bath would be testing your focus. The miasma rising from its oily surface isn't so much rotten as it is chemical, a sour scent reminiscent of green apples — if this is what the side effects are for merely being near it, you can only imagine what'll happen to these men once the transformation begins. Opening the container of sickly pink liquid, you turn it upside down and pour it all out into the pool, letting it act as a large alchemical cauldron. After a few seconds, the green hue of the pool shifts to a magenta color. With this little alteration out of the way, all that's left is to send your test subjects in. You turn to their leader and order him in. There is a moment of hesitation, one last spark of defiance, in the old wolf's eyes, before he sighs with resignation and complies. His men follow him in one by one, submerging into the goo. It's a process of minutes, leaving you to sit by the water's edge and watch. Asgeir surfaces first, shaking out his fur — or is it really his anymore? The old wolf's figure has shifted like remolded clay, softening around the edges; shoulders are more slender while hips have widened to motherly proportions. The feminization is undeniable, instantly recognizable to both Asgeir and the other wolfs that follow in rising from the waters, transformed. The corrupted lupines leer and mock each others' new slenderness before gritting their fangs and grabbing at their loins in order to check what's happening, an instinctive and shameless response to the sudden sensation. At first they panic and pull their pants down for closer inspection, whimpering as their dicks and sheaths wither away, retracting into their bodies and leaving nothing but smooth skin. Their cocks are gone, and in its wake are brand new pink, unused cunts! The corrupted lupines shiver and gasp before running their hands across their chests, only to find that they've grown to be massive pairs of breasts! They then bring their hands up and give their new teats a good pinch and squeeze, admiring their new busts. Before long, all of the wolfmen complete their transformation into b[silly |odacious |uxom ] wolfbabes! From this moment onwards, each and every one of them is now a part of your harem-cum-honor guard. [flags.KQ_POOL 1 | |You think back to the chest you saw in the alchemical pool; it's still there. Since most of your wolfgirls are already swimming in the stuff and are perfectly fine, aside from their drastic transformation, it stands to reason that they'd be best equipped with fetching it for you. You set down your pack, pull out a coil of rope, and hold out one end towards one of your wolfgirls before [pc.isDK |demanding her to |asking if she can ] go down there and tie the rope to the chest. Once she's ready, she can tug on the rope, indicating for you to pull both her and the chest up. "Ooooh," the corrupted lupine croons. "Sure thing, dear." The wolfbabe takes a deep breath and accepts the end of the rope. She then takes a few steps back before dashing forward and plunging headfirst into the magenta liquid. All you can do now is wait. Seconds pass, and the large, busty image of wolfwoman grows increasingly distorted and faded as she descends deeper through the cloudy substance. Before long, you feel a tug coming from the other side, followed by another, and then another. Wasting no time, you begin reeling the rope in, pulling both the wolfgirl and the chest up. It's time to find out how much this trouble was worth. Turning your attention to the chest, you lift the latch and throw it open, finding a singular flute-necked bottle within.There's no doubt about it, this is a dose of Kaelirra's Tears. Furthermore, your storage capacity has increased by 5! ]
rows.translation: 你取来一根长绳，将那些被腐蚀的狼族绑在一起，将他们的手部腕牢牢绑住，这样即使他们在到达那片诡异的绿色水池之前突然想要反抗，也无处逃脱。他们的首领阿斯盖尔低着头屈服了；仅仅这一举动似乎就足以让其他狼族服从命令。 一路上，你解救了那些被狼族俘虏的人们。许多被解救的人在离开之前都向你表达了感激之情。 [party.Yall]在一群被腐蚀的狼族的跟随下，你前往塔苏斯的实验室，取来了进行改造所需的炼金材料。按照他的指示，你将所有这些炼金材料混合在一起，装进一个大罐子里，然后带着那些狼族离开了他的办公室。 经过一段快速的行走，你终于来到了那个充满诡异气息的池塘旁。 当你仔细观察它时，那种潮湿、黏腻的热气以及它那令人作呕的绿色光芒实在让人难以忽视。此时，你不禁想到洗个澡该有多舒服，这种想法不断干扰着你的注意力。从它那油滑的表面散发出来的气味，与其说是一种腐烂的气味，不如说是一种化学气味，那种酸涩的味道让人联想到青苹果——如果仅仅是因为靠近它就会产生这样的副作用，那么可以想象，当这些男人真正开始发生变化时，会发生什么事情。 你打开那个装有淡粉色液体的容器，将其倒置，然后将里面的液体全部倒入水池中，让它们充当一个巨大的炼金锅。几秒钟后，水池中的绿色逐渐变成了洋红色。完成了这个小小的调整之后，接下来要做的就是把你的实验对象放进去。 你转向他们的首领，命令他带头进去。 在那只老狼的眼中，闪过一丝犹豫，最后一丝反抗的火花，但最终它还是无奈地叹了口气，服从了命令。它的同伴们一个接一个地跟了进去，消失在了那黏稠的物质中。 整个过程只持续了几分钟，而你则只是坐在水边，静静地观察着这一切。 阿斯盖尔首先浮出了水面，抖了抖身上的毛发——或者，那真的只是毛发而已吗？ 他的 还像从前那样吗？那只老狼的身影已经发生了变化，就像被重新塑造的黏土一样，边缘变得柔和了；它的肩膀更加纤细，而臀部则变得宽大，呈现出母性般的轮廓。这种女性化的变化显而易见，无论是阿斯盖尔，还是其他那些从水中跃起、同样发生了变化的狼们，都能立刻认出来。 那些被腐蚀的狼族互相注视着，嘲笑对方新出现的纤细身形，然后咬紧牙关，抓住自己的腰部，试图弄清楚到底发生了什么——这种反应纯粹是出于本能，也毫无羞耻之心。起初它们会陷入恐慌，急忙拉下裤子仔细检查，当自己的阴茎和包皮逐渐萎缩、重新缩回体内，只剩下光滑的皮肤时，它们会发出呜咽声。 他们的老二没了，而取而代之的，是那些崭新的、粉红色的、从未被使用过的阴道！ 那些被腐蚀的狼族颤抖着，喘着粗气，然后把手部放在胸口，却发现…… 它们的大小已经变得像巨大的乳房一样了！ 然后她们把双手部举起来，仔细地捏了捏、按了按自己新长出来的胸部，欣赏着自己的新变化。 不久之后， 所有的狼族都完成了向“B形态”的转变。[silly |大胆的、无耻的 |uxom ] 狼女们！ 从这一刻起，他们每一个人都成为了你后宫兼荣誉卫队的一员。 [flags.KQ_POOL 1 | |你回想起来在炼金池里看到的那个箱子，它还在那里。既然你那些变成狼的女孩们都已经泡在那种液体里，而且除了发生了剧烈的变化之外，并没有出现任何问题，那么让她们去把那个箱子拿过来给你应该是最合适的选择。你放下背包，拿出一卷绳子，然后把绳子的一头递给其中一只狼女孩…… [pc.isDK |要求她做…… |询问她是否可以 ] 去那边把绳子系在箱子上面。等她准备好了，就可以拉绳子，这样你就可以把她和箱子一起拉上来。” “哦哦哦……”那只被腐蚀的狼族低声说道，“当然可以，亲爱的。 狼族少女深吸一口气，接受了绳子的束缚。她先后退了几步，然后突然向前冲去，一头扎进了那紫红色的液体之中。 现在，你所能做的，就是等待。 几秒钟过去了，那个身材高挑、胸部丰满的狼族形象在不断向下穿过那片浑浊的物质时，逐渐变得模糊不清、颜色也逐渐褪去。不久之后，你感觉到另一边传来了一阵拉扯力，接着又是另一阵，然后是第三阵。 你没有浪费任何时间，立刻开始把绳子收回来，将那个狼女和那个箱子一起拉了上来。 现在是时候看看这些麻烦到底值不值得了。你把注意力转向那个箱子，打开锁扣，将其掀开，发现里面只有一只长着笛子形状瓶颈的瓶子。毫无疑问，这确实是一剂…… 凯莉拉的泪水. 此外，你的存储容量还增加了5！ ]

rows.original:
[party.hasGuest
        |[drifa.isCorrupt
            |As you leave the mines you're met with a torrential downpour. Looks like you're taking the mountain path; no point climbing down at this juncture. Continuing onwards, being careful as to not slip on the mud as you plod through it, the walk down is quiet, save for the drumming of heavy rain. Drifa's expression is emotionless and hard to read. Once everyone's at the run-down campsite and drying themselves off, Drifa looks to the sky, closes her eyes, and takes a deep breath, feeling the droplets hit her face and drench her clothes. Before long, the rain abates and dulled rays of [dayNight
                |sunshine
                |moonlight
            ] peer through the thick, gray clouds.
            
            "Huh, would you look at that?" Drifa dryly remarks. "The gods have a sense of humor."
            
            Drifa walks to the water's edge and stares longingly at her own reflection[drifa.hasFlower
                |. She then takes the blue flower out of her hair, crouches down, and gently places it on the water before letting it float away from her
            ]. You sidle up next to [drifa.dated
                |your sweetheart
                |the half-lupine priestess
            ] and [drifa.hasFlower
                |ask why she threw your gift away. Was it really that bad?
                |look at her reflection before looking at your own.
            ]
            
            [drifa.hasFlower
                |Drifa stands up and says, "I accidentally ruined it in all the chaos. I'm sorry." Looking at her own reflection again, she says, 
            ]"I've been thinking back to my experience in the mine. You taught me that [var0
                |right and wrong are tidal waves, [pc.name] — they're ever-shifting ideas. I sacrificed my innocence to survive and punish the guilty. But when our enemies posed no further threat to us, you urged me to forgive and walk away. I wanted to hurt Conchobar. I wanted to hurt Asgeir... but broken as they were, how could they hurt anyone? Now the ex-jarl will serve out the rest of his sentence, knowing that I rejected his justifications
                |innocence is a chrysalis, [pc.name] — a phase designed to end. Only when we're free from it do we know ourselves. I'm no longer the naive girl I once was. I sacrificed my innocence to survive and punish the guilty. Now we're strong, and our survival is the only thing that matters... but I can't help but wonder if that makes me the new monster
            ]."
            
            You [drifa.dated
                |rub Drifa's shoulder
                |pat Drifa on the back
            ], comforting her before asking if she feels any regret.
            
            "It's hard to say: we're all the result of our actions. All we can do now is live with our actions. If anything... I'm scared. I'm scared of what the future holds... and I'm scared of being alone. I need you to promise me that you'll never leave. I can't do this alone."
            
            [drifa.dated
                |Isn't that a given, what with your
                |[pc.isDK
                    |You don't know this girl well enough to make such a promise. Doesn't she have a family she can
                    |You're not one to accept promises lightly. There's no telling
                ]
            ]—
            
            "Promise me!"
            
            You relent and promise to never abandon Drifa in her time of need. She doesn't have to be scared of what the future has in store for her. If anything, she's got the freedom to decide what that may be.
            
            "Maybe," Drifa dryly replies, nodding along. "It'll take time for me to adjust, but I know I can do it if I have help. Who knows. Maybe even I can be redeemed... if not, then I can at least accept what I've become and move on."
            |As you emerge from the mines you're met with the sight of [dayNight
                |golden rays of sunlight
                |silver rays of moonlight
            ] peering through the gray, overcast skies.
            
            "We did it. We really did it!" Drifa remarks with astonished joy.
            
            The mountainous path is slightly muddy and slippery with dew, but no way are you risking your neck climbing down the side of it. Continuing onwards, the walk down is surprisingly yet pleasantly quiet. Once everyone's at the run-down campsite and drying themselves off, Drifa walks to the water's edge and stares at her own reflection with a smile on her face. Following her, you sidle up next to [drifa.dated
                |your sweetheart
                |the half-lupine priestess
            ] and look at her reflection.
            
            [silly
                |Despite everything, it's still her.
            ]
            
            You ask Drifa what's on her mind. She was quiet during the walk here, and not her usual kind of quiet either. You doubt she's just admiring her own appearance.
            
            "Oh, yeah. I was just... reflecting on some things."
            
            Such as?
            
            "Well, mostly about what I learned. You taught me that [var1
                |justice is a contract. Once broken, it can never be mended. We fought tooth and nail to protect the innocent... but to the guilty, we showed no mercy. I... I didn't want to hurt Conchobar. But what he did to me — his betrayal — he earned his punishment. I was angry... and scared. My hands were shaking when I did it... but you were there to steady them
                |evil is just a word; under the skin, it's simple pain. For us... mercy was its own victory. We endured, and when given the chance, we forgave. Asgeir thought the world was merciless and cruel... but he was wrong. We're proof of this. And in forgiving, we've left the door open for him. I pray he sees this salvation. Only time will tell what he becomes
            ]. I could not have done this without you, [pc.name]."
            
            You [drifa.dated
                |turn Drifa towards you and plant a kiss on her lips. It's not like you would've left your sweetheart in her time of need. She's stuck with you whether she likes it or not
                |pat Drifa on the back and tell her that you're glad to have helped
            ].
            
            "Thanks," Drifa says[drifa.dated
                |, blushing as her tail wags
                | with a smile, her tail wagging
            ]. "I suppose it's time we pick up our boots and head on out."
        ]
        |[pc.isDK
            |As you emerge from the mines you're met with a torrential downpour; the gods clearly have a sense of humor. The mountainous path is muddy and slick with rain, but no way are you risking your neck climbing down the side of it. Plodding onwards, the walk down is quiet, save for the drumming of heavy rain. Before long, the rain abates and dull rays of [dayNight
                |sunshine
                |moonlight
            ] begin to peer through the thick, gray clouds
            |As you emerge from the mines you're met with the sight of golden rays of sunlight peering through the gray, overcast skies. The mountainous path is slightly muddy and slippery with dew, but no way are you risking your neck climbing down the side of it. Continuing onwards, the walk down is surprisingly yet pleasantly quiet
        ]. All that's left to do is head back to Hawkethorne and get something warm to eat[pc.isDK
            | as you dry off
        ]. After that, it's back to business as usual.
    ]
    
    [var2
        |This just leaves one last question: where is Drifa going to go after this? With the defeat of the corrupted lupines, it's very likely that she'll head back home to her folks, but if she wants to stick around, you'd be glad to have her assistance at the Wayfort. The place could use someone of her talents. The choice to extend the invitation or not to the half-lupine priestess is yours.
    ]
rows.translation:
[party.hasGuest
        |[drifa.isCorrupt
            |当你离开矿区时，突然下起了倾盆大雨。看来你选择了山路；在这个时候下山已经没有意义了。继续前行吧，小心别在泥泞中滑倒。一路上，只有大雨的敲击声，其他一切都显得格外安静。 德里法的表情毫无情绪，让人难以读懂。当所有人都来到那个破败的露营地并擦干身体后，德里法抬头望向天空，闭上眼睛深吸一口气，感受着雨滴打在脸上的感觉，以及雨水浸湿她衣物的感觉。 不久之后，雨势减弱了，阳光重新变得柔和起来。 [dayNight
                |阳光
                |兼职工作
            ] 透过厚厚的灰色云层望去。

“哈，你看看那个吧？”德丽法干巴巴地说道，“神明们还真有幽默感。”

德丽法走到水边，满怀憧憬地凝视着自己在水中的倒影。[drifa.hasFlower
                |然后，她将头发上的蓝色花朵摘下来，蹲下身子，轻轻地将它放在水面上，然后看着它缓缓漂远。
            ]你悄悄地走到他身边。 [drifa.dated
                |你的爱人
                |那位半狼人身份的女祭司
            ] 以及 [drifa.hasFlower
                |问问她为什么把你的礼物扔掉了。真的有那么糟糕吗？
                |先看看她倒影中的自己，再看看你自己的模样。
            ]
            
            [drifa.hasFlower
                |德里法站起身来说：“在那一片混乱中，我不小心把事情搞砸了。我很抱歉。”再次看着自己倒映在镜子中的样子，她继续说道： 
            ]我一直在回想我在矿井里的那些经历。是你教会了我那些…… [var0
                |是非就像潮水一般，来去无常。 [pc.name] — 那些不过是不断变化的借口罢了。我牺牲了自己的清白，只为生存下去并惩罚那些有罪之人。但当我们的敌人不再对我们构成威胁时，你却劝我原谅他们，然后放下过去。我想要伤害康乔巴尔，想要伤害阿斯盖尔……但他们已经如此脆弱，又怎么可能再去伤害别人呢？现在，那位前酋长将会继续完成他的刑期，而他心里明白，我拒绝了他的任何辩解。
                |纯真犹如一只蛹， [pc.name] ——这是一个注定要结束的阶段。只有当我们摆脱了它，才能真正认识自己。我已不再是那个曾经的天真少女。为了生存，也为了惩罚那些有罪之人，我牺牲了自己的纯真。如今我们变得坚强了，生存才是唯一重要的……但我不禁会想，这样的改变是否让我变成了另一个“怪物”。
            ]你 [drifa.dated
                |轻拍德莉法的肩膀
                |表扬某人
            ]在询问她是否感到任何后悔之前，先安慰了她一番。

“这很难说：我们都是自己行为的后果。现在我们能做的，就是接受自己的行为所带来的后果，继续生活下去。如果非要说的话……我害怕。我害怕未来会发生什么……我也害怕孤独。我需要你向我保证，你永远不会离开我。我一个人无法面对这一切。
            
            [drifa.dated
                |考虑到你的情况，这难道不是理所当然的吗？
                |[pc.isDK
                    |你对这个女孩还不够了解，还不足以做出这样的承诺。她难道没有可以依靠的家庭吗？
                    |你可不是那种会轻易相信承诺的人。谁也说不准会发生什么。
                ]
            ]答应我！”

你终于让步了，承诺在Drifa需要的时候永远不会抛弃她。她不必害怕未来会带来什么，相反，她有自由去决定自己的未来会是什么样子。

“也许吧，”Drifa干巴巴地回答着，点了点头。“我需要一些时间来适应，但我相信如果有帮助的话，我一定能做到。谁知道呢……也许我甚至能够得到救赎……如果不能，那么至少我也可以接受自己现在的样子，然后继续前进。
            |当你从矿井中出来时，映入眼帘的是…… [dayNight
                |金色的阳光
                |银色的月光
            ] 透过灰蒙蒙的阴云望去……

“我们做到了，真的做到了！”德里法激动地欢呼道。

这条山路被露水弄得有些泥泞，也变得很滑，但谁也不会冒险从山坡上爬下来啊。 继续前行，下山的路出奇地安静而惬意。当所有人都来到那个破败的露营地并擦干身体后，Drifa走到水边，面带微笑地凝视着自己在水中的倒影。 跟在她身后，你悄悄地走到了她旁边。 [drifa.dated
                |你的爱人
                |那位半狼人身份的女祭司
            ] 然后看看她倒映在镜子中的样子。
            
            [silly
                |尽管发生了这一切，她依然是她。
            ]
            
            你问德丽法在想什么。她在这次路上一直很安静，而且这种安静与她平时的性格完全不同。你怀疑她并不是在欣赏自己的外貌。

“哦，对。我只是在……思考一些事情。”

比如什么事情呢？

“嗯，主要是关于我所学到的一些东西。是你教会了我那些…… [var1
                |正义其实是一种契约。一旦被违背，就再也无法修复。我们拼尽全力去保护无辜的人……但对于那些有罪之人，我们从未手下留情。我……我并不想伤害康乔巴尔。但他对我的背叛……他罪有应得。我当时很愤怒……也很害怕。动手的时候，我的手都在颤抖……但你有在那里，稳住了我的双手。
                |邪恶只是一个词语罢了；实际上，它只不过是一种痛苦而已。对我们来说……宽恕本身就是一种胜利。我们忍受了痛苦，而当有机会时，我们也选择了原谅。阿斯盖尔认为这个世界是无情而残酷的……但他错了。我们就是最好的证明。而通过宽恕，我们也为他留下了重新开始的机会。我祈祷他能看到这种救赎的力量。只有时间才能告诉我们，他最终会变成什么样的人。
            ]没有你，我根本不可能完成这件事。 [pc.name]你 [drifa.dated
                |将Drifa拉向自己，然后在她的嘴唇上轻吻一下。毕竟，在她需要帮助的时候，你肯定不会抛弃自己的爱人。无论她是否愿意，她终究是选择了与你在一起。
                |拍拍德莉法的背，告诉她你很高兴能帮上她的忙。
            ]谢谢，”德里法说道。[drifa.dated
                |她的尾巴摇动着，脸上也泛起了红晕。
                | 她微笑着，尾巴欢快地摇着。
            ]我想，是时候穿上靴子出发了。
        ]
        |[pc.isDK
            |当你从矿井中出来时，迎面扑来的是倾盆大雨；看来诸神确实有着幽默感。山间的小路被雨水冲得泥泞不堪、湿滑难行，但你绝不会冒险从山坡上爬下来。你闷闷不乐地继续前行，下山的路上一片寂静，只有大雨的敲击声回荡在耳边。不久之后，雨势渐渐减弱，昏暗的阳光开始透出…… [dayNight
                |阳光
                |兼职工作
            ] 开始透过厚厚的灰云望去
            |当你走出矿井时，会看到金色的阳光透过灰蒙蒙的云层照射下来。山间的小路被露水弄得有些泥泞且湿滑，但你绝对不会冒险从山坡上爬下来。继续前行，这段下山的路出人意料地安静而惬意。
        ]现在要做的就是回到鹰棘镇，找些热乎的食物来吃。[pc.isDK
            | 等你擦干身体后
        ]之后，一切就会恢复到正常状态。
    ]
    
    [var2
        |这就只剩下最后一个问题了：在这一切之后，Drifa会去哪里呢？既然那些被腐蚀的狼人已经被击败，她很可能会回到家乡与家人团聚。不过，如果她愿意留下来，我们在荒废驿堡也非常需要她的帮助——这个地方确实需要像她这样有能力的人。是否邀请这位半狼人女祭司留下来，这个决定完全由你来做。
    ]

It couldn't hurt to have an extra set of hands around; the halfbreed has proven herself a capable spellcaster and it couldn't hurt to recruit her services. The Wayfort belongs to you and it isn't that far. Having a reliable way of interacting with her would be more fruitful than having to track her down in town each time you want to discuss anything. This just leaves the matter of actually asking her. As skittish as this lady is, there's no telling if she'll just outright turn down the offer, but it doesn't hurt to ask. Despite it being her home, Drifa did say that she felt uncomfortable in town. Extending the invitation, you wait for her response.

        "The old fort? Are you sure?" Drifa asks.
        
        You insist it's fine. The fort is guarded and is not nearly as densely populated as Hawkethrone.
        
        She considers your proposal further before ultimately making her decision. Lifting her chin up, closing the social schism between you and her, the dog-girl finally makes eye contact with you and forms a slight smile on her face. It's a weak smile, but a smile nonetheless.
        
        "I'd like that. Thank you."
        
        Well then, at least that part's dealt with. It might take some time for her to pack up her things and settle in, but you're sure she'll be a pleasant addition to the fort [pc.isDK
            |as someone to mess with
            |and lend a helping hand in whatever way she can
        ]. Once [party.yall] arrive at the fort, you and Drifa split ways[var0
            |, taking the corrupted lupines with you to be processed
        ]. If you ever wish to hang out with Drifa again you at least know where to find her now.

[flags.MERIDYX_CAMP_APPROACH
        |You excuse yourself from the camp and step out, looking for a safe place to do this. 
        
        Once you're a stone's throw away from the camp and absolutely sure that the coast is clear, you reach into your pack and dig around a bit. Before long, you find the speaking stone and bring it to your lips, [pc.isDK
            |order
            |request
        ]ing for your familiar's presence.
        
        "Sounds good," Meridyx's voice says through the device. "Be there soon."
        
        Seconds turn to minutes; soon enough, the red shortstack finally arrives, swooping down from above.
        
        "Heya boss." Meridyx lands before you and rests a hand on her hip, regarding you with a sultry smile. "Is this a booty call or did ya have something else in mind?"
        |You excuse yourself from the camp and step out, looking for a safe place to do this. 
        
        Once you're a stone's throw away from the camp and absolutely sure that the coast is clear, you reach into your pack and dig around a bit until you pull out the porous stone Meridyx gave you. It's still strange: it doesn't look like any other speaking stone you've seen, but that's probably due to its origins. This device, along with its twin in Meridyx's possession, belonged to Kasyrra at one point. Perhaps that's the norm in the realm she comes from. It's not the first time you've seen her with strange apparatuses. No matter. This thing works like any other speaking stone. It shouldn't be hard to use this one. You bring the implement to your lips and speak into its sponge-like pores, [pc.isDK
            |order
            |request
        ]ing for Meridyx's presence.
        
        You get an immediate response back.
        
        "Fuck. Okay, hold on," the voice on the other side says, albeit sounding muffled. You then hear the soft thuds of shuffling objects and the jingle of coins rolling onto each other. After a few seconds, she resumes, sounding much clearer than before as she says, "Ah! There ya are! Hey, [pc.mf
            |stud
            |hun
        ]. I'll be right there.[silly
            | Wait... how many words was that? Fourteen? Alright, that's eleven words—
        ]"
        
        The message ends. All you can do now is wait. You hope she was close by when you called her.
        
        Seconds turn to minutes; soon enough, the red shortstack finally arrives, swooping down from above.
        
        "Nice camp ya got here, [pc.master]. Whole lotta nothing." The imp rests a hand on her hip and regards you with a cheeky grin. "Ya scared about the others seeing us together?" She snickers and then flips her hair. "Don't worry. This can be our little secret. So... now that I'm here, whatcha need from lil ol' me?"

        你还在思考接下来该说什么，但那个小精灵先清了清嗓子，迅速大声喊道：

“除非你立刻彻底投降，否则我什么都不会接受！所以，举起手部来，放下武器，把你的东西都交出来吧！ 否则的话……”

这不可能真的发生吧。他是认真的吗？你又没有放弃自己的东西啊。但是，那个模糊的能量球似乎并不喜欢你的怀疑态度。他的笑容立刻变成了怒容。
        
        很好！那么我就凭自己一个人的力量，彻底打败你们所有人！你们一定会后悔来到我的地盘！
        
        [party.has brint|等我们把他揍得够惨后，我想我应该试试看看精灵们的身体到底有多有弹性，”布林特说道，“我打赌，如果我真的努力的话，肯定能钻进他的身体里去。”

尼尼安忍不住低头看了看你同伴的裆部，他的脸立刻涨得通红。他愤怒地尖叫着，像个小孩子一样在空中盘旋飞舞。难道所有的精灵都是这么不成熟、情绪如此容易失控的，还是说布林特只是个例外呢？ [pc.isDK|非常搞笑|狡猾得很]闭嘴！我现在真的要揍你们所有人了！我可不是什么……你们用来发泄幻想的出气筒，你们这些大混蛋！]
        
        好吧，这种事情真的发生了。 [party.som|你准备好了吗？ [pc.weapon]|你和你的朋友准备好吧。|你和团队迅速做好了战斗准备。]完全不明白为什么事情会发展成一场争吵。 [pc.isDK|但是为那些该死的掐捏行为报仇本身就已经是一种回报了——至少之后你还可以有机会好好教训那个小混蛋一番，从中获得一些乐趣！]
rows.raw:
"
        As you pass through some tightly packed trees whilst casually traversing the Old Forest, you can't shake the feeling that something is different in the air. It's as if you're being stalked by something but you don't hear anything. But then [party.som|you|both you and your companion|all of you] see something zip by with tremendous speed. Ow! Did something just pinch you!? [pc.isDK|SON OF A BITCH! IT DID IT AGAIN!?]

        Another blurry entity shoots around the edge of your vision, various greens standing out as it passes by. But swatting with your [pc.hand] isn't quite fast enough to hit whatever it is. You ready another swing but an explosion of light erupts outward from the pest, blinding [party.som|you|you and [comp1.name]|all of you] before laughing.
        
        "Ha! Got ya!"
        
        You turn your blurry vision towards what sounds like a girl, expecting to find some asshole trickster hiding in some bushes nearby with a corny spell. Instead standing before you is a bona fide[flags.TODO_FEY_CODEX_UNLOCKED| pixie|... forest sprite]?
        
        Floating with dragonfly-like wings flapping at breakneck speeds, the [flags.TODO_FEY_CODEX_UNLOCKED|pixie|sprite] is tiny; only about a foot or so tall.[flags.FEY_CODEX_UNLOCKED|| Their tanned-skin makes them look like a tiny winged wyld elf.] He — or she? — has a gender-neutral face with a confident smirk and long pointy ears, with green eyes that study your every move closely. Their light, yellowish-green undercut hair, with spots of bleached white, curls toward the right side of their adorable tiny face. There's a set of small green lines beneath their eyes like a part of some natural body-markings — if the matching shades are anything to go by — that curl gently away like swirling tides.
        
        But looking them over, you notice that some things stand out; they don't have breasts but rather soft pecs beneath a black-furred, chest-cropped and sleeveless jacket. Down their back, you can see more green markings that form an intricate and symmetrical pattern all the way to their waistline. Their stomach is flat with the smallest trace of abs. Although the hips are androgynous, they form part of a pinch-worthy bubbly butt. And then there is the tiny, human-like cock and matching sack that hangs between their legs; both are outlined vividly against the tight frame of his black, fur loincloth. If the individual was your size — or bigger — you wager they would scale pretty well-off in the dick-size department. Girly as they may be, you can only make a reasoned guess: male.
        
        Tiring of your inspecting gaze however, they bellow at you. "I need you to hand over your food this instant! Or else I'll keep dazzling you!"
        
        Well, that answers who the blur is and why it keeps blinding you.
        
        "I am Ninian, the strongest and most independent of all pixies!" [party.som|He points at you|Both hands rise to point to you and your nearby ally|He waves one of his arms while pointing] and yells right in your face. "And you. Are. Trespassing! You shall pay a tribute of bountiful food, or else!"
        
        [party.has cait|"Aw, isn't he just adorable?" says Cait. Your friendly pink cat can't help but slip up to the front beside you, reaching her hand out and patting the little flying male's head and bringing a blush to his puny cheeks.
        
        "H-Hey! I am big and tough and-"
        
        "Oooo, you're big and tough? I bet you are! Yes, you are! Oh [pc.name], can't we give him something? I'm sure I got something in my bag that he could eat!"|]
        
        You're considering what to say next, but the pixie clears his throat and quickly starts yelling first.
        
        "I will not take anything but your instant and complete surrender! So hands up, weapons down, and surrender your goods! Or else!"
        
        There's no way this is really happening. Is he serious? You aren't giving up your things. But it seems like the blurred ball of energy isn't fond of your incredulity. His smirk turns into a scowl.
        
        "Very well! Then I, Ninian, will beat you totally all on my own! And you're going to regret ever coming to my neck of the woods!"
        
        [party.has brint|"When we're done beating him up, I think I might try seeing just how stretchy pixies really are," Brint says. "I bet I could get inside him if I really tried."
        
        Ninian can't help but look down at your companion's crotch and his face flushes red. He screams out in anger and flies around in circles like a brat. Are all pixies so immature and volatile, or is Brint just that [pc.isDK|hilarious|much of a sly fox]?
        
        "S-Shut up! N-Now I'm really going to beat you all up! I'm not some... some cocksleeve for your stretching fantasies, you huge bully!"]
        
        Well, this is happening. [party.som|You ready your [pc.weapon]|You and your friend ready yourselves|You and the group quickly prepare for battle], completely in the dark about why this had to come to a fight. [pc.isDK|But getting revenge for those fucking pinches is its own reward — or at least offer you a chance to have some fun with the little shit afterward!]"

rows.original: Victorious at last, you get to watch Ninian for a few moments before finally deciding that this is over. Making your way over, Ninian doesn't even try to escape your [pc.hand] grabbing him. Hefting him up to your face,[party.has cait| particularly having to turn away with Ninian in hand so Cait can't snatch him for herself,] you're left with some decisions. You could talk to the little guy, sure... or you could have some fun. Walking away wouldn't be too bad, but would this twink really learn his lesson if you didn't try to reason with or fuck him?

rows.raw: "You don't need to fuck this small and sparsely dressed pixie, so why not just talk with him?"

rows.original: Well... he's small but that doesn't mean you can't get off, right? Flying around with so much skin showing, this little slutty twink is practically asking for it anyway!
rows.translation: 嗯……他确实身材娇小，但那并不意味着你就不能和他发生关系，对吧？穿着这么暴露在空气中飞行，这个看起来那么诱人的小家伙，简直就是在主动邀请别人啊！
rows.raw: "Well... he's small but that doesn't mean you can't get off, right? Flying around with so much skin showing, this little slutty twink is practically asking for it anyway!"

rows.original:
Crumbling to the ground in defeat, you can't believe you lost to a pixie! Ninian can't seem to believe it either, raising both hands and laughing in victory as his wings carry him down to your dirt-smushed face.

    "Hah! I, Ninian the Strongest Pixie, stand victorious! Now, I shall take whatever I wish from you and... uh... you know. I'm going to just get going."
    
    Quickly rooting through your things, almost looking comical with how small he is, Ninian doesn't hesitate before turning and zipping off with his ill-gained goods. Are pixies really this difficult to beat? This feels a lot like you made a mistake and somehow goofed on something that should have been an easy win. But just before he fully slips out of sight, the pixie turns back and extends a puny hand in your direction. Your body's aching fades, but not quick enough as Ninian finishes his flight toward the treetops to hide out. [party.som||Looks like [comp1.name] is feeling better, too.|Based on your party's own recovery, Ninian must have healed all of you.] You're not sure why a thief would heal their victims but at least he hasn't left you to fend for yourself.
rows.translation:
在失败中倒地不起，你简直无法相信自己竟然会输给一个精灵！尼尼安似乎也难以相信这一点，他双手部叉腰，胜利地大笑着，然后展开翅膀，降落在你那被泥弄脏的脸上。

“哈！ 我，最强小精灵尼尼安，胜利了！现在，我可以从你这里拿走任何我想得到的东西……嗯，你懂的。我这就开始行动了。

尼尼安快速地翻找着你的东西，由于他的体型实在太小，这一幕看起来甚至有点滑稽。但他毫不迟疑，拿上那些不义之财后，就匆匆离开了。 精灵真的这么难打败吗？感觉你好像犯了一些错误，导致本该轻松获胜的比赛变得如此艰难。但在它即将完全消失在视线之外时，那只精灵突然转过身来，朝你的方向伸出了它那小小的手部。 身体的疼痛逐渐消退，但还没等你反应过来，尼尼安就已经飞到了树顶，躲了进去。 [party.som||看起来是这样。 [comp1.name] 我也感觉好多了。|根据你们小队的恢复情况来看，尼尼安肯定已经治好了你们所有人。] 你并不明白为什么小偷会治愈他们的受害者，但至少他并没有让你独自面对困境。

Biding your time until a particularly exhaustive fit of his flying, [party.som|you|the pair of you|you and your entire party] turn-tail and make for the nearby forest. Ninian doesn't even chase you, left behind so quickly that all he can do is curse fruitlessly into the woods and watch you[party.som|| both| all] get away.
rows.translation: 这个小精灵实在不值得。不妨耐心等待，等他再次进行一次耗尽体力的飞行吧…… [party.som|你|你们两个|你和你的整个团队] 转身逃往附近的森林吧。尼尼安甚至都不会追你，他丢下你后走得如此之快，以至于他只能在树林里无谓地咒骂着，眼睁睁地看着你离开。[party.som|| 两者都| 所有] 逃掉吧。

rows.original:
Wagging a finger at Ninian, you emphasize that the little twink should recognize his situation and relax. In exchange for giving you some answers, you're willing to release him. There's little more for him to do than pout and shamefully nod unless he really thinks he can get out of your hold.

    "Okay, [pc.isHeight 40|huge one|weirdo]... what do you want to know? Sooner you let me go, the better. Even if I have to talk to someone willing to bully someone so much smaller than them."
    
    It's really not worth reminding the pixie that he started this or you'll end up arguing about it instead of getting any answers. While [party.som|you have time to mess around|your friend might wait around|your party isn't in some huge rush], you definitely can't stand the idea of tussling with this ego-inflated and shrimpy excuse for a thief.
rows.translation:
你用手指轻轻点着尼尼安，示意这个小家伙应该认清自己的处境，放松下来。作为交换，只要你得到一些你想要的答案，你就愿意放他走。除非他真的认为自己能够摆脱你的控制，否则他除了嘟着嘴、羞愧地点头之外，也没有别的选择。

“好吧…… [pc.isHeight 40|巨大的东西|怪人]……你想知道些什么呢？你越早放我走越好。就算我不得不去和那些愿意欺负比自己弱小得多的人的人谈谈也好。

其实根本没有必要提醒那个小精灵是他先挑起的这场事，否则你们最终只会为此争论不休，而根本得不到任何答案。 [party.som|你还有时间瞎闹呢。|你的朋友可能会在外面等着。|你的团队并没有什么紧迫的任务要完成。]你绝对无法忍受与这个自大又弱小的小偷斗智斗勇的想法。

rows.translation: 首先，你得好好了解一下这个精灵！除了那个在你面前飞来飞去的可爱小精灵之外，尼尼安到底是个怎样的人呢？
rows.raw: "First of all, you need to figure out more about this pixie! Who exactly is Ninian besides the little twink pixie fluttering in-front of you?"

rows.original: Well, you know about him. Where does this pixie live or at least reside when he's not roaming around getting beaten up?
rows.translation: 嗯，你应该了解他的情况吧。这个小精灵平时都待在哪儿呢？除非他在外面到处闲逛、被人揍一顿，否则他应该会待在某个地方吧？
rows.raw: "Well, you know about him. Where does this pixie live or at least reside when he's not roaming around getting beaten up?"

rows.original: You know that Ninian doesn't live anywhere and that he's run away from his old home for personal reasons. Didn't he mention dangers out here, aside from you and other big people, that worry him?
rows.translation: 你知道，尼尼安其实没有任何固定的居所，他是因为一些个人原因才离开了自己原来的家的。他不是提到过，除了你和其他一些重要人物之外，这里还存在着一些让他感到担忧的危险吗？
rows.raw: "You know that Ninian doesn't live anywhere and that he's run away from his old home for personal reasons. Didn't he mention dangers out here, aside from you and other big people, that worry him?"

rows.original: Enough is enough. Things are dangerous out here for small pixies like Ninian and he even admitted it! Why isn't he living in Hawkethorne?
rows.translation: 够了，真的够了。对于像尼尼安这样的小精灵来说，外面的世界实在太危险了，他自己也承认了这一点！那他为什么不去鹰棘镇生活呢？
rows.raw: "Enough is enough. Things are dangerous out here for small pixies like Ninian and he even admitted it! Why isn't he living in Hawkethorne?"

rows.original: After talking to him so much, you've got the EP and have talked it out. You can help Ninian move, at long last. Once he moves, though, he's not likely to appear in the Old Forest again...
rows.translation: 经过这么长时间的交谈，你们终于达成了协议，也把所有问题都谈清楚了。现在你可以帮助尼尼安搬家了。不过，一旦他搬走了，就很可能不会再出现在旧森林里了……
rows.raw: "After talking to him so much, you've got the EP and have talked it out. You can help Ninian move, at long last. Once he moves, though, he's not likely to appear in the Old Forest again..."

rows.original: You lack the funds now, but once you gather them, you know you can get this pixie to move where you can easily find him!
rows.translation: 你现在没有足够的资金，但一旦你筹集到了，你就知道一定能把这个小精灵带到你容易找到他的地方去！
rows.raw: "You lack the funds now, but once you gather them, you know you can get this pixie to move where you can easily find him!"

rows.original: "You... want to know more about me?" The pixie's confused face turns to one of relief; perhaps he was expecting far different ideas. "Well, okay... um... as you can see, I'm... a pixie." Gently squirming his way up your grip — bumping your [pc.hand] once or twice with his concealed dick in the process — the pixie finally settles against the sides of your fingers. One of his small hands holds onto you for balance, the free palm moving to straighten his lengthy, film-like wings. Up-close and still, you can make out every fibrous strand along the appendage to reinforce it for flight. "I really do wish you large people were more caring about my wings. I fly around all day and get my wings squeezed by a brute like you?" Releasing his now-straightened wing, Ninian's gaze settles on your wrist and pats you forgivingly. He must fly around a lot to have such an easy time fixing them, particularly if he's so quick to look past your part in it. "Well yeah, I mean... even back when I kinda had our homely spot, but... things happened and I can't very well go back. There are little instances that call for me to land these days." Turning his green eyes up to you, the pixie finally pointed at one of the many trees around both of you. "See these trees? I normally try to rest in the tops, but... well, I'm not used to traveling alone. At least if things get bad, I had a place to stay and rest at that was safe before. Don't even get me started on having to get my own food. Now I have to take from people or scavenge for natural stuff like berries and mushrooms personally[silly|, ALL BECAUSE OF THE DAMN BIRDS! I swear it's like they detect me with some sort of weird, otherworldly precision!|.] If you ask me, though, adventurers like you have the best food. Not to mention that it isn't exactly safe nor easy to find food even for someone who can fly..." [party.has cait|As if on cue, Cait slips up beside you and gently pets Ninian's head, the catfolk poking his cheek with bread until he takes some of it. And with both of you watching, the pixie tears the piece almost as big as his head into two before offering one part back and letting the other rest in his lap. "You know, [pc.name]," Cait whispers over your shoulder before taking her offered crumb back, "He really is just... so itsy-bitsy. I can at least help with that."] "I really do miss our place, but... well, it's either I struggle or I go back. And I refuse to go back as long as... they won't apologize... even if it is the closest thing to home, as you big folk might call it." [party.has arona|Your cocksure orc chuckles, shooting a smirk at the somber pixie. "Well, at least he's got a tough head. Can't say if it's for the right reasons, but for someone so pint-sized, that's not a bad amount of pride!"] As much as you [pc.isDK|could care less trying to|want to] pry the frowning pixie for information, the green-haired boy doesn't seem like he'd want to talk about it anyway. For now, you[pc.isDK| sarcastically] thank him for answering and slowly let go.[party.has cait| Carefully tucking the bite-sized feast of bread Cait gave him into his arms, Ninian clears his throat.] The pixie juts his flat chest out at you, agitatedly puffing his cheeks up. "Yeah, well... you're welcome. I'm uh... going to go. So... next time... I'm totally going to beat you up! No more nice Ninian! Only tough Ninian!" You have to stifle a laugh, but the pair of you part at last.[party.has cait| Watching him fly and wobble around with his bread makes it that much harder.] [party.som|Gathering your things|Looking to your partner|Telling everyone you're moving out], you start back and off to your adventure.
rows.translation: 你……想更多地了解我吗？”小精灵那困惑的表情顿时转为宽慰；或许他原本期待的是完全不同的答案。“嗯，好吧……其实，如你所见，我就是一个小精灵。” 它轻轻扭动着身体，从你的手部中挣脱出来——同时还不小心撞到了你…… [pc.hand] 经过一两次这样的尝试——期间他的阴茎始终被隐藏起来——最终，那个小精灵还是稳稳地依偎在了你的手部指旁。他的其中一只小手部紧紧抓住你，以保持平衡，而另一只空闲的手部则用来整理他那长长的、宛如薄膜般的翅膀。 从近处仔细观察，你可以清楚地看到那附肢上每一根纤维结构，这些结构的存在正是为了增强其强度，从而帮助生物进行飞行。 “我真希望你们这些大个子能多关心一下我的翅膀。我整天都在飞行，结果我的翅膀却被你这样的粗人挤压得疼疼的……尼尼安松开了它那现在已经变直的翅膀，将目光落在你的手部腕上，然后宽容地轻拍了一下你的手部。它一定经常飞行，才能如此熟练地修理这些部位，尤其是它还能如此迅速地忽略你在其中所起的作用。 嗯，其实吧……就算在我们有那个温馨的小家的时候，也还是发生了一些事情，让我再也无法回到那里去了。这些天，还是有一些情况需要我去处理呢。” 精灵抬起他那双绿色的眼睛，最终指向了你们周围众多的树木中的一棵。 看到这些树了吗？我平时都尽量在树顶上休息，但是……嗯，我还不习惯独自旅行。至少如果情况变糟了，我还有个安全的地方可以躲起来休息。更别提每次旅行时还得自己准备食物和用品了…… 拥有 食物。现在我不得不向别人索取，或者亲自去寻找像浆果和蘑菇这样的天然食物。[silly|全都怪那些该死的鸟！我发誓，它们似乎能用某种诡异而超自然的精准度来发现我的存在！|.] 不过，在我看来，像你这样的冒险者才能享受到最美味的食物。更何况，即使对于会飞行的人来说，寻找食物也绝非易事，更谈不上安全了…… [party.has cait|恰在这时，凯特悄悄走到你身边，轻轻抚摸着尼尼安的脑袋。那只猫人用面包轻轻戳他的脸颊，直到他拿了一些面包来吃。在你们两人的注视下，小精灵将那块几乎有它脑袋那么大的面包撕成了两半，然后把其中一半递给了尼尼安，而另一半则放在了他的腿上。 “你知道的…… [pc.name]他真的……太小了，太小了，”凯特在你耳边轻声说道，然后把别人给她的那小块东西拿了回去，“至少这点我可以帮忙。] 我真的很想念我们的家，但是……嗯，要么我继续挣扎着生活，要么就回去。而只要……我还拒绝回去。 他们 他们是不会道歉的……即使那是你们这些大人所说的“最亲近的地方”。 [party.has arona|那个自以为是的兽人轻笑着，朝那个神情忧郁的精灵投去一丝讥讽的目光。 “嗯，至少他还有点骨气。虽然不知道他这么做的理由是否正确，但对于一个身材如此娇小的人来说，这样的自尊心已经相当不错了！] 尽管你很…… [pc.isDK|根本不在乎尝试这件事。|想要] 这个绿头发的男孩看起来并不愿意谈论这个话题，即使你试图通过各种方式去询问那个皱着眉头的小精灵以获取信息。目前来说，你……[pc.isDK| 讽刺地] 感谢他的回复，然后慢慢松开了手部。[party.has cait| 尼尼安小心翼翼地将凯特递给他的那些小块面包塞进他的怀里，然后清了清嗓子。] 小精灵把扁平的胸膛朝你挺过来，气鼓鼓地涨红了脸颊。 “嗯，其实……不客气啦。我先走了……下次……我一定要打败你！再也不做那个温柔的尼尼安了，只做厉害的尼尼安！” 你强忍住笑意，终于和这个小精灵分道扬镳了。[party.has cait| 看着他拿着面包飞来飞去、摇摇晃晃地移动，这让事情变得更加困难了。] [party.som|收拾好你的东西吧。|看向你的伴侣|告诉所有人你要搬走了]就这样，你重新开始，继续你的冒险之旅。
rows.raw: " "You... want to know more about me?" The pixie's confused face turns to one of relief; perhaps he was expecting far different ideas. "Well, okay... um... as you can see, I'm... a pixie." Gently squirming his way up your grip — bumping your [pc.hand] once or twice with his concealed dick in the process — the pixie finally settles against the sides of your fingers. One of his small hands holds onto you for balance, the free palm moving to straighten his lengthy, film-like wings. Up-close and still, you can make out every fibrous strand along the appendage to reinforce it for flight. "I really do wish you large people were more caring about my wings. I fly around all day and get my wings squeezed by a brute like you?" Releasing his now-straightened wing, Ninian's gaze settles on your wrist and pats you forgivingly. He must fly around a lot to have such an easy time fixing them, particularly if he's so quick to look past your part in it. "Well yeah, I mean... even back when I kinda had our homely spot, but... things happened and I can't very well go back. There are little instances that call for me to land these days." Turning his green eyes up to you, the pixie finally pointed at one of the many trees around both of you. "See these trees? I normally try to rest in the tops, but... well, I'm not used to traveling alone. At least if things get bad, I had a place to stay and rest at that was safe before. Don't even get me started on having to get my own food. Now I have to take from people or scavenge for natural stuff like berries and mushrooms personally[silly|, ALL BECAUSE OF THE DAMN BIRDS! I swear it's like they detect me with some sort of weird, otherworldly precision!|.] If you ask me, though, adventurers like you have the best food. Not to mention that it isn't exactly safe nor easy to find food even for someone who can fly..." [party.has cait|As if on cue, Cait slips up beside you and gently pets Ninian's head, the catfolk poking his cheek with bread until he takes some of it. And with both of you watching, the pixie tears the piece almost as big as his head into two before offering one part back and letting the other rest in his lap. "You know, [pc.name]," Cait whispers over your shoulder before taking her offered crumb back, "He really is just... so itsy-bitsy. I can at least help with that."] "I really do miss our place, but... well, it's either I struggle or I go back. And I refuse to go back as long as... they won't apologize... even if it is the closest thing to home, as you big folk might call it." [party.has arona|Your cocksure orc chuckles, shooting a smirk at the somber pixie. "Well, at least he's got a tough head. Can't say if it's for the right reasons, but for someone so pint-sized, that's not a bad amount of pride!"] As much as you [pc.isDK|could care less trying to|want to] pry the frowning pixie for information, the green-haired boy doesn't seem like he'd want to talk about it anyway. For now, you[pc.isDK| sarcastically] thank him for answering and slowly let go.[party.has cait| Carefully tucking the bite-sized feast of bread Cait gave him into his arms, Ninian clears his throat.] The pixie juts his flat chest out at you, agitatedly puffing his cheeks up. "Yeah, well... you're welcome. I'm uh... going to go. So... next time... I'm totally going to beat you up! No more nice Ninian! Only tough Ninian!" You have to stifle a laugh, but the pair of you part at last.[party.has cait| Watching him fly and wobble around with his bread makes it that much harder.] [party.som|Gathering your things|Looking to your partner|Telling everyone you're moving out], you start back and off to your adventure. "

rows.original: Last time, you had heard him mention he left his home. Or something similar to it. Where did Ninian live before coming to the Old Forest and trying to pick fights with people easily multiple times his size? Asking the question alone seems to take him through a loop of emotion. First, the little pixie's face twists with anger, then to a distant smile before it finally returns to a confused frown. "I... don't... really want to talk about it." [pc.isDK|Well tough shit.|He can't even try?] "Well... I... fine." His wings gently flutter as he pushes up and out of your squeezing grasp somewhat to sit along the top of your [pc.hand]. Both of his hands brush his furry cropped vest flat, clearing his throat. His androgynous and muscle-light arms grab hold of you, giving a small swish of his head to clear his extravagantly-cut poofy bangs from obscuring his vision. "I... didn't really... live anywhere. I mean, we had a place to rest. The fairy that made me? We almost always were running around having a blast... but she let someone come back and join us who... well, was awful. A-And... well, he's too much like me in other ways too, so I... I got angry and left." That was a good way to dodge your question but pointing it out makes the small guy blush before rebounding. "... Okay, look, that... that's not really fair! I mean... my %"home" wasn't a traditional one like they have in villages and distant places. It was just sorta part of nature, a place we could come and go when we needed a guaranteed safe place. A sanctum, I guess. I... look, I don't really want to talk about it anymore. I-I'd at least prefer it if we could change the subject." [party.has sheinnai|Your favorite weapon-turned-humanoid can't help but butt-in, approaching you from your rear flank to whisper into your [pc.ear]. "I think it might be in our interest to ease his mind or change the subject, lest he becomes unsettled."] Sighing and raising your free [pc.hand] up to scratch at your scalp, you figure the best move really is to change the subject. But maybe you can keep on the same track. What sort of place would Ninian want or like? The other questions definitely had surprised him with differing levels of emotion, but this one is met with a very simple and relatively neutral smile for the puny punk. "Well, if I had a place like it, I think I'd like having furniture my size. Most of the time, I just share a bed or resting spot... and when you live with others who are larger than you, things are... problematic. My own spot would be so nice... no more having to fear getting rolled over by some big person." [party.has brint|You hear a grumble from Brint, the minotaur growing rather bored of standing around and waiting for Ninian's windy talk to end.] You at least have answers from the little pixie now. More than enough that ending the conversation isn't out of the question [party.has brint|for Brint's or] for your sake. Giving his plump butt a farewell spank with two fingers elicits a startled gasp from Ninian, sending him fluttering free of your now-loosening grip. He should get going too so the birds don't eat all his food. But rather than flee, Ninian surprises you; he gives a red-faced nod and accompanying small wave of farewell. Not before muddying the image with a follow-up shout to you while he flies away. "Next time, I'm totally kicking your butt! Victory will be mine!"
rows.translation: 上次你听到他说过自己离开了家，大概是这个意思吧。在来到旧森林之前，尼尼安到底住在哪里呢？为什么他会总是去找那些比他强壮很多倍的人打架呢？ 仅仅提出这个问题，似乎就让他陷入了一系列复杂的情绪之中。首先，那个小精灵的脸因为愤怒而扭曲，然后又露出一种若有所思的微笑，最后又重新变成了困惑的表情。 “我……其实并不想谈论这个。 [pc.isDK|那可真倒霉。|他甚至都不愿意尝试一下吗？] 嗯……我……好吧。”他的翅膀轻轻颤动，慢慢从你紧握的手部中挣脱出来，然后坐在你的头顶上。 [pc.hand]他用双手部将自己那蓬松短袖背心整理平整，然后清了清嗓子。他那兼具男性与女性特徵、肌肉线条分明的手部臂紧紧抓住你，同时轻轻摇晃着头，让那些剪得格外蓬松的前发不会挡住他的视线。 我……其实并没有真正意义上的‘家’。也就是说，我们有一个可以休息的地方。那个创造我的仙女……我们几乎总是在四处奔跑、享受快乐……但是她让某个人回来了，加入了我们……嗯，那个人真的很糟糕。还有……嗯，他在其他方面也太像我了，所以我就……我生气了，然后离开了。” 这确实是逃避问题的一个好办法，但被指出来后，那个小个子顿时脸红了，然后又恢复了镇定。 ……好吧，听着，那真的不公平！我的‘家’并不是那种传统意义上的家，那种存在于村庄或偏远地区的家。它只是大自然中的一部分，是一个我们在需要安全的地方时可以前往的地方。大概可以称之为一个避难所吧。我……真的不想再谈论这个话题了。至少，我希望我们能换个话题。 [party.has sheinnai|你最喜欢的那把武器变形成的类人生物忍不住插手了，它从你的侧后方靠近你，然后在你耳边低语…… [pc.ear]我认为，为了不让他感到不安，我们或许应该安慰他一下，或者换个话题。] 叹息着，抬起你空闲的双手部…… [pc.hand] 当你仔细思考后，会觉得最好的办法确实是转移话题。但也许你可以继续沿着这个思路想下去——尼尼安会想要或喜欢什么样的地方呢？之前的那些问题确实让他产生了不同程度的情绪反应，但对于这个问题，他只是露出了一个简单而相对中性的微笑。 嗯，如果我也有这样一个地方，我想我一定会想要一些适合我身形的家具。大多数时候，我只能和大家共用一张床或者一个休息的地方……而当你和那些比你体型更大的人一起生活时，就会遇到很多麻烦。拥有属于我自己的空间该有多好啊。再也不用担心会被那些强者碾压了。 [party.has brint|你听到布林特发出了不满的抱怨声——这个弥诺陶洛斯实在厌倦了站在那里，等待尼尼安冗长的讲话结束。] 现在你至少已经得到了小精灵的回答。这些答案已经足够让你决定结束这次对话了。 [party.has brint|为了布林特……] 看在你的份上。他用两根手部指轻轻拍了一下自己圆滚滚的屁股，这一举动让尼尼安吓了一跳，结果他一下子就从你松开的手部中飞了出去。他也该赶紧走了，不然那些鸟会把他的食物都吃轻型的。然而，尼尼安并没有逃跑，反而向你点了点头，还挥了挥手部道别。不过，在飞走之前，他还冲你喊了一句： “下次，我一定要打败你！胜利一定属于我！
