rows.original: "I mean, apart from the big [pc.race] oafs like you? Well... yes. There are all sorts of hazards for someone my size!" Squirming free, it seems like the little guy has a lot more energy than before. Maybe it's because your topic doesn't involve a terribly sore spot about his past. Waiting until the pixie is sitting on the brim of your [pc.hand] as per usual, a roll of the other is all you need to get him to start spilling the proverbial beans. "So, there's obviously hazards on the ground. Like wolves, for example. I've almost been eaten by those things at least once or twice now. Then you got falling branches. Which it might not sound that scary, but consider that some of those branches are as big your arm or body, okay? In scale, that's like an entire tree for someone my size!" Falling trees definitely sounds scary but do they actually threaten him? He seems fast enough to dodge them based on what you've seen. "Well, uh..." Ninian's right-hand moves up to one of his lengthy, almost excessively long ears and gently rubs along its tip. "It's sometimes when the branches fall at me... but it's more to do with... falling with me atop them." Releasing his minuscule ear and turning his green [silly|seeing-orbs|gaze] toward you, Ninian lowers his voice to a whisper[party.som|| after shooting a glance at your partner| after shooting a glance between your allies]. "Sometimes, I... well, if I don't sleep nude, then I get my clothes caught on branches and almost get dragged along with it to the forest floor. It happens a lot more than you'd think." Gently rising and standing atop your extended platform — your [pc.hand] — Ninian clears his throat and tries to return to a bit more of a serious tone. You don't blame him, considering the admittance that the little pixie practically got clothing-snagged to death on more than one occasion. Surely that isn't the only reason he's having problems adapting, though. Giving a prod to that tiny chest of his, you reinforce the point that you are after a real answer and not lead-around. "... Birds." Ninian's face grows red, burning hot enough to stand out on his tanned skin. "It's those [silly|GAWT DAWM|filthy] birds. I... get attacked by birds all the time. Almost excessively considering they're just birds! You might think 'oh, well I doubt a few birds are the end of the world, Ninian,' but I assure you. These aren't only a few birds; it's like a whole flock of harpies except smarter, smaller and not horny! And they always end up making off with my food and anything else I leave sitting around that might make good nesting material!" [party.has etheryn|Harrick squawks defensively, furrowing his brows aggressively. Ninian scowls at the warhawk and claps a fist into his palm. "Don't think you scare me! I'm bigger than you!" Etheryn hushes Harrick and turns, wrangling the bird and disarming the pair before either Harrick or Ninian makes the pixie regret picking a fight. ] Ninian gets robbed... by birds? [pc.isDK|You can't help but chuckle at the mental picture. Even pint-sized runts had their equivalent to harpies; the only difference is Ninian can't get accosted for sex.] "D-Don't you dare laugh! I-It's not like I can't fight them or anything! It's just that their beaks are dangerous and they might go after my wings! Not to mention I'm not very strong unless I use my magic. So, I try to conceal my food as best I can when they come around. Normally, they end up taking my more obvious food stores and flying off. I-It's not all bad since if they eat a poisonous mushroom I can harvest their feathers and eat like a king afterward... but those damned avians always ruin everything!" Ninian stomps his bare feet, quickly followed by the pixie turning and leaping away. It doesn't seem like today will be a day that you can get the prideful twink to sit around and say goodbye. But as he slips off and leaves [party.som|you|you and your partner|your party] behind, your mind can't help but wonder why he doesn't just move around or over to Hawkethorne if things are really so bad. You can always ask next time, you suppose...
rows.translation: 我的意思是，除了那些重大的…… [pc.race] 像你这样的笨蛋？嗯……确实如此。对于我这种体型的人来说，到处都充满了危险！ 它挣扎着摆脱了束缚，看起来比之前精力更加充沛了。也许是因为你提到的这个话题并没有触及它过去那些令人痛苦的经历吧。等到这个小精灵坐到你的…… [pc.hand] 像往常一样，只需要稍微施点压力，他就会开始吐露秘密了。 “所以，地面上显然有很多危险物。比如狼，我就差点被那些东西咬伤过一两次。还有掉下来的树枝……虽然听起来可能不太严重，但实际上也很危险。 那个 很可怕，但你要想想，那些树枝有的甚至有你的手臂或身体那么粗，明白吗？按照实际比例来说，对于我这样的体型来说，那简直就像是一整棵树啊！ 树木倒下听起来确实很可怕，但它们真的会对他构成威胁吗？ 从你所见来看，他的速度似乎足以躲开那些东西。 “嗯，呃……”尼尼安把右手伸到自己那条又长又几乎过长的耳朵上，轻轻揉了揉它的耳尖。“有时候，那些树枝就是会掉到我身上来。……但更重要的是……能和我一起掉到它们上面去。” 他松开了那只小小的耳朵，然后转过头，露出绿色的…… [silly|视觉球体|凝视] 尼尼安对着你低声说道：[party.som|| 瞥了你的伴侣一眼之后| 在向你的盟友们瞥了一眼之后]有时候，我……嗯，如果我不光着身子睡觉，我的衣服就会挂在树枝上，然后我差点就被拉到森林的地面上去。这种事情确实会发生。 很多 比你想象的要多。” 轻轻起身，站在你延伸出来的平台上——你的 [pc.hand] — 尼尼安清了清嗓子，试图恢复严肃的肌肉度。考虑到那个小精灵有几次差点被衣服缠得喘不过气来，你也确实不能责怪他。不过，这肯定不是他适应环境有困难的唯一原因。你轻轻拍了拍他的小胸膛，以此强调你想要的是一个真正的答案，而不是些敷衍的回答。 … 鸟类。尼尼安的脸颊变得通红，那种灼热感甚至让他在黝黑的皮肤上显得格外明显。“就是那些…… [silly|真是见鬼了|肮脏的] 鸟……我竟然会被鸟攻击？ 所有 天啊，简直太过分了——毕竟它们只不过是几只鸟而已！你可能会想：“哦，几只鸟而已，应该不会有什么大不了的吧，尼尼安……”但我可以向你保证，这些鸟可不是普通的几只鸟；它们就像是一群鹰鹫，只不过更聪明、体型更小，而且也没有那么好色！它们总是会把我的食物，以及我放在那里、可能被它们用来筑巢的任何东西都偷走！ [party.has etheryn|哈里克防御性地发出尖锐的叫声，眉头紧锁，显得十分愤怒。尼尼安也怒视着那只战鹰，然后用手掌拍打自己的拳头，说道：“别以为你能吓到我！我可比你块头大得多！” 伊瑟琳安抚住了哈里克，转身控制住那只鸟，同时解除了那两人的武装。在哈里克或尼尼安做出任何会让这位小精灵后悔挑起争端的事情之前，她已经采取了行动。 ] 尼尼安得到了 被抢了由……制作 鸟类? [pc.isDK|看到这样的画面，你不禁会会心一笑。就连那些身材矮小的生物，也有类似于“哈比女妖”的存在；唯一的区别就是，尼尼安不会因为性方面的事情而遭到骚扰。] 你、你敢笑吗！我、我不是说我不能跟它们打架啊！只是它们的喙很危险，可能会攻击我的翅膀！更何况，如果不使用魔法的话，我的力量其实并不强。所以，当它们靠近的时候，我就会尽量把食物藏好。 通常情况下，它们会抢走我那些比较显眼的食物，然后飞走。不过……这也未必全是坏事，因为如果它们吃了有毒的蘑菇，我就可以收集它们的羽毛，之后就可以像国王一样大吃特吃了……不过那些该死的鸟类总是把一切都搞砸！尼尼安光着足部跺了跺足部，紧接着那个小精灵也转身跳开了。看来今天是没法让这个骄傲的小家伙乖乖坐下来道别了。不过，当他悄悄溜走的时候…… [party.som|你|你和你的搭档|你的团队] 在背后，你不禁会想：如果情况真的那么糟糕，他为什么不干脆搬到鹰棘镇去住呢？当然，下次你也可以直接问他……
rows.raw: " "I mean, apart from the big [pc.race] oafs like you? Well... yes. There are all sorts of hazards for someone my size!" Squirming free, it seems like the little guy has a lot more energy than before. Maybe it's because your topic doesn't involve a terribly sore spot about his past. Waiting until the pixie is sitting on the brim of your [pc.hand] as per usual, a roll of the other is all you need to get him to start spilling the proverbial beans. "So, there's obviously hazards on the ground. Like wolves, for example. I've almost been eaten by those things at least once or twice now. Then you got falling branches. Which it might not sound that scary, but consider that some of those branches are as big your arm or body, okay? In scale, that's like an entire tree for someone my size!" Falling trees definitely sounds scary but do they actually threaten him? He seems fast enough to dodge them based on what you've seen. "Well, uh..." Ninian's right-hand moves up to one of his lengthy, almost excessively long ears and gently rubs along its tip. "It's sometimes when the branches fall at me... but it's more to do with... falling with me atop them." Releasing his minuscule ear and turning his green [silly|seeing-orbs|gaze] toward you, Ninian lowers his voice to a whisper[party.som|| after shooting a glance at your partner| after shooting a glance between your allies]. "Sometimes, I... well, if I don't sleep nude, then I get my clothes caught on branches and almost get dragged along with it to the forest floor. It happens a lot more than you'd think." Gently rising and standing atop your extended platform — your [pc.hand] — Ninian clears his throat and tries to return to a bit more of a serious tone. You don't blame him, considering the admittance that the little pixie practically got clothing-snagged to death on more than one occasion. Surely that isn't the only reason he's having problems adapting, though. Giving a prod to that tiny chest of his, you reinforce the point that you are after a real answer and not lead-around. "... Birds." Ninian's face grows red, burning hot enough to stand out on his tanned skin. "It's those [silly|GAWT DAWM|filthy] birds. I... get attacked by birds all the time. Almost excessively considering they're just birds! You might think 'oh, well I doubt a few birds are the end of the world, Ninian,' but I assure you. These aren't only a few birds; it's like a whole flock of harpies except smarter, smaller and not horny! And they always end up making off with my food and anything else I leave sitting around that might make good nesting material!" [party.has etheryn|Harrick squawks defensively, furrowing his brows aggressively. Ninian scowls at the warhawk and claps a fist into his palm. "Don't think you scare me! I'm bigger than you!" Etheryn hushes Harrick and turns, wrangling the bird and disarming the pair before either Harrick or Ninian makes the pixie regret picking a fight. ] Ninian gets robbed... by birds? [pc.isDK|You can't help but chuckle at the mental picture. Even pint-sized runts had their equivalent to harpies; the only difference is Ninian can't get accosted for sex.] "D-Don't you dare laugh! I-It's not like I can't fight them or anything! It's just that their beaks are dangerous and they might go after my wings! Not to mention I'm not very strong unless I use my magic. So, I try to conceal my food as best I can when they come around. Normally, they end up taking my more obvious food stores and flying off. I-It's not all bad since if they eat a poisonous mushroom I can harvest their feathers and eat like a king afterward... but those damned avians always ruin everything!" Ninian stomps his bare feet, quickly followed by the pixie turning and leaping away. It doesn't seem like today will be a day that you can get the prideful twink to sit around and say goodbye. But as he slips off and leaves [party.som|you|you and your partner|your party] behind, your mind can't help but wonder why he doesn't just move around or over to Hawkethorne if things are really so bad. You can always ask next time, you suppose..."

rows.original: Releasing Ninian from the start, you take a deep breath to try to find the right way to ask the important question. If things are so bad, if birds are always mugging him and things suck... then why not set-up a new home within Hawkethorne? Even if it's temporary, isn't that better than getting messed with and threatened? And for the first time, Ninian doesn't give an answer or sobering response. Instead, the pixie is simply staring at you like you're the most insane [pc.race] he's ever known. "Live... in Hawkethorne? But why?" [pc.isDK|Plenty of holes that make a good argument for you, but that cannot be a very good point considering he fits inside most of them too well.] You quickly rattle off the most apparent reasons: not being an easy mark for birds, plenty of access to food, and the ability to see you more. The little twink's arms cross stubbornly, but you touch on your clincher; a nicer place may finally earn him the apology he's after if he can show how well he's doing for himself. That catches him completely off-guard — his dragonfly wings carrying him closer to your face — before pinching his mouth at the corners of his cheeks, pressing his tongue against the inside to further accent his thinking. Yet eventually he stops and gazes up at you approvingly. "Okay... you've got my interest, huge person. How would it get me my apology though? Be specific since this is my plan and all." Well, if he is well-off and they found out wouldn't it make them jealous? "Maybe. I mean, my friends normally spend their time going places, so I don't know if they'd care much that I've settled down in a nice city... especially the one who messed everything up." Well, what if you gave him some personal funding to help with construct something nice? He could bring back other pixies, show off with it... isn't the idea at least worth it? Surely his friends would praise him for all the sweet ass he'd bring in! "... M-maybe but... well... it'd be much more about cocks if you knew anything about my kind. We can get high from either gender's fluids but there aren't many pixies that wouldn't want their whole body fucked with a fat stick any day. I-I definitely wouldn't be for that or anything b-but you get what I mean! So I guess if I have the chance to store some cum and maybe bring some cute girls around to share it with, that wouldn't be so bad for a living." His green eyes drop down,[pc.hasCock| eyeing your bulge rather unusually, given his desire for many %"girlfriends,"] and then Ninian closes his eyes. Chirping bugs, a distant howl and gently buzzing wings are about the only noise you can hear. The pixie clears his throat and meets your gaze, running one of his hands through his huge bangs one more time in acceptance. "Okay, okay! I'll do it. But first bring me about 100 electrum, okay? I think that should be enough based on how much I've stolen before from others and their reactions. If you bring me that... then... I'll be able to pay for my very own place." Nodding and assuring him you understand, you and the twink depart with Ninian turning and quickly taking off into the treeline once more. You now have a simple enough task; if you bring the coin, Ninian will move to town and finally allow you to learn more about the pixie than these brief encounters and volatile scenery allows. [pc.libidoRange 40|Not to mention find out what you can do with the sexy fey-boy. ]It will be a matter of getting the funds set aside for him and finding the puny punk to hand it over. But it's not as if you've had a hard time finding the pixie so far, right? [party.som|Gathering your things|Beckoning your nearby friend|Calling to your party], you decide it's time to stop lollygagging and get your traveling back underway. Adventure calls, after all!
rows.translation: 从一开始就释放了尼尼安之后，你深吸一口气，试图找到恰当的方式来提出这个重要的问题。如果情况真的那么糟糕，如果那些鸟儿总是欺负他，如果一切都不顺利……那么为什么不在鹰棘镇为他找一个新的家呢？即使只是暂时的，这样总比一直受到骚扰和威胁要好吧？ 而这一次，尼尼安并没有给出任何回答或令人深思的回应。相反，这只小精灵只是直直地盯着你，仿佛你觉得才是最疯狂的那个。 [pc.race] 住在鹰棘镇？但为什么呢？ [pc.isDK|这些理由确实为你的观点提供了有力的支持，但考虑到他其实符合其中的大部分描述，这些论点也就算不上是特别有力的了。 太 嗯。] 你迅速列举出了那些最显而易见的理由：这里并不容易成为鸟类的猎物，食物也很充足，而且人们也能更容易地看到你。那个小家伙固执地交叉着双臂，但你指出了关键点：如果他能证明自己在这里过得很好，那么一个更好的环境或许最终能让他得到他一直想要的道歉。 这完全让他措手部不及——他的蜻蜓翅膀让他逐渐靠近你的脸，然后他的嘴唇轻轻捏住自己脸颊的角落，将舌头压在内部，这样更能凸显他思考时的神情。 然而，最终他停了下来，仰望着你，露出赞许的神情。 “好吧……你确实引起了我的兴趣，这个高大的家伙。不过，要让我得到道歉，该怎么做呢？请具体说说，因为这…… 我的 计划什么的。” 那么，如果他很富有，而他们知道了，难道不会让他们感到嫉妒吗？ “也许吧。我的朋友们通常都喜欢到处游玩，所以我也不知道他们会不会太在意我在一个不错的城市安了家。尤其是那个把一切都搞砸的人。” 那么，如果你给他一些资金，让他去打造一些美好的东西，会怎么样呢？他可以重新召集其他小精灵，用这些成果来展示自己的能力……这样的想法，至少是值得尝试的吧？ 他的朋友们肯定会因为他带来的那些好处而表扬他吧！ “……也许吧，但是……嗯……如果你了解我们这类人的话，就会知道，其实这些好处大多和性有关。 可以 无论是男性的体液还是女性的体液，都会让人产生兴奋感，不过也没多少精灵会拒绝让别人用那根粗大的东西触碰自己的身体吧。我……我肯定是不会同意这种事的，不过你应该明白我的意思吧！所以，如果有机会储存一些精液，然后邀请一些可爱的女孩一起来分享的话，这样的生活方式应该也不会太糟糕吧。 他的绿色眼睛低垂了下来……[pc.hasCock| 考虑到他一直想要很多“女朋友”，他这样盯着自己的凸起部位，实在有些反常。] 然后，尼尼安闭上了眼睛。此时，你能听到的只有虫子的鸣叫、远处的嚎叫声，以及翅膀轻轻振动的声音。这个小精灵清了清嗓子，与你的目光对视，然后再次将一只手部穿过自己浓密的刘海，似乎是在表示接受与认同。 好吧，好吧！我会的。但首先你得给我带来大约100枚电银，好吗？根据我以前从别人那里偷东西以及他们的反应来看，这个数量应该够用了。如果你能给我这些……那么……我就能租一个属于自己的地方了。你点了点头，向他保证自己明白他的意思，然后和那个年轻男孩一起离开了。尼尼安则转身迅速钻进了树林中。现在你的任务很简单：只要你拿到那枚硬币，尼尼安就会带你去镇上，这样你就能更深入地了解这些小精灵了——毕竟这些短暂的相遇和不断变化的景色根本无法让你了解到太多关于它们的信息。 [pc.libidoRange 40|更不用说去探索你能用这个性感的精灵男孩做些什么了。 ]只要把钱拨给他，然后找到那个小混蛋把钱交给他就行了。不过，到目前为止，你找那个小精灵应该并不困难吧？ [party.som|收拾好你的东西吧。|召唤你附近的朋友|呼叫你的队伍吧]你决定是时候停止闲逛，继续开始你的旅程了。毕竟，冒险在召唤你！

rows.original:
You tell Ninian that you have a surprise for him. There's no need for him to fly off — fighting with birds, branches, and mutts — while he waits for your apology. Using your free [pc.hand] to grab and pull out the electrum coins, you hand a bag nearly as large as the pixie over, releasing them both only when he's got a good grip on it. Ninian's green eyes study the hefty bag, tugging and grabbing all over its surface. You're unsure if he can figure out how to physically handle such a gift. Maybe giving him the bag right away wasn't the best choice.

    "W-Wait... you... gathered everything? All of it? I... didn't expect that."
    
    You glimpse a momentary frown set over his face, but in a blink, the pixie steels himself anew. Squeezing the bag tightly, Ninian looks at you and puts on a far more confident and tough smirk. Turning and taking off, Ninian doesn't even look back while soaring off toward Hawkethorne. Well... you think it's in the right direction. All you know is that if he cuts and runs with all that, you're going to feel like a real dunce for inviting him whilst funding the pixie's continuing life of thievery in one trusting act of kindness.
rows.translation:
你告诉尼尼安，你有一个惊喜要给他。他没必要在等待你道歉的时候，一直飞来飞去，还要躲避那些鸟儿、树枝以及那些杂种狗……利用你空闲的时间，就可以把惊喜准备好了。 [pc.hand] 为了取出那些电铬币，你递给他一个几乎和那个小精灵一样大的袋子，直到他牢牢握住袋子后，你才把它们都交给他。尼尼安那双绿色的眼睛仔细地打量着那个沉重的袋子，在它的表面来回摸索着。 你不确定他是否能够弄清楚该如何妥善处理这样一份礼物。或许直接把袋子送给他的确不是最好的选择。

“等……等等……你把所有东西都准备好了？真的全部？我真没想到。”

你看到他的脸上瞬间浮现出一丝愁容，但转眼间，那个小精灵又重新振作了起来。 尼尼安紧紧攥着那个袋子，看着你，露出一个自信而坚毅的笑容。然后她转身离去，甚至在飞向鹰棘镇的过程中都没有回头看一眼。嗯……你认为她确实是往正确的方向去了。 你只知道，如果他把那些东西据为己有然后逃之夭夭，那你就会觉得自己真是个大傻瓜——毕竟你当初邀请他，不就是出于善良，想资助那个小偷继续过他的偷窃生活吗。

They're the real problem! Always teasing me and saying how we looked so alike..." A red tint leaps to his tanned cheeks, Ninian's free hand wrapping around his bare stomach while uncomfortably buzzing his wings to shift side-to-side. Time to push on, you figure, raising your hand to stop him; you had another question for him. What did Ninian like to do with his kinda-parents? Your question obviously hits a mark; Ninian uncomfortably shifts for a few seconds before forcing his familiar smile to return. "All sorts of things. I mean even with Nino messing with me, I like to think I had a lot of fun. We'd often go sightseeing as we explored the forests and skies. Though when we flew too high I'd ask them to carry me since my wings and stamina aren't up to par with someone who's large like all of you. We'd visit the beach sometimes, too... that always made our trips interesting. Water is really big when you see the sea for the first time. Especially when you're as small as me." Nino? The way he quickly mentioned the name seems like it fits rather poorly into all this, but this is Ninian's storytime; he's the one getting to tell his past and in his own words. Watching Ninian plop down and cross his dainty legs, the pixie turns his gaze toward the main street and the gateway and lets his smile fade a bit. "But then Nino changed. He was always teasing me, but then he took a trip and when he came back... I... that was when I decided to run away. Being at our normal meeting place just became too much trouble when I'd bump into Nino. Nils insisted that I was overreacting, but how can she understand?" You figure asking about Nino is its own topic entirely, but figure talking about Nils seems like a good angle. Who is she in all this? The question drew the puny lad's smile out of hiding yet again, albeit it morphing into a smirk a moment later. "Nils is the fairy who made me. I think you'd like her a lot, [pc.name]. Particularly because you both are really tough. Nils is the one who made me my jacket and loincloth, taught me to survive... she's way cooler and really smart compared to Nino. I wish I could understand what she sees in him. Maybe if I could, I wouldn't have felt like I needed to run off. Not that I mind much since I got to meet you and see just how useful her teaching is. Fairy magic and the magic I inherited through Nino are pretty useful when you throw 'em together!" "I mean, look at me! I'm not even that old for a pixie, but I'm way cooler and way more experienced than others are at my age! If there was a way to get a bigger body and live longer, like some fairies who basically live forever, do you realize how awesome I could be? Man, it'd be really cool! Though... I mean... I guess I would end up becoming a girl in the process. And being a guy is definitely way cooler... I just need to meet a cute pixie or two and then I'll show 'em how good my dick is! Then I'll know whether I should consider the idea of trading away this awesome dick of mine!" Rolling your eyes, you pat the little pixie's head. That's enough about him and his past; Ninian seems so intent on drifting off into other topics like sleeping around. Ninian really is quite an enthusiastic character for someone his size, but you can't help but feel that this seems almost like he considers himself bigger than he really is. Without your help, the guy was struggling and barely making it not that long ago."

[var0|
        Turning around and looking at the nice and basic box, Ninian brings a hand up and gently tilts the appendage side-to-side. Seems someone isn't the most ecstatic, but it's not like he has the most homely cube in town.
        
        "It's not that great, you know?" The hand lowers down, both moving to sit on his hips as he turns to face the doorway. "I mean, There's only a single floor with a split-off section for me to go to the bathroom and bathe whilst the rest is just... open. All I'm thankful for is the fact I don't need to fly out and find a bush since they used some weird pipe stuff angled outside the city walls-"
        
        Too much info, you mention with a wag of a digit. Ninian blushes but turns to face you with a small nod of understanding.
        
        "If you were smaller, you could come in and see, but I mean they made it a very traditional-type place for a big person. Pixies like me and even fairies don't normally live somewhere that's so closed-up, even if we do settle down. From what I hear, most of us like to live in free-flowing towns or villages if we do that at all. Maybe it's part of that, but this place is definitely uncomfortable."
        
        Pushing through the doorway, you hear rustling within that draws you to lean over and try to peer inside. You're unable to enter, but you can at least try to look around and try to humor him.
        
        The interior of the boxy housing doesn't have any painted walls, the wooden surfaces only lightly smoothed down. The floor's surface is barely visible beneath the various grasses and clumps of fur bound with string to form smaller rugs, a piece of bandaging linen laid out over a particularly well-stuffed section of leaves and flower petals. Ninian is currently messing around with one of a few small coin purses tucked near the corner, pulling out a roasted acorn before turning to face you.
        
        "See? It's just so... plain." The twink scoops at the softened top of the nut, breaking off a mouthful and taking a bite. "Mnf... Ihr mean... jurst loork at iht."
        
        Ninian shouldn't talk with his mouth full[pc.isDK| unless it's full of your [pc.hasCock|[pc.cum]|[pc.girlcum]]], you remind him, but you can't help but agree. The pixie has a definite problem here as cozy and functional as it might be. It keeps him out of the rain but he's the only one who's seemingly taken the time to try to make it cozy. For a place where he spends time in the mornings, it'll only ever be quite boring or outright unpleasant without company. No wonder he always looks like he's trying to keep himself busy from a glance into the alleyway.
        
        But this time, it's Ninian who engages you as he finishes remarkably putting the acorn away into his gullet after a few moments of breathtaking gluttony. Making his way right up to you, the pixie gently pats your cheeks with a stern and unusually serious frown.
        
        "If you ever get the time, [pc.name], I'd really like it if you could help me... with this... problem of mine."
        
        Well, you can't make promises, but you back up and sit up straight so Ninian can exit the little abode. You'll need to talk to him more to figure out what this problem of his will require. You have a hunch it will not be very simple...
        |"I mean, you helped me build it. So... you know... I like it a lot."
        
        Rather bashful, Ninian turns his gaze away and looks back over his shoulder at the intricate and well-designed abode.
        
        "I've stored plenty of food, made it nice and cozy, and even think I might have too much space." A brief interjection via Ninian patting the wooden wall makes you at least feel pleased with your project. "If there comes a day where I have to leave it, Hawkethorne will have some highly contested bird-house territory, I tell you what."
        
        So now he's content that muggers will move in?
        
        "Haha, very funny. All I'm saying is that this place is really awesome, okay? Jeez... learn to take a compliment."
    ]

[var0|
        转过身来，看着那个外观简洁实用的盒子，尼尼安抬手轻轻地将它左右摇晃了几下。看来有人对它并不是特别满意，不过这也不是说他拥有的这个立方体是镇上最精美的了。
        
        其实也没那么好，你知道吗？”他的手缓缓放下，然后搭在自己的臀部上，转身面向门口说道，“我的意思是，整个地方只有一层楼，其中有一小块区域可以让我去洗手间洗澡，而其他地方嘛……就是普通的房间而已。……真是太好了。我唯一感到庆幸的是，他们竟然在城墙外安装了一些奇怪的管道设施，所以我根本不需要飞出去去寻找什么隐蔽的地方。
        
        信息太多了，你只需要用一个手势就能表达清楚。”尼尼安的脸颊微微发红，但还是转过身来，微微点头表示理解。

“如果你个子再小一些，就能进去了看看……不过这个地方确实是为身材高大的人设计的，所以显得非常传统、传统风格。 像我这样的小精灵，甚至仙女们，通常也不会选择居住在如此封闭的环境中，即使我们偶尔会安定下来居住。据我所知，我们大多数人都更喜欢生活在环境开阔、自由流动的城镇或村庄里。也许这也是原因之一，但这个地方确实让人感到很不自在。"
        
        当你推开门走进去时，听到里面传来沙沙声，这让你忍不住倾身想要往里面看。虽然你无法进入，但至少可以四处看看，试着哄他开心一下。

这个方形的房间里，墙壁并没有被涂上任何颜色，木制表面也只是被简单地打磨过而已。 在各种草丛和用绳子绑扎起来的毛茸茸的团块之下，地板的表面几乎看不见了；而在那些被填得特别饱满的落叶和花瓣覆盖的地方，还铺着一块包扎用的亚麻布。 尼尼安正在翻弄放在角落里的几个小钱袋，取出一颗烤过的橡果，然后转过身来面对你。
        
        看吧？就是这么……普通。”那个小家伙用勺子挖起坚果软化后的部分，挖了一口然后咬了下去。“哼……我是说……你真的看看这个吧。”

尼尼安可不能在嘴里塞满东西的时候说话啊。[pc.isDK| 除非里面全是你的东西。 [pc.hasCock|[pc.cum]|[pc.girlcum]]]你提醒了他，但也不得不承认他的想法确实有道理。尽管这个小屋非常舒适且实用，但这里确实存在一个问题——只有他一个人似乎花心思去让它变得温馨舒适，而其他人似乎都没有这个想法。这个小屋确实能让他免受雨淋，但真正用心去营造这种氛围的，却只有他一个人。 对于一个他每天早上都会去的地方来说，如果没有其他人陪伴，那里只会显得极其无聊，甚至令人感到不适。难怪从那条小巷里看去，他总是看起来在忙个不停。
        
        但这一次，是尼尼安主动来找你。在尽情享用美食、将橡果吞进肚子的片刻之后，他走到你面前，用严肃而异常认真的表情轻轻拍了拍你的脸颊。
        
        如果你有空的话， [pc.name]如果你能帮我解决这个……问题，我真的会非常感激。”

嗯，你现在还不能做出承诺，但你可以站直身子，让尼尼安能够从那个小屋里出来。你还需要再和他多聊聊，才能弄清楚他遇到的这个问题究竟需要什么帮助。你有一种预感，这个问题恐怕不会那么简单……
        |我的意思是，是你帮我建造了这个地方。所以……你懂的……我真的很喜欢它。”

尼尼安有些害羞，他把目光移开，回头看了看那座设计精巧、布局合理的住所。

“我准备了大量的食物，把这里布置得既舒适又温馨，甚至觉得空间可能还有点多余。尼尼安轻拍着木墙，发出了一声简短的感叹，这让你对自己的项目感到至少有些满意。“如果有一天我不得不放弃这个项目，鹰棘镇将会拥有一片备受争议的鸟屋用地，我敢肯定这一点。所以现在他觉得有劫匪来住反而挺好的吗？

“哈哈，真有趣。我只是想说，这个地方真的太棒了，懂吗？天啊……学着接受别人的赞美吧。
    ]

rows.original: Well, you got time, so why not hear out Ninian's problems with his home. It'll give you an idea of what you're going to need to do if you do want to help him out. "Well, the first thing I need is more space." The statement's instant reply is telling enough he's been thinking about all this, one of his hands shifting up to scratch at his smoother hair section. "All my bags really do need their own room. Storing food and stuff near where I sleep makes it difficult to take even a nap if I'm the slightest bit hungry." Turning to face the box, the tanned tiny twink waves his hands at the box-shaped building while scowling and buzzing his wings. "And all these walls need to go! If I'm unable to fly in with ease, it just isn't right! I can hang up a sheet if I want privacy or the wind gets too nippy! I slept in treetops before that were more welcoming than this!" Tree branches that broke and almost carried him to the ground below, if you recall. But you can understand the idea that maybe Ninian needs more room. Compared to the forest, that closed-quarter area is more like a hollowed out stump with little appeal. Maybe you could even give it roof access and give him a pleasant surprise... that'd probably be more appreciated it he could land on top instead of slip down and land on the platform where he normally speaks to you from. It's no doubt he would lack the strength to do anything structurally changing, though, and would need to rely on you. Anything else he can think of? "... Well..." Turning so that he's looking up at you, Ninian's face catching in a blush whilst rubbing at his neck. "I-I... I could use some sort of clothing... o-of yours." Trying to muscle through your look of [pc.isBimbo|slutty amusement|confusion], the pixie raises a finger to silence you. "N-Not for anything like that! It's because clothing for big people is really soft and comfortable! I can make a proper bed or something if I just had something. So s-shut up, okay? It has nothing to do with wanting to sleep on your clothes! It'll be fine with anyone! I can wash and prepare it myself!" For now, you pat the flustered twink and get rewarded with a cute grumbling. Well, you have an idea of what he needs to solve this problem... now it's just a matter of helping him out when you get the time.
rows.translation: 嗯，你有时间，不妨听听尼尼安关于他家里的问题。这样你就能知道如果真的想帮助他的话，需要做些什么。 “首先，我需要更多的空间。”他的回答立刻就说明了他一直在考虑这个问题，他的一只手部抬起来，开始挠自己那比较光滑的头发。 我的所有包真的都需要单独的一个空间来存放。如果把食物之类的东西放在我睡觉的地方附近，那么只要我有一点饿，就根本无法小睡一会儿。 它转过身来，面对着那个箱形的建筑，那只皮肤黝黑的小家伙一边皱着眉头，一边振动着自己的翅膀，向那栋建筑挥动着双手部。 “这些墙全都得拆掉！如果我不能轻松地飞进去，那就太不合理了！如果我想隐私一点，或者风太大了，我完全可以挂一块布来遮挡啊！以前我在树顶上睡觉，那里可比这里舒服多了！ 那些断裂的树枝差点把他甩到下面的地上，你应该还记得吧。不过你可以理解，也许尼尼安需要更多的空间。与那片密林相比，那个封闭的空间更像是一个被掏空了的树桩，没什么吸引力可言。 或许你还可以为它搭建一个通道，让它能够飞到屋顶上去，这样就能给他一个惊喜了……如果它能够降落在屋顶上，而不是滑落到它平时与你交谈的那个平台上，它肯定会更加高兴。不过，毫无疑问，它并没有足够的力量去破坏现有的结构，因此还是需要你的帮助。 他还能想到别的什么吗？ “……嗯……” 尼尼安转过身来，抬头看着你，脸上顿时泛起了红晕，同时还不停地揉着自己的脖子。 “我、我……我需要一些衣服……你的衣服。”他努力挤出了这句话，同时试图避开你那充满疑惑的目光。 [pc.isBimbo|低俗的娱乐内容|混乱]小精灵竖起一根手部指，示意你安静。“不、不是因为那个原因！是因为大人的衣服真的又柔软又舒适！要是我有那样的衣服，就能好好地铺张床铺之类的了。所以请闭嘴好吗？这和想睡觉完全没有关系…… 你的 衣服！任何人穿都合适！我可以自己洗干净并准备好。” 目前，你轻轻拍了拍这个慌乱的小家伙，作为奖励，他发出了可爱的抱怨声。嗯，你现在应该知道他需要什么来解决这个问题了……接下来，只要你有时间，帮帮他就行了。

rows.original: While you're sure you're going to meet others in your adventuring, there's one thing you're certain of; you want to know whatever Ninian knows of what pixies and fairies are. His big green eyes of his cloud up with immediately distant and intense thinking; after a few moments, it seems he returns to normal. "Well... since I have some memories, I can tell you what my creator and I both think to a degree... or thought. It's hard to explain but, basically, we inherit memories from our original fairy, so-" Whoa, hold on. Pixies inherit memories? "Yup." Ninian gives a rather simple nod despite how bizarre the situation would be to the average random goon in the world. "When we grow old, we can give our memories back to the fairies that created us. Pixies like me are short-lived by comparison, but... well, we're pretty useful in the terms of your normal people. Not that most fairies use us like that. Companionship is definitely the biggest reason a pixie gets made..." Normal in your terms sounds very specifically pointed out. What does he mean by that? The turn-around question clearly intended for you, of course, as Ninian instantly grins. "Yeah, like you non-fey. Since we like to always go off on whims and explore, it's very unnecessary... but to someone big and huge who likes to settle down in places or adventure into tombs? That sort of learning from pixies would be invaluable to big ones like you! But we don't really use it for any sort of evil. In my case especially, where I'd been created to act like some love child, there was no expectation of anything beyond companionship. That is what we consider important. Friends and... mostly family. And lovers! And having fun." You can't help but point out all of this sounds extremely light-hearted and borderline goofy, particularly coming from the tough-acting twink's lips. Even when he hears that, though, Ninian's smile doesn't falter. Instead, it becomes a smirk. "That's because it really is that simple, [pc.name]. I really do wish it was more complex, so I could make you think we're like some sort of species that hide away in the woods or locks ourselves away in the mountains... but we're not. Fey, particularly fairies and pixies, all have a love for having fun, sexual or otherwise." Carefully turning, his hands motioned to his intricate back pattern while the other points up at the lines along his face. [flags.FAIRY_CODEX_UNLOCKED|"These marks, for example? They get brighter when we're in the moonlight... basically because we're being encouraged to go out and play, as far as I figure." The twink lets his hands fall down to his derriere, patting it in a tease at you before facing you properly and allowing the smirk to rescind into its more casual smile.] "If I can do anything, I'd recommend you be careful around the bigger ones of our kin. Real fey like fairies have tendencies to transform their partners, after all. Pixies don't because we're magic or something I guess... but that's particularly why there are all sorts of tales of fairy princesses swooning over boys and girls making them their supposedly eternal lover. It happens a lot more than you'd think! That's how Nino and Nils met!" While you're not sure there are many tales going around about fairies sluttily seducing the other races of Savarra, you doubt Ninian would lie about the other part. It's good to know that prolonged contact with the tanned lad isn't changing how you end up looking by the end of the day. [flags.PC_FEY_MARKED|Not that it helps you much now. ]You thank Ninian for spending the time to give such a basic run-down. This is definitely a good way to [flags.NINIAN_HAWKETHORNE_TALK_FAE|refresh yourself|get informed].
rows.translation: 虽然你确信在冒险的过程中会遇到其他人，但有一件事你是可以肯定的：你非常想知道尼尼安所了解的关于精灵和仙子们的所有信息。他那双大大的绿色眼睛在思考时会变得若有所思，仿佛陷入了遥远的思绪之中；过了一会儿，他似乎又恢复了正常状态。 嗯……既然我还保留着一些记忆，那么我就可以告诉你们，我和我的创造者都是这么认为的……或者说，我们曾经这么认为。这很难解释，但基本上，我们是从最初的那个精灵那里继承了这些记忆，所以——” 等等，先别急。 精灵会继承记忆吗？ “没错。”尼尼安简单地点了点头，尽管对于世界上那些普通的普通人来说，这种情况听起来确实非常奇怪。“当我们变老的时候，就可以把我们的记忆归还给创造我们的那些精灵。 像我这样的小精灵相对来说寿命较短，但是……嗯，对于你们人类来说，我们还是相当有用的。当然，大多数精灵并不是这样的。 使用 我们就喜欢这样。陪伴，绝对是一个精灵被创造出来的最大原因……” 用你的说法来说，这句话听起来似乎是在特别强调某一点。他到底是什么意思呢？当然，这个反问其实是针对你的，因为尼尼安立刻露出了笑容。 是啊，就像你们这些非精灵族一样。因为我们总是喜欢随心所欲地探索未知，所以这种行为对我们来说并不重要……但对于那些喜欢安定下来生活或者喜欢冒险探索墓穴的庞然大物来说，向小精灵们学习未尝不是件非常有价值的事情吧！对你们这样的生物来说，这种知识绝对是无价之宝！ 但我们其实并没有将其用于任何邪恶的目的。就我而言，我本来就被创造出来，就是要扮演一个充满爱心的角色，人们根本不期望我能够做出什么超出陪伴范围的事情。 那个 这些才是我们认为重要的东西。朋友，还有……主要是家人。当然，还有恋人！最重要的是要开心地生活。” 你不禁会觉得，这些话听起来极其轻松愉快，甚至有点傻乎乎的，尤其是从这个故作严肃的少年口中说出来。不过，当尼尼安听到这些话时，他的笑容丝毫没有减弱，反而变得更加灿烂了。 “因为事实就是这么简单。 [pc.name]我真希望这个设定能更复杂一些，这样就能让你觉得我们像是那种躲在树林里或者把自己关在山里的物种……但实际上并非如此。精灵们，尤其是仙女和小精灵，都喜欢享受各种乐趣，无论是与性相关的还是其他方面的。 他小心翼翼地转动身体，同时用手部指着自己的背部那复杂的图案，另一只手部则指向自己脸上的那些线条。 [flags.FAIRY_CODEX_UNLOCKED|比如这些标记？在月光下它们会变得更亮……我觉得，这大概是在鼓励我们出去玩吧。”那个男孩把双手放在屁股上，轻轻拍了拍，然后才正视着你，把之前的调皮笑容换成了更自然的微笑。] 如果我能提什么建议的话，我劝你在我们这些同类中那些体型较大的个体附近要格外小心。毕竟，真正的精灵，就像那些真正的仙子们一样，往往会改变她们伴侣的形态。而我们小精灵就不会这样，大概是因为我们拥有魔法之类的能力吧……但正正因为如此，才会有各种各样关于仙子公主们为迷恋上的男孩或女孩而改变他们的外貌的故事吧。 据说 永恒的爱人啊，这种事情发生的频率比你想象的要高得多！尼诺和尼尔斯就是这么相识的！ 虽然你不确定是否真的有很多关于精灵们勾引萨瓦拉其他种族的故事在流传，但你觉得尼尼安不会在这一点上撒谎。值得庆幸的是，长时间与那个皮肤黝黑的男孩相处，并不会影响你一天结束时的外貌。 [flags.PC_FEY_MARKED|不过现在这也没什么帮助吧。 ]你感谢尼尼安花时间为大家做了这么详细的介绍。这确实是一种很好的方式。 [flags.NINIAN_HAWKETHORNE_TALK_FAE|稍作休息吧|了解相关信息].
rows.raw: " While you're sure you're going to meet others in your adventuring, there's one thing you're certain of; you want to know whatever Ninian knows of what pixies and fairies are. His big green eyes of his cloud up with immediately distant and intense thinking; after a few moments, it seems he returns to normal. "Well... since I have some memories, I can tell you what my creator and I both think to a degree... or thought. It's hard to explain but, basically, we inherit memories from our original fairy, so-" Whoa, hold on. Pixies inherit memories? "Yup." Ninian gives a rather simple nod despite how bizarre the situation would be to the average random goon in the world. "When we grow old, we can give our memories back to the fairies that created us. Pixies like me are short-lived by comparison, but... well, we're pretty useful in the terms of your normal people. Not that most fairies use us like that. Companionship is definitely the biggest reason a pixie gets made..." Normal in your terms sounds very specifically pointed out. What does he mean by that? The turn-around question clearly intended for you, of course, as Ninian instantly grins. "Yeah, like you non-fey. Since we like to always go off on whims and explore, it's very unnecessary... but to someone big and huge who likes to settle down in places or adventure into tombs? That sort of learning from pixies would be invaluable to big ones like you! But we don't really use it for any sort of evil. In my case especially, where I'd been created to act like some love child, there was no expectation of anything beyond companionship. That is what we consider important. Friends and... mostly family. And lovers! And having fun." You can't help but point out all of this sounds extremely light-hearted and borderline goofy, particularly coming from the tough-acting twink's lips. Even when he hears that, though, Ninian's smile doesn't falter. Instead, it becomes a smirk. "That's because it really is that simple, [pc.name]. I really do wish it was more complex, so I could make you think we're like some sort of species that hide away in the woods or locks ourselves away in the mountains... but we're not. Fey, particularly fairies and pixies, all have a love for having fun, sexual or otherwise." Carefully turning, his hands motioned to his intricate back pattern while the other points up at the lines along his face. [flags.FAIRY_CODEX_UNLOCKED|"These marks, for example? They get brighter when we're in the moonlight... basically because we're being encouraged to go out and play, as far as I figure." The twink lets his hands fall down to his derriere, patting it in a tease at you before facing you properly and allowing the smirk to rescind into its more casual smile.] "If I can do anything, I'd recommend you be careful around the bigger ones of our kin. Real fey like fairies have tendencies to transform their partners, after all. Pixies don't because we're magic or something I guess... but that's particularly why there are all sorts of tales of fairy princesses swooning over boys and girls making them their supposedly eternal lover. It happens a lot more than you'd think! That's how Nino and Nils met!" While you're not sure there are many tales going around about fairies sluttily seducing the other races of Savarra, you doubt Ninian would lie about the other part. It's good to know that prolonged contact with the tanned lad isn't changing how you end up looking by the end of the day. [flags.PC_FEY_MARKED|Not that it helps you much now. ]You thank Ninian for spending the time to give such a basic run-down. This is definitely a good way to [flags.NINIAN_HAWKETHORNE_TALK_FAE|refresh yourself|get informed]. "

rows.original: You ask Ninian to sit down and be calm because you're probably going to upset him. The pixie seems about ready to argue, but a stern wag of your [pc.hand]'s digit silences him instantly. You watch the green-haired lad finally plop down to his girly butt, the twink crossing his arms and giving small buzzes of his wings as he waits to hear it. So you finally ask him the number one question. Why does he have such a huge problem with this Nino? "Well, because Nino is... was... my blueprint!" The energy shifting mid-sentence has the pixie uncertain but at least still sitting down. "When I'd been made, I'd been based on Nino... and... I thought they were a pretty okay person, you know? They were someone who got fey-touched and became Nils' lover, s-so it made sense that I loved both of them. I mean... when I was born, I was basically Nino, right?" The pixie's gaze turns down, both of his hands squeezing his bare knees. It seems that this really is a rotten topic for Ninian, particularly since it's strong enough to make him run away. Before he had also mentioned that Nino had changed; how so? "Yeah, Nino changed... and it wasn't for the best in my case. Nino was a guy like me, but... after he went on a trip and came back, he was a girl. And... and he kept telling me I would make a cute girl, too." So he'd been teased about looking like he'd make a cute girl? That seems like a very ridiculous reason to run away. "W-Well... it's not only that. I... I'm going to be remade someday, right? S-So... when I asked if Nino intended to change his body back so I could be... well, me again... he... said no. And he took offense at it, and... and... I shouldn't have to explain why I got upset! I-I... it's my body, too, right!?" Ninian's eyes water up, tears streaming down his marked face. This is a situation you can't really quite understand, particularly since the body and life of a pixie are so drastically different from the one you could comprehend. Being reliant on the body of others sounds very challenging. Stating it thankfully draws a small laugh from Ninian as the twink rubs his face clean of tears and turns his eyes up to look at you. "I... I really do like being... Ninian, you know? I like to be me, as I am! The concept of death or that kind of change in my future... it's scary. The chance at life has been so fun, getting to play and see things so wild. [pc.isVirgin||Having sex with people is definitely up there, too. ]It's how I met you, even. Losing my friends or... or simply vanishing, becoming part of Nils... that... that's not comforting to me. I'm not... normal like another pixie who's content just getting to live as a girl, either. The idea of meeting an end like that so soon... if there was a way to get a chance to live a long life... to be me for as long as I want, despite Nino's form? I'd do anything for that. That's why I had to run away. If I die... th-then... becoming someone else or a different version of myself isn't what I want." Slowly getting up, Ninian turns his eyes up to you once more with a small frown. "[pc.name]... until that day comes, I want to enjoy myself fully. But I'm not giving up. I'll find a way to live longer and be me somehow. No matter what, I won't let my life abruptly end just when I feel like I'm finally starting it. So... if you hear something that might help, come tell me. But I... I don't want to talk about Nino, okay?" [pc.isDK|Although you couldn't care much|Despite your curiosity, you have to care for his feelings], you agree to drop it for now. You'll just have to hope something happens to encourage Ninian back to this topic. A boy-turned-girl, though? Nino and Nils certainly seem like unique individuals paired with the little twink pixie they brought into existence.
rows.translation: 你让尼尼安坐下，让他冷静下来，因为你说自己的话很可能会让他生气。那个小精灵看起来似乎准备好了要争论，但你严厉地摇摇头…… [pc.hand]那个数字立刻让他安静了下来。你看着那个绿头发的男孩最终坐了下来，双臂交叉，翅膀还不停地轻轻振动，等待着听到那个数字。于是，你终于问出了那个最重要的问题。 他为什么会对这个尼诺如此反感呢？ “嗯，因为尼诺……曾经是我的榜样啊！”他话音突然变了，这让小精灵有些困惑，但至少还是坐了下来。“在我被创造出来的时候，我的设计就是以尼诺为蓝本的。…而且…我觉得他们都是挺不错的人，你知道吗？他们曾经被魔法影响，从而成为了尼尔斯的恋人，所以我觉得自己同时喜欢他们俩也是情有可原的。我的意思是…当我出生的时候，我本质上其实就是尼诺，对吧？小精灵的低下了头，双手部紧紧握住自己光秃秃的膝盖。看来，这个话题确实让尼尼安感到非常不适，甚至到了想要逃跑的程度。而且他之前还提到，尼诺已经发生了变化——究竟发生了什么变化呢？ 是的，尼诺变了……而对我来说，这种变化并没有带来任何好处。尼诺原本和我一样是个男孩，但是……在他去旅行回来之后，他就变成了一个女孩。而且……他还一直这么告诉我…… 我 那样也会变成一个可爱的女孩呢。” 所以，他因为看起来会变成一个可爱的女孩而被人取笑吗？这似乎是个非常荒谬的逃跑理由啊。 “嗯……其实不只是这个原因。我……总有一天我会被重新创造出来的，对吧？ 所以……当我问尼诺是否打算把他的身体变回来，这样我就能……重新变回原来的自己……他……拒绝了。而且他还因此生气了，我根本不需要解释自己为什么会难过！这……这也是我的身体啊，对吧！尼尼安的眼泪开始涌出，泪水顺着他那布满伤痕的脸颊流了下来。这种处境确实很难让人真正理解，尤其是当一个精灵的躯体与生命与人类截然不同时。 依赖别人的身体，听起来确实是一件很有挑战性的事情。不过，当尼尼安擦去脸上的泪水，抬起头看着你时，这句话反而引来了他的一阵轻笑。 “我……我真的很喜欢这样。.. 尼尼安，你明白的吧？我就想做自己，做真正的自己！死亡的概念，或者我未来可能经历的那种改变……真的让人害怕。能够活着，能够去体验各种奇妙的事情，这种感觉真是太棒了。 [pc.isVirgin||与人发生性关系，也绝对属于其中之一。 ]正是这样，我遇到了你。失去朋友，或者……干脆消失，成为尼尔斯的一部分……这种事情，让我感到非常难受。我也和那些只满足于以女孩的身份生活的精灵不同，我并不属于那种“正常”的存在。想到自己会这么快就迎来这样的结局……如果有什么办法能够让我有机会活得更久一些……的话…… 我 只要我愿意，即使尼诺的状态不好，我也愿意做任何事。这就是我不得不逃跑的原因。如果我死了……那么……变成另一个人，或者变成另一个版本的自己，并不是我想要的。 尼尼安缓缓站起身来，再次抬起头看着你，脸上带着一丝忧愁。[pc.name]……直到那一天到来，我想尽情享受生活。但我不会放弃。我会想办法活得更久，继续做真正的自己。无论如何，我都不会让我的生命在我觉得自己终于开始好好生活的时候突然结束。所以……如果你听到什么可能有帮助的信息，请一定要告诉我。不过……我不太想谈论尼诺，好吗？ [pc.isDK|虽然你可能并不太在意……|尽管你充满好奇心，但你还是应该考虑他的感受。]你同意暂时放弃这个话题了。只能希望会有什么事情促使尼尼安重新回到这个话题上来。不过，一个男孩变成了女孩？尼诺和尼尔斯确实是一对非常独特的组合，再加上他们创造出来的那个可爱的小精灵，这个组合更加特别了。

"B-But having sex here... th-this is way too public. So uh... l-let's move first, okay?" Smirking and nodding, you wait for the little twink to dart indoors and finish wrapping up whatever he was up to before you dropped by. Once he's out and flying, the pair of you move out the gate and only a short distance away from the town's exit to a nice and secluded section of brush. Off the beaten trail as it is, you've no doubt Ninian knows the place well, leading you over to a large stump smoothed down from some earlier logging attempt. The pixie sets down and immediately disrobes, putting the clothes down into a pile near the edge of it before turning to face you. Nice and erect, the twink waits for you to quickly undress and let your [pc.cocks] out. The two of you were now nude, secluded, and you had plenty of time... and is that a bottle of lube he's pulling out from a nook in the stump? "Sorry if I seem a bit eager or prepared..." Your green-haired twink gently bumps the glass vial with his gaze squarely fixed on your [pc.cocks]. "After what you've done, helping me get a safe place to figure things out... well, I figured you might be curious about how pixies work... and fuck. It's not like I'm gay or want to be a girl or anything! If a female's body can take someone... th-then so can I, right? Anytime you want to have fun, I'll have a bottle of this stuff restocked or around[flags.SUGO_FOREST| thanks to that pretty-looking centaur lady in town]. I can at least reward you sexually, as many times as needed!" | Ninian perks up when he seems to sense what you have in mind even before it leaves your [pc.lips]. Leaping up and taking the lead, the pixie guides both of you out to the familiar stump. Fittingly enough, you watch the cock-loving lad gracefully undress mid-air before fluttering down and tossing the clothes aside. While you undress, he turns to face you and starts speaking. "Well, here we are." Ninian steps back to the familiar nook, slipping the vial of lube up and out of the crevice and standing it up beside him. "Take your pick, [pc.name]!                 他确实动手改造了它们。他抓起一根已经变硬的断裂木梁，走到桶边，将金属条塞进桶身的接缝处。然后，这个体格健壮、肌肉结实的男子使出了迄今为止最令人惊叹的力量——他绷紧全身那块块结实而布满毛发的肌肉，桶木在压力下发出嘎吱声，而他则将那些金属环向外推了足够大的距离，终于把桶盖取了下来。 而且他并不是只做了一次，而是每个桶都重复做了两次。考虑到一共有七个旧容器，而他却在几分钟内就完成了所有工作，你不禁会惊叹不已。当他熟练地完成拆除木板的工作，将那些木板整齐地堆放在小巷的一边时，你还会看到他满意地拍着手，脸上露出满意的笑容。
                
                好了！全部完成了！而且只用了一个小时！”

尼尼安简直不敢相信自己的眼睛，他飞快地跑过去，检查那堆木材，而加勒特则径直走向了你。
                
                [garret.pcIsBitch|
                嗯，我这个可怜的人…… [pc.ra lupine|贱人|荡妇]哼，”它用一只爪子抢过你手中的钱袋，同时用另一只爪子迅速掐住了你的脖子，“多谢你的‘帮忙’。现在可别再跟你的那个同性恋小朋友装强硬了——我们都知道你真正属于哪里。”

这一句话让人不寒而栗。在它松开你的手之前，你不得不微微点了点头。
                |
                干了一整天的活，就该得到应得的报酬。”那只杂种狗抢过了你许下的那袋硬币，狼吞虎咽地笑着。“我想，是时候好好享受这些钱，找点乐子了。等你没和那个小家伙在一起的时候，来找我吧，好吗？
                ]
                
                当加勒特从你身边走过，去把你的血汗钱据为己有时，你至少可以确信这份工作已经完成得很不错了。从尼尼安那灿烂的笑容来看，你也很确定那个小家伙也对结果很满意！你忍不住注意到，尼尼安正在那堆废墟中翻找着什么，看起来他正在仔细地挑选那些布料……
rows.raw:
"
                You think you've got a guy who actually kinda owes you a favor. Telling Ninian to wait here, you make your way over to the Frost Hound...

                And not but maybe ten minutes later, you're back and escorted by Garth's husky-like son. And as the pair of you make your way into the alleyway, Ninian lifts up and off to fly over and examine the lupine hunk. Of course, that doesn't stop the normally-drinking mutt from smiling and poking the twink pixie's bare stomach.
                
                "I'd heard that there was one of you pixies living around here now... haven't I seen you before in the Old Forest? Swishing in and taking food from people whenever we turned our backs?" Ninian blushes, instantly answering the question for both of you before the mutt looks back to you.
                
                [garret.pcIsBitch|
                "So my little cocksleeve, this is all you needed me to bust up? I might as well fuck you silly and give you your money's worth if this is all there is!"
                
                You lose yourself in the heat-filled image of being worked over by the studly lupine, visibly shaking even with Ninian watching the two of you, mouth agape in shock. Particularly when Garret grabs your [pc.ears] and gives a firm and possessive tug so the pair of you are face to face.
                
                "Afterward, I order you to bring that ass of yours by for a rough, proper fucking... got it?"
                
                You hastily nod, averting your gaze lest things get too arousing where someone might see you. If Garret wants it then, of course, you'll agree in a heartbeat... but for now you and the flustered pixie watch your hunky dom start moving the barrels nearby.
                |
                "Huh... well, it doesn't look that bad. Far from the worst kind of work a guy can get."
                
                Rolling his shoulders a bit, Garret starts forward only for Ninian to flutter in-front of him.
                
                "So how did the two of you meet? I mean, I met [pc.name] in the Old Forest and-"
                
                A hand raises, placing a finger on the twink's lips and basically his entire face. The small guy could do nothing but grumble and wait, finally relieved as the furry digit descends and lets both come face-to-face. Garret is actually smiling while Ninian maintains his puffy-cheeked annoyance.
                
                "[pc.HeShe] helped me out. That's all there is to it. Now mind if I get to work?"
                
                Pushing on and over to the barrels and debris, you can't help but feel maybe Ninian and Garret aren't going to be the fastest of friends. Maybe the future could hold a chance to improve their relationship. If Ninian ends up making this new home of his more permanent in some capacity, the townsfolk at large might humor him.[flags.ETHERYN_RECRUITED| Maybe you could bridge the gap between Ninian and birds with Harrick's help.]
                ]
                
                "Well," Ninian sighs, setting down atop his old home and crossing his arms. "I guess I can't complain about your hired help. He looks like he has a big dick and all..."
                
                [silly|Ha. GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAY!|Is Ninian really thinking about Garret's dick at a time like this?] Your words instantly draw out a scowl and huffy turn of the green-haired lad's head, not even giving you the satisfaction of a voiced reply. Not that you need it; it's so transparent the pixie is letting cock-lust cloud his mind. Maybe Ninian needs some release if he's that curious about what Garret is packing — you suspect it wouldn't be easy to convince the lupine to try testing any sort of boy holes, though.
                
                Neither of you speaks any further, instead opting to sit by and watch as the lupine sets to work. Garret removes his vest and tosses it to the ground nearby, his furry torso and broad shoulders on display as the working man sets into gathering up the debris. Every time he squats to grab a loose shingle or wrestle a broken piece of furniture from their wall-wedged positions, you can't help but think of how tiring it would have been to do this personally. But for Garret, this sort of muscle-heavy work sure looks easy! In no time at all, everything gets cleaned up into a pile pushed near the edge of the street.
                
                "I'll have someone drop by and sort through this stuff later," he states with a casual brush of his hand along his forehead. "Now, to deal with these busted barrels. I've wanted to mess with these things for weeks now..."
                
                And mess with them he does. Grabbing a hardened broken beam, he makes his way over and wedges the metal against the barrel's seams. And with the most impressive show of strength yet, the husky-like male flexes all of his well-toned and fur-bound muscles, the wood of the barrel groaning as he pushes the rings outward just enough to slide it off. And he didn't do it just once, but twice for each barrel. And considering there were seven of the old containers and he got it done in a matter of minutes? You can't help but blink away in awe as he neatly finishes the follow-up job of removing the planks and dropping them to the alleyway's side into a neat pile, clapping and rubbing his palms together with a satisfied smirk.
                
                "There! All done! And in only an hour!"
                
                Ninian can't believe his eyes, fluttering over to the pile and looking over the lumber while Garret makes his way right up to you.
                
                [garret.pcIsBitch|
                "Well my needy [pc.ra lupine|bitch|slut]," he snatches the bag of coins from you with one paw and quickly clasps a chokehold around your neck in the other, "Thanks for the job. Now don't take too long playing tough with your gay little friend. We all know where you really belong."
                
                It sends a chill down your spine, giving him a small nod before the lupine releases you.
                |
                "A good day's work and a good day's pay." The mutt grabs the bag of coins you promised, wolfishly grinning. "Time to hit the sauce and have some fun with it, I think. Drop by sometime when you're not hanging out with the little guy, alright?"
                ]
                
                As Garret passes you and heads off to do whatever he wishes with your hard-earned money, you at least feel confident that the job is well done. Based on Ninian's big grin, you're certain the pipsqueak is too! You can't help but notice Ninian poking around the pile of debris and sorting through it, scavenging pieces of cloth by the looks of it...
                
                "

rows.original:
You'll handle all the work. You're strong enough, you figure... and it's just a little physical labor, right? With the pixie frowning at the idea, you can't help but push past and start your own attempt at doing some proper work!

                That's how it all started out, anyway. 
                
                Backbreaking work keeps you busy for the next three hours, your body covered in sweat as you're left grasping your knees and breathing to slow your heart rate back down. Ninian flies over, gently patting your back as you turn your gaze to Ninian's cutely marked face and see a comforting smile.
                
                "At least it's done... just uh... well, go get some rest, okay? You made me tired just watching all of that..."
                
                Sighing in both agreement and relief that your work is over, you part from the pixie's company. Hopefully this all pays off in the end. You can't help but notice Ninian poking around the pile of debris and sorting through it, scavenging pieces of cloth by the looks of it...

所有的工作都由你来完成。你足够强壮，对吧……而且这也不过是些体力活而已，不是吗？当小精灵听到这个安排时，露出了不悦的表情，但你还是忍不住开始尝试自己动手去做这些工作！

                无论如何，事情就是这么开始的。

接下来三个小时，你一直忙于繁重的工作，全身都浸在汗水中，最后只能双手抱膝，努力调整呼吸，让心跳慢慢恢复平静。 尼尼安飞了过来，轻轻拍了拍你的背。当你抬头看向尼尼安那张带着可爱标记的脸时，看到了她那令人安心的微笑。

“至少事情已经办妥了……嗯，去休息吧，好吗？ 看你干这些，我都看累了……”

你既感到无奈，又暗自松了口气——看来你的工作终于结束了。你离开了小精灵的陪伴，希望这一切最终都能取得好的结果。你不经意地注意到，尼尼安正在那堆废墟中翻找着什么，看起来她正在仔细地挑选那些布片。..

Motioning to the box, you suggest that Ninian step back. It's time to get to work in the now-cleaned out alley! Ninian smiles at your excitement, giving a few nods before turning to take one last look at the awful box.

            "Well... let's get the front pulled off and my stuff out! I'll set it all aside and direct you!"
            
            Thankfully for you, you're not stuck waiting very long while the pixie trots in and flutters out with a bag of supplies. Back and forth, he ferries pouch after pouch into a neat pile. Only when he stops and looks expectantly up at you, before pointing at the front of the box.
            
            "Pull away, my large minion!"
            
            [pc.isDK|Making a note to get even|Shaking your head dismissively], you figure the least you can do is get working. With a tug and a grunt, the front panel comes off and reveals the plain and basic interior. This is going to be a bit of work, you know, but that's just fine. Your [pc.hands] get a firm grip on the top and wrestle it free next...

你指向那个箱子，示意尼尼安退后一些。是时候开始在已经清理干净的小巷里干活了！尼尼安看到你如此兴奋，微微笑了笑，点了点头，然后转身最后再看一眼那个可怕的箱子。

“好吧。快，把前面的东西掀开，把我的东西取出来！我会把它们都整理好，然后指导你们该怎么做！”

幸运的是，你们不用等太久——小精灵很快就飞了进来，然后带着一袋补给品又飞了出去。 来来回回地，他把一个个袋子搬来搬去，最终把它们整齐地堆放在一起。直到他停下来，满怀期待地抬头看着你，然后指向箱子的前面。

“拉开它，我强大的小跟班！
            
            [pc.isDK|记下这件事，以后一定要报复回来。|摇着头表示不屑]你想想，最起码你应该开始动手部干活了。用力一拉、一哼，前面板就被拆了下来，露出了简单而朴实的内部结构。这确实需要花些功夫，不过也没关系。你就开始吧…… [pc.hands] 先牢牢抓住顶部，然后再把它拔出来……

rows.original:
It's been almost two hours, but you plop down on the barrel to examine your hard work, watching Ninian as he flutters around. The little twink is ferrying some sewn cloth to a final nook, tying it off before fluttering back down. Overall, the pair of you can't help but feel accomplished with this new home — even if it's not traditional!

                With a more acorn-like spherical shape thanks to the barrel pieces, the old platform now sits atop stone with proper foundational support. The door hole is wider, covered with cloth for privacy, but it doesn't matter much since the front wall ends after the first floor. With the base floor acting as storage, the second floor is larger, with windows cut out so moonlight shines and wind flows better through the abode. A hammock, stuffed with soft bedding in a middle layer, now acts as a proper bed for Ninian, while small stones and a nail box act as dining furniture. Though there's no definite roofing, the twigs you gathered cross above and over the box and poke out the sides, with fresh leaves and grasses mixed in to provide insulation with some old leather to redirect water beneath it. Drainage holes you personally cut allow water to pass through without disturbing Ninian, passing every drip out and to the alley floor.
                
                Although it isn't necessarily better furnished than some noble child's toy house, it definitely leaves better impressions than the previous feature-lacking pixie-box. Not to mention the bands from the barrels getting hammered and nailed as securing struts to reinforce the home. Unlike the original box that might sway with strong winds or anyone lifting it, this likely can get picked up and moved whenever Ninian wishes while enduring storms. The green-haired lad gently pats his hand on the curvy walls, smiling back at you seconds later.
                
                "You really did a good job, [pc.name]. I... well, maybe... living with big people isn't that bad."
                
                Pft. Is Ninian really getting mushy now?
                
                "O-Of course not!" The red blush his cutely tanned cheeks hinders his rejection, moving both hands to his hips. "I just... it makes me think of... being with Nino and Nils. Someone caring for me this much... [pc.hasCock|y-you really didn't need to do all this|and I didn't even do anything serious with you but you still helped me]."
                
                Watching the minuscule boy turn and flutter up to his hammock, you [pc.isDK|scoff at the pixie's emotional display|smile at the relaxing pest]. For all the crap he can give, Ninian isn't that bad of a person. In the future, you may just find more ways to help him. But for now, you turn and depart while he snuggles against the cloth of what looks suspiciously like a pair of clothes you'd seen in the room you'd awoke in after recovering from your incident with Karyssa. That couldn't be the case though... right?
rows.translation:
已经过去将近两个小时了，你还是坐下来仔细检查自己的劳动成果，看着尼尼安在周围飞来飞去。这个小家伙正在把一些缝好的布料送到最后的角落，系好之后又飞了回来。总的来说，看到这个新家，你们俩都忍不住感到成就感——尽管它并不传统！

                由于加装了那些桶状结构，这个旧平台现在呈现出更加接近橡果形状的球形结构，整个平台被安置在石头基础上，得到了稳固的支撑。门洞变宽了，外面还用布帘遮住了，以保护隐私——不过其实这也无关紧要，因为前墙在第一层就结束了。 由于底层被用作储藏空间，所以二楼的面积更大，窗户也被设计得恰到好处，这样月光可以照进来，空气也能更顺畅地流通。现在，尼尼安在中间层铺上了柔软的 bedding，将吊床当成了真正的床来使用，而一些小石头和钉子盒则被临时改造成了餐具。 虽然没有固定的屋顶结构，但你收集来的细枝被交叉铺设在箱子的上方，并从箱子的两侧伸出；新鲜的树叶和草也被混在一起使用，这些材料与一些旧皮革一起起到了保温的作用，同时还能引导雨水从箱子的下方流走。 你亲自开凿的排水孔让水能够顺利流过，而不会干扰到尼尼安，让每一滴水都流入小巷的地面。
                
                虽然它的装饰未必比某些贵族孩子的玩具屋更豪华，但它确实比之前那个缺乏任何功能的迷你小屋给人的印象要好得多。更不用说那些用木桶制成的构件被敲打、钉牢，被用作加固房屋的结构支撑了。 与那种在强风中可能会摇晃，或者被人轻易抬起来的原始箱子不同，这个箱子显然可以随时被尼尼安拿起来移动，即使是在暴风雨中也是如此。那个绿发男孩轻轻抚摸着那些弯曲的箱子墙壁，几秒钟后，他微笑着向你回望。
                
                你真的做得非常出色， [pc.name]我……嗯，也许……和大人一起生活也没那么糟糕吧。”

“哈，尼尼安现在是不是变得有点多愁善感了？”

“当、当然没有！”他那双被晒得红润的脸颊让他无法顺利拒绝这个想法，他双手部叉腰说道：“我只是……这让我想起……和尼诺还有尼尔斯在一起的日子。有人能这么关心我…… [pc.hasCock|你真的没必要做这么多事情。|而我甚至没有和你做过什么特别亲密的事情，但你还是帮助了我。]看着那个小小的男孩转身飞快地跑向他的吊床，你…… [pc.isDK|对小精灵这种情绪化的表现嗤之以鼻|对这种让人放松的“小麻烦”微笑吧。]尽管尼尼安有时候会说一些让人讨厌的话，但他其实并不是一个坏人。以后，你或许可以找到更多帮助他的方法。不过现在，你还是转身离开吧——而他则正依偎在那些看起来很像你在从卡莉萨那里恢复过来后醒来的那个房间里看到过的衣服上。不过，这应该不会是真的吧……对吧？

                With a more acorn-like spherical shape thanks to the barrel pieces, the old platform now sits atop stone with proper foundational support. The door hole is wider, covered with cloth for privacy, but it doesn't matter much since the front wall ends after the first floor. With the base floor acting as storage, the second floor is larger, with windows cut out so moonlight shines and wind flows better through the abode. A hammock, stuffed with soft bedding in a middle layer, now acts as a proper bed for Ninian, while small stones and a nail box act as dining furniture. Though there's no definite roofing, the twigs you gathered cross above and over the box and poke out the sides, with fresh leaves and grasses mixed in to provide insulation with some old leather to redirect water beneath it. Drainage holes you personally cut allow water to pass through without disturbing Ninian, passing every drip out and to the alley floor.
                
                Although it isn't necessarily better furnished than some noble child's toy house, it definitely leaves better impressions than the previous feature-lacking pixie-box. Not to mention the bands from the barrels getting hammered and nailed as securing struts to reinforce the home. Unlike the original box that might sway with strong winds or anyone lifting it, this likely can get picked up and moved whenever Ninian wishes while enduring storms. The green-haired lad gently pats his hand on the curvy walls, smiling back at you seconds later.
                
                "You really did a good job, [pc.name]. I... well, maybe... living with big people isn't that bad."
                
                Pft. Is Ninian really getting mushy now?
                
                "O-Of course not!" The red blush his cutely tanned cheeks hinders his rejection, moving both hands to his hips. "I just... it makes me think of... being with Nino and Nils. Someone caring for me this much... [pc.hasCock|y-you really didn't need to do all this|and I didn't even do anything serious with you but you still helped me]."
                
                Watching the minuscule boy turn and flutter up to his hammock, you [pc.isDK|scoff at the pixie's emotional display|smile at the relaxing pest]. For all the crap he can give, Ninian isn't that bad of a person. In the future, you may just find more ways to help him. But for now, you turn and depart while he snuggles against the cloth of what looks suspiciously like a pair of clothes you'd seen in the room you'd awoke in after recovering from your incident with Karyssa. That couldn't be the case though... right?
                
                "

rows.original: It's finally time to give the last touches and fix this place up properly!
rows.translation: 是时候进行最后的修饰了，把这个地方彻底整理好吧！
rows.raw: "It's finally time to give the last touches and fix this place up properly!"

rows.original:
As much as you'd love to stick around, you know that there are things to do besides for bother a pixie boy living in an alleyway. Getting up, you raise your [pc.hand] in farewell; Ninian flutters up and waves one his arms at you with a renewed grin of his own.

    "Next time you come by, you better keep walking past my alleyway or I'll scowl at your back and curse you! Not like anyone else comes and pays me visits aside from nosy kids or someone coming by to clean up. And... well... you get what I mean!"
rows.translation:
尽管你很想留下来，但你也知道，除了去打扰一个住在小巷里的精灵男孩之外，还有其他事情需要去做。于是，你站了起来，抬起了手…… [pc.hand] 在告别之际，尼尼安振翅飞起，一边朝你挥手，一边重新露出笑容。

“下次你再来的时候，最好直接从我的小巷旁边走过去，否则我会冲着你背影皱眉骂你！除了那些爱管闲事的孩子，或者那些来打扫卫生的人，根本没人会来看我。嗯……你应该明白我的意思吧！
rows.raw:
"
    As much as you'd love to stick around, you know that there are things to do besides for bother a pixie boy living in an alleyway. Getting up, you raise your [pc.hand] in farewell; Ninian flutters up and waves one his arms at you with a renewed grin of his own.

    "Next time you come by, you better keep walking past my alleyway or I'll scowl at your back and curse you! Not like anyone else comes and pays me visits aside from nosy kids or someone coming by to clean up. And... well... you get what I mean!""

rows.original: You set off along the forest trail, the dense, overgrown trees pressing in on you as if they mean to guide you somewhere. So long as you don't get lost in the twilight of the undergrowth, you're content to let them take you where they may, especially if it's somewhere new...
rows.translation: 你沿着森林小径前行，茂密的树木仿佛在向你示意，想要引导你前往某个地方。只要你不迷失在灌木丛的幽暗之中，就任由它们带你去任何地方吧——尤其是如果那是一个全新的地方的话……
rows.raw: "You set off along the forest trail, the dense, overgrown trees pressing in on you as if they mean to guide you somewhere. So long as you don't get lost in the twilight of the undergrowth, you're content to let them take you where they may, especially if it's somewhere new..."

rows.original: You set off along the myriad of forest trails, picking one at random. So long as you follow the road, you won't get lost, right? Right? Paths used by hunters, trails created by large animals bumbling through the underbrush, adventurers like you forging ahead where no one has gone before...
rows.translation: 你沿着无数条森林小径中的一条随机选择了开始前进。只要沿着这条路走，就不会迷路，对吧？对吧？这些小径有的是猎人走出来的，有的是大型动物在灌木丛中穿行时留下的痕迹，还有像你这样的冒险者在前人未曾涉足的地方开辟出来的……
rows.raw: "You set off along the myriad of forest trails, picking one at random. So long as you follow the road, you won't get lost, right? Right? Paths used by hunters, trails created by large animals bumbling through the underbrush, adventurers like you forging ahead where no one has gone before..."

rows.original:
As you meander through the woods, you come across a particularly rank scent coming from the nearby brush. Tightening your grip on your [pc.weapon], you follow the smell of decay...

        There's a young deer sprawled out in a hollow beneath a gnarly old bush. It's not a fresh kill, but you'd guess it's been in the last couple days. Torn apart by something large and full of fangs... wolves, maybe. But the wounds seem much too large for any normal beast.
        
        You shake your head and step back the way you came.
rows.translation:
当你穿梭在树林中时，突然闻到附近灌木丛中散发出一股特别浓烈的气味。你立刻抓紧了手中的…… [pc.weapon]你顺着腐烂的气味走去……

在一片扭曲的老灌木丛下的凹陷处，有一只小鹿倒在那里。它并不是刚被猎杀的，但看起来应该是在过去几天内被杀的。它的身体被某种体型庞大、长满獠牙的动物撕得支离破碎……也许是狼。不过，这些伤口看起来对于任何普通的野兽来说都太严重了。

你摇了摇头，然后转身沿着来时的路走了回去。
rows.raw:
"
        As you meander through the woods, you come across a particularly rank scent coming from the nearby brush. Tightening your grip on your [pc.weapon], you follow the smell of decay...

        There's a young deer sprawled out in a hollow beneath a gnarly old bush. It's not a fresh kill, but you'd guess it's been in the last couple days. Torn apart by something large and full of fangs... wolves, maybe. But the wounds seem much too large for any normal beast.
        
        You shake your head and step back the way you came."

rows.original: You set off into the woods, and quickly come upon a verdant bush that is as yet untouched by the corruption seeping into the land. Large, succulent orange berries hang in clumps from between lush green leaves, and a sweet aroma wafts enticingly from them. As you draw closer, you note that the berries taper off to white near the stem, making them resemble a fox's tail. One looks particularly ripe for the plucking... You acquired a fox berry!
rows.translation: 你走进树林，很快就发现了一丛尚未受到这片土地上蔓延的腐朽现象影响的翠绿灌木。茂密的绿叶间，结着一簇簇鲜亮的橙色浆果，它们散发着诱人的甜香。当你靠近时，注意到这些浆果在靠近茎部的地方逐渐变成了白色，看起来就像狐狸的尾巴。 其中有一颗看起来已经熟到可以采摘了…… 你获得了一颗狐莓！
rows.raw: " You set off into the woods, and quickly come upon a verdant bush that is as yet untouched by the corruption seeping into the land. Large, succulent orange berries hang in clumps from between lush green leaves, and a sweet aroma wafts enticingly from them. As you draw closer, you note that the berries taper off to white near the stem, making them resemble a fox's tail. One looks particularly ripe for the plucking... You acquired a fox berry!"

rows.original:
As you traipse through the forest, you come across a gorgeous purple flower. [
        flags.LYCANTHORN_FOUND
        |Given your past experience with the flower, you immediately note the thorns on its stem and recognize it as Lycanthorn.
        |[pc.bg acolyte scholar
            |At first glance, you recognize the plant before you as wolfsboon; a flower common to the area and regularly used by lupines for various ritual purposes.
            |It seems familiar, but you can't quite place it. After a few moments of pondering, it finally clicks that the flower is wolfsboon.
        ]
    ] As you get a closer look at it, you discover a trait very different from the wolfsboon you're accustomed to: dozens of small thorns line the stem. You're also given a whiff of a powerful scent, [flags.EFFIGIES_MET|not unlike the one those effigies exude|one that makes you slightly dizzy with arousal]. Would you like to take the flower?
rows.translation:
当你漫步在森林中时，你会遇到一朵美丽的紫色花朵。 [
        flags.LYCANTHORN_FOUND
        |根据你之前对这种花的了解，你立刻注意到了它茎上的刺，于是认出了它就是狼牙棒花。
        |[pc.bg acolyte scholar
            |乍一看，你会认出这种植物其实就是狼爪草——这种花在该地区很常见，狼人族也经常用它来举行各种仪式。
            |这个东西看起来很熟悉，但却一时想不起它到底是什么。经过片刻的思考，终于想起来了——这种花其实就是狼牙草。
        ]
    ] 当你仔细观察它时，你会发现它与你熟知的狼爪草有着截然不同的特征：它的茎上布满了数十根细小的刺。同时，你还能闻到一种浓烈的气味。 [flags.EFFIGIES_MET|与那些雕像所散发出的气息颇为相似|那种会让你因兴奋而感到一阵头晕的感觉]你想拿这朵花吗？
rows.raw:
"

rows.original: You grab the flower, careful to avoid any of the numerous thorns. You gingerly set it into your pack for later. Who knows what possibilities this flower may hold! You acquired a lycanthorn!
rows.translation: 你小心翼翼地摘下那朵花，注意避开那些众多的刺。然后你轻轻地将它放进背包，留待以后使用。谁知道这朵花会带来什么意想不到的惊喜呢！ 你获得了一只狼人角兽！
rows.raw: " You grab the flower, careful to avoid any of the numerous thorns. You gingerly set it into your pack for later. Who knows what possibilities this flower may hold! You acquired a lycanthorn!"

rows.original: You're walking through the forest when something faintly glimmering catches your eye. Stooping down to inspect it further, you realize on closer inspection it's a shard of ice from the nearby river — and somehow still solid. It must've gotten washed up the last time the river flooded and broke its banks, which by the looks of it is quite often. You stop to pocket it and move on. You have obtained a glowing ice shard.
rows.translation: 你正在森林中行走，突然注意到有 something 闪烁着微弱的光芒。你弯下腰仔细查看，发现那是一块来自附近河流的冰块——而且竟然还保持着固态。想必是上次河水泛滥、冲破河岸时被冲上岸来的，而看样子这种事情发生得相当频繁。 你把这块冰块收进口袋，然后继续前行。 你获得了一块发光的冰块碎片。
rows.raw: " You're walking through the forest when something faintly glimmering catches your eye. Stooping down to inspect it further, you realize on closer inspection it's a shard of ice from the nearby river — and somehow still solid. It must've gotten washed up the last time the river flooded and broke its banks, which by the looks of it is quite often. You stop to pocket it and move on. You have obtained a glowing ice shard."

rows.original: You'd expect a brief jaunt into the woods to clear the mind; good for the soul and body both. But this time, you find yourself wandering through a haze of some thick, aromatic scent hanging heavy between the trees. You can't quite place the musky odor... at least, until you look a little more closely at some of the flora growing around you. Vines wrap the trunks of the ash trees around you, seeming to pulsate and leaking a thick white sap. There's no other way to describe them than phallic, with bulbous purple heads that wriggle and squirm as their tainted fluids eject onto the ground. You could swear that some of the vines seem to reach out towards you as you pass by, but when you blink, they've returned to relative stillness. Other plants look conspicuously like pussies, their lush red petals dripping with nectar. The flowers seem to be unnaturally deep, like they were molded by some unseen hand into the perfect shape to slide a dick right into. There is no doubt that [flags.ALRAUNE_DOM|your Alraune is still exerting her influence over the forest.|some corrupted force is influencing the forest, twisting the plants into these... abominations.] You[party.solo||r party] lose[party.solo||s] some HP.
rows.translation: 你本以为去森林里短暂地走走，能让思绪变得清晰，这对身心都有好处。但这一次，你发现自己置身于一片浓重的、芳香四溢的雾气之中，这些气息仿佛在树林间久久徘徊。你一时无法辨认出这种麝香般的气味究竟来自何处……至少，在你仔细观察周围生长的植物之前，你是想不明白的。 缠绕在白蜡树干上的藤蔓似乎在脉动，不断分泌出浓稠的白色汁液。除了这样描述，实在想不出其他更好的词语了…… 阳具状的那些藤蔓长着球状的紫色花序，当它们体内的污秽液体喷溅到地面时，这些花序会不断地扭动、蠕动。你甚至会觉得，当你经过时，有些藤蔓似乎在朝你伸来，但当你眨眼再看时，它们又恢复了静止状态。 其他植物看起来简直就像阴户，它们那鲜红的花瓣上挂满了花蜜。这些花朵的花瓣似乎深得有些不自然，仿佛是某个看不见的手将它们塑成了那种能让阴茎轻易插入的完美形状。 毫无疑问， [flags.ALRAUNE_DOM|你的阿尔劳娜仍在对这片森林施加着影响。|某种邪恶的力量正在影响这片森林，使植物扭曲成这些……令人憎恶的东西。] 你[party.solo||派对] 失败[party.solo||s] 一些生命值。

But this time, you find yourself wandering through a haze of some thick, aromatic scent hanging heavy between the trees. You can't quite place the musky odor... at least, until you look a little more closely at some of the flora growing around you. rows.original: Shortly after setting out, you find yourself walking through a small glade in the woods, just a bit off the trail. It's quiet here, and the wind's died down to almost nothing — just a soft breeze that sends rolling waves through a field of wild tulips growing between the long grass's dew-shined blades. A moment's peace does good for a weary mind and body, but holds nothing of greater interest. You[party.solo||r party] recover[party.solo||s] some health.
rows.translation: 出发不久后，你发现自己正走在树林中的一片小空地上，这条小路稍微偏离了主路径。这里非常安静，风几乎完全停息了，只有微风轻拂，让野郁金香花田中的花朵随风轻轻摆动。这样的宁静对于疲惫的身心确实很有好处，但这里并没有什么特别值得关注的地方。 你[party.solo||派对] 恢复[party.solo||s] 一些生命值。
rows.raw: " Shortly after setting out, you find yourself walking through a small glade in the woods, just a bit off the trail. It's quiet here, and the wind's died down to almost nothing — just a soft breeze that sends rolling waves through a field of wild tulips growing between the long grass's dew-shined blades. A moment's peace does good for a weary mind and body, but holds nothing of greater interest. You[party.solo||r party] recover[party.solo||s] some health."

rows.original:
You stand amidst a garden of titanic flowers. Each stem is as thick as a treetrunk, and the colored petals form a canopy that blocks out the [dayNight|sun|moon]light. Many of them look unmistakably like dicks, pussies, and boobs; every kind of sexual equipment is blatantly on display in the living plants like some sort of pervert's paradise.

    [flags.ALRAUNE_DEFEATED
        |The lingering reek of plant-fucking has died down somewhat since the Alraune was dealt with. Her glade is just ahead, now abandoned.
        |The scent of pollen and sugar hangs heavily in the air, almost enough to make your eyes water. The scent draws your eyes northward along the faint remnants of a road, towards a distant gap in the petal covering. Godrays beam down through the opening onto what looks like a clearing several hundred yards ahead.
    ]
rows.translation:
你站在一片由巨型花朵组成的花园中。每一根花茎都粗如树干，那些色彩斑斓的花瓣共同构成了一个遮天蔽日的花冠。 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]轻型。其中很多东西看起来分明就是阴茎、阴户和乳房；各种生殖器器官都被公然展示在这些“活植物”之中，简直就像是一个变态者的天堂。

    [flags.ALRAUNE_DEFEATED
        |自从解决了那个阿尔劳恩之后，那种浓重的植物腐烂气味已经有所减轻。她的小树林就在前方，如今已经荒废了。
        |空气中弥漫着花粉与糖分的浓烈香气，这种气息几乎会让人流泪。这种香味引导着你的视线沿着那条依稀可见的道路向北方延伸，最终指向花瓣覆盖层中那一处遥远的缝隙。阳光从缝隙中照射进来，照亮了前方几百码处的一片空地。
    ]

The scent draws your eyes northward along the faint remnants of a road, towards a distant gap in the petal covering. Godrays beam down through the opening onto what looks like a clearing several hundred yards ahead.
    ]"

rows.original: The walls of thorn and root protecting the garden are impenetrable without a great many people working at once to hack their way through.
rows.translation: 那些由荆棘和树根构成的围墙，除非有很多人同时努力才能将其凿开，否则根本无法突破。
rows.raw: "The walls of thorn and root protecting the garden are impenetrable without a great many people working at once to hack their way through."

rows.original: There's no sign of the little camp that once stood here. With the Alraune removed from the bridge, Hinata and his underlings must have returned home to the Frostwood. There's nothing for you here now, at least in that regard.
rows.translation: 这里已经没有任何曾经存在过的那个小营地的痕迹了。既然阿尔劳恩已经被从桥上移除，希娜塔和他的手下们肯定已经回到了霜林的家中。至少从这方面来看，你在这里已经没有任何事情可做了。
rows.raw:
"
                

There's no sign of the little camp that once stood here. With the Alraune removed from the bridge, Hinata and his underlings must have returned home to the Frostwood. There's nothing for you here now, at least in that regard."

rows.original:
[dayNight|The remains of a fire sit on the moss-grown stone of the jetty, the ashes long since grown cold, but there's no other sign of life. Hinata and his little posse must be out and about their... well, doing what it is they do.|
            Light at the end of the old elven jetty catches your attention; someone lit a fire in one of the stonework's many potholes, creating a makeshift firepit. You could approach Hinata and his posse, if you like.]
rows.translation:
[dayNight|码头上的石头上覆盖着苔藓，上面还残留着一些火灰，那些灰烬早已冷却了，但除此之外，没有任何其他生命的迹象。雏田和他的小伙伴们肯定已经出去做他们平时该做的事情去了……嗯，也就是他们一贯在做的那些事情吧。|
            在古老的精灵码头尽头，一束光线吸引了你的注意——有人在一个石砌结构中的凹坑里生了火，搭了一个简易的火堆。如果你愿意的话，也可以去找日向和他的同伴们。]
