            Light at the end of the old elven jetty catches your attention; someone lit a fire in one of the stonework's many potholes, creating a makeshift firepit. You could approach Hinata and his posse, if you like.]
rows.translation:
[dayNight|码头上的石头上覆盖着苔藓，上面还残留着一些灰烬，那些灰烬早已冷却了，但除此之外，没有任何其他生命的迹象。雏田和他的小团队应该正在外面忙他们的事情吧……嗯，也就是他们在做的事情罢了。|
            在那座古老的精灵码头尽头，一束光芒吸引了你的注意——有人在这片石砌结构中随处可见的坑洞里生了火，搭起了一个简易的火堆。如果你愿意的话，也可以去找日向和他的同伴们。]
rows.raw: "\n            \\n\\n[dayNight|The remains of a fire sit on the moss-grown stone of the jetty, the ashes long since grown cold, but there's no other sign of life. Hinata and his little posse must be out and about their... well, doing what it is they do.|\n            Light at the end of the old elven jetty catches your attention; someone lit a fire in one of the stonework's many potholes, creating a makeshift firepit. You could approach Hinata and his posse, if you like.]"

rows.original: You should come back at night if you want to talk to them
rows.translation: 如果你想和他们谈话，最好在晚上回来。
rows.raw: "You should come back at night if you want to talk to them"

rows.original: This narrow forest trail stretches away westward from the main path, directly into the dense undergrowth of the Old Forest. While it looks like it might have been once a fairly wide path, enough for logging carts to traverse its length, Garth wasn't wrong about how overgrown it's become. Roots and thorny shrubs grow directly in the middle of the trail, and razor-edged weeds choke the edges.
rows.translation: 这条狭窄的森林小径从主干道向西延伸，直接通向旧森林茂密的灌木丛中。虽然它看起来曾经可能是一条相当宽阔的道路，足以让伐木车在上面通行，但加思说得没错——这条小径已经变得杂草丛生、难以通行了。树根和带刺的灌木直接从道路中间生长出来，而边缘则被锋利的杂草挤得水泄不通。
rows.raw: "\n        This narrow forest trail stretches away westward from the main path, directly into the dense undergrowth of the Old Forest. While it looks like it might have been once a fairly wide path, enough for logging carts to traverse its length, Garth wasn't wrong about how overgrown it's become. Roots and thorny shrubs grow directly in the middle of the trail, and razor-edged weeds choke the edges."

rows.original: Now that you know from experience how much of the trail is traversable, it shouldn't be too hard to get to Westbank Camp through the forest. The going won't be any easier or safer, but at least you aren't going to be wasting time walking in circles and tripping over yourself.
rows.translation: 既然你已经根据经验知道了这条小路上有多少路段是可以通行的，那么穿过森林前往西岸营地应该不会太困难。虽然旅途过程并不会因此变得更容易或更安全，但至少你不会再浪费时间绕圈子走，也不会再经常被绊倒了吧。
rows.raw:
"
            

Now that you know from experience how much of the trail is traversable, it shouldn't be too hard to get to Westbank Camp through the forest. The going won't be any easier or safer, but at least you aren't going to be wasting time walking in circles and tripping over yourself."

rows.original: It wouldn't be right to call this a trail proper, or even a path. This is more on the lines of... well, slightly thinner underbrush. Even with Garth having marked out the route on your map, it's still going to be an effort to not lose your way as you make your way westward. Best start searching for a way forward, then...
rows.translation: 将这条路称为小径甚至路径都不太准确。其实它更像是一片……嗯，植被较为稀疏的灌木丛。尽管加斯已经在你的地图上标出了路线，但在向西行进的过程中，你仍然需要小心谨慎，以免迷路。最好还是先做好充分的准备。 搜索正在寻找前进的道路，那么……

rows.original:
Here it is. Westbank Logging Camp, as Garth explained it, is — or was — the main source of timber for construction in Hawkethorne. The timber used to be carried through the forest back to Hawkethorne via carts, but they've since switched to floating logs downriver, a much easier task. From where you are, you can spy stands of felled trees and new saplings alike in the woods surrounding the camp; the loggers' work appears to have been interrupted midway, and they've never returned to finish the job.

    Surrounded by a palisade wall of sharpened palings, the camp has only one entrance — a large gate of wooden planks, forced open by huge thorny vines that sprout out of the earth. Yeah, those don't look natural.
    
    [var0|Nevertheless, the gate beckons — Garret and the loggers are counting on you to do something about their situation.|Now that the whole ugly business is over and Garret and the loggers are safe, the camp lies abandoned. Presumably business will start up again when the Old Forest is safer or something can be worked out with the pale elves... or when the loggers themselves finally realize they need drinking money at the Frost Hound. Either way, Hawkethorne can't do without fresh timber forever.]
rows.translation:
就是这里。正如加思所描述的，西岸伐木营地曾是——或者说曾经是——鹰棘镇地区建筑用木材的主要供应地。过去，这些木材都是通过马车运送到鹰棘镇的，但后来人们改用了将原木顺流而下运输的方式，这种方式要方便得多。 从你所在的位置，可以看到营地周围树林里既有被砍倒的树木，也有新栽的树苗；那些伐木工人的工作似乎在半途中被中断了，他们再也没有回来继续完成这项工作。

这个营地被一堵由削尖的木桩搭建而成的围墙围着，只有一处入口——一扇由木板制成的大门，而这扇门被从地面中生长出来的粗大带刺的藤蔓强行撑开了。 是啊，那些看起来不太自然。
    
    [var0|然而，那扇门仍在召唤着——加勒特和那些伐木工人们都在期待你能为他们解决目前的困境。|现在，这一切麻烦都已经结束了，加勒特和那些伐木工人们也都安全无恙，这个营地也就被废弃了。想必，等到旧森林的安全状况得到改善，或者能够与那些苍白精灵达成某种协议……又或者那些伐木工人们终于意识到自己需要钱在“霜猎犬”酒馆里喝酒时，生意就会重新恢复。无论如何，鹰棘镇不可能永远没有新鲜的木材可用。]
rows.raw:
"
    Here it is. Westbank Logging Camp, as Garth explained it, is — or was — the main source of timber for construction in Hawkethorne. The timber used to be carried through the forest back to Hawkethorne via carts, but they've since switched to floating logs downriver, a much easier task. From where you are, you can spy stands of felled trees and new saplings alike in the woods surrounding the camp; the loggers' work appears to have been interrupted midway, and they've never returned to finish the job.

    Surrounded by a palisade wall of sharpened palings, the camp has only one entrance — a large gate of wooden planks, forced open by huge thorny vines that sprout out of the earth. Yeah, those don't look natural.
    
    [var0|Nevertheless, the gate beckons — Garret and the loggers are counting on you to do something about their situation.|Now that the whole ugly business is over and Garret and the loggers are safe, the camp lies abandoned. Presumably business will start up again when the Old Forest is safer or something can be worked out with the pale elves... or when the loggers themselves finally realize they need drinking money at the Frost Hound. Either way, Hawkethorne can't do without fresh timber forever.]"

rows.original: Liaden and Azzy are sitting on one of the fat, short flowers of the outer garden, talking quietly. Both seem on their guard, heavy weapons at the ready for danger.
rows.translation: 莉亚登和阿齐坐在外花园里那些肥硕而矮小的花朵上，轻声交谈着。两人都显得十分警惕，手中紧握着重型武器，随时准备应对可能的危险。
rows.raw: "\n            Liaden and Azzy are sitting on one of the fat, short flowers of the outer garden, talking quietly. Both seem on their guard, heavy weapons at the ready for danger."

rows.original: Perched near the wall of spiked vines and ivy, Azyrran the Hive Knight kicks her feet out. She's looking somewhat tired, adjusting her chestwraps while her lance and shield remain in easy reach.
rows.translation: 栖息在长满尖刺的藤蔓和常春藤的墙边，蜂群骑士阿兹兰轻轻踢了踢足部。她看起来有些疲惫，一边调整着自己的胸甲，一边确保长矛和盾牌始终在手边，可以随时使用。
rows.raw: "\n            Perched near the wall of spiked vines and ivy, Azyrran the Hive Knight kicks her feet out. She's looking somewhat tired, adjusting her chestwraps while her lance and shield remain in easy reach."

rows.original: Sigrune remains sitting by the side of the archway. She will no longer oppose your coming and going from the hidden sanctum of the prince...
rows.translation: 西格鲁娜依然坐在拱门旁。她不会再阻拦你进出王子的隐秘居所了……
rows.raw: "\n        Sigrune remains sitting by the side of the archway. She will no longer oppose your coming and going from the hidden sanctum of the prince..."

rows.original:
You stand in the ruins of what might once have been a tall, proud structure; perhaps a temple, or a forum, given the great stone pillars still jutting up from the ground. Most are nothing but shattered husks, broken off in various places to strew their top ends about as so much moss-covered debris. 

    It seems that, long ago, there was a campsite here. You see tattered remnants of cookware and tents. It's a simple matter to patch them together into a serviceable camp of your own.

    [var0|You can feel a powerful arcane presence suffusing the air around this sundered ruin. Your [pc.skin] tingles from the static charge of untapped power all around you. If only you had a night to investigate...]
rows.translation:
你站在一片废墟之中，这些废墟或许曾经是一座高大而庄严的建筑——考虑到那些依然矗立在地面的巨大石柱，它很可能是一座寺庙或广场。然而如今，这些废墟大多已经只剩下支离破碎的残骸，碎片散落在各处，顶端覆盖着苔藓，看起来就像是一些被遗弃的杂物。

看起来，很久以前这里曾经是一个露营地。你可以看到破烂的炊具和帐篷的残余。把这些碎片重新拼凑起来，完全可以让它重新成为一个可以使用的露营地。

    [var0|你能感受到一股强大的神秘力量弥漫在这片废墟之中。你的…… [pc.skin] 你周围充满了尚未被利用的能量，这种能量带来的静电感让你感到一阵阵的兴奋。要是能有一整晚的时间来探索这些能量该多好啊……]
rows.raw:
"
    You stand in the ruins of what might once have been a tall, proud structure; perhaps a temple, or a forum, given the great stone pillars still jutting up from the ground. Most are nothing but shattered husks, broken off in various places to strew their top ends about as so much moss-covered debris. 

    It seems that, long ago, there was a campsite here. You see tattered remnants of cookware and tents. It's a simple matter to patch them together into a serviceable camp of your own.

    [var0|You can feel a powerful arcane presence suffusing the air around this sundered ruin. Your [pc.skin] tingles from the static charge of untapped power all around you. If only you had a night to investigate...]"

rows.original: You need to wait a bit longer for the purification ritual to do its course.
rows.translation: 你还需要再等待一段时间，让净化仪式完成它的过程。
rows.raw: "You need to wait a bit longer for the purification ritual to do its course."

rows.original:
A group of hornet workers — and a single resplendent Hive Knight, just like Azyrran herself — are standing near the edge of the ravine keeping guard. They hop up as you approach, and [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED|the workers smile and stretch their wings. "Need a lift across?"|the workers preen and smile. "Need a ride across, cutie?"]
    
        [pc.hasWings
            |[party.solo
                |You wave them off and stretch your own wings. You'll be fine. The hornets giggle and step back, giving you plenty of room to get a running leap before you spread your wings and fly. It's a short trip across the deep but narrow ravine, and you land with aplomb on the other side.
                |[party.Yall] will need some help getting across, even if you yourself have wings. You leave the hard work to the hornets and take wing yourself, launching off across the ravine and landing on the other side a moment later. An easy flight for you, though it takes a moment for your friend[party.som|||s] to arrive in the arms of [party.has brint|several struggling workers|a particularly strong worker]. You wave the honeypot goodbye once she's done and turn towards the entrance to the hive...
            ]
            |[party.Yall] will need a little help getting across, yeah. [party.som|The biggest and strongest (and bustiest) hornet worker in the group strides forward and flexes for you, hard enough to make her bare chest bead with nectar. "I can take ya!" she offers, circling around you. "Just hold onto something!"|A couple of hornets march over and circle around you, hands brushing your hips. "Just hold on to something..." one of them giggles.|The group hops to it, telling you to hold onto something as they get their arms around your waist and start buzzing their wings.] A moment later and you're airborne, whisked across the narrow but deep ravine. You land heavy on the other side, dropped a foot up by your eager hornet valet before [party.hasCompanions|they turn|she turns] back towards the forest.
        
            "Tell the Queen we said hiiiii!"
        ]
rows.translation:
一群黄蜂工蜂，以及一位英姿飒爽的蜂巢骑士——就像阿兹兰本人一样——正站在峡谷边缘站岗放哨。当你靠近时，它们立刻跳了起来…… [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED|工人们微笑着，展开了他们的“翅膀”。“需要搭个便车吗？|工人们整理着自己的衣着，脸上洋溢着笑容。“小可爱，需要搭车过去吗？]
    
        [pc.hasWings
            |[party.solo
                |你挥手让它们离开，然后张开自己的翅膀。你会没事的。那些黄蜂咯咯地笑着退了回去，为你留下了足够的空间，让你可以迅速跃起，然后展翅飞翔。穿过那条又深又窄的峡谷只需要很短的时间，你便稳稳地落在了另一边。
                |[party.Yall] 即使你自己拥有翅膀，也需要一些帮助才能顺利飞过去。你把繁重的任务交给了大黄蜂，自己则振翅飞起，穿过峡谷，片刻之后便降落在对岸。对你来说，这是一次轻松的飞行——不过你的朋友却需要花费一些时间才能完成同样的旅程。[party.som|||s] 投入……的怀抱 [party.has brint|几名处境艰难的工人|一个特别勤奋的工作者]等她完成后，你挥手部告别了那个蜜罐，然后朝着蜂巢的入口走去……
            ]
            |[party.Yall] 确实需要一些帮助才能让别人理解，没错。 [party.som|群体中最大、最强壮（也是胸部最丰满的）那只黄蜂工蜂迈步向前，用力展示自己的肌肉，以至于她裸露的胸部上都渗出了花蜜。“我能对付你！”它边说边绕着你飞圈。“只要抓紧什么东西就行了！|几只大黄蜂飞过来，在你周围盘旋，它们的触角时不时触碰到你的臀部。“最好抓紧什么东西……”其中一只大黄蜂咯咯地笑了起来。|这群小生物立刻围了上来，它们让你抓紧某个东西，然后用自己的手臂环住你的腰，同时开始振动翅膀。] 片刻之后，你便腾空而起，掠过了那条狭窄而深邃的峡谷。你在对岸重重落地，正好落在那只急切等待你的“大黄蜂侍从”不远处…… [party.hasCompanions|他们转身离开。|她转身了。] 朝着森林的方向走去。

“告诉女王，我们向她问好了！
        ]

rows.original: Your trek through the woods is interrupted by the shine of [dayNight|sun|star]light on something metal. Approaching carefully you can see that someone has left a neatly folded set of clothes on a snowy rock, with a peaked witch's hat sat atop it. There are no signs of any footprints or any life around that isn't [party.solo|you|your group]. Well, waste-not, want-not. [party.has cait|"Oooh, that's cute!" pipes up your buxom partner. |]The hat looks to be quite sturdy leather; its peak doesn't droop when you lift it, and a shiny buckle stands out in gold atop a broad hem. [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|It feels magical to the touch, but not exactly malevolent... stretching the inside of it shows that it's probably enchanted to fit properly.|It's a witch's hat, so it's probably magical in some way. It's stretchy when you tug on it, but it snaps back into place a moment later.] [party.solo|You place the hat aside|You hand the hat off] before picking up the next article of clothing. It looks like a little red cape, but the hood is small and ornamental, and it probably wouldn't do much more than cover your shoulders. There's a little golden clasp in the center of it, [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|that emanates soft magic as well, it might be some kind of focus|maybe it's magical too? At the very least it could go for a pretty penny]. It's warm at least, for as little of your shoulders as it might cover. The last pieces appear to be the same black leather as the hat; a curve-hugging, breast-pushing corset-thong combo, some arm-length gloves, and a pair of glistening heeled fuck-me boots. Altogether the outfit is definitely magical in some way. [silly|Let's face it, it's going to transform the fuck out of you if you put it on|It's not unlikely that it's going to have an effect on your body if you put it on]. But do you? It looks really nice.
rows.translation: 你在森林中艰难前行，突然，一道轻型芒打破了这份宁静…… [dayNight|太阳|星星]在某块金属上投去轻型线。当你小心翼翼地靠近时，会发现有人在雪覆盖的岩石上留下了一套叠得整整齐齐的衣服，上面还放着一顶尖顶的女巫帽。周围没有任何脚印，也没有其他生物的踪迹。 [party.solo|你|你的团队]嗯，不浪费，就不会缺少。 [party.has cait|哦，真可爱！”你那丰满的伴侣兴奋地说道。 |]这顶帽子似乎是由非常结实的皮革制成的；当你把它拿起来时，它的帽顶并不会下垂，而在宽大的帽边处，一个闪亮的金色扣子格外显眼。 [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|触感上它给人一种神奇的感觉，但并不带有恶意……将其内部拉伸开来后，会发现它很可能被施了魔法，才能确保能够完美地贴合在一起。|这是一顶女巫帽，所以它肯定在某种程度上具有魔法效果。当你拉扯它的时候，它会变得有弹性，但过一会儿又会立刻恢复到原来的状态。] [party.solo|你把那顶帽子放在了一边。|你把帽子让给了别人。] 在拿起下一件衣物之前。它看起来像一件小红斗篷，但兜帽很小，主要是用于装饰，并且它的作用大概也就只是遮住肩膀而已。在它的中间还有一个小小的金色扣环。 [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|那种散发出柔和魔力的东西，或许是一种特殊的聚焦装置吧。|也许它也具有某种神奇的力量吧？至少，它肯定能卖个好价钱。]至少，它能让你的肩膀感受到温暖，尽管覆盖的范围可能很小。 最后的几件装备似乎都是用同样的黑色皮革制成的：一条贴合身体曲线的、能将胸部线条凸显出来的束腰带，一些及肘长的手套，以及一双闪闪发轻型的高跟鞋。总体来说，这套服装确实充满了魔力…… 一些 方法。 [silly|说实话，如果你真的使用了它，它肯定会彻底改变你。|如果你将其涂抹在身上，它很可能会对你的身体产生某种影响。]但是你真的这么认为吗？看起来确实很棒啊。
rows.raw: " Your trek through the woods is interrupted by the shine of [dayNight|sun|star]light on something metal. Approaching carefully you can see that someone has left a neatly folded set of clothes on a snowy rock, with a peaked witch's hat sat atop it. There are no signs of any footprints or any life around that isn't [party.solo|you|your group]. Well, waste-not, want-not. [party.has cait|"Oooh, that's cute!" pipes up your buxom partner. |]The hat looks to be quite sturdy leather; its peak doesn't droop when you lift it, and a shiny buckle stands out in gold atop a broad hem. [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|It feels magical to the touch, but not exactly malevolent... stretching the inside of it shows that it's probably enchanted to fit properly.|It's a witch's hat, so it's probably magical in some way. It's stretchy when you tug on it, but it snaps back into place a moment later.] [party.solo|You place the hat aside|You hand the hat off] before picking up the next article of clothing. It looks like a little red cape, but the hood is small and ornamental, and it probably wouldn't do much more than cover your shoulders. There's a little golden clasp in the center of it, [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|that emanates soft magic as well, it might be some kind of focus|maybe it's magical too? At the very least it could go for a pretty penny]. It's warm at least, for as little of your shoulders as it might cover. The last pieces appear to be the same black leather as the hat; a curve-hugging, breast-pushing corset-thong combo, some arm-length gloves, and a pair of glistening heeled fuck-me boots. Altogether the outfit is definitely magical in some way. [silly|Let's face it, it's going to transform the fuck out of you if you put it on|It's not unlikely that it's going to have an effect on your body if you put it on]. But do you? It looks really nice."

rows.original: [silly|Duh, this will be awesome.|Let's find out.]
rows.translation: [silly|这肯定超棒的。|让我们来弄清楚吧。]
rows.raw: "[silly|Duh, this will be awesome.|Let's find out.]"

rows.original: It could be dangerous to wear, but you bet it sells for a pretty penny.
rows.translation: 虽然佩戴它可能会有一定的危险，但可以肯定的是，它的售价肯定相当高。
rows.raw: "It could be dangerous to wear, but you bet it sells for a pretty penny."

rows.original: [silly|Nice try, trapster. You're not falling for any traps.|Let's not take the risk.]
rows.translation: [silly|想得美，陷阱师。你根本不会中任何陷阱的圈套。|我们还是不要冒这个险吧。]
rows.raw: "[silly|Nice try, trapster. You're not falling for any traps.|Let's not take the risk.]"

rows.original:
As you pass through the underbrush, you come to a secluded glade some distance from the main path. A few beams of light break through the thicker canopy of the trees above. The area is filled with bushes covered in nothing but odd, striped berries. On closer inspection, the berries seem to be covered in a thin layer of fur. It's eerily quiet — the only sounds permeating the woods are those of a soft breeze jostling the leaves.

    There's nothing else of note. It'd be best to turn back or, perhaps, gather some berries.
rows.translation:
当你穿过灌木丛时，会来到一片远离主路的幽静小林。几缕轻型线从上方茂密的树冠中透了出来。这片区域里长满了长满各种奇形怪状、带有条纹的浆果的灌木。 仔细观察，那些浆果似乎覆盖着一层薄薄的绒毛。周围一片死寂——唯一能穿透树林的声音，只是微风轻拂树叶时发出的沙沙声。

除此之外，再没有什么值得注意的地方了。最好的选择或许是掉头回去，或者干脆摘一些浆果吧。
rows.raw:
"
    As you pass through the underbrush, you come to a secluded glade some distance from the main path. A few beams of light break through the thicker canopy of the trees above. The area is filled with bushes covered in nothing but odd, striped berries. On closer inspection, the berries seem to be covered in a thin layer of fur. It's eerily quiet — the only sounds permeating the woods are those of a soft breeze jostling the leaves.

    There's nothing else of note. It'd be best to turn back or, perhaps, gather some berries."

rows.original: You peruse the furry berries, eventually spotting a particularly ripe-looking clump and quickly breaking the stem from the rest of the bush before stowing them in your pouch. You acquired a cackle berry!
rows.translation: 你仔细观察那些毛茸茸的浆果，最终发现了一簇看起来特别成熟的浆果，迅速将它们的茎从灌木上折下，然后把它们装进自己的袋子里。 你获得了一颗咯咯莓！
rows.raw: " You peruse the furry berries, eventually spotting a particularly ripe-looking clump and quickly breaking the stem from the rest of the bush before stowing them in your pouch. You acquired a cackle berry!"

rows.original:
Ow! Sharp... you hadn't noticed the honey-scented flowers considering you're so close to the hornet hive, but you managed to brush against a small bushel of pale yellow florae with sharp thorns on them. [party.has azzy
        |"Hm? Oh! Yeah, those grow all around here, sometimes we turn it into honey tea, but it's much nicer to make our own honey these days." The hornet gestures at her own expansive cleavage with a grin.
    ]
    
    With a shrug you pluck them up; might be nice to make a drink out of them.
rows.translation:
哎哟！真扎人……你离黄蜂巢穴穴这么近，肯定没注意到那些散发着蜂蜜香味的花朵，结果还是不小心碰到了那一丛长着尖刺的淡黄色小花。 [party.has azzy
        |嗯？哦！对，这些植物就生长在这附近，有时候我们会把它们用来泡蜂蜜茶，不过现在自己采蜜制作蜂蜜，味道要好多了。”黄蜂一边笑着说，一边用手指着自己的胸脯示意。
    ]
    
    你耸了耸肩，把它们摘了下来；或许可以用它们来泡杯饮料吧。
rows.raw:
"
    Ow! Sharp... you hadn't noticed the honey-scented flowers considering you're so close to the hornet hive, but you managed to brush against a small bushel of pale yellow florae with sharp thorns on them. [party.has azzy
        |"Hm? Oh! Yeah, those grow all around here, sometimes we turn it into honey tea, but it's much nicer to make our own honey these days." The hornet gestures at her own expansive cleavage with a grin.
    ]
    
    With a shrug you pluck them up; might be nice to make a drink out of them.
    "

rows.original: Without warning, an overbearingly earthy aroma hits you in the nose like a sack of rocks, nearly stopping you in your tracks. A short glance around is all you need to spot the perpetrator: a small patch of soil, barren of all but a stalk of brown leaves jutting up from a round bulge that’s only just breaking the surface. Some wild vegetable, from the looks of it. If you can ignore the overpowering scent of dirt and metal, maybe you could find a use for it.
rows.translation: 毫无征兆地，一股浓烈得令人窒息的泥土气息扑面而来，简直就像一袋石头砸在脸上，让你差点停住脚步。只需环顾四周，就能找到罪魁祸首：那一小块土地上，除了一根从地面凸出的棕色叶子外，什么也没有。看样子，这应该是一种野生蔬菜。如果你能忽略那股浓重的泥土和金属气味，或许还能找到它的用途。
rows.raw: "\n    Without warning, an overbearingly earthy aroma hits you in the nose like a sack of rocks, nearly stopping you in your tracks. A short glance around is all you need to spot the perpetrator: a small patch of soil, barren of all but a stalk of brown leaves jutting up from a round bulge that’s only just breaking the surface. Some wild vegetable, from the looks of it. If you can ignore the overpowering scent of dirt and metal, maybe you could find a use for it."

rows.original: Pinching your nose, you give the base of the plant’s stem a firm yank, freeing it from the soil. A few rough shakes to get the clinging dirt off reveals it’s an onion, and a rather large one at that. Ripping the now useless stem from the bulb, you pocket it and continue on your way. You’ve obtained an Ursus Bulb.
rows.translation: 你捏住鼻子，用力一拉植株的茎部，将它从土壤中拔出来。再轻轻摇晃几下，把粘在上面的泥土抖掉，你会发现这其实是一个洋葱，而且还是个相当大的洋葱。 你把已经没用的茎部从洋葱头中拔掉，把它放进口袋里，然后继续前行。 你获得了一颗熊球。
rows.raw: " Pinching your nose, you give the base of the plant’s stem a firm yank, freeing it from the soil. A few rough shakes to get the clinging dirt off reveals it’s an onion, and a rather large one at that. Ripping the now useless stem from the bulb, you pocket it and continue on your way. You’ve obtained an Ursus Bulb."

rows.original:
Walking along the forest path, [party.som|you|you and your companion|you and your companions] spot a decent sized clump of blue headed flowers nestled in a small break in the trees. Approaching the spot, you realize you’ve come across some wild chicory. You could take some or leave the patch be.

    What would you like to do?
rows.translation:
沿着森林小路漫步， [party.som|你|你和你的同伴|你和你的同伴们] 你发现了一丛颜色鲜蓝、大小适中的花朵，它们生长在树林中的一处小空地上。当你走近那里时，你意识到自己找到了一些野生的菊苣。你可以摘一些带走，或者让它们继续生长在原地。

你会选择怎么做呢？
rows.raw:
"
    Walking along the forest path, [party.som|you|you and your companion|you and your companions] spot a decent sized clump of blue headed flowers nestled in a small break in the trees. Approaching the spot, you realize you’ve come across some wild chicory. You could take some or leave the patch be.

    What would you like to do?
    "

rows.original: Digging through the forage, you find a healthy chicory flower, ripe for picking. Tugging it out of the ground at the base, you uproot the plant from the forest floor. There’s still some dirt clinging to the roots of the plant, quickly dislodged as you give the chicory a few quick swipes. Placing the wild chicory in your bag, you continue on your way. You’ve obtained some Wild Chicory.
rows.translation: 在草丛中翻找时，你发现了一朵已经成熟、可以采摘的菊苣花。你从花基部将其拔出，整个植株便从森林的地面上被拔了起来。植物的根部还粘着一些泥土，但你快速地擦了几下，那些泥土便都被清理掉了。 将这朵野生的菊苣放进背包，你继续继续你的旅程。 你获得了一些野生菊苣。
rows.raw: " Digging through the forage, you find a healthy chicory flower, ripe for picking. Tugging it out of the ground at the base, you uproot the plant from the forest floor. There’s still some dirt clinging to the roots of the plant, quickly dislodged as you give the chicory a few quick swipes. Placing the wild chicory in your bag, you continue on your way. You’ve obtained some Wild Chicory. "

rows.original: Place your hand on her tree and call the playful dryad here.
rows.translation: 将你的手放在她的树上，呼唤这位顽皮的水精吧。
rows.raw: "Place your hand on her tree and call the playful dryad here."

rows.translation: 召唤格瑞恩的干树精灵姐妹杜伊伦。

rows.original: Place your hand on Orlaith's tree and call her.
rows.translation: 将你的手放在奥拉伊斯的树上，呼唤她的名字。
rows.raw: "Place your hand on Orlaith's tree and call her."

rows.original: To the east there's a dusty, foot-worn trail which'll bring you closer into the mountains. There, you'll find your quarry, the corrupted lupines. Once you begin the trek there'll be no going back until the job is done.
rows.translation: 向东有一条布满灰尘、被人们踩得发亮的小路，这条路会带你更深入山区。在那里，你就能找到你的目标——那些已经变质的狼毒花。一旦你开始这段旅程，就必须在完成任务之前不能回头。
rows.raw: "\n        To the east there's a dusty, foot-worn trail which'll bring you closer into the mountains. There, you'll find your quarry, the corrupted lupines. Once you begin the trek there'll be no going back until the job is done."

rows.original: Begin your trek to the corrupted mine.
rows.translation: 开始你前往那座已被破坏的矿井的旅程吧。
rows.raw: "Begin your trek to the corrupted mine."

rows.original: You should bring Arona along to confront this, since it's for her.
rows.translation: 你应该带上阿罗娜一起来面对这个问题，因为这关系到她。
rows.raw: "You should bring Arona along to confront this, since it's for her."

rows.original: It looks like Sanders' directions were spot on; hiding in the treeline is an old clearing, with the remains of a series of tent-poles... and perhaps a border-wall. No doubt this place has been picked clean, but plenty of evidence might have been buried by dirt. [party.som |You crouch down in what looks to be the middle of the camp, looking for anything that looks a little bit less densely-packed. |You and [companion1.name] spread out, looking for less densely-packed dirt. "What do you think we'll find?" [companion1.heShe] asks. "Not sure," you confess. |You and your companions fan out across the desiccated camp, hunting for any more loosely-packed dirt that might hint at belongings beneath. "Think we'll find anything?" [companion2.name] asks, frowning at the ground as [companion2.heShe] overturns a heavy-looking rock. "No idea..." ] One particular patch stands out... in fact it looks recently overturned. [party.has arona |Just as you're approaching, Arona wraps an arm around your shoulders and hauls you back. "Watch out!" The earth itself flips over in a mess of snarl and gnashing teeth, before some great shovel-headed beast clamps down on the space you were occupying only moments before. "Fuck, knew that looked similar: Sluasaid burrow. Those're Sailgrave creatures... you alright [arona.isDom |pet? |[pc.mf |master |mistress ]? ]" As the beast pulls itself to its full height, several more of the earth-turning monsters claw themselves free. "Someone must've brought a breeding pair with them in the old days... can't say I've ever known them to be this far west." |Its source becomes apparent at roughly the same time as great gnashing teeth wrap themselves around your leg and clamp down, earth exploding outwards as some shovel-headed beast tears itself free. With a snarl and a shake of its head you're wrenched onto your back, before being flung through the dirt into a heap. [party.som |Shaking the stars from your vision you try to regather yourself, clutching your throbbing leg. |[companion1.name] rushes to your side, [companion1.weapon] at the ready. |your companions rush to your sides, weapons at the ready. "Are you okay?" ] ] Weird... one of those monsters has what appears to be a giant metal bra stuck to its head. [silly |[pc.isBimbo |"Baaaa-byyyy shark doot-do-do-do-do-do," you begin to sing in your brightest and bubbliest voice. ] ]
rows.translation: 看来桑德斯的判断非常准确；藏在树林中的是一片旧空地，那里有一排帐篷杆的残骸……或许还有一道围墙。毫无疑问，这个地方已经被翻得一干二净，但很多证据可能被泥土掩盖住了。 [party.som |你蹲在营地的中央位置，试图寻找那些密度稍微低一些的区域。 |你和 [companion1.name] 他们分散开来，寻找那些密度较低的泥土。“你觉得我们会找到什么？ [companion1.heShe] 不太确定，”你承认道。 |你和你的同伴分散在干涸的营地中，寻找那些可能隐藏着物品的松散堆积的泥土。“你觉得我们会找到什么吗？ [companion2.name] 皱着眉头，低头问道…… [companion2.heShe] 搬动了一块看起来非常重型的石头。 “完全不知道…… ] 有一个特别的补丁格外引人注目……事实上，它看起来像是最近被撤销了。 [party.has arona |就在你即将靠近的时候，阿罗娜一把搂住你的肩膀，将你拉了回去。“小心！” 地面本身开始剧烈翻腾，各种扭曲的岩层和锋利的牙齿不断涌现，紧接着，一只拥有巨大铲状头部的怪物紧紧抓住了你刚才所在的位置。“该死，我就觉得那东西看起来很眼熟：那是塞拉斯德的洞穴生物……你没事吧？ [arona.isDom |宠物？ |[pc.mf |掌握 |女主人；情妇 ]? ]当这只巨兽完全站直身体时，还有几只能够搅动大地的怪物也从地面挣脱了出来。“肯定是在过去的某个时候，有人把一对这样的繁殖个体带到了这里……我以前从来没听说过它们会出现在这么西边的地方。 |就在这时，你才终于明白了事情的来龙去脉——一些长着巨大獠牙的怪物紧紧咬住了你的腿，将你牢牢固定住，而地面也在同一时刻剧烈震动，因为有一只头大如铁铲的野兽正在拼命挣扎着想要逃脱。 随着一声低吼，那些怪物猛地一甩头，将你甩到了背上，然后又把你扔进了泥泞之中，让你重重地摔在了一堆土里。 [party.som |星星仿佛从你的视线中消失，你努力稳住自己，同时紧紧抓住那条正在剧烈跳动的腿。 |[companion1.name] 迅速来到你身边， [companion1.weapon] 随时准备行动。 |你的同伴迅速赶到你身边，手中都握着武器。“你没事吧？ ] ] 奇怪……那些怪物中有一只的头上似乎粘着一件巨大的金属胸罩。 [silly |[pc.isBimbo |バババ——鲨鱼，嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟，”你用最明亮、最欢快的声音开始唱起来。 ] ]

rows.original:
You take a few moments to catch your breath and make sure no permanent harm's been done, before approaching to claim your prize; a giant metal bra.
    
    It's hard to say what kind of clues you expected to find in this camp, but after turning it over for another half hour? Looks like you're walking away with just a bra, and a fistful of coins.
rows.translation:
你花了几分钟时间喘口气，确认自己没有受到任何永久性的伤害，然后才去领取你的奖品——一个巨大的金属胸罩。

其实很难说你原本期望在这个营地找到什么线索，但经过又半个小时的搜寻后？看来你最终得到的只有一个胸罩和一把硬币而已。
rows.raw:
"
    You take a few moments to catch your breath and make sure no permanent harm's been done, before approaching to claim your prize; a giant metal bra.
    
    It's hard to say what kind of clues you expected to find in this camp, but after turning it over for another half hour? Looks like you're walking away with just a bra, and a fistful of coins.
    "

rows.original:
Okay, these creatures are no fucking joke. With one last grunt of effort you snatch the metal bra off of the biting monster's head and stagger back, [party.som|biting down the taste of copper and sprinting out of the camp.|checking only momentarily that [comp1.name] is with you before you limp away.|gathering together your companions before the three of you limp away.]

    It looks like the only clue you're leaving with is this, and hopefully it'll be enough.
rows.translation:
好吧，这些生物绝对不是什么好惹的东西。你使出最后一点力气，从那只咬人的怪物头上扯下了那个金属胸罩，然后踉跄着后退了几步。 [party.som|忍住口中铜金属般的苦涩，冲出了营地。|只是短暂地检查一下而已。 [comp1.name] 在你一瘸一拐地离开之前，它依然与你同在。|你们三个人一起召集同伴，然后一瘸一拐地离开。]

    看来你留下的唯一线索就是这个了，希望它足够有用。
rows.raw:
"
    Okay, these creatures are no fucking joke. With one last grunt of effort you snatch the metal bra off of the biting monster's head and stagger back, [party.som|biting down the taste of copper and sprinting out of the camp.|checking only momentarily that [comp1.name] is with you before you limp away.|gathering together your companions before the three of you limp away.]

    It looks like the only clue you're leaving with is this, and hopefully it'll be enough.
    "

rows.original: [dayNight |You wait and wait, until night begins to fall on the forest. |An hour of waiting passes in the dark of night. ] For most of the duration, there's a sense of tense calm like the air before a storm. Then, a rustling of leaves draws [party.yall] from serenity to immediate combat readiness. You turn towards the sound and see a shadow looming from the forest. One that immediately prompts a loud, "FUCK," from your orcish companion. "N-not again. Oh shitfucking pantycock come ON!" Arona growls as the brush parts, and the darkness takes shape. It's a wolf! No — not quite just a wolf, for it is far too large and covered in inky tendrils of night to be a mere beast of the forest. This creature's eyes are like bloodstones, bright as coals and full of malevolence, and its jagged fangs slaver with ghastly slobber. The thing's semi-translucent, like a shadow of a shadow. Another specter, haunting this world, the hungering spirit of a dire wolf. "Why's it always ghosts!?" [arona.isDom |She raises her [arona.weapon] in a mix of trepidation and rage. "Fuck it. I'm going to kill it. And I'm going to make sure this bastard stays dead." |Seeing her trepidation, you place a comforting [pc.hand] on the orcess' shoulder. [pc.dcbc |"Get in there! Send that thing back to the grave!" |"You can do this, Arona." |"You've got this!" |[silly |"The situation may be dire, but we can handle it." |"Hey, if we've learned anything from our previous experience with them, it's that ghosts can be dispersed. It may be hard, but we can do it. You can do it." ] ] ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: [dayNight |你一直等待着，直到夜幕开始降临在森林上。 |在夜色中，人们等待了一个小时。 ] 在大部分时间里，现场都弥漫着一种紧张而宁静的氛围，就像暴风雨来临前的空气一样。然后，一阵树叶的沙沙声打破了这种宁静…… [party.yall] 从宁静的状态瞬间转变为战斗准备状态。你顺着声音的方向望去，只见一道阴影从森林中缓缓浮现…… 那道阴影立刻让你的兽人同伴发出一声惊恐的叫喊：“该死！” “不……又来这种事。哦，该死的混蛋，快住手吧！当灌木丛被拨开时，阿罗娜发出了低吼，暗影中逐渐显现出一个身影——那是一只狼！不，不仅仅是一只狼，它的体型实在太大了，身上还覆盖着那些漆黑的夜之触须，显然不是一只普通的森林野兽。这只生物的眼睛如同血石般明亮，散发着炽烈的光芒，其中充满了恶意；而它那参差不齐的獠牙上，则挂着令人毛骨悚然的唾液。 这种东西呈半透明状，就像阴影中的阴影。又一个萦绕在这个世界上的幽灵——一只饥饿的恶狼之灵。 “为什么它总是…… 鬼魂!?" [arona.isDom |她抬起了手。 [arona.weapon] 我既紧张又愤怒，心想：“去他的吧。我一定要把它弄死，而且一定要让这个混蛋永远活不下来。 |看到她显得如此忐忑不安，你便安慰道： [pc.hand] 站在奥瑞斯的肩膀上。 [pc.dcbc |进去把那东西赶回坟墓里去！ |你一定能做到的，阿罗娜。 |你一定能做到的！ |[silly |情况可能会…… 糟糕的不过我们能够处理这个问题。 |嘿，如果说我们从之前的经历中学到了什么的话，那就是鬼魂是可以被驱散的。虽然这可能会很困难，但我们一定能做到。 你 一定能做到。 ] ] ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original:
With a final lunge, the spectre brings one of its paws to bear...

    And then everything is blackness as you join it in death.
rows.translation:
随着最后一次猛扑，那个幽灵用它的爪子击中了目标……

随后，一切陷入黑暗，你也随之陷入了死亡。
rows.raw:
"
    With a final lunge, the spectre brings one of its paws to bear...

    And then everything is blackness as you join it in death.
    "

[arona.hpRange 50
        |With a triumphant roar, the [arona.hpRange 100
            |
            |nearly-
        ]unharmed orc raises her [arona.weapon] into the air.
        |Despite her injuries, Arona hefts her [arona.weapon] into the air in pained triumph.
    ] "We fucking did it," she [arona.hpRange 50
        |cheers
        |says through clenched teeth
    ]. 
    
    Before you can speak, your attention is drawn away to the spot where you defeated your ghastly foe. A ball of ethereal light forms where it fell, filling the dark glade with a pale blue glow. It rises into the air and begins drifting away, into the blackness of the forest proper.
    
    Something about it calls to you. [party.som
        |
        |Both of you.
        |All of you.
    ] [party.som
        |
        |The two of you follow
        |Your party follows
    ] it below the ancient tree above you and into the hollow at its roots, until it slowly sinks down and reveals to you the very thing you were sent for: its corpse.
    
    The body of a once-great dire wolf, preserved by both the cold and the restlessness of its spirit. Its side bears the mark of the wound that slew it originally: a deep gash caused by a weapon of immense weight and power. All the flesh around the injury is darkened, as if left behind by an unnatural blight. It's not unlikely that whatever killed this is also the very reason the wolf still haunted the forest.
    
    "Well, I guess that's what Viv wanted us to get." Arona hoists the thing onto her shoulder, clearly ready to get away from the haunted hollow.

[arona.hpRange 50
        |随着一声胜利的咆哮，那个…… [arona.hpRange 100
            |

        ]未受伤害的兽人将她扶了起来。 [arona.weapon] 飞向空中。
        |尽管受了伤，阿罗娜还是勉强站了起来。 [arona.weapon] 伴随着痛苦的欢呼声，它飞向了空中。
    ] 我们他妈的做到了，”她说道。 [arona.hpRange 50
        |干杯！
        |咬牙切齿地说
    ]还没等你开口说话，你的注意力就被吸引到了你击败那个可怕敌人的地方。在那处地方，一团纯净的轻型芒形成了，它将这片幽暗的林间空地照得通亮，那淡蓝色的轻型芒在空气中缓缓上升，然后开始向森林的深处飘去。

某种无形的力量，正在吸引着你前往那里。 [party.som
        |
        |你们两个。
        |你们所有人。
    ] [party.som
        |
        |你们两个跟上来吧。
        |你的队伍紧随其后。
    ] 它从你头顶上那棵古树下方钻入树根的凹陷处，慢慢地沉了下去，最终露出了你此行所要寻找的东西：它的尸体。

那是一只曾经无比强大的凶狼的尸体，寒冷的环境以及它那不安的灵魂共同使它得以保存下来。 它的侧面留有那道致其死亡伤痕的痕迹：一道由极其沉重且威力巨大的武器造成的深深伤口。伤口周围的肉组织都变成了暗色，仿佛被某种非自然的腐蚀力量侵蚀了一般。很有可能，杀死这只狼的凶手，也正是它至今仍在森林中游荡的原因。
    
    嗯，我想这正是Viv希望我们得到的东西。”阿罗娜把那个东西扛在肩上，显然准备立刻离开这个阴森森的空地。

rows.original:
As [party.combatNames] wander through the woods, you're met with a faint noise.

        It sounds distant and guttural, like whatever is making it is struggling... or angry. You barely get any time to focus on that, though, because the sounds are getting closer, worryingly so. 
        
        So you halt [party.isJustPC|yourself|your party] for a moment to focus on the noise, hearing it echo off trees, sounding like its coming from all around until it starts to near, and you can face its true source: wolves.
        
        A pack of the mangy, gray-furred beasts appears from the woods in front of [party.ya'll], barking and howling together, snarling as they charge onward beyond the forest edge and towards [party.isJustPC|you|your party]. The aggressive animals aren't slowing down by any means, and there's nothing but fight and feral need in their cold, canid eyes. 
        
        [party.som|You ready yourself as what looks to be three of the agile beasts close in on you, prepared to fight for your life!|[comp.name] readies [comp.himselfHerself] for what promises to be a bloody fight, and you do the same.|[party.compNames] ready themselves for what promises to be a bloody fight, and you do the same.]
rows.translation:
正如……所言 [party.combatNames] 在树林中漫步时，你突然听到一阵微弱的声音。那声音听起来很遥远，而且听起来像是某种生物在艰难地发出声音……或者说，它在愤怒地叫喊。然而，你几乎没有时间去仔细思考这些，因为那些声音正在逐渐靠近，而且速度越来越快，令人感到十分担忧。

于是，你停下了脚步。 [party.isJustPC|你自己|你的团队] 有那么一刻，你需要集中注意力去聆听那声响——它在树林间回荡，仿佛来自四面八方，直到那声音逐渐逼近，你才能找到它的真正来源：狼群。

一群毛发灰暗、浑身脏兮兮的狼从树林中出现了，出现在…… [party.ya'll]它们一起吠叫、嚎叫，咆哮着冲出森林边缘，朝着前方跑去…… [party.isJustPC|你|你的团队]这些具有攻击性的动物丝毫没有放缓速度，它们那冰冷而充满野性的眼神中，只有战斗的欲望与本能。 
        
        [party.som|准备好吧，因为看起来有三只敏捷的野兽正在向你逼近，它们准备与你决一死战！|[comp.name] 准备就绪 [comp.himselfHerself] 对于这场注定会异常激烈的战斗，你们也应该做出同样的准备。|[party.compNames] 他们做好了迎接一场血腥战斗的准备，你也是如此。]

The aggressive animals aren't slowing down by any means, and there's nothing but fight and feral need in their cold, canid eyes. 
        
        [party.som|You ready yourself as what looks to be three of the agile beasts close in on you, prepared to fight for your life!|[comp.name] readies [comp.himselfHerself] for what promises to be a bloody fight, and you do the same.|[party.compNames] ready themselves for what promises to be a bloody fight, and you do the same.]"

rows.original: You're fighting a pack of feral wolves. Each one of them seems more mangy and beat-up than the last, with patches of missing fur, dirt caking their manes, and old scars and wounds covering their bodies. They circle [party.isJustPC|you|your party] as they snarl and gnash their teeth, foaming at the mouth and seeming as hungry and desperate as any animal. Armed with nothing but their gods-given defenses and weapons, they're more than capable of biting, clawing, and tackling wayward travelers like you into submission. No doubt these beasts have blood on their minds.
rows.translation: 你正在与一群野狼搏斗。每一只狼看起来都比上一只更加肮脏、破败不堪：它们的毛发零落不堪，鬃毛上积满了污垢，身上也布满了陈旧的伤痕。这些野狼正在围着你转圈，伺机发动攻击。 [party.isJustPC|你|你的团队] 当它们咆哮着、咬牙切齿，口吐白沫，显得无比饥饿且绝望时，它们与任何野兽并无二致。这些生物仅凭上天赋予它们的防御能力与武器，就完全有能力咬伤、抓伤那些像你这样的迷路旅人，迫使他们屈服。毫无疑问，这些野兽心中只想着鲜血与杀戮。
rows.raw: "\n        You're fighting a pack of feral wolves. Each one of them seems more mangy and beat-up than the last, with patches of missing fur, dirt caking their manes, and old scars and wounds covering their bodies. They circle [party.isJustPC|you|your party] as they snarl and gnash their teeth, foaming at the mouth and seeming as hungry and desperate as any animal. Armed with nothing but their gods-given defenses and weapons, they're more than capable of biting, clawing, and tackling wayward travelers like you into submission. No doubt these beasts have blood on their minds."

rows.original: With [party.ya'll] knocked out of the fight, you fall to the ground as the wolves circle you. You're on the brink of losing consciousness when you see the beasts darting for your bags and supplies, tearing cloth and leather to get at your things.
rows.translation: 借助…… [party.ya'll] 你被击倒在地，狼群开始在你周围盘旋。就在你即将失去意识的时候，你看到那些野兽冲向你的背包和补给品，它们撕扯着布料和皮革，试图抢走你的东西。
rows.raw:
"
        With [party.ya'll] knocked out of the fight, you fall to the ground as the wolves circle you. You're on the brink of losing consciousness when you see the beasts darting for your bags and supplies, tearing cloth and leather to get at your things. 

        "

rows.original:
Before too long, one of the wild mutts starts to break off, barking at its two compatriots before it begins to run off, and the wolf's packmates quickly follow, darting back off into the woods in the blink of an eye.
        
        Well, that's quite the kick to your ego, not even good enough for wolves to eat.
         
        Once you're sure the coast is clear, you muster all your strength to bring yourself upright, taking a deep breath before [party.hasCompanions|checking on your companion[party.manyCompanions|s] and making sure they're in good enough health to move, then go to inspect and gather your supplies|gathering your wolf-ravaged supplies].
        
        After all that, all there is to do is plan your next move.
rows.translation:
没过多久，其中一只野狼开始脱离队伍，对着它的两只同伴吠叫了几声，然后便跑开了，其他的狼群成员也迅速跟了上去，转眼间就消失在了树林中。

唉，这可真是让你的自尊心受到不小的打击啊——连狼都不愿意吃这样的东西。

等到你确定周围没有危险后，便使出全部力气站直身体，深吸一口气，然后…… [party.hasCompanions|去看看你的同伴吧。[party.manyCompanions|s] 确保它们的健康状况良好，足以进行移动，然后去检查并收集所需的物资。|收拾那些被狼群破坏过的物资]经历了这一切之后，接下来要做的就是规划你的下一步行动。
rows.raw:
"  
        
        Before too long, one of the wild mutts starts to break off, barking at its two compatriots before it begins to run off, and the wolf's packmates quickly follow, darting back off into the woods in the blink of an eye.
        
        Well, that's quite the kick to your ego, not even good enough for wolves to eat.
         
        Once you're sure the coast is clear, you muster all your strength to bring yourself upright, taking a deep breath before [party.hasCompanions|checking on your companion[party.manyCompanions|s] and making sure they're in good enough health to move, then go to inspect and gather your supplies|gathering your wolf-ravaged supplies].
        
        After all that, all there is to do is plan your next move."

rows.original: The wolves quickly find your stores of food and camping gear, taking and eating what they can, [silly|wolfing down|savaging] your stores until they seem satisfied with what they've gotten.
rows.translation: 狼群很快找到了你储存的食物和露营装备，它们拿走了能拿到的东西，并把它们吃掉了。 [silly|狼吞虎咽地吃|猛烈攻击] 让你的顾客持续购买你的产品，直到他们对所获得的东西感到满意为止。
rows.raw: "The wolves quickly find your stores of food and camping gear, taking and eating what they can, [silly|wolfing down|savaging] your stores until they seem satisfied with what they've gotten."

rows.original: It seems they can't find what they're looking for, with no food to be found in your stores, resulting in angry barks and snarls amongst the small pack, along with a few hungry whimpers.
rows.translation: 看来它们找不到想要的东西，因为你们的商店里根本没有食物，于是那小群动物们发出了愤怒的吠叫和咆哮，同时还伴随着几声饥饿的呜咽声。
rows.raw: "It seems they can't find what they're looking for, with no food to be found in your stores, resulting in angry barks and snarls amongst the small pack, along with a few hungry whimpers."

rows.original:
Knocking the resolve out of the last of the pack, the beasts stumble back, whimpering and licking their wounds. One of the mangy mutts barks at the other two before beating a hasty retreat back towards the woods, and its packmates are quick to follow, glancing back at their betters one last time before heading back between the trees, their pitiful cries distancing. 

        [party.isJustPC|You take|Your party takes] a short moment to cheer your victory as the beasts scamper off with their tails between their legs before collecting
        [party.isJustPC|yourself|yourselves].
        
        After all that, all there is to do is plan your next move.
rows.translation:
那些残余的野兽们早已失去了斗志，它们跌跌撞撞地后退着，发出呜咽声，还不时舔着身上的伤口。其中一只浑身脏兮兮的杂种狗对着另外两只吠叫了几声，然后便匆忙逃回了树林里，它的同伴们也迅速跟了上去。在消失在树林之中之前，它们最后还回头看了一眼那些“更强大的同类”，随后那些凄厉的叫声便逐渐远去了。 

        [party.isJustPC|你来负责吧。|你的队伍负责……] 就在大家准备庆祝胜利的瞬间，那些野兽却夹着尾巴逃跑了……
        [party.isJustPC|你自己|你们自己]经历了这一切之后，接下来要做的就是制定下一步的计划。
rows.raw:
"
        Knocking the resolve out of the last of the pack, the beasts stumble back, whimpering and licking their wounds. One of the mangy mutts barks at the other two before beating a hasty retreat back towards the woods, and its packmates are quick to follow, glancing back at their betters one last time before heading back between the trees, their pitiful cries distancing. 

        [party.isJustPC|You take|Your party takes] a short moment to cheer your victory as the beasts scamper off with their tails between their legs before collecting
        [party.isJustPC|yourself|yourselves].
        
        After all that, all there is to do is plan your next move."

rows.original: Take a closer look at the witch.
rows.raw: "Take a closer look at the witch."

rows.translation: 向女巫提出一些问题吧。

rows.original: [atCamp|Make something magical in your tent.|[viviane.fucked|Take your usual trip upstairs with [flags.VIV_DATE|your witchy lover|the busty witch].|Take her up on that offer of a "trip upstairs."]]
rows.translation: [atCamp|在你的帐篷里创造一些神奇的东西吧。|[viviane.fucked|像往常一样，走上楼去吧。 [flags.VIV_DATE|你那位充满魔力的恋人|那个胸部丰满的女巫].|接受她提出的“去楼上走走”的邀请吧。]]
rows.raw: '[atCamp|Make something magical in your tent.|[viviane.fucked|Take your usual trip upstairs with [flags.VIV_DATE|your witchy lover|the busty witch].|Take her up on that offer of a "trip upstairs."]]'

rows.original: Take her up on that offer of a %"trip upstairs."
rows.translation: 接受她提出的“去楼上走走”的邀请吧。
rows.raw: 'Take her up on that offer of a %"trip upstairs."'

rows.original: You think Cait would look really good in an outfit like [flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|the one you found in the forest|Viviane's]. Does the witch have any spares?
rows.translation: 你认为凯特穿上这样的服装一定会非常漂亮吧？ [flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|你在森林里找到的那个。|薇薇安的]那个女巫还有备用的东西吗？
rows.raw: "You think Cait would look really good in an outfit like [flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|the one you found in the forest|Viviane's]. Does the witch have any spares?"

rows.original: You need Cait here so she can try on the outfits!
rows.translation: 这里需要凯特，这样她就可以试穿这些衣服了！
rows.raw: "You need Cait here so she can try on the outfits!"

rows.original: See if Viviane can help you upgrade your wayfort.
rows.translation: 看看薇薇安是否能帮你升级你的传送装置。
rows.raw: "See if Viviane can help you upgrade your wayfort."

rows.original: Ask Viv about a way to protect the Wayfort's dungeons from spellcasters.
rows.translation: 向薇芙请教一下，有什么办法可以保护荒废驿堡的地牢，防止施法者入侵。
rows.raw: "Ask Viv about a way to protect the Wayfort's dungeons from spellcasters."

rows.original: Ask Viviane to make a heating rune for the dragon's bath. This will cost you 125 EC!
rows.translation: 请让薇薇安为龙的浴池制作一个加热符文。这将会花费你125枚EC！
rows.raw: "Ask Viviane to make a heating rune for the dragon's bath. This will cost you 125 EC!"

rows.original: Maybe Viv could make some sense out of this bloody bauble you brought back from Dracia?
rows.translation: 也许薇芙能够弄清楚你从德拉西亚带回来的这个该死的玩意儿到底是什么吧？
rows.raw: "Maybe Viv could make some sense out of this bloody bauble you brought back from Dracia?"

rows.original: Turn in the cinderleaf Viv wanted to try hybridizing in her new enchanted pot.
rows.translation: 把那片烬叶交上来吧，Viv想用她的新魔法锅尝试进行杂交实验。
rows.raw: "Turn in the cinderleaf Viv wanted to try hybridizing in her new enchanted pot."

rows.original: cinderleaf, and you need at least 9 of them.
rows.translation: 炭叶草，而且你至少需要9株这样的植物。
rows.raw: " cinderleaf, and you need at least 9 of them."

rows.original: The gnarled ashen leaves were definitely cinderleaves once upon a time. Maybe they'll combine with the blood gem anyway?
rows.translation: 那些扭曲的灰白色叶子，想必在很久以前也曾是美丽的红叶。或许它们最终还是会与那颗血色宝石结合在一起吧？
rows.raw: "The gnarled ashen leaves were definitely cinderleaves once upon a time. Maybe they'll combine with the blood gem anyway?"

rows.translation: 把魅魔之乳拿给薇薇安看。
把魅魔之乳拿给薇薇安看。

rows.original: [viv.recruited|Ask Viv to Rejoin your party|Take Viviane up on her offer].
rows.translation: [viv.recruited|邀请Viv重新加入你的队伍。|接受薇薇安的邀请吧。].
rows.raw: "[viv.recruited|Ask Viv to Rejoin your party|Take Viviane up on her offer]."

rows.translation: 去问问薇薇安关于她自己的事情吧。

rows.original: What's the deal with the witch outfit you found?
rows.translation: 你找到的那套女巫服装到底是怎么回事？
rows.raw: "What's the deal with the witch outfit you found?"

rows.original: You'd like to hear more about the magic she knows.
rows.translation: 你一定想了解更多关于她所掌握的魔法的细节。
rows.raw: "You'd like to hear more about the magic she knows."

rows.original: You need to know more about her before you can ask about her magic.
rows.translation: 在询问她的魔法能力之前，你首先需要更深入地了解她。
rows.raw: "You need to know more about her before you can ask about her magic."

rows.original: How exactly does one enchant an item? She told you a little, but you'd like to hear more.
rows.translation: 究竟该如何给一件物品施加魔法呢？她已经跟你讲过一些，但你还想了解更多。
rows.raw: "How exactly does one enchant an item? She told you a little, but you'd like to hear more."

rows.original: How was she able to enter your dreams? She didn't mention that in the list of things she can do with magic.
rows.translation: 她究竟是怎么进入你的梦中的？在那些她能用魔法做到的事情清单里，她可没有提到这一点。
rows.raw: "How was she able to enter your dreams? She didn't mention that in the list of things she can do with magic."

rows.original: How does she feel about your fellows?
rows.translation: 她对你们的同事们有什么看法？
rows.raw: "How does she feel about your fellows?"

rows.original: So, how does she feel about her transformation?
rows.translation: 那么，她对自己所经历的这种变化有什么感受呢？
rows.raw: "So, how does she feel about her transformation?"

rows.original: [viv.isDemon|So, how does Viv feel about transforming now that she's a demon?|What did Viv mean when she talked before about being more "malleable?"]
rows.translation: [viv.isDemon|那么，现在变成了恶魔的Viv，她对自己这种变化有什么感受呢？|薇芙之前说的“更具可塑性”是什么意思呢？]
rows.raw: '[viv.isDemon|So, how does Viv feel about transforming now that she\'s a demon?|What did Viv mean when she talked before about being more "malleable?"]'

rows.original: How does she feel about the other witches you've met on your journey so far?
rows.translation: 对于你在这段旅程中遇到的其他女巫，她有什么看法呢？
rows.raw: "How does she feel about the other witches you've met on your journey so far?"

rows.raw: "Invalid attempt to destructure non-iterable instance.\nIn order to be iterable, non-array objects must have a [Symbol.iterator]() method."

rows.original:
You're journeying through the forest [party.som||with [comp.name]|with your companions] when you hear a familiar rustling of leaves, with a related creaking sound following soon after. Before long, you're greeted by the sight of Viviane's walking house, the roots it uses as legs shambling along the ground towards you.

        The house finally clears the last trees between you and it and takes the opportunity to settle, providing the chance for its occupant to exit. Viviane opens the door, [dayNight|brightening the shadowed woods with a stream of light|letting out a stream of light into the dark forest]. "Greetings. If it isn't my favorite [party.som|[pc.title]|duo of adventurers|band of heroes]. [var0|I've gotten the chance to make a few stops since we last saw one another and have been able to restock my alchemy supplies, should you wish to buy some odds and ends. I also have some special projects I've either worked on or found during my travels, if those are more your speed." So, with that in mind, w|W]ill you be gracing this home of mine with your presence?"
        
        Will you?
rows.translation:
你正在森林中穿行。 [party.som||与……一起 [comp.name]|和你的朋友们一起] 当你听到一阵熟悉的树叶沙沙声，紧接着便是那熟悉的吱嘎声时，不久之后，你便看到了薇薇安的移动房屋——它用那些被当作“腿”的根部在地面缓缓地向你移动而来。

终于，那房屋穿过了你与它之间的最后一排树木，然后停了下来，让居住在其中的人有机会出来。薇薇安打开了门…… [dayNight|用一缕光芒照亮那些阴暗的树林|在幽暗的森林中释放出一道光芒]问候语。如果这不是我最喜欢的…… [party.som|[pc.title]|两位冒险者|英雄战队]. [var0|自从我们上次见面之后，我有机会去了几个地方，也因此补充了一些炼金所需的材料。如果你有兴趣的话，也可以买一些零碎的小东西。此外，我还有一些特别的项目，要么是我自己参与的，要么是在旅途中发现的，如果你对这些更感兴趣的话……所以，考虑到这些，我……|W]您愿意轻型临我的家吗？”

“您会来吗？

"
        You're journeying through the forest [party.som||with [comp.name]|with your companions] when you hear a familiar rustling of leaves, with a related creaking sound following soon after. Before long, you're greeted by the sight of Viviane's walking house, the roots it uses as legs shambling along the ground towards you.

        The house finally clears the last trees between you and it and takes the opportunity to settle, providing the chance for its occupant to exit. Viviane opens the door, [dayNight|brightening the shadowed woods with a stream of light|letting out a stream of light into the dark forest]. "Greetings. If it isn't my favorite [party.som|[pc.title]|duo of adventurers|band of heroes]. [var0|I've gotten the chance to make a few stops since we last saw one another and have been able to restock my alchemy supplies, should you wish to buy some odds and ends. I also have some special projects I've either worked on or found during my travels, if those are more your speed." So, with that in mind, w|W]ill you be gracing this home of mine with your presence?"

rows.original: Take the witch up on her offer.
rows.raw: "Take the witch up on her offer."

rows.original: As [party.yall] travel through the ominous[dayNight||ly-dark] forest, [pc.hasEmoteEars|your ears twitch and ]your thoughts are suddenly interrupted by the rustling of leaves. At first, it is only faint, barely noticeable over the natural rustling caused by light breezes or birds. But it grows both in volume and proximity. Soon, another sound joins the rustling: a creaking, as if dozens of floorboards were being tread upon at once. [party.som|You|Both you and [comp.name]|You and your companions] draw your weapon[party.solo|[pc.isDualWielding|s]|s] and turn to face the crescendoing sounds. While it's hard to make out much of anything with only the [dayNight|godrays|moonbeams] that manage to slip through the dense foliage, [pc.hasSlittedEyes|you're able to make out the vaguest shape coming towards you, and it is large.|[party.has cait|Cait, with a gulp, says, "Umm... [pc.name], [silly|by the pricking of my thumbs, something wicked this way comes.|I think I can make out the faintest outline of what's coming towards us. And it's big.]"|you're able to get some sense of the scale of the thing as it comes closer, at which point its forward progress is marked with the addition of rumbling amongst the nearby trees.]] The creaking and rustling continue as their source continues to approach, and before long, you're able to finally make out its shape: that of a house. This apparently-moving house lumbers ever towards you, carried forth on what appear to be six massive tree roots that all connect back to the base of the house, as if part of the very foundations. Even as the %"legs" of the house lift and fall, the structure they bear stays perfectly steady, evidently keeping whatever is inside comfortable and minimizing shifting. At first, you're baffled as to how such a cumbersome entity manages to traverse the dense forest, but as it shambles closer, you're able to see that trees in the house's path bend out of the way, only to move back into place once the roaming home has passed. After what feels like an eternity, the house passes a copse of trees incredibly close, and [party.yall] raise your weapon[party.solo|[pc.isDualWielding|s]|s], ready to react to the slightest sign of hostility. Instead, the wayward home creeps a few feet further forward before the roots suddenly stop and begin to let the structure they carry lower, until the shoddy porch and stairs are able to touch the ground. Practically as soon as the house is steady, the door swings open, and out steps a very obviously feminine figure.
rows.translation: 正如……所言 [party.yall] 穿越那些充满不祥气息的地方……[dayNight||ly-dark] 森林， [pc.hasEmoteEars|你的耳朵不由自主地抽动起来…… ]你的思绪突然被树叶的沙沙声打断了。起初，这种声音很微弱，几乎无法与微风或鸟儿引发的自然沙沙声区分开来。但很快，这种声音的音量越来越大，距离也越来越近。不久之后，另一种声音也加入了这种沙沙声之中——那是一种吱嘎声，仿佛有几十块地板板同时被踩在足部下一样。 [party.som|你|你和……都一样。 [comp.name]|你和你的同伴] 拔出你的武器[party.solo|[pc.isDualWielding|s]|s] 然后转身，面对那些逐渐强烈的声音。不过，仅凭这些声音，其实很难分辨出其中的具体含义…… [dayNight|光环效果|月光] 那些能够穿过茂密枝叶的东西， [pc.hasSlittedEyes|你能够隐约辨认出有某个模糊的形状正在朝你靠近，而那个形状就是…… 大的。|[party.has cait|凯特咽了口唾沫，说道：“嗯…… [pc.name], [silly|根据我的直觉，有不好的事情要发生了。|我觉得我能够隐约辨认出那正在朝我们靠近的东西的轮廓了……而且，它…… 很大。]"|当它逐渐靠近时，你就能感受到这件事的规模有多大；而当它继续向前移动时，附近的树木开始发出隆隆的声响，这标志着它的前进进程正在继续。]] 随着那个发出吱嘎声和沙沙声的物体不断靠近，你终于能够辨认出它的形状：那是一栋房子。 这座似乎在移动的房子，是由六根巨大的树根支撑着缓缓向你靠近的，这些树根全都连接在房子的基座上，仿佛它们本身就是房子的基础部分。 尽管这座“房子”的“腿”在上下晃动，但它所支撑的结构却依然十分稳固，显然这样的设计能够确保内部物品的安全，同时将移动带来的影响降到最低。起初，你会对这样一个笨重的物体是如何在茂密的森林中移动的感到困惑，但当它摇摇晃晃地靠近你时，你就会发现——那些位于它行进路径上的树木…… 弯曲 把它挪到一边，等那辆游荡的房屋经过后，再把它放回原来的位置。 在仿佛过了漫长的时间之后，那栋房子终于极其接近地从一片小树林旁驶过了…… [party.yall] 拔出你的武器[party.solo|[pc.isDualWielding|s]|s]它随时准备对任何敌意信号做出反应。然而，这座倔强的房子却先向前爬行了几英尺，然后它的根部突然停止了移动，让整个结构慢慢下降，直到那破旧的门廊和楼梯能够触到地面。几乎就在房子稳定下来的瞬间，门就被推开了，一个明显属于女性的身影走了出来。

rows.original: You recognize the figure the moment a stray ray of [dayNight|sun|moon]light shines upon the crimson locks that fall from beneath her [flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|ominously familiar hat. [pc.itemIsEquipped WitchsHat|That hat is identical to the very one you're wearing!|That hat is identical to the one [pc.hasItem WitchsHat|in your pack|you found with the rest of that outfit in the forest]!]|impressive hat.] The witch struts forth, off of her deck, down the creaking stairs, and onto the forest floor. "Greetings, [rand|travelers|adventurers]! [pc.itemIsEquipped WitchsHat|I see you're the ones who found one of my old outfits.|[pc.itemIsEquipped WitchsCorset|I see you're the ones who found one of my old outfits. I must say, that corset really suits you. [pc.cupRange G|Though it seems like you hardly needed the little gift that came with it.]|It's not every day I see [a] [pc.ra human|fellow human|[pc.race]] around here.]] What brings [party.som|[a] [pc.mascFem|handsome [pc.manWoman]|pretty [pc.boyGirl]] like yourself|[var0|a pair of [var1]|a ragtag duo] like yourselves|a ragtag bunch like yourselves] to these woods?" [QUEST_IN_HER_FOOTSTEPS.stateRange 0 1 3|You inform her that you're pursuing a demon who was last seen heading to the north of here, flying over the very forest.|You tell her that you're after the %"Mother Alraune" who seems to be the source of all the wandering plant girls.|You state that you're in pursuit of a powerful demoness who intends to corrupt the land.] "Oh my, that sounds like quite the task. Well, I am Viviane, witch and enchantress, and this," she gestures to the house behind her, "is my humble abode. What might your name[party.solo||s] be?" You give your name[party.solo|| and the name[party.manyCompanions|s] of your companion[party.manyCompanions|s]] with [a] [pc.dcb|sneer|bow|giggle]. "Well, I'm afraid I can't give you much in the way of assistance on your journey, but it's been a while since I've had guests, what with all that's been going on with the hornets and those plant girls since the snowstorm. I'd be happy to show you some hospitality, maybe even let you live out your dreams," she says with a wink.
rows.translation: 当一缕轻型线偶然照射到那个身影上时，你立刻认出了他/她。 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]轻型芒洒在她那垂落在身旁的深红色长发上 [flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|那顶看起来如此熟悉的帽子…… [pc.itemIsEquipped WitchsHat|那顶帽子和你现在戴的那一顶一模一样！|那顶帽子和那一顶一模一样。 [pc.hasItem WitchsHat|随你携带|你在森林里找到了那套服装的其余部分。]!]|一顶非常不错的帽子。] 女巫大步走出甲板，沿着吱嘎作响的楼梯走下来，来到了森林的地面上。 “问候大家…… [rand|旅行者们|冒险者们]! [pc.itemIsEquipped WitchsHat|我看就是你们找到了我的那些旧服装。|[pc.itemIsEquipped WitchsCorset|我看就是你们找到了我的那套旧服装。不得不说，那件束腰衣真的很适合你。 [pc.cupRange G|虽然看起来你几乎并不需要它附带的小礼物。]|这种场面可不是每天都能见到的。 [a] [pc.ra human|同人类|[pc.race]] 在这附近。]] 是什么让您前来呢？ [party.som|[a] [pc.mascFem|英俊的 [pc.manWoman]|相当漂亮 [pc.boyGirl]] 像你自己一样|[var0|一对 [var1]|一个临时拼凑起来的小团队] 和你们一样|一群像你们这样的乌合之众] 为什么要来到这片森林里？ [QUEST_IN_HER_FOOTSTEPS.stateRange 0 1 3|你告诉她，你正在追捕一个恶魔，有人最后一次看到它时，它正朝这里的北方飞去，正好飞过了那片森林。|你告诉她，你在寻找那个被称为“阿尔劳娜母亲”的人，她似乎就是所有那些游荡的植物少女的源头。|你表示自己正在追捕一位企图腐蚀这片土地的强大女恶魔。] 哦，天哪，听起来真是个艰巨的任务啊。嗯，我叫薇薇安，是一名女巫和魔法师，而这个……”她指了指身后的房子，“就是我简陋的居所。您叫什么名字呢？[party.solo||s] 你叫什么名字？[party.solo|| 还有这个名字[party.manyCompanions|s] 你的同伴[party.manyCompanions|s]] 与……一起 [a] [pc.dcb|讥笑|鞠躬|轻声笑]嗯，恐怕在您的旅途中，我无法为您提供太多帮助。不过，自从暴风雪过后，由于那些黄蜂和那些植物女孩的事情，我已经有一段时间没有接待过客人了。我很乐意款待您，甚至可以让您在我这里住下…… 梦想是吧？”她眨着眼睛说道。

I told you my mother taught me everything I know, but she also learned from her mother, and so the pattern goes all the way back to before the Fall, and this house has been part of that family tradition of magic for about as far back as we go. rows.translation: 哦，我对这些知识也略知一二，不过我主要专精于少数几种魔法学派：附魔、转化和炼金术。所以，基本上任何与制造和维护魔法物品或药剂相关的内容，都是我的研究范围。这些分别意味着什么呢？ 薇薇安沉思片刻后开始解释：“嗯，‘赋予物品魔力’这个概念其实相当复杂，但简单来说，就是将某种灵魂的共鸣注入物品中，从而使这些物品拥有该生物在生前的某些特性。 一个典型的例子就是利用喷火的巨龙来制造出火焰剑，或者用这种火焰来强化盔甲或衣物，使其具备抗火能力。当然，还有无数其他类似的例子，但这个例子确实很具有代表性。 教科书级的典型例子，而且理由也很充分。” 那么，变形术呢？ “变形术主要用于塑造物体、移动它们，以及实现许多其他用途。我听说过这样的传说：在埃斯托洛，一些强大的法师曾经能够改变某种物质的根本属性，但那应该是‘堕落’之前的事了。就像那个时代的大部分知识一样，那些知识早已失传，或者只有少数人知晓，而我肯定从未遇到过这些人。 我主要用它来让日常生活更加方便。比如，可以从高架子上取书，进行一些基本的缝纫工作，甚至还能神奇地修复那些破损或磨损的物品。 [flags.IVRIS_ALCHEMY|你已经通过伊夫里斯了解了炼金术的相关知识，所以其实并没有必要再详细询问她关于炼金术的那些内容了。她是否还知道其他有趣的事情呢？|炼金术究竟是怎么运作的呢？不就是制作药剂吗？ “没错，”女巫点头说道，“其实就是这个原理。把一些材料放进金属锅里，搅拌均匀，再加入一些电金…… 砰！这样，你就得到了一瓶药水。显然，其中还隐藏着其他秘密，但…… [flags.VIVIANE_NEW_SUPPLIES|我目前并没有足够的资金或物资来向你们演示它的运作方式。也许镇上我听说过的那个盲人精灵能为大家做出更好的展示吧。|实际上，我手头并没有任何材料可以用来进行演示。]除了她的主要专业领域之外，她还了解其他什么有趣的事情吗？] 一些零碎的知识，”薇薇安说道，“比如我学会了一些治愈技巧，用来处理那些小伤口和擦伤。作为一名法师，我也掌握了一些基本的灵魂召唤术，因此，在需要的时候，我可以召唤一只灵魂狼来保护自己。 出于一些显而易见的原因，我知道那些常用的点火法术。也就这些了。” 那她的房子呢？肯定需要耗费大量的魔法才能让它动起来吧？ 薇薇安听到这个问题，轻笑了一声，然后摇了摇头。 恐怕我实在无法告诉你太多关于这座房子的事情。我之前说过，我所学的一切都是我母亲教给我的，但她也是从她的母亲那里学到了这些知识，所以这个传统可以追溯到远古时代。而这座房子，从我们这个家族开始传承魔法传统以来，就一直都是这一传统的重要组成部分。 无论其中蕴含了什么样的魔法，这种力量无疑是强大的。然而遗憾的是，人们已经忘记了如何自己制造这样的东西。 “那么，你还想讨论其他什么吗？
rows.raw: " "Oh, I know a bit of this and a bit of that, though I'm mostly specialized in a small handful of magic schools: enchanting, transmuting, and alchemy. So anything to do with creating and maintaining magic items or potions, really." What do each of those entail? Viviane strokes her chin for a moment before beginning, "Well, enchanting is a complicated topic, but as a concept, it's the act of putting the echo of a spirit into an item to imbue it with some of the properties the creature had in life. The classic example is that of using a flamewing drake to create a flaming sword or to proof armor or clothing against flame. There's a million other things, of course, but it's the literal textbook example, and for good reason." What about transmuting, then? "Transmutation is largely dedicated to shaping things, moving them, and any number of other utilities. I've heard tales that powerful mages in Estelore used to be able to change the very fundamental qualities of a material, but that would have been before the Fall, and like much of the knowledge from those days, has long since been lost or is known to only a few people who I certainly haven't met. I mostly use it to make my daily life easier. You know, things like grabbing a book from the top shelf or some basic sewing or even magically repairing broken or worn items." [flags.IVRIS_ALCHEMY|You already know about alchemy from Ivris, so you don't really feel the need to ask much about the alchemy part of her knowledge. Does she know anything else of interest?|How does alchemy work? It's potion making, right? "Yup," the witch nods, "That's the gist of it. You throw some ingredients in a metal pot, mix 'em up, throw some electrum in, and bam, you've got yourself a potion. There's obviously more to it than that, but [flags.VIVIANE_NEW_SUPPLIES|I don't quite have the finances or supplies to just show you how it works. Maybe that blind elf I've heard about in the town can give you a better showcase.|I don't actually have any of the materials on-hand to demonstrate.]" Does she know anything else of interest besides her main specializations?] "Bits and pieces," Viviane says. "I picked up some healing to patch myself up from minor cuts and scrapes, for example. As an enchanter, I also know some basic spirit summoning and, as such, can summon a spirit wolf to come to my defense, should the need arise. I know the standard fire starting spells, for obvious reasons. That's about it, though." What about her house? Surely animating it required a lot of magic. Viviane chuckles at that, then shakes her head. "I'm afraid I can't actually tell you much about the house. I told you my mother taught me everything I know, but she also learned from her mother, and so the pattern goes all the way back to before the Fall, and this house has been part of that family tradition of magic for about as far back as we go. Whatever magic was involved was certainly powerful, but alas, the know-how to create such a thing for oneself has been lost." "So, would you like to discuss anything else?""

rows.original: "Enchanting? Oh boy. It's a complicated topic, but I'll do what I can to explain it." With that, the witch stands up from her seat and waves you to follow suit, which you promptly do. "It's definitely better if I give a demonstration.[party.solo|| Though the room might get overcrowded if more than just [pc.name] come along, I'm afraid, so it'll have to be just [pc.himHer]]." She leads you into an adjacent room that you immediately recognize as the laboratory that she had you bound in during your dream encounter with her. She beckons you over to a table laden with books and strange trophies from even stranger beasts. As you're looking over the esoteric collection before you, Viviane picks up a book and a charred red scale off the table and tucks them under one arm. The witch walks over to a nearby shelf and, after some contemplation, grabs a dagger that has yellow-gold etchings along the length of the blade and a piece of chalk. "Alright," she says, "if you'll just watch me, I'll explain the steps as I do them." She walks to the center of the room, kneels down, and sets the items on the floor next to her. You follow shortly thereafter to better watch her process, standing several feet away opposite her. Viviane picks up the book and thumbs through it before finally opening it fully to the page she wanted and placing it on the ground next to her. From your position, you're able to make out the words "Flamewing Drake" on the page. "This book," she says, patting it gently, "contains various common summoning rituals for enchanting, including the exact format and runes for the magic circle. Since we'll be enchanting this lovely dagger with some flame, I have to be extra cautious. The last thing I need is the spirit of a flamewing drake running rampant through the house." Using the chalk she previously grabbed, Viviane begins to draw out the summoning circle. She progresses slowly, regularly checking her work against the diagrams of the book. Each rune is carefully marked and the witch takes extra care to avoid smearing or erasing any of the chalk she'd already placed as she moves around the circle. Somehow, even as she practically crawls to make the markings, her hat remains perfectly situated atop her head, never even so much as shifting in her way. When she's finally finished with her work, she sits back up with a sigh. "Well, there it is. A standard summoning and binding circle," she says, gesturing towards it nonchalantly. "The circle itself can't do any magic, but it serves as both a conduit for my own magic and helps contain the magic of the summoned creature within. The magic gets concentrated in the center, which is where we'll be putting all our other components." "With that complete, now we get the item we'll be enchanting." Viviane picks up the dagger and turns it so that the runes engraved in the blade face you. "These runes are made from electrum and were forged into the item during its creation. They'll hold the spirit in the dagger and allow the effect to take hold. While the runes don't have to be part of the enchanted item's original creation and can instead be added later, the effect tends to be stronger if it is. Electrum is commonly used for many of the same reasons it's used in alchemy, including how symbolic it is of mixing. There are other things you can use, of course, but electrum is readily available and fairly effective at the job." The enchantress places the runed dagger in the center of the circle. She then proceeds to grab the scale from before. "And here, we have the key to summoning the spirit echo of creature: a piece of its body. We need a link to the creature's former self in order to draw forth its power, thus, we use parts of its body. As you'll see soon, the used part is expended in the process. It's also worth noting that you can only ever call on the echo once. If you have multiple parts of the same creature and try to reuse the same spirit, all the attempts after the initial will fail." Viviane puts the scarlet scale on top of the dagger and grabs the book off the ground once more, being careful to keep it open to the same page. She then stands up and extends her free hand over the circle. "Now, to begin the incantation." As the witch begins to mutter strange words of power[pc.cl blackmage|—some of which you recognize from your studies—|[pc.bg arcanist|—some of which you recognize from your studies—|, ]]a blue, almost spectral light begins to shine forth from the hand she's holding over the runic circle. The chalk begins to pulse with the same light and you can feel the magical energies filling the room. Suddenly, a flash of orange light nearly blinds you as the center of the circle bursts into a roaring blaze, the flames nearly reaching Viviane's outstretched hand. She takes this in stride, continuing her mystical muttering without so much as missing a beat. Then, as quickly as the flames came, they seem to be sucked into the dagger, the blade of which ignites with the very flames that once filled the entire area. Moments pass as the enchantress finishes her incantation. When she's finally spoken the last words, the blue light that once lit the circle fades, the chalk on the ground seems to dull, and where there was once a crimson scale there is now only a small pile of ash. The dagger's orange flame has also diminished, now only visible in the runes, which are the natural color of electrum no longer. Instead, they flicker as if a flame were trapped inside; oranges and yellows dance along them and give the blade a fiery incandescence. The tense silence that you didn't realize had filled the room is only broken when Viviane begins to walk to the same shelf she got the chalk from previously. She searches around for a short while before pulling a sheath off the shelf. She inspects it momentarily before walking back over to the circle and bending over, grabbing the dagger from its resting place on the somehow-unscorched wooden floor. She stands back up and extends the enchanted weapon to you. "Take it. I hardly need it. Besides, it might help you on your quest to save the world or what have you." As soon as you accept her gift, the witch leads you back to the seating room, wherein you both return to your previous chairs. "Well, any other nagging questions for me, [pc.name]?"
rows.translation: 令人着迷？哦，天哪。这确实是一个复杂的话题，但我会尽力解释清楚的。”说完，女巫从座位上站了起来，示意你也跟着她走，你立刻照做了。“其实，如果我能做一个示范的话，会更容易让人理解。[party.solo|| 虽然如果来的人超过一定数量的话，这个房间可能会变得过于拥挤…… [pc.name] 恐怕不行，所以只能这样了。 [pc.himHer]]她带你走进隔壁的一个房间，你立刻认出这就是你在梦中与她相遇时，她把你绑在那里的实验室。她示意你走到一张摆满书籍以及一些来自奇异野兽的奇怪战利品的桌子旁。当你仔细观察这些稀有的收藏品时，薇薇安从桌上拿起一本书和一块烧焦的红色鳞片，然后将它们夹在手臂下。 女巫走到附近的架子前，沉思片刻后，拿起了一把刀刃上刻有黄金色花纹的匕首，同时还拿了一块粉笔。“好吧，”她说，“你们只要看着我，我一边做一边解释步骤就行了。她走到房间的中央，跪了下来，将那些物品放在身旁的地上。你随后也走了过去，站在几英尺外的地方，以便更好地观察她的动作。薇薇安拿起了那本书，快速翻了几页，最终找到了她想要的那一页，然后把它放在身旁的地上。 从你的位置来看，你可以看到页面上写着“火焰巨龙”这几个字。 这本书，”她轻抚着书页说道，“里面收录了各种常用的召唤仪式，包括绘制魔法阵所需的精确格式和符文。既然我们要用火焰元素来为这把漂亮的匕首施加魔法，我就必须格外小心。我最不希望看到的，就是有一只燃烧火焰的巨龙在房子里肆意横冲。 维薇安拿起之前拿到的粉笔，开始绘制召唤圈。她动作缓慢，不时将自己的绘制过程与书中的图示进行对照。每一个符文都被她仔细地标记出来，这位女巫在绘制圈子的过程中也格外小心，生怕弄脏或擦掉已经画好的部分。 不知怎么的，即使她几乎是爬着去绘制那些标记的，她的帽子依然稳稳地戴在头上，丝毫没有因为她的动作而移动。当她终于完成工作后，她叹了口气，重新坐了起来。 好了，就是这个。一个标准的召唤与束缚法阵，”她漫不经心地指着它说道，“这个法阵本身并不能释放任何魔法，但它既可以作为我自身魔力的传导通道，也能帮助将被召唤生物的魔力限制在法阵范围内。 魔法能量会集中在中心位置，而我们也会将其他所有组件放置在那里。 这样就可以了，现在我们得到了要用来进行附魔的物品了。”薇薇安拿起那把匕首，将其转动过来，让刀刃上刻着的符文朝向你。“这些符文是由电银制成的，在制作这件物品的过程中就被铭刻在了上面。它们能够将匕首中的灵力束缚住，从而使附魔效果得以显现。当然，这些符文本身…… 拥有 如果某种成分是从魔法物品最初创造时就被加入其中的，而不是后来才添加的，那么这种成分所带来的效果往往会更加强烈。电银之所以常被使用，原因与它在炼金术中的用途相同——因为它象征着“混合”的过程。 当然，还有其他方法可以使用，但电铬币这种材料很容易获取，而且在使用效果上也相当不错。 女巫将刻有符文的匕首放在圆圈的正中央，然后拿起了之前准备好的天平。 而在这里，我们找到了召唤生物灵魂回响的关键：它的身体的一部分。我们需要与这个生物曾经的形态建立联系，才能释放它的力量，因此我们使用了它的身体组织。正如你们很快会看到的，这些被使用的组织在过程中会被消耗掉。 同样需要注意的是，你只能使用回声一次。如果你拥有一种生物的多个部分，并试图重复使用同样的灵魂，那么在初次使用之后的所有尝试都会失败。 薇薇安将那片猩红色的鳞片放在匕首上，然后再次从地上捡起那本书，小心翼翼地让它保持在同一页上。 她随后站起身来，将空闲的手伸向那个圆圈。“现在，开始念咒语吧。”当这位女巫开始低声念出那些充满力量的奇怪词语时……[pc.cl blackmage|其中一些内容你肯定在学习过程中接触过。|[pc.bg arcanist|其中一些内容你肯定在学习过程中接触过。|, ]]她将手放在那个符文圈上，一道蓝色的、近乎幽灵般的轻型芒开始从中散发出来。粉笔也随着这轻型芒开始闪烁，你能感受到魔法能量正在充满整个房间。 突然，一道橙色的轻型芒闪现，几乎让你睁不开眼睛——符文圈的中心瞬间燃起了熊熊烈火，火焰几乎蔓延到了薇薇安伸出的手边。 她泰然处之，继续着她那神秘的喃喃自语，丝毫没有受到影响。随后，就像那些火焰出现得那样迅速，它们似乎也被吸进了那把匕首之中，而匕首的刀刃则被那些曾经充斥整个空间的火焰点燃了。 随着女巫完成她的咒语，时间悄然流逝。当她终于说出了最后那些话语时，曾经照亮那个圈圈的蓝轻型渐渐消失了，地面上的粉笔也似乎失去了轻型泽，而原本那里那些猩红色的鳞片，如今只剩下一小堆灰烬。 这把匕首上的橙色火焰也减弱了，现在只有那些符文处还能看到那颜色——因为那些符文原本就是电银的自然色泽。相反，那些符文仿佛蕴含着火焰一般在闪烁，橙色与黄色的轻型芒在符文上跳动，使得刀刃整体呈现出一种炽热的辉轻型。 那种你未曾察觉的紧张沉默，直到薇薇安开始走向之前取过粉笔的那个书架时，才被打破。她四处搜寻了一会儿，最终从书架上取下一个粉笔盒。 她短暂地检查了一下，然后走回到圆圈旁，弯下腰从那块似乎没有受到任何烧损的木地上拿起了那把匕首。她站起身来，将这件被施了魔法的武器递给了你。 收下吧。我几乎不需要它。而且，它或许能帮助你完成拯救世界的使命之类的。 一旦你接受了她的礼物，女巫就会带你回到休息室，你们俩都会回到之前的座位上。 “那么，还有其他想问我的问题吗？ [pc.name]?"

A midnight black corset and matching skirt, a pair of dark leather bracers, and a set of sable thigh-high boots are all whisked up in mere moments, as the witch's memorization and organization skills lead her unerringly to her targets. With the outfit tucked under her arm, Viviane returns to you and Cait at the room's entrance. She hands the clothing off to the priestess, who takes it in a confused scramble. "Alright, why don't you get changed and I'll see if I can't find the finishing touches," Viv says. She steps past the two of you to open an unfamiliar door directly across the hall, revealing what seems to be a guest bedroom of sorts. "As much as I'm sure [pc.name] and I wouldn't mind seeing you strip, there's something so special about getting the full reveal of an outfit instead of watching someone put it on piece by piece." A befuddled Cait is promptly prodded into the makeshift dressing room by the overenthusiastic witch. The catgirl turns around to reply—finally having gathered her wits enough to do so—only for the door to be slammed in her face. Viviane turns around and marches back into the room-turned-wardrobe, punctuating her reentry with that same delighted clap as before. She leans forward, her eyes narrowing but retaining their excited glint as she scans the room, and says, "Now for the most important part: accessories." "Well," she muses as she bounces through the room, "obviously she'll need a hat. What kind of witch goes without a hat, after all. Hmmmm..." The witch appraises a frankly absurd range of the headpieces, skimming over most but pausing every few for closer inspection—lifting them up to check the weight, gauging the fit, and so forth—before finally settling on one almost identical to her own. You do, however, notice one key difference: a pair of ear holes cut out of the crown and brim, perfectly shaped to accommodate a catfolk. "Perfect! I knew I still had at least one of these from my stint with cat ears." A quick glance at your confused face prompts the addition of, "What? They're cute, and I felt like trying something new at the time." With the hat now in hand, the redhead moves over to a display case whose contents are hidden from your sight but you're able to infer from her unabating muttering of variants of just the words, "a staff." After a few seconds of running a finger back and forth across the glass trying to decide, Viviane gives an "aha!" and opens the case, pulling out a gnarled wooden staff. Running along its length are the distinct golden lines of inlaid electrum, each extending forth from a brilliant pink gemstone that sits upon the top of the staff. On occasion, it pulses with a slight light that flows down through all of the metal until dissipating at the end. The witch plops the hat onto the staff's tip, covering the gemstone and freeing a hand... which immediately goes to her chin and she contemplates further accessorization. "What else, what else, what else?" she quanders as she glances around the room. Her eyes go wide as they settle on a row of belts, and she literally jumps with excitement as she's hit with whatever her latest epiphany is. Viviane dashes over and pulls one off of the rack and then heads to the door. "One second, I've had an idea." Within seconds she's out of sight, and all you can hear is a frantic scrambling from a few rooms over as the witch searches for the latest addition to the outfit. Cait peeks her head out into the hallway after her, only to quickly disappear once more into the room to finish changing. Moments later, Viviane returns, grinning like an idiot. "Found it," she says, holding up a tome titled Barriers for Beginners, and Other Supportive Spells and, from the looks of it, a holster for the book. "With the new outfit, she'll probably want to add a few new spells to her repertoire, and I have this book memorized. Might as well pass it on so it gets some use. And she'll need some way to carry it with her."

那位女巫双臂一摊，说道：“欢迎来到我的衣橱。现在，如果我没记错的话，我应该…… 正是如此 我们在这里要找的就是这些……” 薇薇安几乎是在房间里“跳舞”一般移动着，她只是匆匆扫了一眼衣架上的衣物，就立刻抓起了自己需要的衣服。一条深黑色的紧身胸衣和配套的裙子、一双黑色皮制护腕，以及一双长及大腿的貂皮靴子，都在短短几分钟内被她拿在了手部里——这位女巫出色的记忆力和组织能力，让她能够准确无误地找到自己需要的东西。 薇薇安把那套衣服夹在胳膊下，回到了房间入口处，找到了你和凯特。她把衣服递给了女祭司，而女祭司则手部忙脚乱地接过了它。 “好吧，你去换上吧，我再去看看还能不能再找些东西来完善一下。”薇薇安说道。 她从你们两人身边走过，打开了走廊对面那扇陌生的门，里面似乎是一间客房。“虽然我很确定…… [pc.name] 薇薇安转过身，大步走回那个被改造成衣橱的房间，重新进入房间时，她还是像之前一样高兴地拍手部庆祝。她向前倾了倾身子，眼睛眯了起来，但依然闪烁着兴奋的轻型芒，她环顾了一下房间，然后说道：“现在来到最重要的环节：配饰。 偶尔，它会发出微弱的轻型芒，这种轻型芒会穿过所有的金属部件，最终在末端消失殆尽。 女巫将那顶帽子轻轻戴在法杖的顶端，盖住了宝石，这样她就有了一只空闲的手部……她立刻将这只手部放在下巴上，开始思考还能再搭配些什么饰品。“还要什么呢？还要什么……”她一边在房间里四处张望，一边自问。当她的目轻型落在那一排腰带上时，她的眼睛顿时亮了起来，兴奋得几乎跳了起来——因为她突然想到了新的点子。薇薇安立刻跑过去，从架子上拿了一条腰带，然后朝门口走去。“等一下，我突然有了个主意。 几秒钟后，她就消失在了视线之外，此时你只能听到几间房间里传来的慌乱声——原来那位女巫正在寻找她新买的衣服。凯特跟在后面，把头探出走廊，但很快又迅速回到房间里继续换衣服。片刻之后，薇薇安回来了，脸上带着傻乎乎的笑容。 找到了，”她说着，举着一本名为……的巨著。 适合初学者的障碍消除法，以及其他辅助性法术 看样子，这里还有一个用来放置这本书的枪套。“有了这套新装备，她可能会想要在她的法术库中添加一些新的法术，而我把这本书都背得滚瓜烂熟了。把这本书传给她吧，这样它就能派上用场了。而且她肯定也需要某种方式来…… 携带 和她一起做这件事。

A quick rap on the door, however, is still enough to rouse her attention and summon her to the door. If it isn't my favorite [party.som|[pc.title]|duo of adventurers|band of heroes]. Do you have what I need for [silly|the Green Meanie|[arona.isDom|the|your] orc there]'s equipment?

        "Yeah," [arona.isDom|[silly|the Green Meanie|Arona] says. She|you say. Arona] then hefts the dire wolf corpse in front of her to show it off.

        "Perfect. Well, bring it in and I'll get to work on your gear."

As the [party.som||two|three] of you walk up to Viviane's weathered door, she steps in front of you[party.som||| and [comp2.name]]. She reaches forward and presses her hand against the thick wood and whispers some eldritch incantation under her breath. The entrance pulses with blue light for but a moment before fading away, leaving behind only the mundane entryway. 

        She reaches to the door's handle and pushes the portal open. "Shall we?" the witch says with a sweeping invitation as she holds the door for you[party.som||| and [comp2.name]]. "Since we have everything I need for [silly|Big, Green, and Mean here|Arona]'s equipment–"
        
        "Damn right you do," the Orc interjects with a tusky grin.
        
        Viviane lets a sigh, then resumes, "I might as well get to work."

            |当她正在书架里寻找某本书时，说道：“斯……斯……啊，找到了。我就知道我肯定把斯宾格勒、斯坦兹和文克曼的指南放在了这里的某个地方。 
            |在开始酿造之前 [party.yall] 她上班时可以边喝茶边工作。
        ]
        
        这可能需要一些时间。为了准备这个，我花费的时间其实比我愿意承认的要多，但我还需要对这件武器进行最后的完善，而且对于那些剩余的部分，我也有一些想法。所以，在我工作的时候，你们可以随意休息或活动。
rows.raw:
'
        Viviane has your companion set the wolf corpse in her work room [silly
            |while she searches her shelves for a particular book. "S... s... Ah, there it is. I knew I had the Spengler, Stanz, and Venkman guide around here somewhere. 
            |before brewing [party.yall] tea to sip on as she gets to work.
        ]
        
        "This could be a while. I've spent more time than I care to admit preparing for this, but I still need to put the finishing touches on the weapon and I have some... ideas for the leftover parts. So feel free to make yourselves at home while I work."
        '

rows.original: Hours pass in Viv's house while she toils away at crafting Arona's equipment. Occasionally, flashes of light or loud exclamations burst forth from behind the closed door, but for the most part it's a slow, quiet time. Your orc [silly |[arona.fucked |waifu |companion ]|companion ] even manages to nap on one of the chairs for a short while—her snoring providing at least some variety to the house's ambiance. Finally, she exits the room carrying with her two gifts. First, she extends a gorgeous greataxe, electrum inlays glowing in its bronze head. "This," Viviane says, "is Nightfang. Every good magic weapon deserves a name. Take it." Arona takes it gingerly, running her hand first along the haft then tracing the runes with a green finger. "Thank you," is all she can manage to say over her shock. "And this," the witch says as she extends the second: a cloak made from the pelt of the fallen wolf, its head functioning as a headdress, "is your new cloak. It's enchanted to help defend you against spectral foes. So, you know, now you can hit them and they have a harder time actually damaging you." The cloak is immediately put on by a grinning Arona. "Yeah, this is perfect. Thanks, babe. How about I show you some Kervus gratitude and-" "Like I said, I don't accept disappointment as payment. Now, is there anything else you [party.som | |two |three ] need?" Set Acquired: Spirit Totem!
rows.translation: 在薇芙的家中，时间一分一秒地流逝，而她则埋头致力于为阿罗娜制作各种装备。偶尔，闭着的门后会传来一阵闪轻型或是响亮的惊呼声，但大多数时间里，这里都是一片宁静而缓慢的氛围。你的兽人…… [silly |[arona.fucked |老婆/女友 |伴侣 ]|同伴 ] 她甚至还在其中一把椅子上小睡了一会儿——她的呼噜声至少为屋内的气氛增添了一些变化。 最后，她拿着两份礼物走出了房间。首先，她拿出一把华丽的巨斧，青铜斧头上的电银镶嵌物在灯轻型下闪闪发轻型。 “这个，”薇薇安说道，“就是…… 夜牙每一把出色的魔法武器都值得拥有一个名字。收下它吧。” 阿罗娜小心翼翼地接过了武器，先用手抚过剑柄，然后用绿色的手指沿着上面的符文轻轻描摹。“谢谢，”她只能在这种震惊之中挤出这句话来。 而这个，”女巫说着，递出了第二件物品：一件用那只倒下的狼的皮毛制成的斗篷，它的头部还被制成了一顶头饰，“就是你的新斗篷。这件斗篷被施了魔法，能够帮助你抵御那些幽灵般的敌人。所以，现在你可以攻击它们了，而它们要伤害到你也会变得更加困难。笑容满面的阿罗娜立刻穿上了这件斗篷。“没错，就是这件。 完美谢谢，宝贝。要不我向你表达一些我的感激之情吧……” “就像我之前说的，我不会用失望来作为回报。那么，现在还有其他事情吗？ [party.som | |两个 |三 ] 需要吗？ 已获得物品：灵魂图腾!
